title: What Can Energy Become? Energy-to-Data and Energy-to-Material Pathways for Resource-rich Economies
affiliations: , University of Science and Technology of Oran Mohamed Boudiaf (USTO-MB), University of Science and Technology of Oran Mohamed Boudiaf (USTO-MB) and University of Sciences and Technology Houari Boumediene

detail.title: What Can Energy Become? Energy-to-Data and Energy-to-Material Pathways for Resource-rich Economies

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this article.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No human participants, animals, clinical materials or confidential personal data were involved in this scoping review and framework synthesis.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Resource-rich economies are commonly assessed through what they possess: fuels, renewable resources, mineral deposits, land, ports or export corridors. This article starts from a prior policy and business question: what can energy become? It defines Energy-to-Value as the conversion of energy resources, electricity, heat, fuels and energy-related infrastructure into identifiable forms of economic, social, environmental, strategic and institutional value. The review distinguishes two primary frontiers. Energy-to-Data converts electricity and supporting infrastructure into non-material value, including computation, artificial-intelligence inference, data storage, cloud services and digital capability. Energy-to-Material converts energy, water, air, carbon, minerals and feedstocks into material value, including ammonia, fertilisers, desalinated and reused water, methanol, synthetic fuels, critical minerals, metals and industrial products. Using a transparent scoping-review protocol and framework synthesis, the article draws on international institutional sources, official policy materials, major project-facing reports and targeted academic literature while avoiding claims of exhaustive PRISMA coverage. It argues that fossil-based, renewable-based and hybrid routes are energy-source pathways rather than competing definitions of value. For resource-rich economies, Energy-to-Value may support value retention, lower avoidable system losses, diversification and more credible transition strategies, but only under conditions of infrastructure readiness, firm or firmed electricity, water planning and allocation, offtake, institutional coordination, skills, environmental safeguards and bankability. The article gives particular attention to failure modes, including electricity-intensive enclaves, water-burden transfer, fossil lock-in, limited domestic capability formation and quality-blind FDI. Algeria-related examples are used only as bounded, nonranking illustrations, not as country reviews or readiness judgements. The article contributes a decision category through which policymakers, public-finance institutions, infrastructure investors and business leaders can identify what counts as Energy-to-Value before deciding which pathways are feasible, credible or investable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"能源到价值"（Energy-to-Value）这一决策分析框架，将能源资源转化为可识别的经济、社会、环境、战略和制度价值，并区分了能源到数据（非物质价值）与能源到材料（物质价值）两大前沿方向。
AI.research_question: 资源丰富经济体如何将能源资源转化为可识别的多重价值形态？能源到价值的转化框架是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统上，资源丰富经济体仅基于所拥有的资源（燃料、矿产、土地、港口等）被评估，而忽略了"能源可以成为什么"这一更前置的政策与商业问题，需要一个新的决策类别来指导价值识别。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源到价值（Energy-to-Value）框架，区分能源到数据（Energy-to-Data）与能源到材料（Energy-to-Material）两条价值转化前沿，以及化石基、可再生基和混合路径三种能源来源路径。
AI.method: 采用透明的范围审查协议（scoping-review protocol）和框架综合（framework synthesis）方法，综合国际机构来源、官方政策材料、重大项目报告及针对性学术文献。
AI.findings: 能源到价值可支持资源丰富经济体的价值保留、降低可避免的系统损失、多元化发展和更可信的转型战略；但取决于基础设施就绪度、电力供应、水资源规划、承购安排、制度协调、技能、环境保障和可融资性等条件。同时存在电力密集型飞地、水资源负担转移、化石锁定、国内能力形成有限和忽视质量的外国直接投资等失败模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"能源到价值"作为新的决策分析类别，超越了仅以资源禀赋评估经济体的传统视角，并为政策制定者、公共金融机构、基础设施投资者和商业领导者提供识别价值转化机会的概念框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为资源丰富经济体的政策制定者、公共金融机构、基础设施投资者和企业领导者提供实用决策框架，帮助其在判定可行、可信或可投资的路径之前，先识别什么构成能源到价值。阿尔及利亚案例仅作为有界、非排名的说明性示例。

title: The Role of the SCM Marketplace Application in Supporting Material Procurement and Management in the Trade and Customer Management Sector of PT PLN (Persero) UID West Java
affiliations: Telkom University and

detail.title: The Role of the SCM Marketplace Application in Supporting Material Procurement and Management in the Trade and Customer Management Sector of PT PLN (Persero) UID West Java
detail.abstract: Advances in information technology have encouraged companies to implement digital systems to support the effectiveness of business processes, including procurement and material management. PT PLN (Persero) West Java Distribution Unit utilizes this application.Supply Chain Management (SCM) Marketplace is a system used to manage the material procurement process in an integrated manner. This application supports various activities, such as procurement monitoring, material requirements monitoring, contract management, and data integration with SAP systems. This article aims to explain the role of the SCM Marketplace application in supporting material procurement and management in the Commerce and Customer Management Division of PT PLN (Persero) West Java Distribution Unit. The preparation of the article was carried out through observation, documentation, and literature studies related to the business processes and information systems used. Based on the results of observations, the use of SCM Marketplace helps the material procurement process become more structured, facilitates monitoring of material availability in each unit, and accelerates access to the required information. In addition, integration with the SAP system also supports data accuracy and increases efficiency in material management. With the SCM Marketplace, the material procurement and management process can run more effectively so as to support smooth operations in the Commerce and Customer Management Division of PT PLN (Persero) West Java Distribution Unit.

AI.tldr: 本文通过观察、文献和文档研究，分析了PT PLN西爪哇配电单位商业与客户管理部门中SCM Marketplace应用在物料采购与管理中的作用。研究发现，该应用使采购流程更结构化、便于监控物料可用性、加速信息访问，并通过与SAP系统集成提升数据准确性和管理效率。
AI.research_question: SCM Marketplace应用如何在PT PLN（Persero）西爪哇配电单位的商业与客户管理分部中支持物料采购与管理？
AI.motivation: 信息技术进步推动企业实施数字化系统以支持业务流程效率，包括采购和物料管理。PT PLN利用SCM Marketplace应用，本文旨在阐明其在支持物料采购和管理方面的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链管理（SCM）理论；数字信息系统在业务流程支持中的应用框架
AI.method: 定性研究方法，包括观察（observation）、文档分析（documentation）和文献研究（literature study），结合对业务流程和信息系统的分析。
AI.findings: SCM Marketplace使物料采购流程更结构化，便于监控各单位的物料可用性，加速信息获取；与SAP系统的集成提高了数据准确性和物料管理效率，从而支持部门运营的顺畅进行。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文丰富了供应链管理数字化应用在电力行业国有企业（尤其是印尼PLN）情境下的实证案例研究，为SCM系统与ERP系统集成效果的文献提供了实践证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业（尤其是电力公用事业公司）实施SCM数字平台提供实践参考，展示如何通过供应链管理应用与SAP集成来优化物料采购流程、提升监控能力和运营效率。

title: A GenAI-assisted Privacy Gateway for Secure Third-party Data Processing

detail.title: A GenAI-assisted Privacy Gateway for Secure Third-party Data Processing

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is currently employed by Wipro Limited, however, this work was undertaken independently in the author’s personal capacity and does not represent the views of Wipro Limited, its clients, or any affiliated organization. The author declares no personal or financial conflicts of interest that could have influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This work did not involve human participants, patient data, clinical procedures, or experiments requiring institutional ethics approval. The evaluation was conducted using prototype-based system testing and non-human sample data, therefore, formal ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This work received no external funding. The research, prototype development, and manuscript preparation were carried out independently by the author.

detail.abstract:
Today, there is a diverse range of services available outside enterprise boundaries that can augment enterprise capabilities to fulfill business needs. These include infrastructure offerings (e.g., cloud platforms), domain-specific services (e.g., fraud detection), and specialized business workflows provided by third-party vendors (e.g., finance or recruitment services). However, using these services often requires sharing internal data with external processors, which raises significant privacy, compliance, and data-governance concerns. 

Organizations frequently handle sensitive data, including personally identifiable information (PII) and other confidential enterprise attributes, which cannot be freely transmitted to external systems due to regulatory frameworks, contractual obligations, and internal governance policies. Conventional anonymization techniques are primarily applied in one-way data publishing and do not adequately address controlled re-identification following external computation. In addition, rule-based PII detection methods often fail to identify contextual or implicit identifiers, particularly within unstructured text. 

This paper proposes a GenAI-assisted Privacy Gateway that enables secure, policy-driven data exchange between enterprises and external processing services. The architecture introduces a reversible transformation workflow in which sensitive values in outbound data are replaced with deterministic placeholders prior to external transmission, while inbound results can be selectively rehydrated using securely stored identifier mappings. This approach allows organizations to leverage external processing capabilities while ensuring that external systems operate only on transformed representations of sensitive data. 

The gateway combines rule-based detection with GenAI-assisted contextual analysis to identify sensitive information across heterogeneous enterprise datasets. Anonymization, mapping management, and rehydration remain deterministic and policy-driven. A dual-pipeline architecture supports both structured datasets and unstructured data flows, enabling consistent anonymization while preserving structural relationships required for meaningful external computation. 

The reference implementation was evaluated using synthetic structured and unstructured datasets containing 1,000, 5,000, and 20,000 records. For the evaluated workloads, the system achieved 100% placeholder restoration fidelity with zero unresolved placeholders, while LLM-assisted contextual detection accounted for the majority of anonymization processing time. These results demonstrate the feasibility of meaningful external computation on transformed data while maintaining deterministic round-trip restoration and architectural safeguards against direct exposure of sensitive information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种GenAI辅助的隐私网关架构，通过可逆转换工作流（将敏感数据替换为确定性占位符，并在接收结果时按需恢复），实现企业与外部处理服务之间的安全、策略驱动的数据交换，同时支持结构化与非结构化数据的统一匿名化处理。
AI.research_question: 如何在不暴露敏感数据的前提下，使企业能够安全地利用外部处理服务（如云平台、第三方业务工作流）完成数据计算与分析任务？
AI.motivation: 企业使用外部服务时常需共享内部数据，但敏感信息（如PII）受法规、合同和治理政策约束不能直接传输。现有匿名化技术主要适用于单向数据发布，无法支持受控的再识别；基于规则的PII检测方法也常无法识别非结构化文本中的上下文或隐式标识符。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可逆转换架构（确定性占位符替换与安全映射恢复）、GenAI辅助的上下文感知敏感信息检测、规则与AI混合检测框架、双流水线架构设计。
AI.method: 构建GenAI辅助隐私网关参考实现，结合规则检测与LLM辅助上下文分析识别敏感信息，通过确定性映射管理实现匿名化、映射管理和再水化的闭环，采用双流水线架构同时支撑结构化数据集与非结构化数据流，并在合成数据集（1000/5000/20000条记录）上进行评估。
AI.findings: 系统在评估负载下实现了100%的占位符恢复保真度，零未解析占位符；LLM辅助的上下文检测占用了大部分匿名化处理时间；证明了在转换数据上进行有意义的外部计算是可行的，同时保持确定性的往返恢复和防止敏感信息直接暴露的架构保障。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了可逆转换+确定性占位符映射的新框架，弥补了传统单向匿名化技术在受控再识别需求上的不足；将GenAI上下文检测引入隐私网关架构，拓展了敏感信息识别的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了一套可落地的隐私网关参考实现，支持在合规前提下利用外部云平台和第三方服务；在保证数据隐私的同时维护外部计算所需的结构关系，具有实际部署价值。

title:
The user side of AI Model Lifecycles: 
Evidence from the Keep4o Movement

detail.title:
The user side of AI Model Lifecycles: 
Evidence from the Keep4o Movement

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
AI model lifecycles are commonly understood as a series of technical and organizational processes. Yet once a model enters sustained use, subsequent changes can also affect established user practices and user value. Using the Keep4o movement around GPT-4o as a case, this study examines post-deployment AI model lifecycle issues from the user side. We collected 61,846 public original posts on X from August 2025 to March 2026 and, using a systematically developed coding framework and LLM-assisted content analysis, analyzed discussion themes, users’ reasons for wanting to keep GPT-4o, and the specific claims they made.

Findings show that the Keep4o discussion extended well beyond continued access to the model itself. It covered concrete experiences of use, model behavioral characteristics and how they changed, and management issues across different stages of the model lifecycle. Reasons for keeping GPT-4o reflected interactional and relational value formed through long-term use, as well as judgments about the adequacy of replacement and the reasonableness of related decisions. The corresponding claims further reflected users’ specific expectations for model lifecycle arrangements and governance. Overall, the call to “keep GPT-4o” brought together different judgments about user value and governance concerns.

These findings suggest that technical version succession does not necessarily amount to effective replacement on the user side. Post-deployment AI model lifecycle management therefore needs to consider whether established user value can be carried forward and how model changes affect actual use. This study thus provides user-side empirical evidence for AI model lifecycle management. It further shows that user experience can provide important information for identifying post-deployment impacts and should be incorporated into lifecycle evaluation and decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本研究以围绕GPT-4o的"Keep4o"用户运动为案例，通过分析X平台上61,846条原始帖子，探讨AI模型部署后从用户端出发的生命周期管理问题。研究发现用户的"保留"呼声不仅关乎模型访问权，更反映了通过长期使用形成的互动性与关系性价值、对替代方案充分性的判断，以及对模型生命周期治理的具体期望。研究指出技术版本迭代不等于用户端的有效替代，模型生命周期管理需要考虑既有用户价值的延续性，并将用户体验纳入生命周期评估与决策。
AI.research_question: AI模型部署后，用户端的生命周期问题是什么？用户为何希望保留GPT-4o？用户的诉求反映了哪些对模型生命周期安排的期望和治理关切？
AI.motivation: AI模型生命周期通常被理解为一系列技术性和组织性过程，但模型进入持续使用后，后续变更会影响已建立的用户实践和用户价值。现有研究缺乏从用户端审视模型部署后生命周期问题的实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI模型生命周期管理理论；用户价值理论（互动性和关系性价值）；技术替代/版本迭代的有效性理论
AI.method: 以Keep4o运动为案例，收集2025年8月至2026年3月X平台上61,846条公开原创帖子，采用系统开发的编码框架和LLM辅助的内容分析，分析讨论主题、用户保留GPT-4o的原因及其具体主张。
AI.findings: 1）Keep4o讨论超出对模型本身持续访问的诉求，涵盖具体使用体验、模型行为特征及其变化，以及模型生命周期各阶段的管理问题；2）保留GPT-4o的原因反映了长期使用中形成的互动性和关系性价值，以及对替代方案充分性和相关决策合理性的判断；3）用户的诉求体现了对模型生命周期安排和治理的具体期望；4）"保留GPT-4o"的呼声汇聚了不同的用户价值判断与治理关切。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了技术版本更替并不等于用户端的有效替代，为AI模型生命周期管理提供了用户端的实证证据，拓展了对模型生命周期问题的理解维度（从技术/组织过程延伸到用户价值与治理）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI模型生命周期管理实践提供用户侧经验证据，指出用户体验蕴含识别部署后影响的重要信息，应将其纳入生命周期评估和决策过程。

title: Commercial Residual Control and Prudential Authority: Bank versus Platform Governance of Stablecoin Issuers
affiliations: Hanyang University

detail.title: Commercial Residual Control and Prudential Authority: Bank versus Platform Governance of Stablecoin Issuers

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This theoretical study involved no human participants, animals, or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: A payment stablecoin is a digital token that promises a fixed value in a national currency. Its issuer must both keep that promise and make the token useful. Banks can safeguard reserves and redeem tokens; commerce platforms can build wallets, recruit merchants, and create payment services. Yet two important tasks—platform innovation and bank readiness for cyber incidents or financial stress—are hard to measure in advance. This paper uses a stylized formal model and a reproducible numerical illustration to ask who should control a company that issues one currency-backed stablecoin. Platform control encourages investment when the value the platform creates is neither fully portable nor fully captured under bank control. Bank control encourages safety effort unless contracts and economic exposure fully align the bank under platform control. Platform control is socially better only when its innovation benefit, after accounting for other governance costs that may favor either arrangement, outweighs greater-use risk, unsafe decisions, lost bank safety effort, and veto costs. Defined rights to stop unsafe decisions can help, but wider powers also add delay and invite misuse. Portability reduces dependence but need not favor platform control. When the threshold favors platform control, the proposed arrangement lets the platform direct commerce while banks provide contracted safety services; ring-fenced reserves and defined powers protect issuance, redemption, and recovery. South Korea's unresolved bank-consortium debate and rules abroad motivate the design; they do not test the model or establish an enacted ownership rule.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个形式化模型和可复现的数值示例，研究应谁控制发行单一货币挂钩稳定币的公司（平台抑或银行）。平台控制能促进投资创新，银行控制能促进安全投入。平台控制仅在创新收益超过更大使用风险、不安全决策、银行安全投入损失和否决成本时，才具有社会更优性。定义明确的安全否决权有助益，但过宽权力会带来拖延与滥用。本文还以南韩银行财团争论和海外规则作为设计动机。
AI.research_question: 谁应控制一家发行货币挂钩稳定币的公司——平台还是银行？
AI.motivation: 支付稳定币发行者必须同时兑现固定价值承诺并使代币有用。银行能保障储备和赎回，平台能构建钱包、招募商户和创建支付服务。但平台创新和银行对网络事件或金融压力的准备这两项重要任务难以事先衡量，因此需要探讨合适的控制权安排。
AI.theoretical_framework: 形式化（stylized）正式模型，结合可复现的数值示例，分析平台控制与银行控制下的激励权衡。
AI.method: 采用形式化（stylized）正式模型与可复现的数值说明（numerical illustration）进行分析。
AI.findings: (1) 当平台创造的价值不完全可迁移也未完全被银行控制捕获时，平台控制鼓励投资；(2) 除非合同与经济暴露使银行在平台控制下完全对齐，否则银行控制鼓励安全投入；(3) 平台控制仅当创新收益超过更大使用风险、不安全决策、银行安全投入损失与否决成本之和时，社会更优；(4) 界定明确的止停不安全决策的权利有助益，但过宽权力增加拖延并易被滥用；(5) 可迁移性降低依赖，但不必然偏向平台控制。
AI.theory_contributions: 为稳定币治理提供正式的控制权分配理论框架，阐明平台控制与银行控制的激励权衡条件与权衡边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出混合治理安排建议——平台主导商业方向，银行提供合同化安全服务，隔离储备金与界定权力以保护发行、赎回和恢复。南韩银行财团争论和海外规则为设计提供动机与参考。

title: American Journal of Business Science Philosophy Market Dominance of GCash in the Philippine Digital Payment Ecosystem: A Secondary Data Analysis

detail.title: American Journal of Business Science Philosophy Market Dominance of GCash in the Philippine Digital Payment Ecosystem: A Secondary Data Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author(s) declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

publicationDetails.detailsText: American Journal of Business Science Philosophy, volume 3, issue 1, 2026[10.70122/ajbsp.v3i1.8]

detail.abstract: The rapid expansion of digital payment systems has transformed financial transactions in the Philippines, with mobile wallet platforms becoming central to everyday economic activities. This study examines the market dominance of GCash within the Philippine digital payment ecosystem using a secondary data analysis approach. Data were synthesized from official statistics, industry reports, and fintech market analyses to examine trends in digital payment adoption, mobile wallet usage, merchant integration, and market growth. Findings indicate an increase in digital payment adoption, with the share of digital retail payments rising from approximately 1% in 2013 to 57.4% in 2024. Concurrently, GCash experienced user expansion, growing from 20 million registered users in 2019 to more than 81 million in 2023, alongside a merchant network exceeding 2.5 million partners nationwide. Comparative analysis also shows that GCash maintains the most comprehensive service ecosystem among Philippine e-wallet platforms, contributing to its widespread adoption among consumers and small businesses. The results suggest that platform accessibility, trust, convenience, and network effects contribute to the platform's dominant position. This study provides empirical insight into the structural and behavioral factors shaping digital payment adoption in the Philippines and highlights the role of fintech platforms in supporting the country's expanding digital economy.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过二手数据分析，考察了GCash在菲律宾数字支付生态系统中的市场主导地位。研究发现菲律宾数字零售支付占比从2013年的约1%上升至2024年的57.4%，GCash用户从2019年的2000万增长至2023年的8100万以上，商户网络超过250万。平台可及性、信任、便利性和网络效应是GCash占据主导地位的关键因素。
AI.research_question: GCash如何在菲律宾数字支付生态系统中实现并维持市场主导地位？其背后的结构性因素和行为因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 菲律宾数字支付系统快速扩张，移动钱包平台成为日常经济活动核心，但缺乏对市场主导平台（GCash）的系统性实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 平台经济理论、网络效应理论
AI.method: 二手数据分析方法，综合官方统计数据、行业报告和金融科技市场分析数据。
AI.findings: 1) 菲律宾数字零售支付占比从2013年的约1%上升至2024年的57.4%；2) GCash用户从2019年2000万增长到2023年超过8100万，商户网络超250万；3) GCash拥有菲律宾电子钱包平台中最全面的服务生态系统；4) 平台可及性、信任、便利性和网络效应是GCash占据主导地位的关键驱动因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解新兴市场中数字支付平台主导地位的形成提供了实证证据，揭示了结构性（平台生态）和行为性（信任、便利性）因素在网络效应中的交互作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为菲律宾及其他新兴市场数字支付政策制定者和金融科技企业提供了关于平台增长模式和用户采纳驱动因素的实证洞察，有助于理解金融科技在支持数字经济发展中的作用。

title: From AI-Agent Instruction to Final Settlement: Evidencing State Transitions in Tokenized Securities
affiliations: and Hanyang University

detail.title: From AI-Agent Instruction to Final Settlement: Evidencing State Transitions in Tokenized Securities

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing financial or non-financial interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study analyzes public documents and does not involve human participants, personal data or animals.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: AI agents can originate instructions that cross participant, ledger and settlement-system boundaries between accountable checks. This paper asks how a central securities depository (CSD) can connect evidence for those transitions without deciding customer assent, manufacturing cash finality or treating execution as a rights-effective transfer. Extending JFMI research on message-induced value changes, DLT coordination and legal finality, it develops an evidence-gated framework from a prospective public-document analysis of Korea's 2026-27 transition, contrasted with DTC, Project Agorá and Swiss designs. A proposed action precedes six states: participant-accepted, technically executed, rights-effective, securities-final, cash-final and exception or remedy. Without authoritative evidence for the next state, processing must not progress automatically. From February 2027, Korea's amended Act on Electronic Registration of Stocks and Bonds will preserve registration and issue-integrity controls while permitting specified account books to use a distributed ledger together with an electronically linked ledger. The paper assigns KSD only a conditional interface role and specifies matched simulation or pilot tests using state error, mismatch, detection and resolution time, false rejection, delay and asset reservation. It offers a pre-production decision protocol, not evidence that KSD centralization is superior.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨中央证券存管机构（CSD）如何在不决定客户同意、不制造现金最终性或视执行为权利生效转移的前提下，为AI代理在多参与方、多账本和结算系统边界间发起的指令连接证据。论文基于对韩国2026-27年转型的前瞻性公共文件分析，提出了一个"证据门控"框架，定义了指令从提议到例外/补救的六个状态，并规定缺乏权威证据时处理不得自动推进。
AI.research_question: 中央证券存管机构（CSD）如何为跨越参与方、账本和结算系统边界的AI代理指令连接证据，同时不决定客户同意、不制造现金最终性或视执行为权利生效的转移？
AI.motivation: AI代理可以发起跨越多个账本和结算系统边界的指令，这给CSD带来了证据连接的新挑战。现有JFMI研究关注消息引发的价值变化、DLT协调和法律最终性，但缺乏一个将技术执行与法律权利生效明确区分、且不将执行直接视为权利转移的证据连接框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该论文建立在JB（JFMI）研究的基础上，包括：消息引发的价值变化、DLT协调和法律最终性理论。论文扩展了这一体系，提出了"证据门控"框架，将处理流程分为六个状态：参与者接受、技术执行、权利生效、证券最终、现金最终、例外或补救。
AI.method: 采用前瞻性公共文件分析方法，分析韩国2026-27年转型，并与DTC（美国存托信托公司）、Project Agorá和瑞士设计进行对比。论文提出预生产决策协议，并指定了使用状态错误、不匹配、检测与解决时间、误拒绝、延迟和资产保留等指标的匹配模拟或试点测试。
AI.findings: 从2027年2月起，韩国修订的《股票和债券电子登记法》将在保留登记和发行完整性控制的同时，允许指定账簿使用分布式账本配合电子关联账本。论文将韩国证券存管所（KSD）仅分配条件性接口角色。论文提供的是预生产决策协议，而非证明KSD集中化更优的证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 论文扩展了JFMI研究，提出了"证据门控"框架，将客户同意、现金最终性和权利生效转移从CSD的证据连接职责中分离出来。理论贡献在于明确区分了技术执行与法律权利生效，为AI代理指令在多系统间的证据连接提供了概念化模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 论文为CSD提供了预生产决策协议，包括六个状态转换的证据门控机制，以及具体的匹配模拟或试点测试指标（状态错误、不匹配、检测与解决时间、误拒绝、延迟和资产保留）。为韩国2026-27年DLT转型提供了KSD条件性接口角色的具体定位。

title: Towards Inclusive Governance: Blockchain in Citizen Representation
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Towards Inclusive Governance: Blockchain in Citizen Representation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study analyzed publicly available, secondary anonymized survey datasets and open government data; no primary clinical trials were conducted.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency and was conducted as an independent Master's thesis at Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin, Germany in 2024.

detail.abstract: Drawing on philosophical theories of justice, sociological critiques of surveillance and institutional trust, and political frameworks of polycentric governance, this study examines how blockchain technology can restructure public administration to foster inclusive citizen representation. By analyzing longitudinal datasets, including a decade of Democracy Radar Waves (DRW) surveys, the Global Corruption Barometer, OECD governance indicators, and Freedom House indices, alongside qualitative assessments of municipal smart city initiatives (such as Vienna’s public sector blockchain projects), this thesis investigates whether decentralized technologies can help strengthen inclusive governance paradigms. It seeks to bridge the gap between theoretical frameworks of decentralized ledger technology and the practical demands of contemporary democratic administration.

AI.tldr: 本研究从正义哲学、监督社会学、制度信任及多中心治理政治框架出发，探讨区块链技术如何重构公共行政以促进包容性公民代表。通过分析十年民主雷达波（DRW）调查、全球腐败晴雨表、OECD治理指标和自由之家指数等纵向数据集，并结合维也纳等城市公共部门区块链项目的定性评估，探讨去中心化技术能否强化包容性治理范式，弥合分布式账本理论框架与当代民主行政实践之间的鸿沟。
AI.research_question: 区块链技术能否以及如何重构公共行政体系，以促进更具包容性的公民代表性（inclusive citizen representation）和包容性治理范式？
AI.motivation: 现有研究存在分布式账本技术理论框架与当代民主行政实践需求之间的鸿沟，需要探索去中心化技术在公共治理领域的实际应用可能性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 正义哲学理论、监督与制度信任的社会学批判理论、多中心治理（polycentric governance）的政治框架。
AI.method: 混合方法研究：包括十年民主雷达波（DRW）调查、全球腐败晴雨表、OECD治理指标和自由之家指数等纵向定量数据集分析，以及对维也纳公共部门区块链项目等市政智慧城市倡议的定性评估。
AI.findings: 该研究认为去中心化技术有潜力帮助增强包容性治理范式，但具体实证结果需要查看完整论文。
AI.theory_contributions: 将正义哲学、监督社会学、制度信任与多中心治理等跨学科理论框架整合到区块链治理研究中，弥合了去中心化账本技术理论与民主行政实践之间的理论鸿沟。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共行政部门利用区块链技术促进包容性公民参与和治理提供实证依据和实践参考，包括对维也纳等市政区块链项目的具体洞察。

title: FLAP-X: A Dual-Leaf Attestation Protocol for Cross-Agent Regulatory Governance with Retrospective Cryptographic Verification

detail.title: FLAP-X: A Dual-Leaf Attestation Protocol for Cross-Agent Regulatory Governance with Retrospective Cryptographic Verification

declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A.
declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded - no funding received.

detail.abstract: Cryptographic verification presupposes determinism: a hash either matches or it does not, and a signature either holds or it fails. Agentic AI systems violate this precondition-identical inputs may produce different outputs, so there is no fixed expected value against which behaviour can be verified, and the naive application of cryptographic audit to AI fails at the first step. This paper takes a different route: separate what can be held invariant from what cannot. Credentials, delegation chains, prompt-template versions, access profiles, and controlexecution records are invariant by construction; model output is not. FLAP-X anchors the invariant set cryptographically and governs the variable residual with a calibrated tolerance, making non-deterministic multiagent systems retrospectively auditable. The dual-leaf attestation structure follows from this separation: Leaf 1 at the decision layer captures clause discharge, controls fired, and output hash; Leaf 2 at the workflow layer captures orchestration, delegation, and template version; the leaves are cross-linked and hash-bound to a principal chain rooted in a human agent owner. A four-check verification protocol operates across both surfaces. We parameterise a 15-condition test protocol in four parts-core verification (8), adversarial (3), governance lifecycle (3), and a comparative experiment (1) demonstrating two fault classes a single-surface record cannot handle: output substitution, which the single-surface record passes as a false negative, and surface attribution, which it cannot distinguish. We report honest negatives: adjacent-agent collusion producing mutually consistent false attestations passes verification, and a stolen signing key defeats signature checks; both are stated trust-boundary limitations addressed by the lifecycle layer, not the attestation layer. Effectiveness of the lifecycle controls at production scale remains future work; the author is actively seeking an empirical validation partnership.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FLAP-X框架，通过区分可保持不变的部分（凭证、委托链、提示模板版本、访问配置、控制执行记录）与不可变的部分（模型输出），将前者用密码学锚定、后者用校准容差治理，从而实现非确定性多智能体系统的追溯审计。采用双叶证明结构（决策层+工作流层），配合四检查验证协议和15条件测试协议，解决了单面记录无法处理输出替换和表面归因两类故障的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何在密码学验证预设确定性的前提下，实现本质上非确定性的智能体AI系统的可追溯审计？
AI.motivation: 传统密码学验证预设确定性——哈希匹配或不匹配、签名有效或失败。但智能体AI系统违反这一前提：相同的输入可能产生不同输出，没有固定期望值可供验证行为，导致朴素地应用密码学审计在第一步就失败。
AI.theoretical_framework: 密码学验证理论、确定性预设假设、可追溯审计理论、容差治理框架、双叶证明结构（决策层与工作流层分层）
AI.method: 提出FLAP-X框架：将可不变事物（凭证、委托链、提示模板版本、访问配置、控制执行记录）与可变事物（模型输出）分离；采用双叶证明结构（Leaf 1决策层：子句解除、控制触发、输出哈希；Leaf 2工作流层：编排、委托、模板版本），交叉链接并哈希绑定到根植于人类代理所有者主体的主链；设计四检查验证协议和15条件测试协议（核心验证8项、对抗3项、治理生命周期3项、对比实验1项）。
AI.findings: 双面记录能处理两类单面记录无法处理的故障：输出替换（单面记录会误通过为假阴性）和表面归因（单面记录无法区分）。诚实报告局限性：相邻代理合谋产生相互一致的虚假证明可通过验证；被盗签名密钥可击败签名检查——两者属于信任边界限制，由生命周期层而非证明层处理。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出密码学验证从确定性假设扩展到非确定性系统的理论路径：将"可保持不变"与"不可变"分离，用密码学锚定不变集、用校准容差治理可变残余，为AI审计领域提供新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为生产环境的智能体AI系统提供可操作的审计方案，包括15条件测试协议和四检查验证流程；明确信任边界局限（合谋、密钥被盗），并指出生命周期控制需进一步实证验证，正在寻求合作验证伙伴。

title: Libby Care Dies Quietly

detail.title: Libby Care Dies Quietly

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Not applicable.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded.

detail.abstract: The federal model for occupational disease care collapsed in Montana. Workers’ compensation inherits the wreckage. After a century of struggle, the United States had embarked on a new course for occupational medical care. That was written in good faith about a real statutory innovation. The innovation was sound. The delivery vehicle was a single nonprofit clinic in a town of three thousand people, funded by a renewable grant, exposed to hostile qui tam litigation by a party it had every reason to expect would be adverse, and dependent on an executive designation that has never been repeated. The more durable lesson is that occupational disease will not be solved one town at a time. The delivery of medical care to exposed workers belongs in a universal, non-litigious system coordinated with CMS, where entitlement does not depend on the employer, the chemical, the county, or the appropriations cycle.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨蒙大拿州联邦职业疾病护理模式崩溃后工人赔偿体系所面临的问题，指出以单一非营利诊所作为创新载体存在结构性脆弱，并主张职业疾病医疗应纳入与CMS协调的普遍性、非诉讼化系统。
AI.research_question: 蒙大拿州联邦职业疾病护理模式为何崩溃？以及职业疾病医疗服务的更优制度设计应该是什么？
AI.motivation: 美国经过一个世纪的斗争后，曾尝试通过一项真实的法规创新来开辟职业医疗护理的新路径，但该创新因载体设计脆弱而失败，需要从中汲取教训。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度设计与制度脆弱性理论；职业疾病护理的制度经济学视角；普遍主义福利制度与诉讼化赔偿体系的比较。
AI.method: 案例分析法——以蒙大拿州单一非营利诊所模式为案例，分析其制度设计缺陷与失败原因。
AI.findings: 该创新本身是合理的，但交付载体存在严重缺陷：诊所仅位于三千人口的小镇、依赖可续期拨款、面临敌对的qui tam诉讼、且依赖从未被重复过的行政指定。更深的教训是：职业疾病无法通过逐镇解决，应纳入与CMS协调的普遍性、非诉讼化系统，使资格不取决于雇主、化学品、县域或拨款周期。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了单一机构示范项目在职业疾病治理中的结构性局限，论证了职业疾病护理应从碎片化、诉讼化的工人赔偿模式转向普遍性医疗系统。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国职业疾病医疗政策改革提供了方向性建议：将受暴露工人的医疗服务纳入普遍性、非诉讼化、与CMS协调的系统，消除对雇主、化学品、地域和拨款周期的依赖。

title: How NFT Transaction Networks Structure Digital Market Participation: Ecosystem-Level Evidence from Ethereum and Polygon
affiliations: Telkom University, Telkom University and Telkom University

detail.title: How NFT Transaction Networks Structure Digital Market Participation: Ecosystem-Level Evidence from Ethereum and Polygon
detail.abstract: Non-Fungible Tokens (NFTs) have emerged as a new organizational layer of digital exchange, raising questions about how participation, concentration, and community formation are structured within on-chain markets. Understanding whether these structures differ systematically across blockchain ecosystems with distinct asset orientations requires examining ecosystem-level interaction patterns. Most studies focus on specific collections or single platforms, offering limited insight into how connectivity, concentration, and community structure vary across markets with different NFT use cases. This study compares Ethereum and Polygon, two major NFT platforms with distinct dominant asset orientations (investment-oriented vs utility-oriented), to examine how their transaction networks differ at the ecosystem level. Using 3.9 million NFT transactions from May 2022 to May 2024, we apply network analysis to assess connectivity, centralization, community structure, and temporal dynamics. The findings show highly skewed interaction patterns in both ecosystems, with a small subset of addresses accounting for a disproportionate share of activity. Polygon networks exhibit higher modular segmentation and sharper upper-tail dominance, with communities aligning near-perfectly with application-specific boundaries, whereas Ethereum networks display comparatively more integrated, crosscollection interaction structure. These contrasts are interpreted as ecosystem-level structural patterns conditional on each chain's market composition and dominant NFT use cases, offering socio-technical insights into how participation concentrates and communities form across blockchain-based digital markets.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对比以太坊和Polygon两大NFT平台的交易网络，利用390万笔NFT交易数据进行网络分析，发现两个生态系统中均存在高度偏斜的交互模式（少数地址占据大部分活动），但Polygon网络展现出更高的模块化分割和更明显的尾部主导，社区近乎完美地与应用边界对齐，而以太坊网络则呈现更整合、跨收藏集的交互结构。
AI.research_question: 在不同区块链生态系统（以太坊vs Polygon）中，NFT交易网络的连通性、集中度、社区结构和时间动态是否存在系统性差异？这些差异如何与各链主导的NFT资产取向（投资导向vs效用导向）相关联？
AI.motivation: 大多数现有研究聚焦于特定NFT收藏或单一平台，缺乏对生态系统层面交互模式的理解。需要从生态系统视角探讨NFT市场的参与结构、集中度和社区形成如何在具有不同资产取向的区块链中呈现差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会技术系统理论、网络分析理论（连通性、集中度、社区结构）、数字经济市场结构理论
AI.method: 收集2022年5月至2024年5月间390万笔NFT交易数据，运用网络分析方法评估以太坊和Polygon两个平台的连通性、集中化程度、社区结构及时间动态特征。
AI.findings: （1）两个生态系统中均存在高度偏斜的交互模式，少数地址占据不成比例的活动份额；（2）Polygon网络展现出更高的模块化分割和更尖锐的上尾支配，社区与具体应用边界近乎完美对齐；（3）以太坊网络呈现相对更整合、跨收藏集的交互结构。
AI.theory_contributions: 该研究将NFT市场结构差异概念化为生态系统层面的结构模式，表明这些模式受各链市场构成和主导NFT用例的条件约束，为理解区块链数字市场中参与集中和社区形成提供了社会技术视角的理论洞见。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解不同区块链生态系统中NFT市场的参与模式和社区结构提供经验证据，有助于平台设计者、政策制定者和市场参与者更深入地理解投资导向与效用导向NFT市场的结构性差异。
