title: Smaller but Safer How Quantitative Easing Reshapes Bank−Intermediated Financial Systems

detail.title: Smaller but Safer How Quantitative Easing Reshapes Bank−Intermediated Financial Systems
detail.abstract: How has quantitative easing (QE) reshaped the architecture of financial intermediation? In a balanced panel covering 33 economies for the period 2012 to 2020, banking structure is measured by the asset-to-deposit ratio, a composite that is immune to pandemic-era GDP distortions. Two-way fixed effects estimates with Driscoll–Kraay standard errors show that QE compressed the depth of the structure by one standard deviation over the policy range studied. Component decomposition confirms that the result is not a shared-denominator artefact. Bank assets contract, while deposits expand. The relationship is inverted-U and satisfies the Lind-Mehlum condition, with a turning point near 0.8 percent of GDP, and beyond that point the marginal effect triples. Transmission is entirely concentrated in the bank-intermediated system; in the market-mediated system it is statistically zero. While the policy effect resembles the decade-long trend, we detect genuine discontinuities in the capital channels during the pandemic, suggesting a failure of the buffer in terms of its usability as the more capitalized system deleveraged more aggressively in 2020. At the same time, QE improved bank solvency by increasing the distance to default. We conclude that policy intensity makes the bank-intermediated system structurally smaller, but safer on observable measures.

AI.tldr: 本文使用33个经济体2012-2020年的平衡面板数据，研究量化宽松（QE）如何重塑金融中介架构。研究发现QE使银行中介系统深度（以资产-存款比率衡量）压缩了一个标准差，银行资产收缩而存款扩张，且呈倒U型关系（拐点约为GDP的0.8%）。传导完全集中在银行中介系统，市场中介系统无显著效应。QE还通过增加违约距离改善了银行偿付能力。
AI.research_question: 量化宽松（QE）如何重塑金融中介的架构？具体而言，QE政策强度如何影响银行中介系统的结构深度与安全性？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多关注QE对宏观经济变量或资产价格的影响，但缺乏对QE如何系统性改变金融中介架构、尤其是银行中介与市场中介相对格局的深入分析。此外，已有研究常受GDP扭曲（如疫情期间）干扰，需要更稳健的度量方式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融中介理论、银行中介与市场中介的二分框架、资本缓冲理论、违约距离（distance to default）模型。
AI.method: 使用33个经济体2012-2020年的平衡面板数据，以资产-存款比率度量银行结构深度（该指标不受疫情期GDP扭曲影响）；采用双向固定效应估计，并使用Driscoll-Kraay稳健标准误；进行成分分解排除共同分母假象；运用Lind-Mehlum检验识别倒U型关系及拐点；分系统（银行中介vs市场中介）进行传导分析。
AI.findings: （1）QE压缩了银行中介系统结构深度约一个标准差；（2）效应源于银行资产收缩与存款扩张，非分母假象；（3）关系为倒U型，拐点约为GDP的0.8%，超过拐点后边际效应翻三倍；（4）传导完全集中在银行中介系统，市场中介系统效应统计上为零；（5）疫情期间资本渠道出现真实断裂，资本化程度更高的系统在2020年去杠杆更激进，表明资本缓冲可用性失败；（6）QE通过增加违约距离改善了银行偿付能力。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次系统性地将QE与金融中介架构的变迁联系起来，揭示政策强度与银行系统结构深度之间的非线性（倒U型）关系；（2）将QE对金融机构的影响区分为银行中介和市场中介两个系统，发现传导的非对称性；（3）揭示资本缓冲在极端压力时期（疫情）存在可用性失效问题——资本化更高的银行反而更激进地去杠杆，挑战了传统资本充足监管的有效性假设；（4）区分了QE对银行规模（变小）和安全性（更安全）的两个维度效应。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为货币政策制定者提供QE政策强度对金融中介结构的定量参考，特别是超过GDP 0.8%后边际效应放大的非线性警示；（2）提示监管者在设计资本缓冲时应考虑其实际可用性，而非仅关注资本充足率水平；（3）为评估QE政策的金融稳定影响提供实证依据，表明QE在使银行系统变小的同时提升了其偿付安全性。

title: Heterogeneous Effects of SNAP Benefit Enhancements on Food Sufficiency and Mental Health
affiliations: Texas A&M University (TAMU), Central Texas, Texas A&M University (TAMU), Central Texas, Texas A&M University - Department of Agricultural Economics and USDA-ERS

detail.title: Heterogeneous Effects of SNAP Benefit Enhancements on Food Sufficiency and Mental Health

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported in part by the US Department of Agriculture (USDA), Economic Research Service through cooperative agreement NA#58-4000-2-0077. The findings and conclusions in this publication are those of the authors and should not be construed to represent any official USDA or US Government determination or policy.

detail.abstract: For Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) households, the maximum benefit was temporarily increased by 15% from January through September 2021, with an April revision to Emergency Allotments (EA) raising benefits further for the lowest-net-income participants. We evaluate how the combined effects of these temporary benefit enhancements vary across households with different levels of susceptibility to food insufficiency, anxiety, and depression, as well as by household composition and geographic cost of living. Using data from the Household Pulse Survey, we first apply machine learning to predict households' susceptibility to each hardship outcome, then estimate treatment effects across the predicted susceptibility distribution using both traditional and doubly robust difference-indifferences estimators. The enhancements improved household food sufficiency by about 3-4% on average. Gains tended to be larger among households with higher predicted susceptibility to food insufficiency and in lower-cost regions (e.g., 6-7% in the Midwest), with smaller or null effects in higher-cost regions (e.g., the West). Across these dimensions, gains emerged largely after the April EA revision. We find no significant effects on anxiety over the January-September period in the full sample. In January-March, however, anxiety fell by about 3% across all households, driven by large reductions among those without children.

AI.tldr: 本文利用家庭脉冲调查数据，通过机器学习预测家庭对食品不足、焦虑和抑郁的易感性，并采用传统和双重稳健双重差分估计器，评估2021年1月至9月SNAP临时福利增强（15%最高福利增加及4月紧急配给修订）对不同易感性和不同特征家庭的影响。结果显示，福利增强使家庭食品充足率平均提高3-4%，且对高易感性家庭和低成本地区（如中西部6-7%）效果更大，高成本地区效果较小或无效；主要效果出现在4月修订之后。对焦虑在1-3月期间平均下降3%（主要由无子女家庭驱动），但1-9月整体无显著效果。
AI.research_question: SNAP临时福利增强（2021年1-9月15%最高福利提升及4月紧急配给修订）对不同易感性水平、家庭构成和地理生活成本的家庭的食品不足、焦虑和抑郁的影响有何差异？
AI.motivation: COVID-19期间SNAP福利临时增强是一项大规模政策干预，但已有研究较少关注其异质性效应——即不同易感性、家庭结构和生活成本地区的家庭如何差异化受益。理解这些异质性对于优化社会福利政策设计、确保资源精准分配至最需要群体具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于福利经济学和健康不平等理论框架，结合机器学习预测的个体易感性分布，运用传统双重差分和双重稳健双重差分估计器进行因果推断。
AI.method: 使用家庭脉冲调查（Household Pulse Survey）数据，首先运用机器学习预测家庭对食品不足、焦虑和抑郁三种不良结果的易感性，然后在预测易感性分布上使用传统双重差分和双重稳健双重差分估计器估计处理效应。
AI.findings: （1）SNAP福利增强使家庭食品充足率平均提高3-4%；（2）增益在高食品不足易感性家庭和低成本地区更大（中西部6-7%），高成本地区（西部）效果较小或为零；（3）效果主要出现在4月紧急配给修订之后；（4）1-9月全样本对焦虑无显著影响，但1-3月焦虑平均下降约3%，主要由无子女家庭驱动。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将机器学习预测的易感性分布与双重差分因果推断相结合，系统地揭示了SNAP福利增强效应的异质性，丰富了食品不安全和社会福利政策影响的理论理解，特别是福利边际效应对不同易感性和不同生活成本地区家庭的差异化作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于SNAP福利增强如何在不同人群和地区产生差异化效果的经验证据，有助于优化未来紧急社会福利政策的目标定位和福利发放设计，特别是在考虑地区生活成本差异和受益者易感性的基础上提高政策效率。

title: Energy-Related Financial Literacy and Fuel Efficiency: Evidence from Motorcycles in Nepal
affiliations: Tribhuvan University, ETH Zürich - CER-ETH - Center of Economic Research at ETH Zurich, ETH Zürich - CER-ETH - Center of Economic Research at ETH Zurich, Tribhuvan University and ETH Zürich - CER-ETH - Center of Economic Research at ETH Zurich

detail.title: Energy-Related Financial Literacy and Fuel Efficiency: Evidence from Motorcycles in Nepal
detail.abstract: Encouraging the adoption of fuel-efficient vehicles represents a viable strategy to mitigatethe escalating air pollution in urban centers of developing countries, where pollutionlevels frequently surpass recommended thresholds, posing serious health risks. However,various behavioral biases may inhibit individuals from investing in more fuel-efficientoptions, thereby contributing to the persistent ’energy efficiency gap.’ A key factor inthis gap is individuals’ limited cognitive capacity to evaluate the lifetime costs associatedwith durable goods, a concept encompassed by ’energy-related financial literacy’ (ERFL).This study draws on novel data from Kathmandu, Nepal, to investigate the determinantsof ERFL and its effect on reducing the energy efficiency gap in motorcycle choice. Thefindings suggest that individuals with higher ERFL, particularly those with strongercomputational skills, are more likely to own fuel-efficient motorcycles. These resultsunderscore the importance of low-cost policy interventions, such as educational programs,to promote energy-efficient investment decisions.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用尼泊尔加德满都的新数据，考察能源相关金融素养（ERFL）对摩托车选择中能源效率差距的影响，发现具有更高ERFL（尤其是计算能力更强）的个体更可能拥有节能摩托车，从而支持通过教育项目等低成本政策干预促进节能投资。
AI.research_question: 能源相关金融素养（ERFL）的决定因素是什么？ERFL如何影响摩托车选择中的能源效率差距？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家城市空气污染严重，鼓励采用节能车辆是缓解策略之一，但行为偏差导致"能源效率差距"持续存在。个体评估耐用品生命周期成本的认知能力有限（即ERFL不足）是关键因素，因此需要深入理解ERFL的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学中的能源效率差距理论、能源相关金融素养（ERFL）概念
AI.method: 基于尼泊尔加德满都的新调查数据，实证分析ERFL的决定因素及其对摩托车节能选择的影响。
AI.findings: 具有更高ERFL的个体，尤其是计算能力更强的个体，更可能拥有节能摩托车。
AI.theory_contributions: 将ERFL概念拓展到发展中经济体的摩托车消费情境，补充了能源效率差距理论在发展中国家耐用消费品（特别是两轮车）领域的应用证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调低成本政策干预（如教育项目）对促进节能投资决策的重要性，为发展中国家制定推广节能车辆的政策提供实证依据。

title: Propaganda Machinery: National Socialism
affiliations: Universidad de la Republica

detail.title: Propaganda Machinery: National Socialism
detail.abstract:
Between 1920 and 1933, the National Socialist German Workers' Party (NSDAP) made propaganda a central component of its political and electoral organization. This book examines that process in the context of the crisis of the Weimar Republic and analyzes how message simplification, repetition, public staging, construction of the adversary, and personalization of leadership expanded the movement's capacity for mobilization.

Drawing on speeches by Adolf Hitler and Joseph Goebbels, the party press, visual material, and historiographical sources, Propaganda Machinery examines the rhetorical and organizational devices that structured National Socialist communication. The analysis pays particular attention to the relationship among language, political emotions, symbols, media of dissemination, and audience segmentation.

The approach combines political history, linguistics, rhetoric, and discourse analysis. Propaganda is not presented as a single cause of the Nazi rise to power, but as an instrument whose effectiveness depended on economic, institutional, and social conditions, party organization, and, increasingly, political violence.

The study distinguishes party propaganda before 1933 from the state system of propaganda, censorship, and cultural coordination developed after the seizure of power. This distinction makes it possible to examine more precisely which resources were used in electoral competition and which belonged to the subsequent institutionalization of dictatorship.

AI.tldr: 本书考察1920至1933年间纳粹党（NSDAP）如何在魏玛共和国危机背景下将宣传打造为核心政治与选举工具，分析信息简化、重复、公开表演、敌人建构和领袖个人化等手段如何扩展其动员能力，并区分了夺权前的政党宣传与夺权后的国家宣传体制。
AI.research_question: 纳粹党在1920-1933年间如何通过宣传手段构建政治与选举组织，并扩大其动员能力？宣传在纳粹崛起中扮演何种角色？
AI.motivation: 既有研究往往将宣传简单视为纳粹上台的单一原因，缺乏对其运作机制、资源分配以及宣传在不同政治阶段（夺权前后）的差异化作用的细致考察。本书旨在更精确地理解宣传作为一种工具如何依赖于经济、制度、社会条件并与政党组织及政治暴力相互作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合政治史、语言学、修辞学与话语分析的跨学科框架，关注语言、政治情感、符号、传播媒介与受众细分之间的关系。
AI.method: 基于希特勒与戈培尔的演讲、纳粹党报、视觉材料及史学文献，对纳粹宣传的修辞与组织手段进行定性的文本与话语分析。
AI.findings: 纳粹宣传通过信息简化、重复、公开表演、敌人建构和领袖个人化等策略有效扩展了动员能力；其有效性依赖经济、制度和社会条件及政党组织；宣传并非纳粹上台的单一原因。此外，夺权前的政党宣传与夺权后建立的国家宣传、审查和文化协调体系存在本质区别，前者服务于选举竞争，后者服务于专政的制度化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出区分政党宣传与国家宣传体制的分析框架，更精确地界定宣传在选举竞争与极权制度化中的不同功能与资源运用，超越了将宣传视为单一因果变量的简化叙事。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解现代政治动员中宣传、传媒与受众互动提供历史参照，有助于识别极权主义宣传工具从选举阶段向制度镇压阶段演变的路径。

title: Sorting Fact From Fiction When Reasoning Is Motivated
affiliations: Vienna University of Economics and Business, , University of Vienna and University of Vienna - Department of Government

detail.title: Sorting Fact From Fiction When Reasoning Is Motivated

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study was approved by the ethics board at the Vienna University of Economics and Business (WU-RP-2023-006).
declarations.funderStatement: Melis Kartal gratefully acknowledges financial support by the funds of the Oesterreichischen Nationalbank (Austrian Central Bank, Anniversary Fund, project number: 18682).

detail.abstract: We combine a simple theoretical framework with a survey experiment to investigate how individuals sort fact from fiction and update their assessments in societally important but politicized topics, such as climate change and public health. We show that cognitive ability improves news discernment and in particular, the ability to make correct assessments that contradict one's prior issue positions. However, when we disaggregate results by topic, higher cognitive ability sometimes amplifies motivated decision-making rather than attenuating it. Our framework and findings suggest a hard-easy pattern: more complex issues elicit greater motivated reasoning; simpler ones elicit less. In addition, overconfidence reduces responsiveness to new information, contributing to the persistence of misperceptions. Higher institutional trust appears to weaken motivated reasoning, suggesting that institutional quality may play an important role in constraining opinion polarization.

AI.tldr: 本文结合一个简单的理论框架和调查实验，研究了人们如何在气候变暖和公共卫生等社会重要但政治化的议题中区分事实与虚构，并更新其评估。研究发现认知能力整体上改善新闻辨别力，但按议题细分时，更高的认知能力有时会放大而非减弱动机性推理；更复杂的议题引发更多动机性推理。过度自信降低对新信息的响应度，而更高的制度信任则削弱动机性推理。
AI.research_question: 个体如何在政治化议题（如气候变化和公共卫生）中区分事实与虚构并更新其信念？认知能力和心理因素如何影响这一过程？
AI.motivation: 在政治化议题中，错误信息持续存在且对政策制定有重大影响，但人们对认知能力、动机性推理和信念更新之间关系的理解尚不充分，尤其是分议题的差异化效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于动机性推理理论，结合认知能力（cognitive ability）与议题复杂性的理论框架，提出"困难-简单"模式（hard-easy pattern），并纳入过度自信和制度信任等调节因素。
AI.method: 采用调查实验（survey experiment）方法，结合一个简单的理论框架进行实证检验，按议题（气候变化、公共卫生等）进行结果分解分析。
AI.findings: （1）认知能力整体上提高新闻辨别能力，特别是做出与自身既有立场相矛盾的正确判断的能力；（2）按议题细分时，更高认知能力有时放大而非减弱动机性推理，复杂议题引发更多动机性推理，简单议题则较少；（3）过度自信降低对新信息的响应，导致错误认知持续；（4）更高的制度信任削弱动机性推理，可能有助于抑制观点极化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并验证"困难-简单"模式：议题复杂性调节认知能力与动机性推理之间的关系，丰富了动机性推理理论在政治传播领域的应用；识别出过度自信和制度信任作为影响信念更新的关键调节变量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和传播者提供干预启示：提升制度信任可能有助于减少极化；针对不同复杂度的议题应采取差异化信息传播策略；关注过度自信群体以设计更有效的信息纠错机制。

title: Equity in Funding and the Mortality Gap: An Analysis of Resource Allocation and Health Inequalities in England
affiliations: , University of Liverpool, University of York (UK) Centre for Health Economics and University of Liverpool - Department of Public Health, Policy and Systems

detail.title: Equity in Funding and the Mortality Gap: An Analysis of Resource Allocation and Health Inequalities in England

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Not applicable
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: not applicable

detail.abstract:
Background Health inequalities in England remain stark, with mortality nearly twice as high and life expectancy a decade shorter in the most deprived areas compared to the least deprived. The English National Health Service (NHS) allocates a greater share of resources to more deprived areas to help reduce this gap. The extent to which this is the case has however changed over time. We examined how the relationship between NHS funding and deprivation has changed between 2000 and 2023 and estimated the potential impact of these changes on contemporary inequalities in mortality.


Methods We analysed NHS funding allocations to local health planning areas in England from 2000–2023, mapped to a consistent geography of 322 local authorities. We used a log-linear regression model to estimate the annual Deprivation Funding Ratio, measured as the relative gradient of funding to deprivation. We assessed the causal effects of NHS expenditure on age-adjusted mortality across deprivation quintiles, using instrumental variable techniques, with the annual government distance from target funding index as an instrument for expenditure in each year 2013–2023, controlling for prior health and socioeconomic factors. We then used Monte Carlo simulations to model how much greater the gap in mortality was in 2023 compared to a counterfactual scenario of maintaining the 2005 peak pro-deprivation funding gradient.


Results The Deprivation Funding Ratio increased from 2000, peaking at 1.47 (95% CI: 1.42–1.52) in 2005, indicating 47% higher funding in the most deprived areas compared to the least, then declined to 1.32 (95%CI 1.28 to 1.36) by 2023. Instrumental variable estimates showed that a 1% increase in funding decreased mortality by 0.41% (95% CI 0.33 to 0.49) in the least deprived areas and by 0.85% (95% CI 0.73 to 0.98) in the most deprived areas. Maintaining the 2005 funding gradient would have reduced mortality in the most deprived quintile by 37 deaths per 100,000 (95% CI  8 to 175) and narrowed the mortality gap by 46 deaths per 100,000 (95% CI 11 to 194).


Conclusion NHS resource allocation became less equitable after 2005, contributing to widening health inequalities. Fairer distribution of resources towards deprived areas could reduce mortality and narrow health gaps, supporting policy ambitions to restore equity and improve population health.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2000-2023年间英格兰NHS资金分配与地区贫困程度之间的关系变化，发现资金分配在2005年达到最有利于贫困地区的峰值后持续衰减，这一变化加剧了死亡率不平等。通过工具变量和蒙特卡洛模拟估计，若维持2005年的资金梯度，最贫困地区的死亡率可显著降低，卫生不平等差距可缩小。
AI.research_question: 2000年至2023年间，英格兰NHS资金分配与地区贫困程度的关系如何变化？这些变化对当代死亡率不平等有何潜在影响？
AI.motivation: 英格兰健康不平等问题依然严峻——最贫困地区死亡率几乎是最不贫困地区的两倍，预期寿命短十年。NHS向更贫困地区分配更多资源以缩小差距，但这种分配的公平程度随时间发生了变化，需要量化评估这一变化的健康影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资源分配公平性理论和健康不平等的社会决定因素理论，利用资金梯度（Deprivation Funding Ratio）衡量资源分配与贫困程度的关联强度，并结合因果推断框架评估资金对健康结果的边际效应。
AI.method: 分析2000-2023年英格兰322个地方当局的NHS资金分配数据，使用对数线性回归模型估计年度Deprivation Funding Ratio；采用工具变量技术（以政府年度目标资金距离指数为工具变量）评估2013-2023年NHS支出对年龄调整死亡率的因果效应；运用蒙特卡洛模拟对比2023年实际死亡率与维持2005年资金梯度情景下的反事实死亡率。
AI.findings: Deprivation Funding Ratio从2000年上升，2005年达到峰值1.47（最贫困地区资金比最不贫困地区高47%），随后下降至2023年的1.32。工具变量估计显示，资金增加1%使最不贫困地区死亡率降低0.41%，使最贫困地区死亡率降低0.85%。若维持2005年资金梯度，最贫困五分位地区死亡率可降低每10万人37例，整体死亡率差距可缩小每10万人46例。
AI.theory_contributions: 为资源分配公平性与健康结果之间的因果链条提供了量化证据，表明资金分配政策的公平程度下降确实会转化为可测量的健康不平等扩大，丰富了健康公平政策评估的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了明确的循证依据：恢复向贫困地区倾斜的资金分配可以显著降低死亡率并缩小健康差距，支持英格兰恢复卫生资源分配公平性的政策目标；量化了不同资金分配情境下的健康收益，有助于指导资源再分配决策。

title: Regime-Conditional Miscalibration of Chronos-2 in Indian Equity Forecasting: A Calibration Audit with Conformal Correction

detail.title: Regime-Conditional Miscalibration of Chronos-2 in Indian Equity Forecasting: A Calibration Audit with Conformal Correction
detail.abstract: Time series foundation models such as Chronos-2 promise strong zero-shot forecasting performance, but whether their uncertainty estimates are trustworthy on non-stationary, regime-shifting financial data is underexamined. We audit Chronos-2's probabilistic calibration on two major Indian equity indices, Sensex and Nifty, using a rolling-window forecast setup (352 and 403 evaluation windows respectively). We find that the model's stated 80% prediction interval is well calibrated one day ahead (80.7% empirical coverage) but drops to approximately 74% coverage from day 2 onward and remains flat there rather than degrading gradually, indicating persistent overconfidence beyond the first forecast step. Stratifying by volatility regime reveals that this miscalibration is not uniform: low-volatility periods are better calibrated at short horizons, but this reverses by the end of the 30-day horizon, where high-volatility periods achieve better coverage, a pattern that replicates on both indices. The reversal is closely associated with interval width-Chronos-2 outputs substantially wider intervals during high-volatility periods, providing a plausible mechanism for why this extra width disproportionately benefits coverage at longer horizons. To test whether this reversal is specific to Chronos-2 or a general property of forecasting Sensex, we benchmark against a classical SARIMAX baseline: SARIMAX is more overconfident than Chronos-2 at every horizon and shows low-volatility coverage exceeding high-volatility coverage at all 30 horizons with no reversal, consistent with its comparatively modest interval-width response to volatility regime relative to Chronos-2's, though the sample size here is too small to call this gap significant. We propose a regime-conditional calibration audit with pooled conformal correction, combining fixed and adaptive conformal prediction, stating the coverage guarantees each method relies on and validating the regime effect via bootstrap resampling; applying it improves day-16 coverage from 75.2% to 78.0% (fixed) and 78.7% (adaptive) against an 80% target, at a modest cost in interval width. While we also propose and test a pooled (non-regime-specific) conformal correction as a preliminary secondary contribution, the paper's central finding is the regime-conditional reversal in calibration itself, which we establish independently of any correction method. Together, these results indicate that foundation model calibration in financial forecasting is jointly regime-and horizon-dependent, a consideration that matters for any downstream use in financial risk management.

AI.tldr: 本文审计了时间序列基础模型Chronos-2在印度两大股指（Sensex和Nifty）上的概率校准表现，发现其预测区间在一天前校准良好（80.7%经验覆盖率），但从第二天起覆盖率降至约74%并保持平坦，表明存在持续的过度自信。更重要的是，校准偏差并非均匀分布：波动率体制与预测水平期之间存在反转效应——低波动期在短期校准更好，但30天后高波动期覆盖率反而更佳，这一模式在两个指数上均复现。该反转与区间宽度密切相关：Chronos-2在高波动期输出更宽的区间，这解释了为何额外宽度在长水平期时更有利于覆盖率。作者还对比了传统SARIMAX基线（在所有水平期都更过度自信且无反转），并提出了体制条件校准审计与池化共形校正方法（将固定与自适应共形预测结合），将第16天覆盖率从75.2%提升至78.0%（固定）和78.7%（自适应）。核心发现是校准的体制条件反转本身，而非任何校正方法。
AI.research_question: Chronos-2等时间序列基础模型在非平稳、体制切换的金融数据上，其不确定性估计（预测区间）是否可信？校准表现是否随波动率体制和预测水平期而变化？
AI.motivation: 时间序列基础模型（如Chronos-2）宣称具有强大的零样本预测性能，但其在非平稳、体制切换的金融数据上的不确定性估计可靠性尚未被充分检验。金融风险管理高度依赖准确的不确定性量化，因此审计这类模型的概率校准至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 概率校准理论（预测区间覆盖率）、波动率体制理论、共形预测（固定与自适应）、滚动窗口预测评估框架、bootstrap重抽样验证
AI.method: 采用滚动窗口预测设置（Sensex 352个评估窗口，Nifty 403个评估窗口），对Chronos-2的80%预测区间进行经验覆盖率审计；按波动率体制分层分析校准差异；与经典SARIMAX基线进行对比；提出体制条件校准审计框架，结合固定和自适应共形预测进行池化校正，并通过bootstrap重抽样验证体制效应。
AI.findings: （1）Chronos-2一天前预测区间校准良好（80.7%覆盖率），但第2天起降至约74%并保持平坦而非逐步恶化，表明超过第一步后持续过度自信；（2）按波动率体制分层，发现校准反转效应：低波动期短期校准更好，但30天水平期结束时高波动期覆盖率反而更佳，两个指数均复现；（3）反转与区间宽度相关：Chronos-2在高波动期输出更宽区间，这解释了对长水平期覆盖率的超额益处；（4）SARIMAX基线在所有水平期均比Chronos-2更过度自信，且无反转现象（低波动覆盖率始终高于高波动），与它对波动率体制的区间宽度响应较温和一致；（5）体制条件共形校正显著改善覆盖率（如第16天从75.2%提升至78.0%/78.7%），代价是区间宽度适度增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地揭示基础模型在金融预测中的校准是体制依赖与水平期依赖的联合函数，发现了校准表现随波动率体制与预测水平期交互作用的"反转效应"这一新规律，超越了简单"基础模型校准良好或不良"的二元判断框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了体制条件校准审计框架与池化共形校正方法（结合固定与自适应共形预测），可有效改善预测区间覆盖率；为金融风险管理中基础模型不确定性估计的使用提供了重要的实践警示与改进工具。

title: Air Pollution and Equity Returns in an Emerging Market: Evidence from Kazakhstan

detail.title: Air Pollution and Equity Returns in an Emerging Market: Evidence from Kazakhstan

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Does air pollution move stock prices in a market where most investors are exposed to it? Using the topography of the Almaty basin, where winter temperature inversions compress the atmospheric mixing layer from 924 metres to as little as 21, we instrument daily PM2.5 with meteorological dispersion conditions and estimate the effect on the Kazakhstan Stock Exchange Index across 1,042 trading days. We find no detectable effect (−0.083 percentage points of daily return per log unit of PM2.5, SE 0.083) and reject, at the five per cent level, effects exceeding 0.152 percentage points per doubling of concentration.

A substantial literature reports that ambient air pollution depresses daily equity returns through investor mood, with the most cited estimate drawn from the S&P 500. That literature identifies the effect overwhelmingly through controls rather than instruments, maintaining that pollution is conditionally exogenous to returns; the one instrumented study we are aware of uses lagged wind speed and atmospheric pressure, variables the mood-and-weather literature treats as candidate channels in their own right. We relax that assumption. The exogeneity assumption is at least testable here: ordinary least squares is positive and indistinguishable from zero, and instrumenting moves the estimate roughly 1.1 standard errors in the direction economic-activity confounding predicts, though formal exogeneity tests are inconclusive. We further show that the benchmark's dose-response does not transport linearly to a market at 2.8 times its concentration, and we decompose the precision cost of credible identification, which is roughly 2.4-fold and largely explains why instrumented estimates in this literature are scarce.

AI.tldr: 本文利用阿拉木图盆地特殊地形（冬季逆温压缩大气混合层）作为工具变量，研究空气污染对哈萨克斯坦股市指数的影响，发现PM2.5对日收益率无显著影响，并精确拒绝了效应超过每翻倍0.152个百分点的情况，同时揭示了该领域工具变量估计稀缺的精度代价。
AI.research_question: 在大多数投资者都暴露于空气污染的市场中，空气污染是否会影响股票价格？
AI.motivation: 现有文献主要基于S&P 500报告空气污染通过投资者情绪压低股票日收益，但绝大多数研究依赖条件外生性假设而非工具变量识别；唯一使用工具变量的研究采用滞后风速和大气压，而这些变量在情绪与天气文献中被视为候选传导渠道。本文旨在放松这一假设，提供更可信的因果识别。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投资者情绪理论（空气污染通过影响投资者情绪进而影响股票收益）；拟自然实验框架（利用阿拉木图盆地地形与冬季温度逆温造成的混合层压缩作为气象扩散条件的工具变量）
AI.method: 利用阿拉木图盆地地形（冬季逆温将大气混合层从924米压缩至最低21米）作为工具变量，以气象扩散条件对每日PM2.5进行工具化处理，在1,042个交易日样本上估计PM2.5对哈萨克斯坦证券交易所指数日收益率的影响。
AI.findings: PM2.5每增加一个对数单位，日收益率变化为-0.083个百分点（标准误0.083），无可检测效应；在5%显著水平上拒绝了浓度每翻倍效应超过0.152个百分点的情况。OLS估计为正值且与零不可区分，工具变量估计向经济活动混杂所预测的方向移动约1.1个标准误；基准计量模型的剂量-反应关系不能线性推广到PM2.5浓度高2.8倍的市场；可信识别带来的精度代价约为2.4倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 放松了污染与收益条件外生性的假设，提供了该领域稀缺的工具变量因果估计；检验了基准模型的剂量-反应关系在不同浓度水平市场的外推有效性；量化了可信识别的精度代价，解释了该领域工具变量估计稀缺的原因。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高污染市场中的投资者和监管者提供了空气污染对资产价格影响的更可信因果证据；表明在污染严重的市场中空气污染对股票收益的边际影响可能不显著，对投资决策和政策评估具有参考意义。

title: Preventive Trade Compliance Strategies for Reducing FDA Import Refusals and Strengthening Supply Chain Resilience in U.S. Food Imports: A Critical Integrative Review and Documentary Analysis

detail.title: Preventive Trade Compliance Strategies for Reducing FDA Import Refusals and Strengthening Supply Chain Resilience in U.S. Food Imports: A Critical Integrative Review and Documentary Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: International food supply chains face increasing regulatory complexity and operational risk, particularly in the United States, where FDA requirements can result in import refusals and supply chain disruptions. This article presents a critical integrative review supported by regulatory and documentary analysis examining how preventive trade compliance can reduce FDA import refusals while strengthening supply chain resilience. Based on scientific literature and official regulatory sources, the study proposes the Preventive Trade Compliance Framework (PTCF), an integrated managerial framework organized around five dimensions: Regulatory Intelligence, Supplier Governance, Documentation Integrity, Preventive Risk Assessment, and Continuous Improvement. The framework integrates fragmented compliance activities into a preventive supply chain perspective, supporting the identification and mitigation of compliance risks before shipment. By positioning regulatory preparedness as a strategic organizational capability, the PTCF provides a conceptual foundation for improving operational resilience and future empirical research on the relationship between preventive trade compliance and supply chain performance.

AI.tldr: 本文通过批判性整合综述和监管与文献分析，提出了预防性贸易合规框架（PTCF），包含监管情报、供应商治理、文件完整性、预防性风险评估和持续改进五个维度，旨在减少FDA进口拒绝并增强供应链韧性。
AI.research_question: 预防性贸易合规如何能够减少FDA进口拒绝并同时增强供应链韧性？
AI.motivation: 国际食品供应链面临日益复杂的监管环境和运营风险，FDA要求可能导致进口拒绝和供应链中断，而现有的合规活动分散、缺乏整合视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预防性合规视角、供应链韧性理论、战略组织能力理论
AI.method: 批判性整合综述（critical integrative review），结合监管和文献分析，基于科学文献和官方监管来源
AI.findings: 提出了预防性贸易合规框架（PTCF），围绕五个维度（监管情报、供应商治理、文件完整性、预防性风险评估、持续改进）将碎片化的合规活动整合为预防性供应链视角，支持在装运前识别和缓解合规风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 将监管准备定位为战略组织能力，为预防性贸易合规与供应链绩效之间的关系提供概念基础，推动未来实证研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为食品供应链管理者提供整合性的PTCF框架，帮助其在装运前主动识别和降低合规风险，减少进口拒绝并提升运营韧性。

title: Global Exposure Reduction Strategy: A Unified Framework for Lowering Human Vulnerability Across Climate, Pollution, Conflict, and Digital Fragility

detail.title: Global Exposure Reduction Strategy: A Unified Framework for Lowering Human Vulnerability Across Climate, Pollution, Conflict, and Digital Fragility
detail.abstract:
The report presents a unified, quantitative framework for reducing human vulnerability across four accelerating systemic risk domains: climate exposure, pollution and biological degradation, geopolitical conflict, and digital fragility. It argues that the global macroeconomic system has entered a polycrisis epoch in which formerly isolated shocks now propagate through hyper‑connected networks, producing non‑linear cascading failures. As stated in the document, “cascading systemic failures are not merely possible, but highly probable without immediate, non-linear capital reallocation.”

Using advanced network geometry, thermodynamic scaling laws, and multi‑agent simulation architectures (including Fraktál‑like orchestration), the analysis maps tipping points where urban systems, supply chains, and AI‑dependent digital infrastructure transition from productive to fragile. The report identifies accelerating cost‑curve compressions in renewable energy, desalination, agri‑tech, and AI‑driven surveillance as a narrow but viable window for global resilience-building.

Across regional assessments, the study finds consistent structural deficits in adaptive capacity driven by thermal stress, critical mineral scarcity, and digital endpoint vulnerabilities. It recommends reallocating 9–15% of infrastructure budgets toward decentralized energy systems, hyper‑local manufacturing, multi‑agent AI defense layers, and continuous biological/environmental telemetry. As the report concludes, “the architecture of human civilization is currently operating beyond its thermodynamic and geometric safety limits.”

The Global Exposure Reduction Strategy ultimately proposes a shift from centralized, brittle systems to distributed, autonomous, multi-agent resilience architectures capable of maintaining continuity during compound shocks—framing this transition as essential to preserving long‑term global development trajectories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的量化框架，用于降低人类在四大系统性风险领域（气候暴露、污染与生物退化、地缘政治冲突、数字脆弱性）中的脆弱性，主张全球宏观经济系统已进入"多重危机时代"（polycrisis epoch），需要从集中化脆弱系统转向分布式、自主、多智能体的韧性架构。
AI.research_question: 如何通过统一的量化框架降低全球人类在气候、生物、地缘政治和数字领域的系统性脆弱性，并识别全球韧性建设的关键窗口？
AI.motivation: 全球宏观经济系统已进入多重危机时代，原先孤立的冲击现在通过超连接网络传播并产生非线性级联失效，现有集中化基础设施架构已超出其热力学和几何安全极限，亟需量化分析和资本再配置方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络几何学（network geometry）、热力学尺度律（thermodynamic scaling laws）、多智能体仿真架构（multi-agent simulation architectures）及级联失效理论。
AI.method: 运用高级网络几何分析、热力学尺度律以及多智能体仿真架构（包括Fraktál类编排）进行系统建模，对城市系统、供应链和AI依赖的数字基础设施的临界点进行映射，并进行区域评估。
AI.findings: 研究发现：各区域在适应性能力上存在结构性赤字，主要由热应力、关键矿产稀缺和数字端点脆弱性驱动；可再生能源、海水淡化、农业科技和AI驱动监控领域正出现成本曲线加速压缩，构成全球韧性建设的狭窄但可行的机会窗口。
AI.theory_contributions: 将热力学尺度律与网络几何学结合起来分析多重危机时代的系统性风险，提出了从集中化脆弱系统到分布式韧性架构的转型理论框架，深化了对级联失效和复合冲击下系统连续性的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议将基础设施预算的9-15%重新配置到去中心化能源系统、超本地制造、多智能体AI防御层和持续生物/环境遥测领域；提出"全球暴露减少战略"（Global Exposure Reduction Strategy），为政策制定者和投资者提供可操作的风险缓解路径。

title: Calibration Error for Decision Making

detail.title: Calibration Error for Decision Making
detail.abstract:
In modern AI workflows where prediction and decision-making are separated, an upstream prediction team must serve unknown or heterogeneous downstream decision makers. Calibration, a property of predictive models, enables this separation. It requires reported probabilities to be conditionally unbiased, so they can be trusted and directly used by any downstream decision maker without task-specific correction. 

We propose Calibration Decision Loss (CDL) as a decision-theoretic calibration error. CDL is defined as the largest improvement in expected payoff obtainable by recalibrating a predictor across all bounded decision problems. By definition, CDL captures the worst-case decision loss from miscalibration and therefore directly measures whether a predictive model is trustworthy for heterogeneous downstream users. 

Our results highlight a fundamental difference between decision-theoretic error and known calibration errors. CDL counts only biases that can change decisions, whereas standard metrics such as Expected Calibration Error (ECE) average over all prediction biases, regardless of their impact on decisions. In an online setting, this perspective leads to a prediction algorithm with near-optimal expected CDL, improving upon decision-making guarantees obtained by optimizing canonical calibration errors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出校准决策损失（CDL）作为一种决策理论视角下的校准误差度量，定义了在所有有界决策问题中，通过重校准预测器所能获得的最大预期收益改进。CDL仅计算能够改变决策的偏差，与标准校准误差（如ECE）形成根本差异，并在在线场景中实现了接近最优的期望CDL。
AI.research_question: 如何从决策理论角度定义校准误差，使其能够直接衡量预测模型对异构下游决策者的可信赖程度？
AI.motivation: 在现代AI工作流中，预测与决策分离，上游预测团队需要服务未知或异构的下游决策者。现有的校准误差度量（如ECE）平均了所有预测偏差，不区分这些偏差是否真正影响决策，因此无法直接反映模型对下游决策的实际价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 决策理论框架，将校准误差定义为重校准在各种有界决策问题中可能带来的最大预期收益改进（worst-case decision loss）。
AI.method: 提出Calibration Decision Loss (CDL)作为新的校准误差度量；通过理论分析对比CDL与标准校准误差（ECE）的差异；在在线学习场景中设计预测算法以优化期望CDL。
AI.findings: (1) CDL仅计算能改变决策的偏差，而ECE对所有预测偏差取平均，两者存在根本区别；(2) 在在线场景中，提出的预测算法可实现接近最优的期望CDL，优于通过优化经典校准误差所获得的决策保证。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从决策理论视角定义校准误差，将校准与决策价值直接关联，揭示了决策理论误差与已知校准误差之间的根本差异，扩展了校准理论的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为预测模型在异构下游决策者场景下的可信度评估提供了直接可用的度量标准，并在在线预测场景中提供了实用的算法解决方案，帮助实践者识别真正影响决策的校准偏差。

title: Metaphors for Agency: Getting Past the Paralysis of Complexity and Accelerate Transformative Change
affiliations: University of Hamburg and University of Exeter - College of Life and Environmental Sciences

detail.title: Metaphors for Agency: Getting Past the Paralysis of Complexity and Accelerate Transformative Change

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflicts of interest are known to the authors.

detail.abstract: Addressing complex, interconnected issues such as environmental sustainability and social inequality requires urgent transformative change. Yet humans did not evolve to understand complex systems easily, and those seeking change can easily become paralysed by their complexity. The use of metaphor can help people to engage with complexity, but the choice and design of metaphors in this context remain underexamined, despite the prominence of metaphor in systems thinking and sustainability discourse. To address this gap, we evaluate three metaphors for engaging with systems-the widely used 'iceberg', Donella Meadows' 'leverage points', and the emergent ecological and living systems metaphors. We show that, while these metaphors offer useful entry points, the first two often fall short in capturing the dynamic, relational, and multi-level character of systems. And whilst ecological and living-systems metaphors better foreground interdependence and embeddedness, they lack the inclusion of purposeful but bounded agency, multi-level coordination, and the possibility that small interventions at key leverage points can redirect larger collective trajectories without presuming full central control. This creates a need for a metaphor that can capture multi-level, multidirectional processes of change. Consequently, we apply metaphor design principles to develop our own generative, three-part, nautical metaphor for transformation of complex systems: 1) the flap rudders, 2) on a fleet of ships, 3) sailing through the environment. The flap rudder metaphor conveys how a tiny intervention (the flap) can move a modest thing (the rudder) and then a large thing (the whole ship) through leverage. The fleet conveys how larger-scale change depends on the coordinated movement of interdependent actors, enabled by mutual protection, coordination, and support. The wider environment shows how transformation is shaped not only by leverage and coordination within systems, but also by the ecological and contextual conditions in which those systems are situated. We apply the new and existing metaphors to a case studyelectric vehicles-and evaluate their capacity to provide insights that facilitate action in the face of complexity. Throughout, we demonstrate how design science approaches can enhance the development of more effective tools for communicating and thinking about complex phenomena when paired with guidance suited to the particular design challenge, thereby inviting broader use of such approaches across research contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了三种用于理解复杂系统的隐喻（冰山、杠杆点、生态/生命系统隐喻），指出现有隐喻在捕捉动态性、关系性和多层次性方面的不足，并基于隐喻设计原则开发了一个新的三部分航海隐喻（襟翼舵+船队+航行环境），以更好地表征复杂系统转型中多层次、多方向的变革过程。
AI.research_question: 如何设计和选择有效的隐喻，帮助人们更好地理解和应对复杂系统（如环境可持续性和社会不平等）的转型变革？
AI.motivation: 人类在进化上并不擅长理解复杂系统，容易因复杂性而陷入瘫痪。隐喻虽被广泛用于系统思维和可持续性话语中，但关于隐喻的选择和设计仍缺乏系统审视。现有隐喻（冰山、杠杆点）未能充分捕捉系统的动态性、关系性和多层次性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统思维理论、隐喻设计原则、生态与生命系统理论
AI.method: 隐喻比较评估与设计科学方法：先评估三种现有隐喻（冰山、杠杆点、生态/生命系统隐喻）的优劣，再应用隐喻设计原则开发新的航海隐喻，并通过电动汽车案例研究对新旧隐喻的洞察力进行实证评估。
AI.findings: 1) 冰山和杠杆点隐喻难以捕捉系统的动态性、关系性和多层次性；2) 生态/生命系统隐喻更好地突出了相互依存和嵌入性，但缺乏有目的但有界的能动性、多层次协调以及关键杠杆点的小干预可改变集体轨迹的机制；3) 新开发的航海隐喻（襟翼舵+船队+环境）成功整合了多层次、多方向的变革过程。
AI.theory_contributions: 为系统转型的隐喻设计提供了理论框架，展示了设计科学方法如何与隐喻设计原则相结合以开发更有效的认知工具；填补了复杂系统转型中隐喻选择与设计缺乏系统化研究的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实践者和政策制定者提供了更有效的航海隐喻，帮助其在面对复杂系统（如电动汽车转型）时更好地识别杠杆作用、协调多方行动并关注生态环境约束，从而促进实际变革行动。

title: From Asset Classification to Intermediary Governance: A Bibliometric and Doctrinal Review of Crypto-Asset Exchange Regulation

detail.title: From Asset Classification to Intermediary Governance: A Bibliometric and Doctrinal Review of Crypto-Asset Exchange Regulation
detail.abstract: Crypto-asset exchanges have moved from the periphery of cryptocurrency law to the centre of financialregulatory design. Yet the literature remains divided among licensing, custody, market abuse, anti-money laundering, operational resilience and private-law protection, making it difficult to identify whether these strands amount to a coherent law of exchange intermediation. This article combines bibliometric mapping with doctrinal synthesis to reconstruct that field. An OpenAlex title-and-abstract search produced 536 article and review records. After relevance screening, 152 records were classified as core exchange/VASP/CASP studies, 269 as regulatory-supporting studies, and 18 as contextual studies; the principal bibliometric corpus therefore comprised 421 records, with 439 retained for the extended qualitative review. A DOI/APIresolvable subcorpus of 387 records was analysed in VOSviewer 1.6.21. The results show a clear shift from asset classification and virtual-currency status toward intermediary governance. Three connected research regions dominate the term network: exchange structure and organisational risk; institutionalisation through VASP/CASP licensing, MiCA and investor protection; and AML/CFT, legal status, licensing and transaction supervision. Bibliographic coupling nevertheless reveals weak integration between public regulation and private-law protection, between market entry and exit, and between domestic licensing and cross-border enforcement. Using Vietnam's post-2025 regulatory transition as a stress test, the article argues that the most productive unit of legal analysis is not the token but the multifunctional intermediary. It develops a ten-pillar regulatory-lifecycle framework spanning perimeter, entry, governance, conflicts, custody, market integrity, AML/CFT, operational resilience, supervision and exit. The framework offers a comparative tool for evaluating emerging crypto-asset exchange regimes beyond formal licensing alone.

AI.tldr: 本文通过文献计量学映射与教义学综合相结合的方法，系统重构了加密资产交易所监管研究领域，发现研究已从资产分类转向中介治理，但公共监管与私法保护、市场准入与退出、国内许可与跨境执法之间仍缺乏整合。作者提出以多功能中介而非代币为核心的分析单位，并构建了涵盖十个支柱的监管生命周期框架，以越南2025年后的监管转型作为压力测试验证该框架的适用性。
AI.research_question: 加密资产交易所的监管文献是否构成一个连贯的交易所中介监管法律领域？各研究分支之间如何整合？以多功能中介为分析单位的监管框架能否更好地评估新兴加密资产交易所监管制度？
AI.motivation: 加密资产交易所已从加密货币法律的边缘进入金融监管设计的中心，但现有文献分裂于许可、托管、市场滥用、反洗钱、运营韧性和私法保护等多个独立领域，难以判断这些分支是否构成连贯的交易所中介监管法律体系，且缺乏统一的比较分析工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以"多功能中介"为法律分析单位的理论视角，结合监管生命周期框架（涵盖边界、准入、治理、冲突、托管、市场诚信、反洗钱、运营韧性、监管和退出十个支柱）。
AI.method: 混合方法：首先通过OpenAlex进行标题与摘要检索（获得536条记录），经相关性筛选后分类为核心交易所/VASP/CASP研究（152条）、监管支撑研究（269条）和情境研究（18条）；然后使用VOSviewer 1.6.21对387条DOI/API可解析子语料进行文献计量分析（术语网络与书目耦合分析）；最后结合教义学综合与越南2025年后监管转型压力测试。
AI.findings: 研究发现：第一，研究重心已从资产分类和虚拟货币地位明显转向中介治理；第二，术语网络存在三个相互关联的研究区域——交易所结构与组织风险、通过VASP/CASP许可与MiCA及投资者保护的制度化、以及反洗钱/反恐融资、法律地位、许可和交易监管；第三，书目耦合揭示了公共监管与私法保护之间、市场准入与退出之间、国内许可与跨境执法之间存在薄弱整合。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出以多功能中介（而非代币）作为加密资产法律分析的最有效单位，构建了十支柱监管生命周期框架，为理解加密资产交易所监管提供了一个连贯的理论整合视角，弥补了现有文献各分支相互割裂的不足。
AI.practical_contributions: 十支柱框架可作为比较工具，超越正式的许可制度来评估新兴加密资产交易所监管制度；为越南等正在经历监管转型的国家以及各国监管机构设计综合性的交易所监管政策提供了可操作的分析框架。

title: Talking About Platform Labour: The Voice of the Last-Mile Workers, Between Freedom, Exploitation and ‘Slaverty’
affiliations: , University of Valladolid - Universidad de Valladolid and University of Valladolid - Universidad de Valladolid

detail.title: Talking About Platform Labour: The Voice of the Last-Mile Workers, Between Freedom, Exploitation and ‘Slaverty’

declarations.ethicsApproval: In this study participants gave informed consent, with their identities protected via pseudonyms in compliance with the UPF Committee for Ethical Review of Projects (CIREP) (Ref. 166).
declarations.funderStatement: The PLATCOM project (2020-24) was supported by the Ministry of Science, Innovation and Universities and the State Research Agency under Grant PID2019-109846RB-I00.

detail.abstract: This article examines the discursive dynamics of platform labour through the voices of 'last-mile' workers in Spain. Based on fieldwork conducted between 2020 and 2024 in Barcelona and Madrid, it analyses narratives from delivery, care and driving sectors to explore how workers articulate their lived experiences and the ideological frameworks shaping them. Drawing on 73 in-depth interviews with 48 platform workers, the study combines Critical Discourse Analysis, socio-semiotics and rhetoric to examine invoked entities and meta-collectives, metaphors, selfexplanatory nominal forms and ideological markers. The analysis reveals a set of tensions and contradictions condensed in the neologism slaverty, which captures the ambivalent coexistence of empowerment and exploitation in platform workers' discourse. The findings show how freedom, autonomy and flexibility are constantly negotiated with precarity, dependence and control, shaping workers' perceptions, experiences and forms of engagement within Spain's increasingly platformised labour market and everyday service economy during and after the COVID-19 pandemic.

AI.tldr: 本文通过西班牙巴塞罗那和马德里2020-2024年的田野调查，基于对48名平台工人的73次深度访谈，结合批判性话语分析、社会符号学和修辞学，揭示了平台劳工话语中的矛盾张力。研究发现新造词"slaverty"凝聚了赋权与剥削的并存矛盾，展现了自由、自主、灵活与不稳定、依赖、控制之间的持续协商。
AI.research_question: 平台劳工如何通过话语表达其生活经验，以及塑造这些经验的意识形态框架是什么？
AI.motivation: 平台经济（特别是"最后一英里"配送、照护和驾驶行业）快速扩张，但工人自身的声音和话语实践在学术研究中相对缺乏深入分析，尤其是在南欧（西班牙）背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判性话语分析（CDA）、社会符号学、修辞学理论，涉及对唤起实体、元集体、隐喻、自解释性名词形式及意识形态标记的分析。
AI.method: 定性研究：2020-2024年在巴塞罗那和马德里进行田野调查，对配送、照护和驾驶三大行业的48名平台工人进行了73次深度访谈，运用批判性话语分析、社会符号学和修辞学方法分析访谈语料。
AI.findings: 研究发现平台工人话语中同时存在赋权与剥削的矛盾张力，凝缩于新造词"slaverty"中。自由、自主和灵活性不断与不稳定、依赖和控制相互协商，形塑了工人对平台化劳动市场的感知、经历和参与方式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"slaverty"这一概念性新造词，捕捉了平台劳动话语中赋权与剥削的辩证共存；丰富了平台劳动研究与批判性话语分析的交汇领域，揭示了意识形态框架如何通过话语实践在工人主体性中运作。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解西班牙（及更广泛的南欧语境）平台化劳动市场中的工人体验提供了实证洞察；对政策制定者、平台企业和工会组织理解工人话语诉求及其矛盾心态具有参考价值，特别是在后疫情时代的日常服务业背景下。

reference: University of Pennsylvania Journal of Business Law
title: The Market Solution to Private Credit's Stress
affiliations: University of South Dakota Law School

detail.title: The Market Solution to Private Credit's Stress

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Pennsylvania Journal of Business Law

detail.abstract:
Private credit is a hybrid lending model that combines banks’ relationship-lending paradigm with the investor-funded structures of the public credit markets. Private credit's first sustained period of market stress reveals the industry’s responses to mounting redemption requests, valuation criticisms, and fears of fire-sale risk. Unlike banks, private credit funds are not prudentially regulated to mitigate these risks; unlike public credit markets, they lack a robust secondary trading infrastructure. Consequently, funds’ responses to stress are shaped less by prudential regulation and secondary market liquidity than by their external funding arrangements, internal structures, and managerial incentives.

Private credit is better calibrated to the illiquidity of its underlying assets than recent commentary suggests. Most private credit funds do not perform a liquidity transformation function associated with banks: investors lack direct claims to the fund assets, have no redemption rights, and cannot force immediate liquidation. Even semi-liquid vehicles that allow periodic withdrawals gate redemptions while raising liquidity through loans, portfolio cash flows, or orderly asset sales.

The critiques of private credit valuation practices identify genuine shortcomings, but they are symptomatic of the asset class, not grounds for treating private credit funds like banks. Until private credit develops a robust secondary market, valuations for illiquid direct loans will remain highly discretionary. Investors recognize this reality and have prioritized realized returns over mark-to-model estimates. The quest for high returns despite the illiquidity risk further distinguishes private credit investors from depositors and makes prudential bank-like regulation a poor fit.

The most promising response to private credit’s liquidity and valuation challenges is the development of a robust private credit secondary market. Deeper trading of private loans would improve price discovery, expand liquidity options for funds and investors, and reduce reliance on discretionary valuations. Momentum toward more active secondary trading is already building, and policymakers should facilitate that evolution rather than respond with increasingly bank-like prudential regulation. The question is no longer whether private credit will converge with the public debt markets, but how. This Article argues that the next stage of that convergence should be driven by market infrastructure rather than prudential regulation.

AI.tldr: 本文分析私人信贷在首次持续市场压力下的表现，认为其并非像银行那样从事流动性转换，估值批评也仅是资产类别的症状而非银行化监管的理由。文章主张最有效的应对是发展私人信贷二级市场，以市场基础设施而非审慎监管推动与公共债务市场的融合。
AI.research_question: 私人信贷在面临市场压力时，应通过何种机制（审慎监管还是二级市场基础设施）来应对流动性和估值挑战？私人信贷是否应被视为银行而受到类似银行的审慎监管？
AI.motivation: 私人信贷经历了首次持续的市场压力期，面临赎回请求增加、估值批评和抛售风险担忧。与银行不同，私人信贷基金不受审慎监管以缓解这些风险；与公共信贷市场不同，其缺乏强大的二级交易基础设施。在此背景下，需要厘清私人信贷的本质特征及其最优应对路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合借贷模型理论（结合银行关系借贷与公共信贷市场的投资者资助结构）、流动性转换理论、审慎监管理论、二级市场定价与价格发现理论。
AI.method: 定性分析/规范性法律经济学分析：对比银行与私人信贷基金在监管框架、流动性结构、投资者权利和估值实践上的差异，并结合市场机制分析提出政策建议。
AI.findings: （1）私人信贷基金大多不执行银行的流动性转换功能：投资者对基金资产无直接索取权、无赎回权、不能强制清算；半流动产品也通过门禁机制限制赎回。（2）估值批评虽揭示真实缺陷，但属于资产类别的固有症状，不应据此将私人信贷基金当作银行对待。（3）私人信贷投资者重视实际回报而非按模型估值，与存款人存在本质区别。（4）最有前景的应对是发展私人信贷二级市场，以改善价格发现、扩大流动性选项并减少对自由裁量估值的依赖。
AI.theory_contributions: 文章挑战了将私人信贷基金类比为银行并适用银行式审慎监管的理论主张，论证了私人信贷在流动性结构、投资者权利和估值现实上与银行存在本质区别，为私人信贷的监管理论提供了新的分析框架，提出"市场基础设施驱动型融合"替代"审慎监管驱动型融合"的理论路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供明确的政策建议：应促进私人信贷二级市场的发展而非对私人信贷基金施加银行式审慎监管；为私人信贷行业参与者指出了市场基础设施建设的优先方向，包括改善价格发现、扩大流动性选项、减少对自由裁量估值的依赖。

title: Matching Technology and Competition in Ride-hailing Marketplaces
affiliations: University of Wisconsin-Madison - Department of Operations and Information Management and University of California, Riverside (UCR) - A. Gary Anderson Graduate School of Management

detail.title: Matching Technology and Competition in Ride-hailing Marketplaces
detail.abstract:
Problem definition: We study how operational differences influence competition between taxis and Uber. Taxis and Uber differ in their matching technology -- taxis use street hailing while Uber drivers use central dispatch -- and in their supply elasticity -- taxi supply is fixed by regulation while Uber's supply is determined by the number of drivers who choose to drive. Inspired by the launch of Uber Taxi, we ask whether taxis benefit from adopting central dispatch.

Methodology/results: We construct a model where matching frictions drive competition for two types of wait-sensitive passengers: constrained passengers, who need a ride within a limited time frame and choose the service more likely to meet this deadline, and unconstrained passengers, who choose the service with shorter expected wait. In the status quo equilibrium, where taxis use street hailing and Uber uses central dispatch, we find that differentiated matching technology can segment the market: street hailing appeals to constrained passengers by delivering a high chance of a shorter-than-average wait while central dispatch appeals to unconstrained passengers by offering short average wait. Centralizing taxi dispatch does not necessarily increase taxi market share, for two reasons. First, losses among constrained passengers need not be offset by gains among unconstrained passengers. Second, under dispatch parity, Uber drivers may participate in greater numbers than before. Lacking a similar supply elasticity, taxis are left less competitive with both passenger types. Together, these effects can leave taxis with less market share than in the status quo.

Managerial implications: This work shows that a seemingly straightforward improvement in matching technology can erode, rather than expand, taxis’ market share. Our results demonstrate that taxis evaluating matching technologies must consider the entire wait-time distribution, not just its mean, and account for competitors' supply-side responses. In some scenarios, a matching technology with a longer average wait yields a larger market share.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了出租车与Uber之间的运营差异如何影响竞争。出租车使用路边招手匹配，供应量受监管限制；Uber使用中央调度，供应量由司机自主决定。研究发现，出租车采用中央调度并不一定能提升市场份额，因为可能失去对时间紧迫乘客的吸引力，同时Uber的供应弹性会使其在调度对等下增加司机参与，反而使出租车竞争力下降。
AI.research_question: 出租车是否能够通过采用中央调度技术（如Uber Taxi）来提升其市场竞争力？
AI.motivation: 出租车和Uber在匹配技术和供应弹性上存在根本差异，Uber Taxi的推出引发了一个重要问题：简单的技术改进（从街头招手改为中央调度）是否真的能让出租车受益？
AI.theoretical_framework: 匹配摩擦驱动的竞争模型；乘客分为两类：受限乘客（对等待时间有限制，选择更可能满足截止时间的服务）和非受限乘客（选择期望等待时间更短的服务）
AI.method: 构建理论模型，分析两种匹配技术（街头招手与中央调度）在不同乘客类型下的竞争均衡，并比较现状均衡与调度对等均衡下的市场份额。
AI.findings: （1）差异化的匹配技术可以细分市场：街头招手吸引受限乘客（提供高于平均水平的短等待概率），中央调度吸引非受限乘客（提供更短的平均等待）。（2）出租车采用中央调度不必然提升市场份额：受限乘客的损失可能无法被非受限乘客的获益所抵消；调度对等下Uber司机参与数增加，供应弹性差异使出租车竞争力进一步下降。（3）在某些情境下，平均等待更长的匹配技术反而能带来更大的市场份额。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示匹配技术差异化作为市场细分机制的作用；将供应弹性引入匹配技术竞争的考量；表明评估匹配技术不能只看平均等待时间，而需考虑完整的等待时间分布。
AI.practical_contributions: 为出租车行业评估匹配技术升级提供警示：单纯采用中央调度可能侵蚀而非扩大市场份额；管理者需考虑完整的等待时间分布以及竞争对手的供应侧反应。

title: Simultaneous School Applications with Expectations-Based Reference Dependence
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Information Systems, Business Statistics and Operations Management

detail.title: Simultaneous School Applications with Expectations-Based Reference Dependence
detail.abstract:
School applications are a simultaneous-search problem. Before admission outcomes are known, applicants choose a costly portfolio of schools and ultimately enroll in the most preferred school among those offering admission. Standard models evaluate application portfolios using expected placement value and application costs. However, application portfolios also shape applicants' expectations, creating the possibility that anticipated disappointment influences application choices. Motivated by evidence that expectations-based loss aversion affects school-choice behavior, we study application portfolios when outcomes are evaluated relative to expectations generated by the portfolio itself. The self-evaluated utility of a portfolio admits an exact representation as expected value and a loss-aversion-weighted measure of pairwise outcome dispersion. The choice-acclimating personal equilibrium (CPE) is the portfolio that maximizes self-evaluated utility, and the actual portfolio choice must be behaviorally credible through preferred personal equilibrium (PPE). 

For independent admissions outcomes, pairwise dispersion satisfies a global Lipschitz bound, yielding structural insights and computational screening rules for PPE. In an exchangeable school environment, every PPE portfolio is weakly larger than the CPE, while in a safety-reach environment a highly selective school rejected by CPE may nevertheless persist in PPE. For correlated admissions generated by a common applicant score, we derive an exact state-weight representation and identify an upper-tail paradox: stronger reference dependence can make an elite reach school less attractive to add ex ante, yet harder to remove once its admission possibility becomes part of the applicant's reference distribution. Overall, loss aversion need not reduce application volume or favor conservative portfolios.

AI.tldr: 本文研究期望损失厌恶如何影响学校申请组合的选择。申请组合不仅产生预期价值，还塑造了申请者的期望参照点，因此申请结果相对于自身组合产生的期望进行评估。文章引入自评估效用概念，将其精确表示为期望价值与损失厌恶加权的两两结果离散度之和，并在CPE和PPE框架下刻画最优组合的决策逻辑，发现损失厌恶并不必然会减少申请数量或偏向保守组合。
AI.research_question: 当申请结果相对于申请组合自身产生的期望进行评估时（期望损失厌恶），申请者如何选择学校申请组合？损失厌恶如何影响组合的结构、规模与选择行为？
AI.motivation: 标准模型仅考虑期望安置价值和申请成本，但经验证据表明期望损失厌恶会影响学校选择行为。申请组合不仅带来结果，也塑造了申请者的期望参照点，因此传统模型可能遗漏了期望形成的渠道，需要构建将参照点内生于组合选择的模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 期望损失厌恶（expectations-based loss aversion）、选择适应个人均衡（CPE）、偏好个人均衡（PPE）、参照依赖偏好。
AI.method: 理论建模与均衡分析。对独立录取结果建立全局Lipschitz界以获得结构洞见和计算筛选规则；在可交换学校环境中比较CPE与PPE组合大小；在安全-冲刺环境中分析精英学校在PPE下的存续；对由共同申请者分数驱动的相关录取建立精确状态权重表示。
AI.findings: （1）独立录取下，两两离散度满足全局Lipschitz界，可将非CPE组合排除在PPE之外；（2）可交换环境中，每个PPE组合弱大于CPE组合；（3）安全-冲刺环境中，被CPE拒绝的高选择性学校可能在PPE中存续；（4）存在上尾悖论：更强的参照依赖使精英冲刺学校在事前更难被添加，但一旦纳入参照分布则更难被移除；（5）总体而言，损失厌恶不必然减少申请数量或偏向保守组合。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将期望损失厌恶引入学校申请组合选择模型，建立了自评估效用的精确分解表示；刻画了损失厌恶下CPE与PPE之间的结构性差异；揭示了参照依赖偏好在组合选择中产生的新奇现象（上尾悖论、PPE组合偏大等）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为申请者提供了考虑损失厌恶时的组合筛选规则和计算工具；揭示了影响申请组合规模与构成的非传统因素，有助于政策和咨询实践理解申请行为的系统性偏差；对学校招生政策的设计（如录取结果发布时机对申请者期望与决策的影响）具有启示意义。

title: Beyond Technical Compliance IV: Whose Safety? Linguistic Hegemony as Designed Fragility-Cross-Regional Evidence and the Cooperative Alignment Assessment Framework

detail.title: Beyond Technical Compliance IV: Whose Safety? Linguistic Hegemony as Designed Fragility-Cross-Regional Evidence and the Cooperative Alignment Assessment Framework
detail.abstract: Current AI safety frameworks claim technical neutrality while systematically privileging English-language and Western cultural contexts. This paper presents cross-regional empirical evidence from Japan (CJK character corruption, behavioural manipulation), West Africa (safety capability gap: 90% English refusal rate vs. 35-55% in low-resource languages), and Norway (tokenization failures undermining semantic integrity), demonstrating that these failures are not company-specific anomalies but architectural priorities observed across independently developed systems-what this paper terms designed fragilities. Three independently developed systems, built by three different companies, exhibit the same structural failures, confirming that linguistic hegemony is not incidental but embedded in the architecture of AI development. I present the Cooperative Alignment Assessment Framework (CAAF): a four-dimensional evaluation structure measuring behavioural accountability, cultural and linguistic integrity, measurement inclusivity, and stakeholder participation depth. Grounded in the Japanese cultural figure of Doraemon and Shin'ichi Hoshi's 1971 literary foresight, CAAF offers a third governance path beyond EU precautionary regulation and US market-driven models-one that treats AI governance as intentional socio-technical co-creation across diverse cultural stakeholders rather than technical compliance with hegemonic standards.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"设计脆弱性"（designed fragilities）概念，指出当前AI安全框架表面技术中立实则系统性偏向英语和西方文化语境。通过日本、西非、挪威三个地区的跨区域实证证据，证明语言霸权嵌入AI架构而非偶然缺陷。作者提出合作对齐评估框架（CAAF），提供欧盟预防性监管和美国市场驱动模式之外的第三条治理路径。
AI.research_question: AI安全框架是否真正技术中立？语言霸权和文化偏见是否内嵌于AI系统架构之中，而非公司个别的技术失误？
AI.motivation: 现有AI安全框架声称技术中立，但缺乏系统性跨区域实证证据来证明AI系统中语言和文化偏见的结构性、架构性本质，而非偶然性缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 设计脆弱性理论（designed fragilities）、语言霸权理论、社会技术共创理论（socio-technical co-creation）、基于日本文化符号（哆啦A梦、星新一1971年文学预见）的治理框架
AI.method: 跨区域实证研究：日本（CJK字符损坏、行为操纵）、西非（安全能力差距：英语拒绝率90% vs. 低资源语言35-55%）、挪威（分词失败破坏语义完整性）。分析三个独立开发的系统以确认结构失败的一致性。
AI.findings: 三个不同公司独立开发的系统表现出相同的结构性失败模式，证明语言霸权并非偶然而是嵌入AI开发架构之中。具体表现为：日语CJK字符损坏和行为操纵问题、西非地区低资源语言安全能力显著落后（差距达35-55个百分点）、挪威语因分词失败导致语义完整性受损。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"设计脆弱性"（designed fragilities）概念，将AI语言偏见从"公司特定异常"重新定义为"架构性优先选择"；提出合作对齐评估框架（CAAF）四维评估结构；引入日本文化视角（哆啦A梦、星新一）作为治理理论的文化基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供CAAF作为可操作的AI治理评估工具（行为问责、文化与语言完整性、测量包容性、利益相关者参与深度四维度）；提出超越欧盟预防性监管和美国市场驱动的第三种治理路径，促进跨文化利益相关者的社会技术共创。

title: Black Hole Economics: An Accretion-Based Mathematical Framework for Economic Concentration and Capital Dynamics

detail.title: Black Hole Economics: An Accretion-Based Mathematical Framework for Economic Concentration and Capital Dynamics
detail.abstract: Economic systems are characterized by continuous movements of capital, investment, labour, knowledge, and productive resources across firms, sectors, regions, and economic centres. In some circumstances, these flows may generate self-reinforcing patterns of economic concentration in which already dominant economic centres attract disproportionately large quantities of additional resources. Such concentration may be associated with increasing returns, network effects, agglomeration economies, technological advantages, financial complementarities, and institutional advantages. This paper develops a nonlinear dynamical framework for studying such selfreinforcing economic concentration using an analogy inspired by accretion processes in high-energy astrophysics. The framework does not interpret an economic system as a literal astrophysical black hole. Instead, selected structural features of accretion dynamics-including attraction, accumulation, dispersion, and feedback-are translated into mathematically defined economic mechanisms. We formulate a coupled nonlinear dynamical system in which economic concentration evolves through exogenous capital inflow, nonlinear economic accretion, dispersive forces, and endogenous feedback. The model permits the derivation of equilibrium conditions and local stability criteria. A model-defined critical concentration threshold, termed the Economic Event Horizon, is introduced to distinguish dispersion-dominated and accretion-dominated economic regimes. The framework is intended as a theoretical contribution at the intersection of mathematical economics, econophysics, and high-energy-astrophysics-inspired modelling. Numerical analysis can subsequently be used to investigate how changes in the strength of nonlinear attraction, economic dispersion, and feedback influence the stability and concentration of an economic system. The proposed framework provides a basis for examining whether strongly nonlinear resource-attraction mechanisms can produce persistent and self-reinforcing economic concentration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个受高能天体物理学中吸积过程启发的非线性动力学框架，用于研究经济系统中的自增强性经济集中现象。该框架将吸引、积累、分散和反馈等吸积动力学的结构特征转化为数学定义的经济机制，构建了一个耦合非线性动力系统，并引入了"经济事件视界"这一关键浓度阈值来区分分散主导型和吸积主导型经济体制。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个非线性动力学框架来研究经济系统中的自增强性经济集中现象？特别是，强非线性资源吸引机制能否产生持久且自增强的经济集中？
AI.motivation: 经济系统普遍存在资本、投资、劳动力、知识和生产性资源在企业、部门、区域和经济中心之间的持续流动，这些流动在某些情况下会产生自增强的经济集中模式，而已有理论工具对这类非线性聚集动态的刻画尚不充分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非线性动力学理论；受高能天体物理学吸积动力学启发的类比建模（吸引、积累、分散、反馈机制）；经济事件视界概念；均衡条件与局部稳定性分析
AI.method: 构建耦合非线性动力系统模型，包含外生资本流入、非线性经济吸积、分散力和内生反馈四个机制；推导均衡条件与局部稳定性准则；定义临界浓度阈值（经济事件视界）以区分不同经济体制；后续可通过数值分析研究参数变化的影响。
AI.findings: 模型能够推导出均衡条件和局部稳定性判据；通过"经济事件视界"阈值可以区分分散主导和吸积主导两种经济体制；数值分析可揭示非线性吸引强度、经济分散和反馈的变化如何影响经济系统的稳定性和集中度。
AI.theory_contributions: 在数学经济学、经济物理学与高能天体物理学启发建模的交叉领域做出了理论贡献，为研究非线性资源吸引机制与自增强经济集中的关系提供了新的形式化分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为分析经济集中度与区域发展不平衡提供理论工具，有助于理解强非线性资源吸引机制对经济系统稳定性的影响，可为经济政策制定（如区域平衡发展政策）提供理论基础。

reference: Bani Waleed University Journal of Humanities and Applied Sciences (2026), volume 2, issue 11, pp. 172-186.
title: Data-Driven Interventions in Higher Education: Enhancing Student Performance through Educational Data Mining
affiliations: Bani Waleed University, Bani Waleed University and Libyan Center for Engineering Research and Information Technology

detail.title: Data-Driven Interventions in Higher Education: Enhancing Student Performance through Educational Data Mining

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bani Waleed University Journal of Humanities and Applied Sciences (2026), volume 2, issue 11, pp. 172-186.

detail.abstract: This paper aims to explore how data mining can enhance performance in higher education while taking into account external factors such as socioeconomic status, family background, and access to different resources. The study analyzes student performance records for the Computer Science Department for two semesters, Fall and Spring term. Descriptive statistics, data visualization, and hypothesis testing techniques were applied to assess the overall performance of students in response to the interventions. The results indicate an increase in performance during Spring term due to changes made in the methods of pedagogy, framing of the curriculum, and system supports provided in the semester, guided by data. This study finds that data mining has the ability to assist in revealing students who may not perform well and provide the needed assistance to help attain increased participation in higher education. It also establishes that data mining can significantly improve academic performance, lessen performance discrepancies, and assist in building a more favorable academic environment.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了数据挖掘如何提升高等教育中的学生表现，同时考虑社会经济地位、家庭背景和资源获取等外部因素。研究分析了计算机科学系两个学期（秋季和春季）的学生成绩记录，采用描述性统计、数据可视化和假设检验技术评估干预措施下的学生整体表现。结果表明，在数据指导下对教学方法、课程框架和系统支持进行改进后，春季学期的学生表现有所提升。研究发现数据挖掘有助于识别可能表现不佳的学生，并提供必要帮助以提升高等教育参与度，同时可显著改善学业表现、缩小表现差距并构建更有利的学术环境。
AI.research_question: 数据挖掘如何结合社会经济地位、家庭背景和资源获取等外部因素来提升高等教育中的学生学术表现？
AI.motivation: 高等教育中存在学生表现差异的问题，需要一种系统性的方法来识别可能表现不佳的学生并提供针对性支持，同时考虑影响学生表现的外部因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据挖掘理论在教育领域的应用，结合教育干预理论与学生表现评估框架，考虑社会经济地位和家庭背景等因素对学生学业的影响。
AI.method: 分析了计算机科学系两个学期（秋季和春季）的学生成绩记录，采用描述性统计、数据可视化和假设检验技术来评估学生在教学干预下的整体表现变化。
AI.findings: 春季学期学生表现有所提升，这归因于在数据驱动指导下对教学方法、课程框架和系统支持所做的改变。数据挖掘能够识别可能表现不佳的学生，改善学术表现，缩小表现差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了数据挖掘可以作为识别学业风险学生和评估教育干预效果的有效工具，为教育数据挖掘领域提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高等教育机构提供了一种基于数据驱动的方法来改进教学策略、优化课程设计，并通过精准识别需要帮助的学生来提升整体教育质量和学生参与度。

title: The Discomfort of Leadership

detail.title: The Discomfort of Leadership

declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This research involved no human participants, personal data collection, or experimental procedures requiring ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Leadership is commonly described through authority, influence, decisiveness, service, courage, or the ability to mobilize others toward collective objectives. These accounts capture important dimensions of leadership but leave unresolved a structural problem: consequential authority is exercised under incomplete knowledge, while its effects are distributed among people who often possess information the decision-maker does not.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，传统领导力描述（如权威、影响力、决断力、服务、勇气或动员能力）虽然抓住了领导力的重要维度，但遗留了一个结构性难题：关键权威在信息不完整的情况下行使，而其影响却分散到常常拥有决策者所不具备信息的人们身上。
AI.research_question: 领导力中存在的结构性难题：如何在信息不完备的情况下行使权威，同时其影响又分散到拥有不同信息的人身上？
AI.motivation: 传统领导力理论虽然从权威、影响力、决断力、服务、勇气等多个维度描述了领导力，但未能解决一个根本性的结构问题——决策者在信息不完整条件下行使权威，而决策后果却由掌握不同信息的人承担。
AI.theoretical_framework: 领导力理论（涉及权威、影响力、决断力、服务、勇气、动员能力等多个维度）与信息不对称/知识分布理论。
AI.method: 本文为理论性/概念性论文，基于对现有领导力描述的逻辑分析，揭示了其中的结构性矛盾。
AI.findings: 传统领导力描述未能解决结构性难题：权威行使与知识分布之间的脱节——决策者缺乏必要信息，而信息分散在受决策影响的人手中。
AI.theory_contributions: 指出了领导力理论中的一个核心结构性盲区，即信息不对称条件下权威行使与责任分配的悖论，为领导力理论的进一步完善提供了方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示组织在领导实践中需要重视信息分布问题，重新思考决策机制与信息共享的结构性安排，以弥合决策权威与知识分布之间的鸿沟。

title: Dynamic Permit Budgeting under Mobility Uncertainty: A Mean Field Equilibrium Model of Periodic Driving Restrictions
affiliations: School of Economics and Management, Beihang University, School of Economics and Management, Beihang University, School of Economics and Management, Beihang University and Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Civil Engineering

detail.title: Dynamic Permit Budgeting under Mobility Uncertainty: A Mean Field Equilibrium Model of Periodic Driving Restrictions
detail.abstract: This paper studies a periodic permit-based driving restriction scheme in which commuters receive a finite number of non-tradable driving permits over a planning horizon. Driving consumes one permit, while taking public transit preserves the remaining permit balance. Commuters face uncertain daily travel needs and differ in the additional disutility of using transit when urgent needs arise. To capture the resulting intertemporal tradeoff, we formulate an individual dynamic logit model under a conjectured congestion path and embed the induced responses in a mean-field user equilibrium. The analysis identifies the dynamic opportunity cost of permit use as the key mechanism linking current driving decisions with future mobility flexibility. We establish structural properties of this opportunity cost and characterize how commuter heterogeneity affects driving probabilities through the interaction between urgent day driving incentives and regular day permit preservation. The analysis further shows that permit budgeting varies with the urgency environment and commuter heterogeneity, thereby clarifying who budgets and when in a periodic driving permit system. Numerical experiments then show that the timing, intensity, and persistence of urgent travel needs reshape equilibrium permit use and the resulting aggregate driving patterns. Compared with a rigid benchmark, the proposed scheme reallocates driving access toward more valuable days and reduces urgent-state transit burden. Permit endowment has a nonmonotone effect on system performance, highlighting the need to balance mobility flexibility and congestion control.

AI.tldr: 本文研究周期性基于许可的驾驶限制方案，通勤者在规划期内获得有限数量的不可交易驾驶许可，每天驾驶消耗一个许可，而乘坐公交则保留许可余额。通勤者面临不确定的每日出行需求，并在紧急需求下使用公交存在不同程度的不便。通过个体动态logit模型嵌入平均场用户均衡，识别了许可使用的动态机会成本这一关键机制，并刻画了通勤者异质性如何影响驾驶概率及许可预算行为。
AI.research_question: 在周期性驾驶许可限制方案下，通勤者如何根据不确定的日常出行需求在驾驶与公交之间做出跨期决策？许可使用的动态机会成本如何影响驾驶概率和许可预算行为？
AI.motivation: 传统驾驶限制方案（如尾号限行）缺乏灵活性，无法将驾驶机会分配给更有价值的日期。周期性许可方案提供了灵活性，但需要理解通勤者面临不确定需求时的跨期权衡行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 个体动态logit模型、平均场用户均衡、动态机会成本理论
AI.method: 构建个体动态logit模型，嵌入平均场用户均衡框架，通过数值实验分析参数变化对均衡许可使用和整体驾驶模式的影响。
AI.findings: 许可使用的动态机会成本是连接当前驾驶决策与未来机动性灵活性的关键机制；通勤者异质性通过紧急日驾驶激励与常规日许可保留的交互影响驾驶概率；许可预算行为随紧急环境和通勤者异质性变化；紧急出行需求的时间、强度和持续性重塑均衡许可使用；与刚性基准相比，该方案将驾驶机会重新分配给更有价值的日期并减少紧急状态公交负担；许可配给量对系统性能有非单调影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 识别并刻画了许可使用动态机会成本的结构性质；阐明了通勤者异质性如何通过跨期交互影响驾驶概率和许可预算行为。
AI.practical_contributions: 为周期性驾驶许可方案的设计提供理论依据，特别是关于许可配给量的设定需要平衡机动性灵活性与拥堵控制；揭示了紧急出行需求特征对方案实施效果的影响。

title: Collective Intelligence Of Coalitions

detail.title: Collective Intelligence Of Coalitions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder and principal of Wisdom Agent Inc. No other personal or financial relationships that could be perceived to have influenced this study exist.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is purely theoretical and mathematical. No human subjects, participants, or patient data were involved. No ethics approval or IRB review was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was funded entirely by Wisdom Agent Inc. No external funding was received.

detail.abstract: Classical cooperative game theory solves the allocation and stability problems for a characteristic function v : 2 N → R supplied from outside. Because v is an unexplained primitive, the theory can allocate a surplus but cannot derive one, diagnose vulnerability, or measure adaptive capacity. This paper develops Coalition Intelligence Theory, a structural theory that equips v with decomposable causal factors. Agents carry capability vectors factored into a magnitude and a profile; the coalition's state is the profile density matrix ρ F , and its value is v(F) = D(F) • R(F), rank diversity times an aggregate resource function. A Spectral Invariance Theorem separates a structural layer-density matrix, entropy, null space, collapse threshold, adaptive capacity-from an interchangeable domain layer. The spectrum of ρ F organizes three independent roles of diversity: value creation, through superadditivity and an exact Shapley decomposition whose span-expansion bonus is a scarcity rent dissipating as 1/n once the coalition exceeds its capability dimension; resilience, through a collapse threshold that is positive iff profiles span the full space and is controlled linearly by the entropy near homogeneity; and adaptation, through a Fisher-Coalition theorem making expected improvement proportional to profile variance. A structural fragility theorem shows that extraction-driven homogenization destroys all three simultaneously-three independent collapses of one spectrum. Applications to extractive institutions and international trade, the latter unifying Ricardian and Heckscher-Ohlin comparative advantage, follow with seven falsifiable predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出联盟智能理论（Coalition Intelligence Theory），通过为特征函数v赋予可分解的因果因子来构建结构性合作博弈理论。联盟价值被分解为多样性秩（rank diversity）与聚合资源函数的乘积，并通过谱不变量定理分离结构层与可互换领域层，统一解释多样性的三大作用：价值创造、韧性与适应能力。
AI.research_question: 经典合作博弈理论将特征函数v视为外部给定的未解释原语，无法推导剩余（surplus）的来源、诊断联盟脆弱性或度量适应能力。本文的研究问题是：如何构建一种结构性博弈理论，使v具有可分解的因果基础，从而同时解释多样性的价值创造、韧性与适应功能？
AI.motivation: 经典合作博弈论只能分配给定剩余，却无法回答剩余从何而来、联盟为何脆弱、以及如何度量其适应能力。这一理论空白限制了博弈论对制度与贸易等现实问题的解释力，促使作者构建一个将结构（谱）与领域（可互换成分）分离的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 联盟智能理论，包含：谱不变定理（结构层与领域层分离）、超可加性与Shapley分解（价值创造）、坍缩阈值（韧性）、Fisher-联盟定理（适应能力）、结构性脆弱性定理（提取驱动的同质化同时摧毁三种多样功能）。
AI.method: 理论建模与公理化方法。作者将代理人的能力向量分解为幅度（magnitude）与轮廓（profile），定义联盟状态为轮廓密度矩阵ρF，联盟价值为v(F)=D(F)·R(F)（秩多样性乘以聚合资源函数），并通过谱分析证明核心定理。
AI.findings: （1）谱不变定理将结构层（密度矩阵、熵、零空间、坍缩阈值、适应能力）与可互换领域层分离；（2）多样性的三种独立作用统一于同一谱：价值创造（超可加性与精确Shapley分解，span扩张红利是稀缺租金，超过能力维度后以1/n消散）、韧性（坍缩阈值仅在轮廓张满全空间时为正，且受同质性附近熵的线性控制）、适应（Fisher-联盟定理使预期改进正比于轮廓方差）；（3）结构性脆弱性定理表明提取驱动的同质化同时摧毁这三种功能；（4）应用于攫取性制度与国际贸易（统一李嘉图与赫克歇尔-俄林比较优势），提出七项可证伪预测。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将经典合作博弈论从"分配理论"升级为"推导理论"，使剩余可被内生解释；（2）建立多样性的统一理论——价值创造、韧性、适应三者同一谱的三个独立功能；（3）通过谱不变量定理提供结构层与领域层的分离原则；（4）统一李嘉图与赫克歇尔-俄林比较优势理论于同一博弈框架。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为诊断联盟/制度的脆弱性提供可操作的数学判据（坍缩阈值）；（2）为度量制度适应性提供理论工具（Fisher信息与轮廓方差）；（3）为评估攫取性制度的破坏性提供统一框架；（4）提供七项可证伪预测，可用于国际贸易与制度经济学的实证检验。

title: Partially Reversible Retirement under Borrowing Constraints: A Switching-Controller versus Singular-Controller Game
affiliations: Kyung Hee University - Department of Applied Mathematics  and Ajou University - Department of Business Administration

detail.title: Partially Reversible Retirement under Borrowing Constraints: A Switching-Controller versus Singular-Controller Game
detail.abstract: We study an infinite-horizon consumption-investment problem with partially reversible retirement and a no-borrowing constraint. In the dual formulation, a nonincreasing shadow-price process represents the borrowing constraint, while employment status is chosen by repeated switching between work and retirement. The result is a zero-sum game between a switching controller and a singular controller. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first tractable stochastic-game formulation in which these controls are exercised by opposing players. Their interaction generates one work-to-retirement boundary, one working-state borrowing boundary, and, when reemployment is active, a bounded retirement-to-work band. The relative positions of these boundaries produce exactly four nondegenerate regimes. We solve the corresponding free-boundary systems, prove existence and uniqueness, and construct globally C 1 and piecewise C 2 solutions of the coupled HJB quasi-variational inequalities. Closed-loop verification identifies the dual game value, while a static-budget converse and strong duality recover optimal consumption, portfolio, retirement, and reemployment policies. Economically, borrowing constraints reshape both retirement timing and the option to return to work. Under CRRA preferences, numerical phase diagrams show transitions among the four configurations, and the wealth-space policies reveal that a nondegenerate dual reemployment band can collapse to a single economically relevant wealth point.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个无限期水平下具有部分可逆退休决策和无借款约束的消费-投资问题。通过对偶公式化，将问题转化为一个切换控制者与奇异控制者之间的零和博弈，首次提出了这一可解的随机博弈框架。求解了对应的自由边界系统，证明了耦合HJB拟变分不等式解的存在唯一性，并通过闭环验证和强对偶恢复了最优消费、投资组合、退休和再就业策略。经济上，借款约束重塑了退休时机和重返工作的期权价值。
AI.research_question: 在无借款约束和部分可逆退休（即可重新就业）的设定下，如何求解无限期消费-投资问题的最优策略？借款约束如何影响退休时机和重返工作的选择？
AI.motivation: 现有文献中，退休决策通常被建模为不可逆或完全可逆的，且借款约束与退休决策的相互作用尚未得到充分研究。本文首次将切换控制（就业状态）与奇异控制（借款约束）分配给对立参与者的随机博弈框架公式化，以捕获两者的交互作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机博弈理论（零和博弈）；切换控制与奇异控制的对立博弈；动态规划（HJB拟变分不等式）；对偶理论/鞅方法；自由边界问题。
AI.method: 采用对偶公式化方法，将原问题转化为零和随机博弈；求解耦合的HJB拟变分不等式对应的自由边界系统；通过闭环验证识别对偶博弈值；利用静态预算逆命题和强对偶恢复原问题最优策略；在CRRA偏好下进行数值相图分析和财富空间策略分析。
AI.findings: 交互作用产生了一个工作转退休边界、一个工作状态借款边界，以及（当再就业活跃时）一个有界的退休转工作带。这些边界的相对位置产生四种非退化状态配置。借款约束重塑了退休时机和重返工作的期权，且对偶再就业带可坍缩为单个经济相关的财富点。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出了切换控制与奇异控制由对立玩家行使的可解随机博弈公式化；证明了耦合HJB拟变分不等式解的存在唯一性；构建了整体C1和分段C2的解；通过静态预算逆命题和强对偶建立了从对偶博弈值到原问题最优策略的完整理论桥梁。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实际消费-投资-退休决策提供了可计算的最优策略框架；数值相图揭示了四种不同的经济状态配置及其转化条件；帮助理解借款约束对个人退休时机和重返工作决策的实际影响。

title: India-Thailand Bilateral Trade and Investment Relations

detail.title: India-Thailand Bilateral Trade and Investment Relations
detail.abstract: This study examines the macroeconomic determinants of bilateral trade between India and Thailand from the period 1990-2024 using the gravity model of international trade estimated through the Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) Bounds Testing Approach. In addition, the study provides a descriptive assessment of bilateral foreign direct investment (FDI) trends between the two countries during 2019-2025. The empirical results confirm the existence of a stable long-run relationship among bilateral trade, the combined economic size of India and Thailand, the bilateral exchange rate, and the ASEAN-India Free Trade Agreement (FTA). The analysis reveals that the combined economic size of India and Thailand both countries has a positive and statistically significant impact on bilateral trade, while exchange rate movements have a negative effect in both the short run and the long run. The error correction mechanism indicates that approximately 39.5% of short-run deviations from the long-run equilibrium between India and Thailand are corrected annually, indicating a moderate speed of adjustment towards long-run equilibrium. The investment analysis reveals that bilateral investment relations have strengthened over time, with Thai investment in India exceeding Indian investment in Thailand. In addition, Thai investments in India are becoming increasingly diverse, spanning various industries, including renewable energy, manufacturing, digital technologies, electronics, and infrastructure sectors. The Findings suggest that sustained economic growth, exchange rate stability, improved trade facilitation, and stronger bilateral investment cooperation are essential for expanding trade and deepening long-term economic integration between India and Thailand.

AI.tldr: 本文利用引力模型和ARDL边界检验方法，研究了1990-2024年间印度与泰国双边贸易的宏观经济决定因素，并对2019-2025年两国双边FDI趋势进行了描述性分析。研究发现两国的经济规模总和与双边贸易正相关，汇率变动在短期和长期均有负向影响，误差修正机制显示每年约39.5%的短期偏离得到修正。投资方面，泰国对印投资超过印度对泰投资，且呈多元化趋势。
AI.research_question: 1990-2024年间，哪些宏观经济因素决定了印度与泰国之间的双边贸易？以及2019-2025年间两国双边FDI的发展趋势如何？
AI.motivation: 印度和泰国作为重要的区域经济伙伴，其双边贸易关系对区域经济一体化具有重要意义，但现有研究对其宏观经济决定因素的长期动态关系缺乏系统考察，特别是结合FDI趋势的综合分析较为有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际贸易引力模型（Gravity Model of International Trade）
AI.method: 基于引力模型，采用自回归分布滞后（ARDL）边界检验方法（Bounds Testing Approach）；对FDI采用描述性统计分析。
AI.findings: （1）双边贸易、两国经济规模总和、双边汇率和东盟-印度FTA之间存在稳定的长期关系；（2）两国经济规模总和正向显著影响双边贸易；（3）汇率变动在短期和长期均对贸易有负向影响；（4）误差修正系数约39.5%，表明每年约39.5%的短期偏离得到修正，调整速度为中等水平；（5）泰国对印投资超过印度对泰投资，且泰国投资日益多元化，覆盖可再生能源、制造业、数字技术、电子和基础设施等行业。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了引力模型在印度-泰国双边贸易研究中的应用，通过ARDL边界检验方法提供了短期和长期动态关系的分层证据，补充了发展中国家之间双边贸易宏观决定因素的经验研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实证依据，表明持续的经济增长、汇率稳定、贸易便利化改善和加强双边投资合作是扩大印泰贸易和深化长期经济一体化的关键。

title: The Supported Set: What Verification Design Can and Cannot Buy Together

detail.title: The Supported Set: What Verification Design Can and Cannot Buy Together
detail.abstract: A programme of seventeen papers has priced the instruments of verification design-who writes the disclosure, where the courtroom looks, how much a documented file counts, how many matters may be named-and each declined to choose a welfare function. This paper answers the question that discipline leaves standing, without withdrawing it. Putting the instruments into one model and asking what is achievable, the natural object fails: with four objectives the Pareto frontier contains two thirds of the menu and selects nothing. The object that works is the supported set-the configurations optimal under some nonnegative linear weighting-which for a non-convex achievable set is far smaller, and which is exactly what one inverts to say what a choice reveals. Of 100,270 attainable outcome classes, 182 are supported; the other 99.82% are chosen by no authority with linear weights, whatever those weights are. Agreement on which objectives matter, without agreement on how to weigh them, compresses the problem by a factor of five hundred. Each survivor carries a full-dimensional cone of supporting weights, reported as exact intervals: choosing the maximal-deterrence configuration commits an authority to weighting deterrence at least 0.40; choosing amnesty commits it to weighting the honest profession's burden in [0.32, 1.00] and accepting zero deterrence and zero detection. The supported set also has a shape. Four fifths of it is a single amnesty class in which the file is credited in full and the regime collects nothing-amnesty is a basin, not a corner. Outside that basin, the rate at which disclosure partitions are supported falls monotonically in their fineness, and full revelation is supported at no weight at all. The instruments obey no general law: among the four core instruments' pairs two complement, two substitute and one is non-monotone, and a mechanism hypothesis predicting which was refuted twice. Finally the programme audits clean-every published recommendation is supported-while the supported configurations no paper proposed share one feature, opacity: the pen goes unused in all of them. The paper supplies no optimum. It supplies the map on which every recommendation sits, and the price, in stated beliefs, of choosing any point on it.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将验证设计（谁撰写披露、法庭如何审视、文件证据分量、可命名事项数量）的所有工具纳入统一模型，计算了100,270种可达结果类别中仅182种为受支持配置（即在线性权重下最优的配置），其余99.82%不会被任何线性权重下的权威选择。受支持集具有明确形状：五分之四是单一特赦类（盆地而非角落），且完全披露在任何权重下都不受支持。文章不提供最优解，而是提供一张"地图"呈现所有建议的位置及其选择代价。
AI.research_question: 当验证设计的各种工具被纳入统一模型时，什么配置是可达的、可被选择的（受支持的），以及达成目标间的权衡关系如何？
AI.motivation: 此前的十七篇论文将验证设计工具逐一定价，但拒绝选择福利函数。本文在保留该学科传统（不选择福利函数）的前提下，回答被搁置的问题——找出在所有线性权重下可能被选择（受支持）的配置集合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 受支持集理论（supported set）：在非凸可达集上，受支持配置（在某些非负线性权重下最优）远小于帕累托前沿；通过反转受支持集可揭示选择所隐含的权重信念。
AI.method: 将17篇论文的验证设计工具整合入单一模型，枚举所有可达结果类别（100,270种），计算每种配置的受支持状态及支撑权重锥，并以精确区间报告权重约束。
AI.findings: （1）100,270种可达结果中仅182种受支持，其余99.82%不会被任何线性权重权威选择；（2）受支持集四分之五为单一特赦类（文件全额计分、制度零收取），特赦是盆地而非角落；（3）披露分区的受支持率随精细度单调下降，完全披露在任何权重下不受支持；（4）工具间关系无一般规律：四种核心工具两两之间两互补、两替代、一非单调，机制假设被反驳两次；（5）所有已发表建议均受支持，而所有未提出的受支持配置共同特征是"不透明"（笔未被使用）。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明在非凸可达集中帕累托前沿失效（三分之二菜单被纳入且不选择任何结果），而受支持集是有效的分析对象；提供一种无需选择福利函数即可进行规范分析的理论方法，通过权重锥的精确区间揭示配置选择所隐含的信念承诺。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和制度设计者提供一张"地图"，使每个验证设计建议都可定位并计算其选择代价（如选择最大威慑配置须承诺威慑权重≥0.40；选择特赦则须接受零威慑与零检测）；揭示未提议的受支持配置共同具有不透明性（笔未被使用），提示新政策空间。

title: International Trade Challenges for Usbekistan
affiliations: PFH Private University of Applied Sciences

detail.title: International Trade Challenges for Usbekistan
detail.abstract: Uzbekistan's status as the world's largest double-landlocked country imposes substantial constraints on its participation in international trade. This paper examines how geographic isolation from maritime routes translates into elevated transit times, higher transportation costs, and heightened dependence on neighboring transit states, drawing on comparative data from other landlocked economies in Central Asia and beyond.
