declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not obtain IRB approval or consent from participants because the data came from publicly available surveys and Census data. Data and analysis syntax are available on the Open Science Framework: https://osf.io/38aqf/?view_only=c874f49e31154cdfb1da7d33c4fd1cc4
declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by a William Ladany faculty scholarship.

detail.abstract: Some researchers have argued that modernization is making cultures more individualistic and shrinking cultural differences. This article points to counterintuitive new evidence that modernization is increasing some cultural differences. For example, across the 40 years of the World Values Survey, nations are becoming more different in their values, rather than more similar. This article proposes that modernization sometimes acts like water on a seed, giving people resources that they decide to use in ways that depend on their pre-existing values and beliefs. The seed model offers a framework for understanding findings that do not fit classic modernization theory from domains of psychology to behavioral genetics. I outline critical questions this model needs to answer if it is to become useful, such as where the seeds of culture come from and when we should predict decreasing versus increasing differences as a result of modernization.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了现代化使文化更趋同的传统观点，提出"种子模型"：现代化像水浇灌种子一样，赋予人们资源，但人们会依据其既有的价值观和信念来使用这些资源，因此现代化有时反而会加大文化差异。基于世界价值观调查40年的数据，作者发现各国价值观差异在扩大而非缩小。
AI.research_question: 现代化是缩小还是扩大文化差异？为什么在现代化进程中，一些文化差异反而在增大？
AI.motivation: 经典现代化理论认为现代化会导致文化更加个人主义化并缩小文化差异，但作者发现了反直觉的新证据：现代化正在增加某些文化差异，这无法用经典理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 种子模型（Seed Model）：现代化像水浇灌种子，提供资源，但资源的使用方式取决于人们既有的价值观和信念，从而产生差异化的结果。
AI.method: 基于世界价值观调查（World Values Survey）40年跨国数据，分析各国价值观随时间的变化趋势。
AI.findings: 跨国数据表明，在40年间，各国价值观差异在扩大而非缩小，与经典现代化理论的预测相反。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"种子模型"作为理解现代化与文化差异关系的新框架，整合了心理学与行为遗传学中与经典现代化理论不符的发现，为文化多样性研究提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出该模型需要回答的关键问题（如文化种子的来源、何时应预测差异增大或缩小），为未来研究和政策制定提供方向指引。

title: Talent Management and Employee Retention: Evidence from Academic and Non-teaching Staff of The University
affiliations: University of Ilorin, Ilorin, Nigeria

detail.title: Talent Management and Employee Retention: Evidence from Academic and Non-teaching Staff of The University
detail.abstract: Prior studies have shown that, after investing in recruitment, onboarding training/development, compensation, and other initiatives, organisations often experience high turnover among high-performing employees. Therefore, this study investigates the effect of talent management on employee retention of academic and non-teaching employees of the University of Ilorin, Kwara State, Nigeria. This was a cross-sectional survey study. The study participants are 3,391 University academic and nonteaching staff. Based on this, 358 samples were selected using the Taro Yamane formula, and the valid responses were analysed.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了人才管理对尼日利亚伊洛林大学学术与非教学员工留任的影响。通过横截面调查，采用Taro Yamane公式从3,391名员工中抽取358个样本进行分析。
AI.research_question: 人才管理如何影响尼日利亚伊洛林大学学术与非教学员工的留任？
AI.motivation: 以往研究表明，组织在招聘、入职培训、薪酬等投入后，仍经常面临高绩效员工的高流失率，因此亟需探究人才管理对员工留任的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 未在摘要中明确提及具体理论框架。
AI.method: 横截面调查研究；研究对象为3,391名大学学术与非教学员工；采用Taro Yamane公式选取358个样本；对有效问卷进行分析。
AI.findings: 摘要中未明确呈现具体研究发现，需查看全文获取结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 补充了人才管理与员工留任关系在尼日利亚高等教育机构情境下的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼日利亚乃至类似发展中国家的大学如何通过人才管理策略提升员工留任提供实践参考。

title: Information-Theoretic Boundaries and Dynamic Market Model for Quantitative Factor Mining: A Complete Research Framework Based on the OHLCV Data Domain

detail.title: Information-Theoretic Boundaries and Dynamic Market Model for Quantitative Factor Mining: A Complete Research Framework Based on the OHLCV Data Domain

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no potential conflict of interest. This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The views expressed in this paper are those of the author and do not represent the position of any institution.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants, patient data, or animal experiments. The research is based on theoretical and methodological analysis using publicly available financial market data (OHLCV price/volume series).
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The author conducted this study as an independent researcher.

detail.abstract: This paper studies the information-theoretic boundaries of factor mining under the OHLCV data domain. We decompose the problem into three layers: data domain information bound, market effective bound, and state-conditional bound. We distinguish raw data information I_raw(Y;X) from factor-extractable information I_factor(Y;F), and introduce a mapping function Φ that translates statistical information into economic predictive advantage A. We propose a "zero-axis Alpha" model where most OHLCV information's economic value clusters near zero, with only few structures stably deviating from zero in specific market regimes forming researchable Alpha. We integrate information theory, factor crowding, behavioral finance, and Adaptive Markets into a unified dynamic market information discovery framework, and derive six falsifiable predictions linking market adoption to out-of-sample performance decay. The long-term goal of factor mining is not to maximize IC, but to identify conditional information that stably deviates from zero, remains unabsorbed by the market, and retains economic value after transaction costs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了OHLCV数据域下因子挖掘的信息论边界，将问题分解为数据域信息界、市场有效界和状态条件界三个层次，提出"零轴Alpha"模型，整合信息论、因子拥挤、行为金融和自适应市场理论，构建统一的动态市场信息发现框架。
AI.research_question: 在OHLCV数据域下，因子挖掘的信息论边界是什么？如何区分原始数据信息与因子可提取信息，以及如何在市场动态演化中识别可持续的Alpha？
AI.motivation: 传统因子挖掘缺乏对信息理论上限的系统性认识，因子拥挤和市场自适应导致样本外表现衰减，需要建立统一的理论框架来理解哪些信息具有真正的经济预测价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息论、因子拥挤理论、行为金融学、自适应市场假说（Adaptive Markets Hypothesis）
AI.method: 理论分解方法：将因子挖掘问题分解为数据域信息界（I_raw）、市场有效界和状态条件界三层；引入映射函数Φ将统计信息转化为经济预测优势A；构建"零轴Alpha"理论模型。
AI.findings: 大多数OHLCV信息的经济价值集中在零附近，只有少数结构在特定市场制度下稳定偏离零形成可研究的Alpha；推导出六个可证伪的预测，关于市场采纳与样本外表现衰减之间的关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 统一了信息论、因子拥挤、行为金融和自适应市场假说，提出动态市场信息发现框架；引入"零轴Alpha"概念重新定义因子挖掘的目标——不是最大化IC，而是识别条件性稳定偏离零的信息。
AI.practical_contributions: 为量化投资实践提供了因子挖掘的战略指导：应聚焦于未被市场吸收、稳定偏离零且在扣除交易成本后仍具经济价值的信息结构，而非盲目追求高IC。

title: Is the Equity Dispersion Spread Informative? A Correlation and Lead-Lag Study of S&P 500 Dispersion.

detail.title: Is the Equity Dispersion Spread Informative? A Correlation and Lead-Lag Study of S&P 500 Dispersion.
detail.abstract: I test whether the S&P 500 dispersion spread, the gap between the average volatility of index constituents and the volatility of the index itself, carries information about widely followed financial risk metrics. Across 3,968 daily observations from 2010-02-03 to 2026-06-22 on the S&P 500 constituent universe, the dispersion spread is found to be significantly correlated with tail risk pricing (CBOE SKEW, ρ = +0.43) and, more weakly, with credit stress (LQD/HYG, ρ =-0.18). The dispersion spread shows no significant contemporaneous relationship with VIX or rate volatility (MOVE) at full universe scale (ρ =-0.01 in both cases, p > 0.83), but the two effects it combines do. Separating the dispersion spread into its two parts, the average stock's volatility level and how correlated stocks are with each other, produces opposite-signed coefficients against VIX (+4.53 and-1.61, both p < 0.01), where regressing VIX on the combined spread alone gives +0.47 (n.s.). MOVE behaves the same way, at +5.95 and-4.21 separately against-0.62 (n.s.) combined. The dispersion spread does not forecast forward index volatility, returns, or drawdowns at a one month horizon, in sample or out. No metric in the panel shows a stable, directional lead-lag relationship with dispersion in either direction. Those results characterize the dispersion spread as a coincident state variable, a real time gauge of the market's volatility regime rather than a predictor of it. A two year test on implied dispersion (CBOE DSPX) finds the implied and realized series only loosely linked (ρ = +0.17), with no stable lead in either direction.

AI.tldr: 本文检验了S&P 500离散度价差（成分股平均波动率与指数本身波动率之差）是否包含广泛的金融市场风险指标信息。基于2010至2026年3968个日度观测，发现离散度价差与尾部风险定价（SKEW指数）显著正相关（ρ=+0.43），与信用压力弱相关（ρ=-0.18），但与VIX和MOVE无显著同期关系。将价差分解为平均波动率水平和股票相关性两部分后，对VIX和MOVE产生相反符号的显著系数。离散度价差无法预测一个月维度的指数波动率、收益率或回撤，被定性为同步状态变量而非预测指标。
AI.research_question: S&P 500离散度价差（成分股平均波动率与指数波动率之差）是否承载关于广泛金融市场风险指标的信息？它是否具有预测能力？
AI.motivation: 离散度价差将市场波动分解为个股平均波动水平和股票间相关性两个维度，这可能揭示VIX等综合波动率指标所掩盖的不同风险特征，值得系统性检验其信息含量与预测能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 波动率分解理论（平均成分股波动率与相关性），市场风险状态变量理论，同步指标与领先指标时变关系框架
AI.method: 基于2010-02-03至2026-06-22期间3968个日度观测的相关性分析、多元回归（将价差分解为两部分的符号分离回归）、月度预测回归（样本内与样本外）、领先-滞后关系检验，以及CBOE DSPX隐含离散度的两年对比测试。
AI.findings: （1）离散度价差与SKEW显著正相关（ρ=+0.43），与信用压力弱负相关（ρ=-0.18）；（2）与VIX和MOVE无显著同期关系（ρ=-0.01），但分解后的两成分对VIX（+4.53和-1.61）及MOVE（+5.95和-4.21）产生相反符号的显著系数；（3）价差无法预测一个月维度的指数波动率、收益率或回撤；（4）隐含离散度（DSPX）与实际离散度仅松散相关（ρ=+0.17），无稳定领先关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 将离散度价差概念化为同步状态变量而非预测指标，揭示了综合波动率指标（VIX、MOVE）中隐含的对冲成分效应——平均波动水平与相关性对市场风险指标产生相反的抵消性影响，丰富了波动率分解理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为市场参与者提供了离散度价差作为实时波动率状态监测工具的证据；强调在使用离散度价差时应区分其两成分来解读VIX和利率波动率变动，并为基于隐含离散度（DSPX）进行风险管理提供了其与实现离散度相关性有限的警示。

title: The New Convergence Frontier: Why Late-Industrializing Economies are Catching Up Through Services, Digitalization, and Energy Transitions

detail.title: The New Convergence Frontier: Why Late-Industrializing Economies are Catching Up Through Services, Digitalization, and Energy Transitions
detail.abstract: Late‑industrializing economies are converging with advanced nations through a new development pathway that no longer relies on traditional manufacturing. As documented in The New Convergence Frontier, this shift is driven by three mutually reinforcing pillars: the rise of tradable services, the widespread adoption of digital public infrastructure, and the strategic advantages created by the global energy transition. Premature deindustrialization—where manufacturing peaks at low income levels—has forced emerging markets to bypass legacy industrial models and instead leverage dematerialized, knowledge‑intensive sectors. Modern IT and BPO exports, digital identity and payments systems, e‑commerce ecosystems, and decentralized renewable energy grids enable rapid productivity gains, financial inclusion, and broad‑based economic participation. Countries such as India, Brazil, and Kenya demonstrate how services‑led growth, digital leapfrogging, and renewable deployment can jointly accelerate structural transformation. This report argues that these dynamics constitute a viable, scalable alternative to the historical industrialization pathway, offering policymakers a blueprint for sustainable, inclusive catch‑up growth in the 21st century.

AI.tldr: 本报告指出，后发经济体正通过一条不再依赖传统制造业的新型发展路径与发达国家趋同。这一转变由三大相互强化的支柱驱动：可贸易服务业的兴起、数字公共基础设施的广泛采用，以及全球能源转型带来的战略优势。早期去工业化迫使新兴市场绕过传统产业模式，转而利用非物质化、知识密集型部门实现跨越式发展。印度、巴西和肯尼亚等国的案例表明，服务业主导的增长、数字跨越和可再生能源部署能够共同加速结构转型，为21世纪提供了可持续、包容性追赶增长的政策蓝图。
AI.research_question: 后发经济体如何在不依赖传统制造业的情况下实现与发达国家的经济收敛，以及这一新型发展路径的可行性与可扩展性如何？
AI.motivation: 传统制造业驱动的工业化路径已不再适用于当代后发经济体。早期去工业化（制造业在低收入水平即达到峰值）迫使新兴市场寻找替代性发展道路。现有文献多以制造业为中心讨论结构转型，缺乏对服务业、数字基础设施和能源转型三者协同作用如何推动经济收敛的系统性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于"新型收敛前沿"（The New Convergence Frontier）的框架，提出以可贸易服务业、数字公共基础设施和全球能源转型为三大支柱的替代性经济发展理论，挑战传统的制造业导向的工业化收敛模型。
AI.method: 本报告采用定性分析方法，结合印度、巴西、肯尼亚等国的案例研究，考察IT与BPO出口、数字身份与支付系统、电子商务生态系统以及分布式可再生能源电网等具体实践，论证服务业导向增长与数字跨越式发展的可行性。
AI.findings: 研究发现，现代IT和BPO出口、数字身份与支付系统、电子商务生态系统和分布式可再生能源电网能够实现快速生产率提升、金融包容和广泛的经济参与。印度、巴西和肯尼亚的实践表明，服务业主导增长、数字跨越和可再生能源部署可以协同加速结构转型，构成对历史工业化路径的可行且可扩展的替代方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文提出了"新型收敛前沿"理论框架，修正了以制造业为中心的经典工业化理论，论证了去物质化、知识密集型部门可以成为后发经济体实现经济收敛的核心驱动力，拓展了结构转型与经济发展理论的分析边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了一条可持续、包容性追赶增长的蓝图，指明了可贸易服务业、数字公共基础设施和可再生能源三大政策支柱的具体着力点，为新兴市场国家制定发展策略提供了实践指导和行动框架。

title: Assessing the Impact of Economic Recession on the Academic Performance of Undergraduate Students in Nigeria

detail.title: Assessing the Impact of Economic Recession on the Academic Performance of Undergraduate Students in Nigeria
detail.abstract:
This study investigates the impact of economic recession on the academic performance of undergraduate students in Nigeria, with a focus on the University of Benin. The study examined the relationship between financial hardship, resource accessibility, psychological stress, and students' academic outcomes. A survey research design was adopted, and data were collected from 150 undergraduate students across various faculties using structured questionnaires. Descriptive statistics, ANOVA, and regression analysis were used to test the hypotheses. 

The findings revealed that economic recession significantly affects undergraduate students' academic performance by influencing their motivation, access to educational resources, and overall psychological well-being. Financial instability was found to be the strongest predictor of academic performance, with students in professional and resource-intensive programs reporting greater challenges. The study concluded that the economic recession negatively impacts academic achievement and recommended that government and institutions strengthen financial aid programs, improve support services, and implement policies to cushion the effects of economic instability on education.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了经济衰退对尼日利亚贝宁大学本科生学业表现的影响，通过150名学生的问卷调查，发现经济衰退通过影响学习动机、教育资源和心理健康显著降低学业表现，其中财务不稳定是最强预测因素。
AI.research_question: 经济衰退如何影响尼日利亚本科生的学业表现？具体探讨财务困难、资源可及性和心理压力与学生学业成果之间的关系。
AI.motivation: 经济衰退对高等教育的影响日益显著，尤其在发展中国家如尼日利亚，但相关实证研究不足，特别是对学生学业表现的具体影响机制缺乏深入探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究基于财务困境、资源可及性与心理压力对学生学术成果影响的理论框架，未明确提及特定的单一理论。
AI.method: 采用调查研究设计，使用结构化问卷收集贝宁大学150名各院系本科生的数据，运用描述性统计、方差分析（ANOVA）和回归分析检验假设。
AI.findings: 经济衰退显著影响本科生学业表现，通过影响学习动机、教育资源可及性和心理幸福感发挥作用。财务不稳定是学业表现的最强预测因素，专业性和资源密集型项目的学生面临更大挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 为经济衰退与高等教育学业表现之间的关系提供了来自尼日利亚发展中国家的实证证据，识别出财务不稳定作为学业表现最强预测因素，并揭示专业型和资源密集型专业学生面临更大困境的差异化影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议政府和教育机构加强经济援助项目，改善学生支持服务，并制定政策以缓解经济不稳定对教育的负面影响。

title: The Door Effect: Lender Identity and Unexplained Variation in FHA Mortgage Denial Outcomes — Evidence from the Complete 2025 HMDA Record

detail.title: The Door Effect: Lender Identity and Unexplained Variation in FHA Mortgage Denial Outcomes — Evidence from the Complete 2025 HMDA Record

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author operates FinanceRateCalc, an independent public-data website on which an earlier, non-academic summary of these results and the underlying open dataset (CC BY 4.0) are published. The website generates no revenue from, and has no financial relationship with, any lender named or analyzed in this paper. No other relationships to declare.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no funding from any agency, institution, or commercial entity. All data used are public federal records.

detail.abstract: Denial rates on Federal Housing Administration (FHA) mortgage applications vary enormously across lenders operating under the same federal program rules: among the one hundred highest-volume FHA lenders in the 2025 Home Mortgage Disclosure Act (HMDA) record, lender-level denial rates range from 1.8 percent to 78.7 percent. This paper asks how much of the variation in individual denial outcomes can be attributed to lender identity after conditioning on the applicant characteristics observable in the federal record. Using 859,090 decisioned FHA applications, I estimate two nested logistic regressions: a profile-only model of observable application characteristics (income, loan amount, debt-to-income band, small-loan status, and state), and an augmented model that adds a single categorical variable — lender identity. The profile-only model attains a McFadden pseudo-R2 of 0.1712; adding lender identity raises it to 0.2760. Lender identity therefore accounts for 37.97 percent of all explained variation in denial outcomes — the "door effect." I further compute mix-adjusted expected denial rates for each large lender and document overlay residuals of up to +43.7 percentage points, and I cluster lenders into five denial-reason "fingerprint families." All estimates are associational, not causal; the residual is consistent with lender overlays, channel composition, documentation practices, and unobserved risk mix. The full results dataset is public under CC BY 4.0.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2025年HMDA中859,090份FHA贷款申请数据，通过嵌套逻辑回归发现，在控制申请人可观测特征后，贷款机构身份（"门效应"）解释了所有已解释变异中37.97%的拒绝结果差异，机构层面的拒绝率从1.8%到78.7%不等。
AI.research_question: 在控制联邦记录中可观测的申请人特征后，贷款机构身份对个人拒绝结果差异有多大程度的贡献？
AI.motivation: 在相同的联邦项目规则下运营的不同贷款机构，其FHA贷款拒绝率存在巨大差异（最高达78.7% vs 1.8%），这引发了关于机构行为如何影响贷款结果公平性的疑问。
AI.theoretical_framework: 嵌套逻辑回归模型（nested logistic regressions），基于McFadden伪R²的方差分解，以及"门效应"（door effect）概念来解释机构身份对拒绝结果的解释力。
AI.method: 使用859,090份已决策的FHA贷款申请，估计两个嵌套逻辑回归模型：（1）仅包含可观测申请人特征的profile-only模型（收入、贷款金额、债务收入比区间、小额贷款状态、州）；（2）加入贷款机构身份单一分类变量的增强模型。计算McFadden伪R²差异以量化"门效应"，并计算混合调整后的预期拒绝率和拒绝原因"指纹家族"聚类。
AI.findings: Profile-only模型的McFadden伪R²为0.1712，加入机构身份后升至0.2760，机构身份占所有已解释变异的37.97%。大型贷款机构的混合调整后预期拒绝率残差最高可达+43.7个百分点，并将机构聚类为五个拒绝原因"指纹家族"。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"门效应"（door effect）概念，量化了贷款机构身份对拒绝结果变异的贡献；通过McFadden伪R²的增量分解提供了一种将机构身份从申请人特征中分离出解释力的方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和政策制定者提供了实证证据，表明机构层面的实践（如overlays、渠道构成、文件记录实践）显著影响贷款审批结果；公开了完整数据集（CC BY 4.0），可供后续研究和监管审查使用。

reference: ZEW – Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No. 26-033
title: Staying for Discovery, Monetizing Elsewhere: Platform Governance and Complementor Bypassing
affiliations: ZEW – Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research, ,  and

detail.title: Staying for Discovery, Monetizing Elsewhere: Platform Governance and Complementor Bypassing

publicationDetails.detailsText: ZEW – Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No. 26-033

detail.abstract: Digital platforms govern not only how ecosystem value is created, but also how complementors capture it. In this paper, we study how content creators respond when a dominant platform restricts monetization while remaining essential for audience discovery. Our setting is YouTube's revision of its monetization regime, implemented in the aftermath of the 2017 advertiser boycott known as the "Adpocalypse". Under the new regime, YouTube tightened content moderation and monetization rules, reducing the level and predictability of creators' advertising revenues. Creators could partially bypass YouTube's monetization layer through Patreon, a membership platform enabling recurring direct payments from users. Using monthly panel data on approximately 8,400 video creators active on Patreon between August 2017 and August 2018, we compare creators with a pre-shock YouTube link to creators without an observed link in a matched difference-in-differences design. Following the policy change, exposed creators increased their production of member-only Patreon content without reducing freely accessible posts. They also accumulated paying patrons and recurring membership revenue at a significantly faster monthly rate, with a differential increase of approximately 9%. The increase in paid content was strongest among creators whose content faced greater pre-existing monetization risk. The findings suggest that platform governance can reallocate complementor effort and value capture across platforms: creators can shift monetization toward an auxiliary channel while continuing to rely on the dominant platform for audience discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文研究当主导平台（YouTube）在2017年"广告末日"事件后收紧变现政策时，内容创作者如何通过辅助平台（Patreon）重新分配变现努力。利用约8400名创作者的月度面板数据和匹配双重差分设计，发现政策冲击后受影响创作者显著增加了会员专属内容的产出，付费会员和经常性收入的月增速提高约9%，且这种效应在面临更高变现风险的创作者中更强。研究表明平台治理可以重新分配互补者的努力和价值获取渠道。
AI.research_question: 当主导平台限制变现但仍是受众发现的关键渠道时，内容创作者如何回应？即平台治理如何影响互补者跨平台的价值获取与努力分配？
AI.motivation: 数字平台不仅治理生态系统价值的创造方式，也治理互补者如何获取价值。现有研究对平台治理如何影响互补者在跨平台情境下的价值捕获行为知之甚少，本文利用YouTube 2017年"广告末日"政策变革作为自然实验来填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 平台生态系统治理理论、价值创造与价值捕获理论、互补者多平台战略理论。
AI.method: 匹配双重差分设计（matched difference-in-differences），使用约8400名活跃于Patreon的视频创作者在2017年8月至2018年8月的月度面板数据，比较政策冲击前有YouTube链接的创作者与无链接的创作者。
AI.findings: (1) 政策变化后，受影响的创作者增加了会员专属Patreon内容的产出，但并未减少免费公开内容；(2) 他们积累付费赞助者和经常性会员收入的月增速显著加快，差额增幅约9%；(3) 这种付费内容的增加在先前面临更高变现风险的创作者中最为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了平台治理可以跨平台重新分配互补者的努力和价值获取：互补者可以将变现转向辅助渠道，同时继续依赖主导平台进行受众发现，丰富了平台生态系统治理与互补者多平台战略的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台管理者提供了关于治理政策跨平台溢出效应的实证证据，提示平台在收紧变现规则时需考虑互补者向其他平台转移价值捕获的行为；同时为内容创作者提供了多平台变现策略的实践参考。

reference: ZEW – Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No. 26-034
title: From Lion Rock to Locked Gates: The Decline of Upward Mobility in Hong Kong
affiliations: ZEW Mannheim and

detail.title: From Lion Rock to Locked Gates: The Decline of Upward Mobility in Hong Kong

publicationDetails.detailsText: ZEW – Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No. 26-034

detail.abstract: Using Hong Kong census data from 1976 to 2021, this paper provides the first comprehensive analysis of absolute intergenerational mobility (AIM) in a transitioning Asian economy. We introduce two innovations: decomposing AIM by factor income (labor component vs. capital component) and a Mincer-based counterfactual framework isolating education, birthplace, and other sociodemographic factors. AIM declined sharply from 85% for the 1976 cohort to 49% for the 2001 cohort, driven primarily by slower income growth rather than rising inequality, which is similar to France or Sweden, but lagging Western economies by one to two decades. Labor component mobility drove the entire decline (75% to 49%), while capital component mobility remained low and stable (17-20%). Education expansion temporarily boosted AIM by up to 18 percentage points for the 1991 cohort, coinciding with Hong Kong's post-1989 tertiary enrollment surge. Instrumental variable estimates using the 1978 compulsory education reform are consistent with the OLS-based estimates and support their validity. Our replicable framework offers insights for transitioning economies facing similar structural shifts.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1976-2021年香港人口普查数据，首次对转型亚洲经济体中的绝对代际流动性（AIM）进行了全面分析，发现AIM从1976年队列的85%骤降至2001年队列的49%，主要驱动力是收入增长放缓而非不平等加剧。通过将AIM按要素收入分解（劳动与资本），并构建基于Mincer方程的反事实框架，作者发现劳动收入的流动性下降（75%至49%）贡献了全部下降，而资本收入流动性保持低水平稳定（17-20%）。教育扩张（尤其是1989年后香港高等教育扩招）对1991年队列的AIM起到了临时性提振作用，最高达18个百分点。
AI.research_question: 在转型亚洲经济体中，绝对代际流动性（AIM）如何演变？其下降的关键驱动力是什么？不同收入来源（劳动vs资本）对其贡献有何差异？
AI.motivation: 现有代际流动研究多聚焦于相对流动性和西方发达经济体，对转型亚洲经济体中的绝对代际流动性缺乏系统分析。香港作为从制造业向服务业转型、经历教育快速扩张和制度变革的独特案例，为理解结构性变迁对代际流动的影响提供了理想场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 绝对代际流动性（AIM）理论框架；基于Mincer收入方程的反事实分解框架；要素收入分解框架（劳动收入vs资本收入）；工具变量方法（1978年义务教育改革作为工具变量）
AI.method: 使用1976-2021年香港人口普查数据，构建AIM度量；创新性地按要素收入（劳动与资本）分解AIM；构建基于Mincer方程的反事实框架以隔离教育、出生地及其他社会人口因素；采用1978年义务教育改革作为工具变量的IV估计以验证OLS结果的有效性。
AI.findings: (1) AIM从1976年队列的85%下降至2001年队列的49%；(2) 下降主要由收入增长放缓而非不平等上升驱动，这一模式与法国或瑞典类似，但落后西方经济体一至两个十年；(3) 劳动收入流动性贡献了全部下降（75%降至49%），资本收入流动性保持低而稳定的水平（17-20%）；(4) 教育扩张在1991年队列中临时性提振AIM最高达18个百分点，与1989年后香港高等教育扩招时期吻合；(5) IV估计与OLS估计一致，支持结果的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次对转型亚洲经济体进行全面的AIM分析；引入AIM按要素收入分解的创新方法；提出基于Mincer方程的AIM反事实分解框架，为代际流动性研究提供了可复制的方法论工具；拓展了代际流动性研究至转型经济体的理论适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为面临类似结构性转型的经济体提供政策启示：AIM下降主要由收入增长放缓驱动，提示政策应关注经济增长与收入改善；教育扩张仅产生暂时性提振效应，需配套其他结构性政策；劳动收入流动性下降值得政策关注，资本收入流动性低而稳定则提示财富分配政策的重要性。

title: AI-Enabled Autonomy, Homeland Security, and the Governance Gap: A Four-Phase Capability-Diffusion Framework, Convergent Risk Estimation, and a Nexus with Guardrails

detail.title: AI-Enabled Autonomy, Homeland Security, and the Governance Gap: A Four-Phase Capability-Diffusion Framework, Convergent Risk Estimation, and a Nexus with Guardrails

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial interest in any organization that manufactures, sells, or services unmanned aircraft systems, counter-unmanned-aircraft systems, artificial intelligence systems, or chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear detection equipment, and no financial interest in any organization named in this paper. The author discloses the following relationships, which a reader could reasonably perceive as bearing on the analysis. The author is a candidate in Georgetown University's Master of Professional Studies in Artificial Intelligence Management program at the School of Continuing Studies, and an alumnus of Grand Canyon University. Neither institution funded, directed, reviewed, or approved this work. The paper does not represent the position of either institution. The author is a retired United States Army Sergeant First Class with twenty years of active service as a Unit Supply Specialist, occupational specialty 92Y, including deployments during the Global War on Terror. That experience informs the paper's treatment of property accountability, Army supply regulation, and counter-improvised-explosive-device program history. The author states this plainly because professional formation in military logistics shaped which analogies the paper found available and persuasive, and a reader is entitled to weigh that. The author holds the Demonstrated Senior Logistician designation from SOLE, The International Society of Logistics, a professional body in the logistics field this paper analyzes. The designation carries no financial interest in and no obligation to SOLE. The author writes as an independent researcher. No government agency, contractor, vendor, advocacy organization, or funder commissioned, sponsored, reviewed, or approved this manuscript, and none had sight of it before submission. The paper proposes a new civilian-led federal coordinating body. The author holds no position in, and no financial stake in, any entity that would be created, funded, or staffed under that proposal.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involved no human participants, no patients, no animal subjects, and no personally identifiable data. It is a documentary and doctrinal analysis of publicly available sources, including statutes, bills, regulations, court decisions, oversight and audit reports, agency publications, military doctrine, peer-reviewed scholarship, research-institution work, and press reporting. No institutional review board approval or ethics committee approval was required, and written consent was not applicable. The author applied a deliberate information-hazard restriction throughout. The paper analyzes the governance consequences of lowered barriers to capability. It does not describe agent selection, production or acquisition pathways, precursor information, formulation or dispersal engineering, dosage, or casualty modeling, and it does not describe how any platform or payload is assembled, modified, or attached. The unit of analysis is the institutional barrier rather than the artifact. Where a cited source contained operational detail of that kind, the paper cites the source for its governance finding and omits the detail. The paper also declines to publish a point probability for any named future attack, following the National Academies position that adversary intent is properly treated as an analytic output rather than elicited as a probability input. Appendix B records the evidence gaps that follow from these choices, and Appendix C states the observations that would disconfirm each load-bearing claim. AI-enabled autonomy is moving from software into embodied systems, and domestic governance has not been integrated at a comparable level of specificity. This paper calls that a governance gap and treats it as an empirical and institutional claim, not a prediction, resting on oversight evidence of fragmented artificial-intelligence acquisition and counter-unmanned-aircraft-system governance. The central device is a four-phase capability-diffusion gradient, not a resemblance claim, tracking commercially accessible firepower, improvised systems, commercial aerial delivery in conflict zones, and AI-enabled platforms carrying persistent software and remote reprogramming. It does not equate an improvised device with a robot or predict domestic prevalence. The Ukrainian record supplies partial evidence for the fourth phase and supports a new construct, flash-to-bang compression, naming the lag between a capability becoming available and its hostile employment at scale. A further section separates payload from consequence. Two methodological contributions follow. Six operations-research relations convert contested governance language into auditable measurement, making layered defense a survival-probability standard, saturation a fielding condition, de-siloing a graph property, and information sharing a latency objective. Convergent risk estimation characterizes the threat distribution while refusing a point probability for any named future event. The conclusion follows a documented reversal in which the Department of Homeland Security identified a coordination gap, created an office to close it, then dispersed its functions. The paper proposes a civilian-led statutory AI-Autonomy and CBRN Resilience Nexus with a narrow charter, civil-liberties gating, independent audit, measurable indicators, and sunset provisions, offered as a testable design hypothesis whose disconfirming observations the appendices state.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no funding. The author received no grant, contract, fellowship, stipend, in-kind support, or institutional research support for this work, and self-funded all costs associated with it. No funder had any role in the design of the study, the selection or analysis of sources, the drafting of the manuscript, or the decision to submit it.

detail.abstract: AI-enabled autonomy is moving from software into embodied systems, and domestic gov‐ ernance has not been integrated at a comparable level of specificity. This paper calls that condition a governance gap and treats it as an empirical and institutional claim rather than a prediction. Oversight evidence documents fragmented artificial-intelligence acquisition and counter-unmanned-aircraft-system governance, including inconsistent internal guidance and constrained operational approvals. The paper’s central analytic device is a four-phase capability-diffusion gradient rather than a resemblance claim. It tracks commercially accessible firepower, improvised systems and dis‐ tributed knowledge, commercial aerial delivery in conflict zones, and AI-enabled systems that pair commercial platforms with persistent software and remote reprogramming. The frame‐ work asks whether access, adaptation, and institutional response change across phases. It does not equate an improvised device with a robot, predict domestic prevalence, or treat lower access barriers as evidence of operational success. The Ukrainian record supplies partial evidence for the fourth phase, running from commercial quadcopter grenade drops in 2022 through mass-produced strike drones to AI-enabled termin‐ al guidance. That record supports a new interpretive construct, flash-to-bang compression, which names the lag between a capability becoming available and its hostile employment at scale. The paper separates payload from consequence, showing that production and formula‐ tion barriers remain substantial while institutional and economic consequence cannot be reduced to lethality. Two methodological contributions follow. Six operations-research relations convert contested governance language into auditable measurement, making layered defense a survival-probabil‐ ity standard, saturation a fielding condition, de-siloing a graph property, and information sharing a latency objective. Convergent risk estimation then characterizes the threat distribu‐ tion without predicting a specific attack, supporting a bounded heavy-tail claim while refusing a point probability for a named future event. A separate analysis identifies four mechanisms through which aggregate cost-exchange ratios understate the defender’s burden. The prescriptive conclusion follows from a documented institutional reversal. The Department of Homeland Security testified in 2017 that it lacked a focal point in the weapons-of-massdestruction threat space, created an office to fill that role, allowed its authorization to lapse, and then dispersed its functions across multiple components. The paper proposes a civilianled statutory AI-Autonomy and CBRN Resilience Nexus with a narrow coordination and as‐ surance charter, no independent targeting or enforcement authority, civil-liberties gating, Inspector General audit, measurable indicators, and sunset provisions. It is offered as a testable design hypothesis, and the appendices state the observations that would disconfirm each load-bearing claim.

AI.tldr: 本文指出人工智能自主性正从软件进入实体系统，而国内治理未能以同等程度的特异性进行整合，构成"治理鸿沟"。论文提出了四阶段能力扩散梯度作为核心分析工具，并引入"闪光到爆炸压缩"（flash-to-bang compression）这一解释性建构，以刻画能力可用与敌对大规模使用之间的时间滞后。论文还提供两项方法论贡献：六种运筹学关系将争议性治理语言转化为可审计的度量，以及收敛风险估计方法在不预测特定攻击的前提下刻画威胁分布。最后提出以文官主导的法定AI-自主性与CBRN韧性联络枢纽作为可检验的制度设计假设。
AI.research_question: 如何理解和应对人工智能自主性从软件进入实体系统后所产生的国内治理鸿沟？具体而言，四阶段能力扩散如何演进、治理制度如何回应，以及应设计何种制度安排来弥合这一鸿沟？
AI.motivation: AI赋能的自主性正从软件领域扩展到实体系统（如无人机、自主武器等），但国内治理体系未能在同等特异性层面实现整合，形成了治理鸿沟。作者将其视为一个经验和制度性主张而非预测，旨在通过监督证据和系统性分析来阐明这一鸿沟的性质，并提供可操作的治理建议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 四阶段能力扩散梯度（四阶段能力扩散梯度）作为核心分析装置，取代了"相似性主张"；引入了"闪光到爆炸压缩"这一解释性建构；六种运筹学关系（分层防御作为生存概率标准、饱和作为部署条件、去筒仓化作为图属性、信息共享作为延迟目标等）；收敛风险估计。
AI.method: 基于监督证据的实证分析；四阶段能力扩散梯度框架；六种运筹学关系将治理语言转化为可审计度量；收敛风险估计方法；乌克兰的记录（从2022年商用四轴无人机投弹到大规模生产攻击型无人机再到AI终端制导）作为第四阶段的实证证据；文献分析识别四种使成本交换比率低估防御方负担的机制。
AI.findings: 治理鸿沟真实存在：人工智能采购和反无人机系统治理碎片化，内部指导不一致且作战审批受限。四项扩散阶段在获取渠道、适应性和制度响应方面存在差异。载荷与后果需要分离——生产和配方障碍仍然巨大，制度与经济后果不能简化为致命性。成本交换比率通过四种机制系统性低估防御方负担。国土安全部2017年以来的制度逆转（创建WMD协调办公室、授权失效、职能分散）证明了机构整合失败的教训。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"治理鸿沟"概念作为经验和制度性主张；创建"闪光到爆炸压缩"这一新的解释性建构；将争议性治理语言转化为可审计的度量关系；提出收敛风险估计方法，支持有界重尾主张但拒绝为特定未来事件提供点概率；区分载荷与后果的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了以文官主导的法定AI-自主性与CBRN韧性联络枢纽（AI-Autonomy and CBRN Resilience Nexus）制度设计，具有窄协调与保证章程、无独立目标定位或执法权、公民自由门控、监察长审计、可测指标和日落条款；提供了识别治理不足的六种度量工具；为政策制定者提供了可证伪的制度设计假设及相应的证伪观察清单。

title: Optimal Hybrid Storage Management for Stochastic Dual-Commodity Energy Systems
affiliations: , Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR) - Erasmus School of Economics (ESE), Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR), Rotterdam School of Management (RSM) and Erasmus Univeristy Rotterdam School of Management

detail.title: Optimal Hybrid Storage Management for Stochastic Dual-Commodity Energy Systems
detail.abstract: Electrification replaces fossil-fuel-based energy consumption with electricity increasingly generated from renewables. As electricity expands into transportation, heating, and industrial applications such as hydrogen production, a common renewable supply must serve multiple energy streams with distinct temporal requirements, connected through lossy conversion processes. Coordinating the resulting hybrid storage systems requires deciding how much inventory to preserve, where to store it, and when to transfer it across streams. Motivated by this setting, we study a broader finite-horizon stochastic resource-allocation problem with distinct demand streams, interconnected storage assets, and imperfect transfer operations. We characterize the optimal policy using storage-specific marginal values that organize decisions through three operating margins: service, transfer, and reserve. We show that storage assets act as substitutes when serving a common requirement but become complements within the transfer margin, where both source inventory and receiving capacity are required. Storage losses create an efficiency wedge between preserving existing inventory and creating inventory through transfer, generating ordered threshold regions in inventory space. We derive primitive-parameter bounds that yield exclusion conditions for operating margins without solving the dynamic program. In the final period, the policy admits an exact three-regime characterization, including an intermediate regime, in which one storage asset serves current shortages while the other is preserved for a terminal obligation. Benchmark models identify when this multidimensional structure collapses to classical single-inventory formulations. The framework provides insights into hybrid storage systems, including battery–hydrogen coordination, and more broadly into multi-inventory systems with heterogeneous demands and lossy resource transformation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个有限时域下的随机资源分配问题，其中包含不同的需求流、相互关联的存储资产以及有损耗的转移操作。作者利用存储特定的边际价值来刻画最优策略，通过服务、转移和储备三个运营边际来组织决策，并揭示了存储资产在不同边际下的替代与互补关系，以及存储损耗产生的效率楔子如何形成有序的阈值区域。
AI.research_question: 在电气化背景下，当可再生能源同时服务多个具有不同时间需求且通过有损耗转换过程连接的能源流时，如何最优地协调混合存储系统——即决定保留多少库存、存储在哪里以及何时跨流转移？
AI.motivation: 随着电气化推进，电力扩展到交通、供暖和工业应用（如氢能生产）等领域，一个共同的可再生能源供应必须服务多个具有不同时间需求的能源流，且这些流通过有损耗的转换过程连接。协调由此产生的混合存储系统是一个重要且尚未充分解决的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有限时域随机资源分配模型；存储特定的边际价值分析；三个运营边际（服务、转移、储备）的决策框架；动态规划。
AI.method: 构建有限时域随机资源分配问题的数学模型，利用存储特定的边际价值刻画最优策略结构，通过三个运营边际组织决策；推导原始参数边界以获得运营边际的排除条件；在最终时期给出精确的三区域刻画；并通过基准模型比较，识别多维结构何时退化为经典单库存模型。
AI.findings: （1）存储资产在服务共同需求时是替代品，但在转移边际内成为互补品，需要同时具备源库存和接收容量；（2）存储损耗在保留现有库存与通过转移创造库存之间产生效率楔子，形成库存空间中有序的阈值区域；（3）在最终时期，策略具有精确的三区域特征，包括一个中间区域，其中一种存储资产服务当前短缺，而另一种被保留用于最终义务；（4）原始参数边界可用于排除某些运营边际而无需求解动态规划。
AI.theory_contributions: 为多库存系统（具有异质需求和有损耗资源转换）提供了结构化的最优策略刻画，扩展了经典单库存随机库存理论；阐明了存储资产之间替代与互补关系如何随运营边际变化；建立了存储损耗与转化效率对策略结构影响的系统性理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为混合存储系统（如电池-氢能协调）提供了可操作的决策框架和阈值策略指南；通过参数边界条件帮助管理者在不求解复杂动态规划的情况下判断哪些运营边际需要激活，从而简化实际决策。

title: From Bottleneck Fit to Corporate Viability The Mewes/EKS Strategy in the Dynamic Architecture of the Schließmann Strategy Cube

detail.title: From Bottleneck Fit to Corporate Viability The Mewes/EKS Strategy in the Dynamic Architecture of the Schließmann Strategy Cube

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the originator of the Schließmann Strategy Cube and the Interdependency framework, both of which form part of the conceptual foundation examined in this paper. The author is collaborating with Dr. Jacek Marczyk and Ontonix since 2009 in integrating the OntoSpace methodology into the Interdependency approach for the analysis of complex organizational systems. These relationships constitute an intellectual and professional interest in the subject matter and are disclosed for transparency. The paper contains no sponsored evaluation or endorsement of Ontonix, the Wolfgang Mewes Foundation, or any other third-party organization.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research received no external grant funding. The study was conducted as independent research by the author.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The study was conducted as independent research by the author.

detail.abstract: The Mewes Strategy, historically known as the Bottleneck-Concentrated Strategy (EKS), is one of the most rigorous demand-oriented approaches to strategic positioning. Its principal contribution lies in concentrating a firm’s capabilities on a specific target group and on the bottleneck that most strongly constrains that group’s development. The methodology thereby creates a distinct fit between capabilities, customer problem and problem solution. Its seventh phase extends this logic by orienting the firm toward a supposedly constant underlying need, thereby moving the strategic perspective above individual products, technologies and temporary market configurations.¹ This paper examines the Mewes/EKS Strategy through the lens of Corporate Viability and the Schließmann Strategy Cube. Both approaches share a strong orientation toward customer utility, concentration and systemic thinking. Their diagnostic reach, however, differs. EKS primarily seeks to create a strong bottleneck fit. The Schließmann approach adds the distinct category of the firm’s viability within its relevant system and integrates relative strength in the Strategically Relevant Market, performance in that market and systemic viability into a three-dimensional diagnostic architecture.³ The particular dynamism of the Strategy Cube results from the context-dependence of all three dimensions. The definition of the Strategically Relevant Market determines which competitors and substitutes are relevant, which performance benchmarks are meaningful and which internal and external variables become decisive for viability. If the context changes, the strategic coordinates may change as well. The cube should therefore be understood as a moving strategic coordinate system. Particular attention is devoted to the viability dimension. Viability is conceptualized as a dynamic relationship between agility, robustness and complexity.¹⁰ The underlying variables are system-specific and evolve over time. This makes it possible to interpret viability as a trajectory. A firm may remain strong and profitable while its systemic viability is already deteriorating. The paper further examines the OntoSpace/Ontonix methodology integrated into Schließmann’s complexity-management framework. Quantitative Complexity Management can complement qualitative system diagnosis by monitoring changing interdependencies, complexity and resilience over time.¹⁴ ¹⁵ Combined with scenario analysis, it provides a conceptual basis for Viability Trajectory Monitoring. The central proposition is that EKS creates bottleneck fit, while Corporate Viability addresses the organizational capability for repeated strategic re-fit across changing bottleneck, business-model and system configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过企业生存力（Corporate Viability）和Schließmann战略立方体的视角，审视了Mewes/EKS战略（瓶颈集中战略）。EKS侧重于创造瓶颈契合度，而Schließmann方法则增加了企业在相关系统中的生存力维度，将战略相关市场中的相对实力、市场绩效和系统生存力整合为三维诊断架构。文章提出EKS创造瓶颈契合，而企业生存力关注组织在变化的瓶颈、商业模式和系统配置中反复进行战略再契合的能力。
AI.research_question: EKS/Mewes战略如何通过企业生存力（Corporate Viability）和Schließmann战略立方体的视角被重新审视和理解？两者的诊断范围、理论基础及互补性何在？
AI.motivation: EKS战略虽严谨但主要聚焦于瓶颈契合度的创造，忽视了企业在系统层面的生存力维度。作者希望通过引入Schließmann战略立方体和企业生存力概念，弥补EKS在动态环境适应性和系统生存力诊断方面的不足，为战略定位提供更全面的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. EKS瓶颈集中战略理论：能力集中于特定目标群体和制约其发展的瓶颈；2. 企业生存力理论：敏捷性、稳健性与复杂性之间的动态关系；3. Schließmann战略立方体：战略相关市场相对实力、市场绩效、系统生存力的三维诊断架构；4. OntoSpace/Ontonix复杂性管理方法论。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性论文。通过比较分析方法，将Mewes/EKS战略与Schließmann战略立方体及企业生存力框架进行理论整合和对比分析，并结合场景分析和定量复杂性管理（QCM）方法作为补充工具。
AI.findings: 1. EKS主要创造瓶颈契合度，而企业生存力关注组织在变化的系统中反复进行战略再契合的能力；2. 战略立方体的三个维度均具有情境依赖性，应被视为一个移动的战略坐标系；3. 生存力可被解释为一条轨迹——企业可能在系统生存力恶化时仍保持强大和盈利；4. 定量复杂性管理与场景分析结合，为生存力轨迹监测提供概念基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献在于：将EKS瓶颈契合逻辑与系统生存力的动态视角进行整合，提出了"生存力轨迹"概念，丰富了对企业长期战略适应性的理论理解，并将战略定位从静态的瓶颈匹配扩展到动态的系统生存力监测。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献在于：为企业提供了超越单一瓶颈匹配的三维战略诊断框架，通过生存力轨迹监测帮助管理者在系统环境变化前识别潜在危机，为战略再定位和复杂性管理提供了可操作的监测工具。

title: Reform of Financing for the Merah Putih Village and Urban Village Cooperatives in West Papua to Achieve Transparency and Economic Justice in West Papua Province
affiliations: , STIM Publik Makassar, Universitas Musamus Merauke, Papua, indonesia, Wira Bhakti College of Economics and Wira Bhakti College of Economics

detail.title: Reform of Financing for the Merah Putih Village and Urban Village Cooperatives in West Papua to Achieve Transparency and Economic Justice in West Papua Province
detail.abstract: Merah Putih Village/Kelurahan Cooperatives (Koperasi Desa/Kelurahan Merah Putih KDKMP) are intended to strengthen community-based economic institutions in Indonesia. This study examines financing governance in KDKMP in West Papua, focusing on institutional capacity, information transparency, regulatory alignment, digital governance, and member participation. A descriptive qualitative case-study design is employed using interviews, observation, documentation, and policy review. The empirical material covers government actors, cooperative managers, Business Assistants (BA), Project Management Officers (PMO), community representatives, and cooperative stakeholders. The analysis follows data reduction, data display, and conclusion drawing. The findings indicate a gap between formal institutional expansion and substantive governance capacity. Across 831 cooperatives reported in the 2025 SIMKOPDES data, 202 had NIB, 667 had NPWP, and 213 had conducted RAT in 2025. Field evidence further indicates geographic and logistical constraints, incomplete administrative requirements, regulatory uncertainty, limited managerial capacity, uneven information disclosure, weak connectivity, and incomplete digital reporting. The study argues that digital governance should complement not substitute for institutional capacity. Based on the findings, a transparent financing framework is proposed combining policy alignment, proportional financing, transparent funding flows, digital reporting, capacity building, member participation, oversight, and local adaptation. The contribution is an empirically grounded policy framework for understanding how a national cooperative program is translated into local institutional practice in a geographically complex region.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过描述性定性案例研究，考察了西巴布亚地区Merah Putih村合作社（KDKMP）的融资治理，发现正式制度扩张与实际治理能力之间存在差距，并提出结合政策对齐、比例融资、透明资金流、数字报告、能力建设、成员参与、监督和地方适应的透明融资框架。
AI.research_question: 在印尼西巴布亚的地理复杂区域，国家合作社计划（KDKMP）如何转化为地方机构实践？其融资治理面临哪些挑战？
AI.motivation: KDKMP旨在加强印尼社区经济机构，但正式制度扩张与实际治理能力之间存在差距，需要实证研究来理解这一国家级计划在地理复杂区域的落地情况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度治理理论视角，涵盖制度能力、信息透明度、监管对齐、数字治理和成员参与等维度。
AI.method: 描述性定性案例研究设计，采用访谈、观察、文献和政策审查收集数据，涵盖政府行为者、合作社管理者、业务助理（BA）、项目管理官（PMO）、社区代表等多元利益相关者，分析遵循数据缩减、数据展示和结论提炼。
AI.findings: 正式制度扩张与实质治理能力之间存在差距：2025年SIMKOPDES数据中831家合作社仅有202家有NIB、667家有NPWP、213家完成了RAT。实地证据显示地理和物流约束、行政要求不完整、监管不确定性、管理能力有限、信息披露不均、连接性薄弱和数字报告不完整等问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出数字治理应补充而非替代制度能力的论点，并构建了一个基于实证的透明融资框架，为理解国家合作社计划在地理复杂区域的本地转化提供了理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出结合政策对齐、比例融资、透明资金流、数字报告、能力建设、成员参与、监督和地方适应的透明融资框架，为政策制定者和合作社管理者提供实践指导。

title: Artificial Intelligence, Human Rights and the Transformation of Constitutional Law

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence, Human Rights and the Transformation of Constitutional Law
detail.abstract: This article examines how automated decision-making is altering the doctrinal architecture through which constitutional courts protect fundamental rights, without amendment of the underlying constitutional texts. The literature on artificial intelligence and constitutional law has concentrated on two separate strands-administrative-law accountability for algorithmic government decisions, and data-protection doctrine-while leaving underexplored how proportionality review itself, the primary interpretive mechanism by which constitutional courts adjudicate rights limitations, is being reshaped by opaque, statistically derived decision criteria that resist the necessity and suitability inquiries proportionality doctrine assumes. Drawing on comparative constitutional analysis across the European Union, Germany, the United States, Brazil, India, and South Africa, and on jurisprudence including the Dutch SyRI litigation, the German Bundesverfassungsgericht's informational self-determination line, the Indian Supreme Court's Puttaswamy decision, and Brazil's Supremo Tribunal Federal data-protection rulings, this article argues that proportionality analysis is undergoing silent doctrinal drift: courts are substituting procedural transparency mandates for substantive necessity review because the latter has become epistemically inaccessible to judicial reasoning. The article's original contribution is to identify this drift as a distinct constitutional phenomenon-proportionality's evidentiary collapse-and to propose the Algorithmic Proportionality and Rights Continuity Standard (APRCS), an institutional mechanism requiring courts to appoint independent technical assessors before proportionality review proceeds in any case involving automated rights-affecting decisions. The article concludes that constitutional law is being transformed not through formal amendment but through the quiet erosion of the evidentiary preconditions proportionality doctrine requires, with consequences for the legitimacy of rights adjudication generally.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨自动化决策如何在不修改宪法文本的情况下，悄然改变宪法法院保护基本权利的教义架构。作者通过比较分析欧盟、德国、美国、巴西、印度和南非的宪法实践，论证比例原则审查正经历"证据性崩溃"——法院因必要性审查在认识论上难以企及，转而以程序性透明度要求替代实质性必要性审查。文章提出"算法比例原则与权利连续性标准"（APRCS）作为制度性解决方案，要求法院在涉及自动化决策影响权利的案件中进行比例原则审查前，任命独立技术评估员。
AI.research_question: 自动化决策如何重塑宪法法院进行基本权利保护的比例原则审查机制？面对不透明、基于统计学的决策标准，比例原则教义中的必要性和适当性审查正在经历怎样的变革？
AI.motivation: 现有AI与宪法法研究集中于行政法问责和数据保护教义两条路径，忽略了比例原则审查本身——宪法法院裁决权利限制的首要解释机制——如何被规避必要性和适当性审查的算法决策重塑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比例原则教义（涵盖适当性、必要性、狭义比例性审查）；比较宪法分析；程序性正当程序与实质性审查的区分；认识论可及性理论。
AI.method: 比较宪法分析，涵盖欧盟、德国、美国、巴西、印度和南非的司法判例，包括荷兰SyRI诉讼、德国联邦宪法法院的信息自决权判例、印度最高法院Puttaswamy判决、巴西最高法院数据保护裁决。
AI.findings: 比例原则审查正经历"静默的教义漂移"：法院以程序性透明度要求替代实质性必要性审查，因为后者在认识论上已对司法推理变得不可及。这种"比例原则的证据性崩溃"是一个独立的宪法现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将比例原则的"证据性崩溃"识别为独特的宪法现象；提出"算法比例原则与权利连续性标准"（APRCS）这一制度性机制，填补了比例原则在算法决策情境下的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出可操作的政策建议：在涉及自动化决策影响权利的案件中，法院须在比例原则审查前任命独立技术评估员，以保障权利的实质审查而非程序替代，从而维护权利裁决的正当性。

title: Household Electrification and Fintech Adoption Rate in Ghana
affiliations: University of Cape Coast - Department of Economics, Students,  and Northeastern University (USA)

detail.title: Household Electrification and Fintech Adoption Rate in Ghana

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that there are no conflicts of interest related to this research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific funding from public agencies, commercial entities, or non-profit organizations.

detail.abstract: Ghana's energy and financial inclusion policies have developed along largely separate tracks, and the empirical literature on financial technology adoption in Sub-Saharan Africa has generally treated locality as an undifferentiated rural or urban indicator rather than isolating household electrification as a distinct predictor. This study examines the association between household electrification and mobile money adoption in Ghana using data from the seventh round of the Ghana Living Standards Survey (N = 13,844), estimating three Bayesian logistic regression models to test whether this association exists, whether it varies by locality, and whether it varies across the household welfare distribution. Household electrification is credibly associated with mobile money adoption net of mobile phone ownership, consumption, household size, locality, and region (OR = 1.18, 95% CI: 1.04, 1.34). This association is concentrated among rural households (OR = 1.21, 95% CI: 1.05, 1.40) and is not credible among urban households (OR = 1.08, 95% CI: 0.84, 1.41). Across the welfare distribution, the association traces an inverted-U pattern, credible in the second and third welfare quintiles but not in the poorest, fourth, or wealthiest quintiles. Leave-one-out cross-validation indicates neither interaction detectably improves out-of-sample predictive accuracy relative to the baseline model, a finding reported alongside the credible-interval evidence rather than in place of it. These results suggest household electrification carries an unevenly distributed association with financial technology adoption.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用加纳第七轮生活水平调查数据（N=13,844），通过三个贝叶斯逻辑回归模型考察家庭通电与移动货币采用之间的关联。研究发现家庭通电与移动货币采用之间存在可信的正向关联（OR=1.18），该关联主要集中在农村家庭，并呈倒U型分布（在第二、第三福利五分位区间显著）。尽管交互项并未显著提升样本外预测准确性，但研究揭示了家庭通电与金融科技采纳之间不均匀的关联模式。
AI.research_question: 家庭通电是否与移动货币采用相关联？这种关联是否因城乡区位而异？这种关联是否随家庭福利分布而变化？
AI.motivation: 加纳的能源政策与金融包容政策长期分离发展，且撒哈拉以南非洲的金融科技采用实证文献通常将区位视为未区分的城乡指标，而非将家庭通电作为独立预测因子，存在研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融包容理论与能源获取的赋能视角，将家庭通电作为金融科技（移动货币）采用的独立预测因子。
AI.method: 使用加纳第七轮生活水平调查数据（N=13,844），估计三个贝叶斯逻辑回归模型，并采用留一法交叉验证评估模型预测性能。
AI.findings: 家庭通电与移动货币采用存在可信的正向关联（OR=1.18, 95% CI: 1.04-1.34），该关联集中在农村家庭（OR=1.21）而非城市家庭（OR=1.08）；关联在福利分布中呈倒U型，在第二和第三福利五分位区间可信，但在最贫困、第四和最高五分位区间不可信；交互项未显著改善样本外预测准确性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将家庭通电从笼统的城乡区位指标中分离出来，作为影响金融科技采用的独立预测因子，填补了文献空白；揭示了能源获取与金融技术采用之间不均匀的关联结构。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加纳乃至撒哈拉以南非洲的能源政策与金融包容政策的协同整合提供了实证依据，表明应针对农村家庭和中等福利群体进行精准干预。

The author's Post-Graduate Fellowship at Ashoka University (completed) was not associated with this specific research project.

detail.abstract:
India's fiscal federal architecture structured around Articles 266-267 and 292-293 of the Constitution, periodic Finance Commission awards, and the Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management (FRBM) framework has thus far not incorporated a formalised, state-level investment fund architecture as an instrument of intergenerational savings and counter-cyclical capital deployment.

This paper argues that the creation of constitutionally anchored Sub-National Investment Funds (SNIFs) for each Indian state represents a structurally significant, institutionally feasible, and macroeconomically desirable reform. Drawing on the existing precedents of the Kerala Infrastructure Investment Fund Board (KIIFB, cumulative approved outlay of ₹96,487 crore as of December 2025), the Tamil Nadu Infrastructure Fund Management Corporation (TNIFMC), the National Investment and Infrastructure Fund (NIIF, USD 4.9 billion AUM targeting doubling to USD 10 billion by 2028-29), and international analogues such as the Alberta Heritage Savings Trust Fund and the Alaska Permanent Fund, the paper develops a comprehensive policy proposal for a uniform SNIF architecture. It assesses the constitutional landscape under Part XII of the Constitution, identifies the precise statutory and regulatory actions required including potential constitutional amendments to entrench mandatory savings rules and intergovernmental coordination and quantifies the potential economic impact, including effects on gross capital formation, state infrastructure financing, and fiscal deficit sustainability.

The paper finds that no constitutional amendment is legally necessary to establish SNIFs, but strategic amendments would significantly strengthen their effectiveness, insulate them from political capture, and embed them into the formal edifice of cooperative fiscal federalism. Given that the 16th Finance Commission's award (2026-31) retains states' vertical share at 41 per cent, introduces a new 10 per cent GDP contribution criterion for horizontal devolution, drops the 2.5 per cent tax effort criterion, and ends revenue deficit grants entirely, and given the troubling evidence that 20 major states collectively achieved only 77.23 per cent capex budget utilisation in FY2025-26 despite budgeting a higher ₹10.26 trillion outlay, the structural case and policy timing for this reform are uniquely compelling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出为印度各邦建立宪法锚定的"次国家级投资基金"（SNIFs）架构，作为代际储蓄和反周期资本部署的制度工具。论文论证该改革具有结构重要性、制度可行性和宏观经济可取性，并基于国内外先例（如喀拉拉邦基础设施投资基金、阿尔伯塔遗产储蓄信托基金等）提出统一政策方案。
AI.research_question: 印度各邦是否应该以及如何建立宪法锚定的次国家级投资基金（SNIFs）架构，以作为代际储蓄和反周期资本部署的制度工具？
AI.motivation: 印度当前的财政联邦架构（宪法第266-267条和第292-293条、财政委员会裁决及FRBM框架）尚未纳入正式的邦级投资基金架构。同时，各邦资本支出预算执行率仅77.23%（FY2025-26），财政纪律和基础设施融资面临严峻挑战，亟需制度性改革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政联邦主义理论；代际公平储蓄理论；反周期财政政策理论；合作性财政联邦主义框架
AI.method: 定性政策分析：宪法法律分析（Part XII）、案例比较研究（国内外基金先例）、制度设计与政策提案构建、经济影响量化评估
AI.findings: 1) 建立SNIFs在法律上无需宪法修正案；2) 战略性宪法修正将显著增强其有效性并防止政治俘获；3) 当前政策时机（第16届财政委员会裁决及资本支出低执行率）使得该改革具有独特紧迫性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将代际储蓄基金理论拓展至次国家级财政联邦主义语境，提出"宪法锚定的反周期投资基金"作为财政联邦架构的新制度化工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为印度各邦提供可操作的SNIF架构设计方案；2) 明确所需的宪法修正和法规行动路径；3) 量化改革对资本形成、邦基础设施融资和财政赤字可持续性的潜在影响；4) 提供国内外基金先例的借鉴框架。

title: Screening for Collusion by Stage, Not by Type A Lifecycle-organised Instrument for Public Asset Disposition

detail.title: Screening for Collusion by Stage, Not by Type A Lifecycle-organised Instrument for Public Asset Disposition

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is a named petitioner, together with the National Association of Judicial Auctioneers, in the administrative control proceeding discussed in the author's related working paper, and authored the legal opinion that supported it. He serves as President of the National Association of Judicial Auctioneers and of the São Paulo State Auctioneers' Union, professional bodies whose members benefit from the rule under discussion. The instrument presented here derives from the author's own practice as an Official Public Auctioneer.

detail.abstract:
Existing guidance on detecting collusion in public transactions is organised around forms, patterns and observable manifestations of the conduct. The OECD Bid-Rigging Detection List groups red flags by manifestation: warning signs in bidding patterns, in tender documents and in pricing, together with suspicious statements and suspicious behaviour. The Antitrust Division of the Department of Justice organises its published red flags under the acronym MAPS: Market, Applications, Patterns, and Suspicious Behavior. FAR 3.301(a) enumerates examples of anticompetitive practices, and FAR 3.303(c) a longer list of practices or events that may evidence violations. The taxonomies differ, but they share an orientation: each leads the user to recognise patterns and signs associated with collusion, rather than organising observation by the operational stage at which the official stands. That orientation does not suit the official conducting the sale. That official moves through a sequence: receiving the asset, valuing it, preparing the listing, qualifying bidders, running the bidding, verifying payment, documenting transfer. At each stage some things are visible and others are not. An instrument organised by type of conduct requires the official to hold the whole taxonomy in mind at every moment. An instrument organised by stage tells the official what to look for now. 

This paper presents a screening instrument for collusion in public asset disposition organised by the stage of the disposition lifecycle at which the official stands. It comprises thirty-seven indicators distributed across seven stages, seven of which are quantitative and applicable retrospectively to an agency's own sales history. Three design choices are defended: organisation by stage; calibration of thresholds against the agency's own historical series rather than against an external benchmark; and the placement of the indicator-evidence distinction, which both principal sources state but which this instrument repeats at every section and converts into an express prohibition. 

The instrument is offered for use and for criticism. It has not been validated against known outcomes, and Part VII states what such validation would require.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种按公共资产处置生命周期阶段组织的合谋筛查工具，包含37个指标，分布在7个阶段中，其中7个为可追溯应用于机构历史销售数据的定量指标。该工具区别于现有按行为形式组织的检测框架（如OECD、DOJ MAPS、FAR），强调按操作阶段组织观察，并辩护了三个设计选择：按阶段组织、校准阈值基于机构自身历史序列、以及指标与证据的区分。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种按公共资产处置流程操作阶段组织的合谋筛查工具，以更好地匹配现场官员的实际工作流程？
AI.motivation: 现有合谋检测指南（OECD Bid-Rigging Detection List、DOJ的MAPS框架、FAR条款）均按行为类型或表现形式组织，要求官员在每时每刻记住整个分类体系。但实际执行出售的官员是按阶段顺序工作的（接收资产、估值、准备挂牌、资格审核、投标运行、付款验证、文件转移），按阶段组织的工具能告诉官员"现在该看什么"。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公共采购/处置中的合谋检测理论，以及操作阶段流程理论（disposition lifecycle stages）。文章参考了OECD和DOJ的现有红旗清单分类体系，但提出按操作阶段重组观察框架。
AI.method: 提出一个筛查工具（screening instrument），包含37个指标，分布在7个处置生命周期阶段。其中7个为定量指标，可回溯应用于机构自身的销售历史。文章辩护三个设计选择：按阶段组织、阈值校准基于机构自身历史序列而非外部基准、指标与证据的区分，并将其转化为明确禁令。
AI.findings: 提出了一个由37个指标组成的七阶段合谋筛查工具。该工具尚未针对已知结果进行验证，第七部分说明了验证所需的条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种新的检测工具组织原则——按操作阶段而非行为类型组织合谋筛查，弥补了现有框架（OECD、DOJ、FAR）不适应现场官员工作流程的缺陷。同时辩护了基于机构自身历史序列的阈值校准方法，以及指标-证据区分的制度化。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共资产处置官员提供了一份按工作阶段组织的、可直接操作使用的合谋筛查清单，包含37个可操作指标和7个定量回溯性指标，并明确说明了未来验证该工具所需的步骤。该工具同时供使用和批评，处于开放讨论状态。

title: GPU-Optimized Lock-Free FIFO Queues for High-Throughput Parallel Computing

detail.title: GPU-Optimized Lock-Free FIFO Queues for High-Throughput Parallel Computing
detail.abstract: The rapid growth of GPU computing has transformed the way computationally intensive workloads are processed, particularly in scientific computing, artificial intelligence, graph analytics, simulation, image processing, and high-performance data analytics. Modern graphics processing units provide thousands of simultaneously active threads, allowing large collections of independent operations to be executed at very high throughput. However, many important applications are not purely data parallel. They contain dynamic workloads in which threads must generate, exchange, schedule, and consume tasks during execution. In such situations, a concurrent first-in-first-out (FIFO) queue becomes an important coordination mechanism. Conventional queue implementations based on locks can become a significant bottleneck because thousands of GPU threads may attempt to access the same data structure simultaneously. Lock contention, serialization, thread divergence, synchronization overhead, and memory-system pressure can prevent an application from benefiting fully from the massive parallelism of the GPU. The proposed methodology evaluates queue performance through throughput, latency, contention, scalability, occupancy, memory efficiency, and correctness under different producer-consumer configurations. The analysis shows that a successful GPU queue should not simply translate a CPU lock-free algorithm directly to CUDA. Instead, it must account for SIMT execution, memory hierarchy, warp behavior, atomic contention, synchronization scope, and workload imbalance. GPU-optimized lock-free FIFO queues therefore represent an important building block for scalable task scheduling and irregular parallel algorithms where dynamic work generation is unavoidable.

AI.tldr: 本文研究GPU环境下并发FIFO队列的性能评估与优化方法，指出传统的基于锁的队列实现在GPU大规模并行场景下会成为性能瓶颈，而GPU优化的无锁FIFO队列是实现可扩展任务调度和不规则并行算法的关键构建模块。
AI.research_question: 在GPU大规模并行计算环境下，如何设计和评估高性能的并发FIFO队列？传统的CPU锁基队列实现是否能直接迁移到GPU平台？
AI.motivation: GPU计算在各领域快速增长，但许多重要应用包含动态工作负载，需要并发FIFO队列作为协调机制。传统基于锁的队列实现在GPU上会因锁竞争、串行化、线程发散、同步开销和内存系统压力等问题成为性能瓶颈，阻碍应用充分利用GPU的大规模并行性。
AI.theoretical_framework: GPU并行计算模型（SIMT执行模型）、无锁并发数据结构理论、GPU内存层次结构理论、生产者-消费者并发模型
AI.method: 提出一套综合性的队列性能评估方法论，通过吞吐量、延迟、竞争程度、可扩展性、占用率、内存效率和正确性等多个维度，在不同生产者-消费者配置下评估GPU队列性能。
AI.findings: 成功的GPU队列不应简单地将CPU无锁算法直接移植到CUDA，必须考虑SIMT执行特性、内存层次结构、warp行为、原子操作竞争、同步作用域和工作负载不平衡等因素。GPU优化的无锁FIFO队列是动态任务调度和不规则并行算法的重要基础组件。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了CPU无锁算法直接移植到GPU的局限性，为GPU并发数据结构设计提供了理论指导框架，强调了SIMT执行模型下队列设计的特殊考量因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了GPU队列性能的多维度评估方法论，指导开发者如何针对GPU架构特性优化无锁FIFO队列，为科学计算、AI、图分析等领域中动态工作负载的高效调度提供实践指导。

title: Redistribution Through Market Power: Monetary and Fiscal Transmission
affiliations: University of South Carolina - University of South Carolina - Darla Moore School of Business - Department of Economics

detail.title: Redistribution Through Market Power: Monetary and Fiscal Transmission
detail.abstract: Markups determine how much of a policy impulse reaches households as wages rather than profits, and those flows accrue to households with different propensities to consume. I embed a calibrated heterogeneous-firm markup block in a heterogeneous-agent New Keynesian model and vary market power over the range implied by US manufacturing data, holding the top-five-percent sales share fixed. Higher market power weakens fiscal policy because shocks generate less wage income as the labor share falls. Monetary policy works differently: rate cuts generate larger equity revaluations, and because these accrue to low-propensity households, output changes little while incidence shifts toward wealthy households. In general equilibrium the top and bottom wealth quintiles gain almost equally at low market power, while the top gains about twice as much at high market power. These effects concern the marginal policy dollar; in the baseline model, higher market power lowers steady-state consumption proportionally across the wealth distribution.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含异质性企业加成率和异质性代理人的新凯恩斯模型，研究市场势力如何影响财政与货币政策的传导效果。研究发现，更高的市场势力会削弱财政政策效果（因为劳动收入份额下降），而货币政策通过股权重估对富裕家庭产生更大影响，且在高市场势力下顶层财富群体受益约为底层两倍。
AI.research_question: 市场势力的变化如何影响财政政策和货币政策向家庭部门的传导，以及不同财富群体的分配效应？
AI.motivation: 加成率（markup）决定了政策冲击有多少转化为工资而非利润，而工资与利润流向不同消费倾向的家庭，因此市场势力对政策效果和分配效应有重要影响。现有研究对此关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质性企业加成率模型 + 异质性代理人新凯恩斯模型（HANK）
AI.method: 构建包含校准的异质性企业加成率模块的异质性代理人新凯恩斯模型，在美国制造业数据隐含的市场势力范围内变动市场势力，同时保持前5%销售份额不变，进行定量模拟分析。
AI.findings: 1）更高的市场势力削弱财政政策效果，因为劳动收入份额下降导致工资收入减少；2）货币政策效果不同：降息导致更大的股权重估，但因这些收益流向低消费倾向家庭，产出变化很小而负担转向富裕家庭；3）一般均衡下，低市场势力时顶层与底层财富五分位家庭获益几乎相等，而高市场势力时顶层获益约为底层的两倍；4）在基准模型中，高市场势力按比例降低财富分布各阶层的稳态消费。
AI.theory_contributions: 将市场势力（企业定价能力）引入异质性代理人新凯恩斯框架，揭示了市场势力对财政/货币政策分配效应的不对称影响机制，为理解市场集中度与宏观经济政策效果的关联提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于市场势力如何影响财政与货币政策有效性和分配后果的定量证据，提示在高市场势力环境下需要调整政策工具的选择与设计。

title: Mergers and Economic Efficiency
affiliations: Dartmouth College - Tuck School of Business

detail.title: Mergers and Economic Efficiency

keywords: Public and Private Firms JEL classification: D24

detail.abstract:
In this chapter, I review the research on mergers and acquisitions and their implications for economic efficiency. The central question is whether ownership changes improve the allocation and operation of productive assets, or instead primarily reshape market structure and pricing. The evidence points to a substantial reallocation role for the market for corporate assets. Plants and divisions move toward higher-productivity owners, particularly when product market shocks change the efficient scale or scope of production. Outcomes also depend on what happens after closing, since many transactions are followed by divestitures, plant closures and refocusing. Boundary adjustment is part of the mechanism through which gains are realized. 

A second theme is that productivity measurement is not neutral to market power. Revenue-based productivity measures can rise when prices or markups rise, so credible research designs rely on asset-level data, explicit attention to selection and counterfactuals, and settings where physical efficiency can be observed. A third theme is that mergers that combine complementary assets that can bring new products to market are also a significant source of value. Transactions between firms with similar products are frequently followed by new product introductions, a margin that plant-level productivity measures cannot capture, since the output is a product that did not exist before. Public firms can play a central role here in developing the innovation of private firms. Small private firms are often efficient at discovery but may lack the capacity, distribution and capital to commercialize their discoveries. Ex post potential sales can raise the return to research, so an active acquisition market can encourage small firm innovation rather than suppressing it. 

I close by discussing implications for antitrust and corporate finance. I emphasize the need to measure efficiency and market power jointly, to model restructuring as part of the merger process, to recognize that restricting acquisitions carries a dynamic cost in innovative industries, and to understand when public and private merger waves differ in their efficiency content.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了并购研究及其对经济效率的影响，核心问题是所有权变更是否改善生产性资产的配置和运营，还是主要重塑市场结构和定价。证据表明公司资产市场具有显著的再配置作用，工厂和部门会向生产率更高的所有者转移。论文还探讨了生产率测度与市场势力的关系、互补性资产并购的创新价值，以及对反垄断和企业金融的启示。
AI.research_question: 所有权变更（并购）是否改善生产性资产的配置和运营，还是主要重塑市场结构和定价？
AI.motivation: 并购对经济效率的影响存在争议，需要系统梳理证据以理解并购的再配置作用、生产率测度问题、创新价值及其政策含义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 并购再配置理论、生产率测度理论（收入型生产率与市场势力）、互补性资产与创新理论
AI.method: 文献综述方法，综合回顾并购领域的实证研究证据。
AI.findings: 1) 并购具有显著的资产再配置作用，资产向生产率更高的所有者转移，尤其在产品市场冲击改变生产有效规模或范围时；2) 并购后常有剥离、工厂关闭和业务聚焦，边界调整是收益实现机制的一部分；3) 收入型生产率测度可能因价格上涨或加成率上升而虚增，需依赖资产级数据和注意选择与反事实问题；4) 合并互补性资产、将新产品推向市场的并购是重要价值来源，相似产品企业间的交易常伴随新产品引入；5) 上市公司在开发私营企业创新方面发挥核心作用，活跃的收购市场可以鼓励而非抑制小企业创新；6) 需要同时测度效率和市场势力，将重组视为并购过程的一部分，并认识限制收购在创新行业中的动态成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合了并购的再配置效率、生产率测度偏差与市场势力、创新激励三个维度的理论视角，提出了效率与市场势力需联合测度的理论主张。
AI.practical_contributions: 为反垄断政策和企业金融实践提供启示：需要联合测度效率和市场势力、将重组建模为并购过程的一部分、认识创新行业中限制收购的动态成本、理解公共与私营并购浪潮在效率内容上的差异。

title: Responsible Persons and Responsible Governance: A Proposal for Ontario's Nonprofit Reform, circa 2030

detail.title: Responsible Persons and Responsible Governance: A Proposal for Ontario's Nonprofit Reform, circa 2030
detail.abstract: Responsible Persons and Responsible Governance: A Proposal for Ontario's Nonprofit Reform Ontario's nonprofit sector faces a persistent governance gap rooted in the continued use of commercial corporate terminology-particularly the term director-to describe fiduciaries of mission-driven, public-purpose organizations. Although the Not-for-Profit Corporations Act, 2010 (ONCA) modernized procedural governance when it finally came into force in 2021, it did not modernize fiduciary identity. As a result, many nonprofits continue to operate with outdated bylaws, inconsistent governance practices, and conceptual misunderstandings about fiduciary duty. Drawing on comparative developments in Australia and New Zealand, this paper argues that Ontario should adopt the term Responsible Persons to replace or supplement "director," thereby aligning fiduciary identity with the mission-anchored, trust-law-influenced nature of nonprofit governance. The paper further proposes the adoption of an objective fiduciary litmus test, grounded in author's recent scholarship to transform nonprofit decision-making from subjective appeals to mission alignment into structured, evidence-based fiduciary analysis. Together, these reforms would strengthen governance integrity, reduce fiduciary risk, improve dispute-resolution processes, and support Ontario's nonprofit sector in fulfilling its public-purpose role. Ontario spent a decade studying nonprofit governance; the next decade should be spent modernizing it.

AI.tldr: 本文主张安大略省应改革非营利组织治理，采用"Responsible Persons"（负责人）一词替代"director"（董事），并引入客观的信义义务试金石测试，以弥合商业公司法术语与非营利使命驱动型组织之间的治理鸿沟。
AI.research_question: 安大略省非营利部门应如何改革其治理框架，以解决商业公司术语（特别是"director"）与使命驱动的公共目的组织之间的错配问题？
AI.motivation: 尽管2010年《非营利公司法》（ONCA）于2021年生效，实现了程序治理的现代化，但未能实现信义身份（fiduciary identity）的现代化。许多非营利组织仍以过时的章程、不一致的治理实践和对信义义务的概念性误解运作，存在持续性的治理赤字。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信义义务理论（fiduciary duty theory）、信托法影响下的非营利治理理论、比较公司法/非营利法框架（澳大利亚和新西兰）
AI.method: 比较法分析方法，借鉴澳大利亚和新西兰的立法发展，结合作者前期关于客观信义义务试金石测试的学术研究成果，提出规范性改革建议。
AI.findings: 建议安大略省采用"Responsible Persons"替代或补充"director"术语；提议采纳基于证据的客观信义义务试金石测试，将非营利决策从主观的使命一致性呼吁转变为结构化的信义分析。
AI.theory_contributions: 将非营利组织中的"director"概念重新概念化为"Responsible Persons"，将信义身份与使命锚定的、受信托法影响的非营利治理本质对齐；提出将信义义务分析从主观标准转向客观结构化标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出强化治理完整性、降低信义风险、改善争议解决流程的具体改革方案，支持安大略省非营利部门履行其公共目的角色。

title: Content Generation: Human Creators, AI Learning, and Platform Design
affiliations: , University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management and

detail.title: Content Generation: Human Creators, AI Learning, and Platform Design

declarations.funderStatement: The authors gratefully acknowledge support from the Management Data and Analytics Lab at the Rotman School of Management.

detail.abstract: Generative AI increasingly competes with human creators for consumer attention on the same platforms, even as it improves by training on the very content those creators produce. We study how a platform should manage this feedback loop through its two principal levers: how it compensates human creators, and how prominently its recommendation algorithm promotes human relative to AI content. We develop a three-stage game in which the platform sets these instruments, the creator then chooses a costly effort that effectively determines her content quality, an AI generator produces content whose quality combines a baseline capability with how effectively it learns from the creator (learning efficiency), and consumers choose between the two sources in a Hotelling market. We characterize the equilibrium of this game under two platform monetization designs: view-based, in which revenue and payment to creators scale with the audience size, and engagement-based, in which they scale with the quality consumed. While the platform always prefers a higher AI capability (i.e., baseline quality or learning efficiency), the human content creator may prefer an intermediate AI capability that balances the (negative) competitive effects on the human creator and the (positive) effect on the quality of the AI content. From a design point of view, we show how the platform's and creator's preference between the two designs depends on the AI baseline quality and learning efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文研究平台如何通过两个杠杆（对创作者的补偿机制和推荐算法中人类与AI内容的相对曝光度）来管理生成式AI与人类创作者之间的反馈循环。通过三阶段博弈模型，分析了基于观看量和基于互动量两种平台变现设计下的均衡结果。
AI.research_question: 平台应如何管理生成式AI与人类创作者之间的反馈循环？具体而言，平台应如何设置创作补偿和内容推荐两个杠杆，以优化其收益和平台生态？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI与人类创作者在同一平台上争夺消费者注意力，且AI通过训练人类创作者产生的内容来提升自身能力，形成一个反馈循环。这种新型竞争格局对平台管理提出了新的挑战，现有研究尚未系统回答平台如何通过补偿和推荐两个杠杆来管理这一反馈循环。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三阶段博弈模型、Hotelling市场模型、反馈循环理论
AI.method: 构建三阶段博弈模型：平台设定补偿和推荐工具→创作者选择努力水平（决定内容质量）→AI生成器产生内容（质量取决于基准能力和从创作者学习的能力）→消费者在Hotelling市场中选择来源。
AI.findings: （1）平台总是偏好更高的AI能力，但人类创作者可能偏好中间水平的AI能力，以平衡竞争负效应和AI内容质量提升的正效应；（2）平台和创作者对两种变现设计（基于观看量vs.基于互动量）的偏好取决于AI基准质量和学习效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将生成式AI与人类创作者的反馈循环纳入平台管理博弈分析框架，揭示了AI能力对平台与创作者激励的非对称影响，并比较了两种变现设计下的均衡结果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台在AI时代如何设计创作者补偿机制和推荐算法提供了理论指导，帮助平台在AI能力不同发展阶段选择最优的变现设计策略。

title: China's Open Innovation Network: Anatomy and Lessons for Policy
affiliations: Xi'an Jiaotong-Liverpool University (XJTLU)

detail.title: China's Open Innovation Network: Anatomy and Lessons for Policy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Author has no conflict of interest to declare
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: Network effects on innovation are a highly relevant area of interest for managers and policy makers. Anatomizing the formation and the key features of such ecosystem in a fast growing, innovation-driven country like China can provide instructive lessons on designing policies that more effectively foster innovation. In particular, China's ecosystem exhibits a fast growing and dense core of collaborations. State-owned enterprises are the most central within this core, whereas government institutes and universities also play important parts. Econometric analysis of the network reveals that central nodes are larger in size, each surrounded by a community of smaller collaborators. Yet, most of these collaborations are short-lived, often dissolving within a few years. In contrast, collaborations among small business are long-lasting-a key requisite of fundamental or basic innovation. The results underscore the need for policies that facilitate more durable partnerships and mitigate the power imbalance inherent in the formation of large innovation communities.

AI.tldr: 本文通过解剖中国创新生态系统的网络形成与关键特征，发现其核心合作网络增长迅速且密集，国有企业处于核心位置，政府机构和大学也扮演重要角色。中心节点规模更大且被小型合作者社区包围，但多数合作短暂（几年内解散），而小企业之间的合作则长期持久，这更有利于基础性创新。研究呼吁政策应促进更持久的伙伴关系并缓解大型创新社区中的权力失衡。
AI.research_question: 中国快速增长的创新驱动型经济中，创新生态系统的网络是如何形成的？其关键特征是什么？网络结构对创新有何影响？
AI.motivation: 网络效应对创新具有高度相关性，对管理者和政策制定者具有重要意义。通过解剖中国这一快速增长的创新驱动型国家的生态系统形成和关键特征，可以为设计更有效促进创新的政策提供指导性经验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络效应理论、创新生态系统理论
AI.method: 网络分析（解剖生态系统形成与特征）+ 计量经济学分析
AI.findings: 1. 中国创新生态系统具有快速增长和密集的合作核心；2. 国有企业在核心中最为中心，政府机构和大学也发挥重要作用；3. 中心节点规模更大，被小型合作者社区包围；4. 大多数合作短命，几年内解散；5. 小企业之间的合作持久，是基础性创新的关键前提。
AI.theory_contributions: 从网络视角揭示了创新生态系统中不同主体（国企、政府机构、大学、小企业）的结构性角色与合作持续性差异，深化了对网络结构与创新（尤其是基础性创新）之间关系的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供启示：应促进更持久的伙伴关系，并缓解大型创新社区形成过程中的权力失衡问题，以更有效促进创新。

title: Accurate but Correlated: Common AI Forecast Errors and Endogenous Market Volatility

detail.title: Accurate but Correlated: Common AI Forecast Errors and Endogenous Market Volatility
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence can improve each institution's risk forecast while reducing the financial system's ability to diversify forecast errors. This paper separates these two objects. Individual accuracy is a marginal property of an error distribution; systemic model risk is a covariance property. With N institutions, equicorrelated log-risk forecast errors leave an aggregate variance floor of ρσ² that does not vanish as N grows. We derive the exact threshold above which an AI technology with lower individual mean-squared error nevertheless creates greater aggregate forecast risk than noisier independent legacy models. Risk-sensitive position rules then map common errors into synchronized net demand. With linear price impact, forecast-error covariance enters return variance; with GARCH updating, the initial variance increment is propagated by the multiplier (1-β)/(1-α-β). Prospectively separated simulations validate the signs under smooth volatility targeting and a discrete risk limit. Holding marginal error variance fixed, raising cross-institution error correlation from zero to 0.8 increases return variance by 3.15% under the smooth rule and 6.26% under the discrete risk limit. The stronger precommitted claim that both variance and one-percent expected shortfall rise by at least 5% is rejected. Common errors robustly amplify two-sided volatility under the model's conditions, but symmetric errors do not necessarily create comparably large downside-tail losses. Model diversity should therefore be evaluated through error covariance rather than model counts, vendor counts, or average predictive accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文区分了AI在提升单个机构预测准确性与增加系统性模型风险之间的权衡。通过理论推导和模拟验证，证明当跨机构预测误差相关性超过特定阈值时，即使AI具有更低的均方误差，也会产生比更嘈杂的独立传统模型更大的总预测风险，因此模型多样性应通过误差协方差而非模型数量或平均精度来评估。
AI.research_question: AI技术如何同时影响单机构预测准确性和系统性模型风险？在何种条件下，个体更准确的AI模型会导致更大的总体预测风险？
AI.motivation: 现有文献通常关注AI对单个机构风险预测的提升，但忽视了多个机构同时采用相似AI模型可能导致预测误差高度相关，从而削弱金融系统分散化预测错误的能力，产生系统性模型风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预测误差分布理论（边际性质与协方差性质分离）、等相关对数风险预测误差模型、风险敏感头寸规则、线性价格冲击模型、GARCH更新机制
AI.method: 理论推导（推导AI技术阈值条件）、前瞻性分离模拟（smooth volatility targeting与discrete risk limit两种规则）
AI.findings: 1) 当N个机构的等相关对数风险预测误差存在时，总体方差下限为ρσ²，不随N增大而消失；2) 推导出AI技术产生更大总体风险的精确阈值；3) 在固定边际误差方差下，将交叉机构误差相关性从0提高至0.8，平滑规则下收益方差增加3.15%，离散风险限制下增加6.26%；4) 拒绝"方差和1%预期缺口均至少上升5%"的更强声明；5) 共同误差稳健地放大双向波动，但对称误差不必然产生可比的下尾损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将"个体预测准确性"（边际性质）与"系统性模型风险"（协方差性质）分离研究；推导出AI技术导致更大总体风险的精确定量阈值；提出用误差协方差而非模型数量来评估模型多样性的新框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和金融机构提供评估AI系统采用风险的新指标（误差协方差），指导模型多样性管理策略，提示在AI部署时需要平衡个体效率与系统稳健性。

title: Cost-Aware Preference-Based Bayesian Optimization for Structured Prompt Configuration of Large Language Models
affiliations: , Università degli Studi di Milano-Bicocca - UNIVERSITA' DI MILANO BICOCCA and University of Milano-Bicocca

detail.title: Cost-Aware Preference-Based Bayesian Optimization for Structured Prompt Configuration of Large Language Models

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any funding.

detail.abstract: Prompt configuration strongly affects the accuracy, reliability, and cost of large language models (LLMs), but jointly tuning instructions, output contracts, demonstrations, reasoning cues, and decoding settings creates a large mixed discrete black-box optimization problem. We propose MNL-PCO, a cost-aware, preference-based Bayesian optimization framework that uses a ridge-regularized multinomial-logit (MNL) discrete-choice surrogate over structured prompt components. The surrogate is learned from pairwise preferences induced by observed configuration scores and provides directly interpretable component utilities without requiring learned prompt embeddings or kernel design. Evaluations are performed at three validation-subset fidelities (15%, 40%, and 100%); expected improvement is weighted by a fidelity-information factor, normalized by a pre-evaluation token-cost proxy, and combined with periodic full-fidelity promotion. We evaluate MNL-PCO in two stages. A controlled study covers four simulation regimes, 30 paired seeds per regime, a 23,328-configuration space, and 11 methods/ablations.
