MNL-PCO obtains the highest mean selected-prompt accuracy among the principal methods in all four regimes (0.907-0.960), significantly outperforming Hyperband and random-search baselines after Holm correction. On 100 unseen simulated configurations, its mean held-out Spearman correlation is 0.807 versus 0.667 for direct-score ridge. We then evaluate two local open-weight models-Llama 3.2 1B and Qwen2.5 1.5B-on IMDb, SST-2, and AG News with five paired seeds per setting and actual token/runtime accounting. MNL-PCO has the best mean test accuracy in four of six model-task settings and the best average accuracy rank (1.83), but it does not dominate IMDb, and the direct-score ridge surrogate ranks unseen live configurations better. These results support MNL-PCO as a competitive, interpretable structured-search method while also identifying the limits of an additive MNL utility model on real LLM behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MNL-PCO，一种基于成本感知和偏好优化的贝叶斯优化框架，用于大型语言模型（LLM）的提示配置调优。该框架使用岭正则化的多项Logit（MNL）离散选择模型作为替代模型，从成对偏好中学习提示组件的可解释效用，并综合考虑验证集保真度、token成本和全保真度提升策略。在两个阶段（受控模拟研究和真实LLM评估）中，MNL-PCO在多数任务上表现最优，但实证表明其对真实LLM行为的建模存在局限。
AI.research_question: 如何在大规模混合离散提示配置空间中，进行成本感知的、可解释的LLM提示调优？
AI.motivation: 提示配置（指令、输出契约、示例、推理线索、解码设置）对LLM的准确性、可靠性和成本影响显著，但联合调优这些组件构成了一个大规模混合离散黑箱优化问题，现有方法缺乏可解释性且未充分考虑成本因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于偏好优化的贝叶斯优化框架，采用岭正则化多项Logit（MNL）离散选择模型作为替代函数；期望改进（EI）结合保真度信息因子和预评估token成本代理进行加权。
AI.method: 两阶段评估：(1) 受控模拟研究：4个模拟机制、每机制30对种子、23,328配置空间、11种方法/消融比较；(2) 真实LLM评估：Llama 3.2 1B和Qwen2.5 1.5B在IMDb、SST-2、AG News上，每设置5对种子，使用实际token和运行时核算。
AI.findings: MNL-PCO在四种模拟机制中均获得最高平均选中提示准确率（0.907-0.960），显著优于Hyperband和随机搜索基线（经Holm校正）；在100个未见模拟配置上的平均保留Spearman相关为0.807（直接分数岭回归为0.667）。在六个真实模型-任务设置中的四个获得最佳平均测试准确率，平均准确率排名1.83；但未在IMDb上占优，且直接分数岭替代模型在排序未见实时配置方面表现更好。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 提出MNL-PCO框架，将MNL离散选择模型应用于LLM提示调优，无需学习提示嵌入或核设计即可获得直接可解释的组件效用；(2) 提出保真度信息加权和成本代理的期望改进策略；(3) 揭示了加性MNL效用模型在真实LLM行为上的局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 提供了一个竞争性、可解释的结构化提示搜索方法，适用于本地开源模型；(2) 通过成本感知策略降低调优过程中的token开销；(3) 在多个模型-任务组合上验证了方法的实用性，同时明确了其适用边界。

title: The New Geography Of Value Creation: Mapping How Digital Infrastructure, Logistics Networks, And Institutional Capacity Redistribute Global Economic Power

detail.title: The New Geography Of Value Creation: Mapping How Digital Infrastructure, Logistics Networks, And Institutional Capacity Redistribute Global Economic Power
detail.abstract:
The report argues that global economic power is being reorganized around a new triad of digital infrastructure, logistics networks, and institutional capacity, replacing the old model of cost‑efficiency and borderless globalization. As geopolitical fragmentation, supply‑chain shocks, and regulatory divergence reshape capital flows, value creation increasingly concentrates in regions that combine secure data environments, automated and redundant transport systems, and predictable policy frameworks.

Across 20 economic corridors, the analysis shows that regions integrating these three pillars consistently outperform historical baselines—often with FDI inflows 12–18% higher than prior decades, as noted in the Executive Summary: “nations heavily investing in submarine data cable landings, AI-ready data centers, port automation, and compliant industrial policies are experiencing FDI inflows averaging 12–18% higher than historical baselines.”

The report demonstrates that value is no longer captured primarily at points of resource extraction or final assembly, but at intermediary nodes capable of synchronizing digital and physical throughput while reducing institutional risk. Case studies—from the US‑Mexico corridor to ASEAN, the Middle Corridor, Silicon Savannah, and the Gulf—illustrate how regions with strong digital substrates, resilient logistics, and forward‑looking governance are becoming gravitational centers for capital, talent, and advanced manufacturing.

The strategic implication is clear: geography has reasserted itself as a core determinant of corporate and national competitiveness. Firms and policymakers must prioritize geographic redundancy, data‑sovereign architectures, and proactive institutional engagement to thrive in an era defined not by de‑globalization, but by re‑globalization along strategically engineered corridors.

AI.tldr: 本报告认为全球经济正围绕数字基础设施、物流网络和制度能力三大支柱重组，取代了旧有的成本效率和无边界全球化模式。分析20条经济走廊后发现，整合三大支柱的区域表现持续优于历史基准，FDI流入较此前十年平均高出12-18%。价值创造正从资源开采点和最终组装点，转向能够同步数字与物理吞吐、降低制度风险的中介节点。
AI.research_question: 全球经济力量如何围绕数字基础设施、物流网络和制度能力的新三支柱进行重组？哪些区域能够成为资本、人才和先进制造业的引力中心？
AI.motivation: 地缘政治碎片化、供应链冲击和监管分化正在重塑资本流动，传统的成本效率和无边界全球化模式已无法解释新的经济格局，需要重新审视地理因素在竞争力中的核心作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新三支柱框架（数字基础设施、物流网络、制度能力）、经济走廊理论、再全球化理论、中介节点价值捕获理论
AI.method: 对20条经济走廊进行比较分析，结合案例研究（美墨走廊、东盟、中间走廊、硅谷草原、海湾地区），并引用FDI流入数据作为量化指标
AI.findings: 结合数字基础设施、物流网络和制度能力三大支柱的区域，FDI流入较历史基线平均高出12-18%。价值捕获正从资源开采和最终组装点转向中介节点，地理因素重新成为企业和国家竞争力的核心决定因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新三支柱框架替代旧有的成本效率与无边界全球化范式，重新将地理因素纳入经济和战略分析的核心，提出了"战略性工程化走廊"下的再全球化概念，区别于简单的去全球化叙事。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供地理冗余、数据主权架构和制度参与的优先战略方向；为政策制定者提供投资数字基础设施、自动化物流和合规产业政策的政策指引，以在再全球化时代增强竞争力和吸引外资。

title: Development Finance in a Fragmenting World: Geopolitics, Capital Flows, and the Future of Emerging-Market Convergence

detail.title: Development Finance in a Fragmenting World: Geopolitics, Capital Flows, and the Future of Emerging-Market Convergence
detail.abstract: Emerging-market convergence after 2000 was financed by a private-capital map that no longer exists as a development-finance system. World net FDI inflows peaked at 5.3 percent of GDP in 2007. By 2024 they were 1.4 percent. Upper-middle-income intensity fell from 3.7 percent to 1.0. In a population-weighted reading of World Bank GDP per capita at PPP, developing economies moved from 12.5 percent of the high-income level in 2000 to 22.8 percent in 2023. Drop China and the same ratio moves from 13.3 to 18.3. That is the catch-up this paper is asked to project forward. The capital that produced it will not. UNCTAD puts 2024 developing-country FDI at 867 billion dollars, 57 percent of the world total, with ten recipients holding three-quarters of the inflows. In our 2018-23 country file, China alone is 37 percent of developing FDI dollars. OECD DAC ODA fell to 174 billion dollars in 2025, the largest annual contraction on record. Ukraine, counting EU institutions, received 45 billion-more than all least-developed countries or all of sub-Saharan Africa. World Bank debt service by low-and middleincome countries hit 1.4 trillion dollars in 2023. Lower-middle-income debt service as a share of exports nearly doubled after 2010, from 7.9 percent to 14.5. We score 131 developing countries on three capital clocks: private (FDI intensity or scale), official (ODA of at least 3 percent of GNI), and debt capacity (service at or below 15 percent of exports). Seventy-four countries clear the private clock, covering 5.11 billion people. Fifty-nine clear the official clock, covering 1.00 billion. Sixty-five clear debt capacity. Twenty-three clear all three, covering 0.50 billion, and they are not the catch-up club. The material host cell-private capital, debt room, an open trade ratio, and a large enough economy that the dollars are real-has seven members covering 0.58 billion people: Viet Nam, Mexico, Thailand, the Philippines, Cambodia, Ghana, and the Democratic Republic of Congo. Forty-nine countries, 2.11 billion people, sit behind a debt-service wall. Remittances to developing reporters were 672 billion dollars on the latest observation, against 465 billion of FDI and 167 billion of ODA. Friend-shoring is a resorting of the private map, not a new development-finance system. A dollar of FDI in Viet Nam, a dollar of ODA in Malawi, and a dollar of debt service in Egypt do not finance the same convergence.

AI.tldr: 本文审视了2000年以来新兴市场收敛所依赖的私人资本融资体系已不复存在的现实。全球FDI净流入从2007年占GDP的5.3%降至2024年的1.4%，ODA创纪录下降，发展中国家的债务服务负担急剧上升。作者通过对131个发展中国家在私人资本、官方援助和债务能力三个"资本时钟"上的评分，识别出仅23国同时通过全部三项，而真正具备"实体宿主细胞"条件（私人资本、债务空间、开放贸易比率和足够大的经济规模）的国家仅有7个，覆盖5.8亿人口。文章指出侨汇已超过FDI和ODA成为最大的外部资金来源，并强调"友岸外包"只是私人资本地图的重排而非新的发展融资体系。
AI.research_question: 2000年以来驱动新兴市场经济收敛的私人资本融资体系是否仍然存在？未来哪些国家具备继续实现经济收敛的融资条件？
AI.motivation: 新兴市场在2000-2023年间实现了显著的经济收敛（人均GDP从高收入水平的12.5%升至22.8%），但这种收敛是由此前的私人资本融资体系支撑的。然而这一体系已发生根本性变化：FDI大幅下降、ODA创纪录收缩、债务服务负担沉重。因此有必要重新评估哪些国家在未来仍具备融资条件可持续地推进经济收敛。
AI.theoretical_framework: 发展融资体系分析框架，包括三类"资本时钟"：私人资本时钟（FDI强度或规模）、官方资本时钟（ODA至少占GNI的3%）、债务能力时钟（债务服务不超过出口的15%）。
AI.method: 基于世界银行、UNCTAD和OECD DAC等数据的定量分析。对131个发展中国家按三个资本时钟维度进行评分和分类，识别同时满足三项标准及"实体宿主细胞"条件（私人资本、债务空间、开放贸易比率、足够大的经济规模）的国家集合。
AI.findings: （1）全球FDI净流入从2007年占GDP的5.3%降至2024年的1.4%；（2）仅23国同时通过三项资本时钟，覆盖5亿人口；（3）真正具备"实体宿主细胞"条件的仅7国（越南、墨西哥、泰国、菲律宾、柬埔寨、加纳、刚果民主共和国），覆盖5.8亿人口；（4）49国（21.1亿人）被"债务服务墙"阻挡；（5）侨汇（6720亿美元）已超过FDI（4650亿）和ODA（1670亿）成为最大外部资金来源。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"资本时钟"概念框架，用以系统评估发展中国家的外部融资可得性；挑战了将"友岸外包"视为新发展融资体系的观点，指出其仅为私人资本地图的重排；区分了不同类型的资本对不同国家收敛的异质性作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者识别了实际具备未来经济收敛潜力的少数国家集合（7国），警示了49国面临的债务服务困境，并强调侨汇作为被忽视的发展融资渠道的重要性。提示传统的"FDI+ODA"发展融资叙事需要修正。

title: A Cryptocurrency Market Treatment Plan for Maintaining U.S. National Security: Legal Foundation and Operational Regulatory Design

detail.title: A Cryptocurrency Market Treatment Plan for Maintaining U.S. National Security: Legal Foundation and Operational Regulatory Design
detail.abstract:
This document is Volume III of Foundation of Law, presenting a complete legal‑operational treatment framework for the U.S. cryptocurrency market, built upon U.S. founding‑era political philosophy, constitutional provisions, relevant statutes and judicial precedents. The upper volume establishes legal authority: it applies the founding principle that property rights are bounded by collective public interests, and analyses existing constitutional powers including commerce power, monetary power, taxing power, police power and national‑security‑related authority. 

It documents major harms stemming from crypto markets: national‑security risks such as ransomware financing, state‑sponsored cyber‑theft, sanctions evasion and foreign‑controlled critical‑adjacent infrastructure; environmental burdens of high energy consumption, carbon emissions and electronic waste; plus financial‑systemic risks including market concentration, intermediary failures, crypto‑bank contagion and retail investor losses. It addresses thirteen major constitutional and legal objections against the proposed framework, such as regulatory takings, major‑questions doctrine, direct‑tax restrictions and First‑Amendment‑style code‑as‑speech arguments, and responds with case‑based reasoning. 

The lower volume lays out concrete operational mechanisms, emphasising “treatment instead of prohibition” — it does not ban cryptocurrency, but internalise external costs and contain systemic risks. Core mechanisms contain five operating principles; an energy‑anchored compensation regime for proof‑of‑work mining; an asset‑monitoring regime targeting proof‑of‑stake systemic vulnerabilities; four‑function separation to break vertical integration risks of crypto intermediaries; boom‑phase excess‑profit surrender feeding a market‑stabilisation reserve; tiered crash‑phase market‑disposition rules; multi‑faceted anti‑evasion architecture; special enforcement doctrines including rebuttable presumptions on manipulative intent; a comprehensive pollution‑index‑driven environmental‑health compensation system; plus stablecoin and foreign‑control safeguards for national‑security purposes. 

A phased four‑stage implementation roadmap (visibility, compensation, stabilisation, equilibrium verification) is provided, and provisions that require fresh congressional enactment are explicitly identified. The whole framework adheres to the Locke‑derived §135 constraint: regulation shall not arbitrarily destroy the cryptocurrency market itself, but impose proportionate obligations to protect national security, public environment and retail participants.

AI.tldr: 本文是美国加密货币市场《法律基础》第三卷，基于美国建国时期政治哲学、宪法条款、成文法与判例，构建了一套完整的"治理而非禁止"的法律运营框架。上卷确立法律权威并记录加密市场危害，回应十三项宪法与法律反对意见；下卷提出具体运行机制，包括能源锚定补偿、资产监测、四功能分离、市场稳定储备、分层处置等，并提供四阶段实施路线图。
AI.research_question: 如何在美国宪法框架下建立一个既能保障国家安全、公共环境与零售参与者利益，又不至于摧毁加密货币市场本身的完整法律运营治理框架？
AI.motivation: 加密货币市场带来了国家安全风险（勒索软件融资、国家级网络盗窃、制裁规避）、环境负担（高能耗、碳排放、电子垃圾）以及金融系统性风险（市场集中、中介失败、银行传染、零售投资者损失），需要一套符合美国宪法原则的系统性法律治理方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于洛克式第135条约束（规制不得任意摧毁加密货币市场本身，但可施加相称义务）、建国时期财产权受集体公共利益限定的原则，以及商业权、货币权、征税权、警察权与国家安全相关权力等宪法权力分析。
AI.method: 法律分析：综合运用宪法条文、成文法、司法先例进行判例推理，回应十三项宪法与法律反对意见（如规制性征收、重大问题原则、直接税限制、第一修正案代码即言论等），并设计具体操作机制。
AI.findings: 提出五条运营原则、工作量证明的能源锚定补偿机制、权益证明的资产监测机制、加密中介四功能分离、繁荣期超额利润上缴注入市场稳定储备、分级崩盘期处置规则、反规避架构、操纵意图可推翻推定、污染指数驱动的环境健康补偿系统，以及稳定币和外国控制的国家安全保护措施，配合四阶段实施路线图。
AI.theory_contributions: 将美国建国时期财产权哲学与洛克式规制约束系统应用于加密货币治理，论证了"治理而非禁止"的宪法路径，为加密资产法律规制提供了宪法与政治哲学层面的理论正当性基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可直接操作的具体监管机制设计和四阶段实施路线图（可见性、补偿、稳定化、均衡验证），明确标识需要新国会立法的事项，对政策制定者和监管机构具有直接参考价值。

title: Extrapolative Expectations and Behavioral Latency in Indian Capital Markets Evidence from Retail SIP Flows and Nifty 50 Returns, 2019-2024
affiliations: University of Mumbai

detail.title: Extrapolative Expectations and Behavioral Latency in Indian Capital Markets Evidence from Retail SIP Flows and Nifty 50 Returns, 2019-2024

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human or animal participants. The research relies exclusively on publicly available, aggregate financial and market data sourced from the Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI) and the National Stock Exchange of India (NSE).
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. It was conducted as independent undergraduate research.

detail.abstract: The rapid expansion of systematic investment plans (SIPs) has changed the composition of retail participation in Indian mutual funds. This study asks a simple but important question: do stronger equity-market returns lead households to increase SIP participation, or do SIP flows themselves help predict subsequent market returns? Using monthly SIP contribution data published by the Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI) and the Nifty 50 Total Return Index (TRI) over January 2019-December 2024, the study applies a vector autoregression (VAR) and Granger-causality framework. The source analysis reports a strong association between market performance and subsequent retail SIP activity, with Nifty 50 returns showing statistically significant predictive power for SIP flows, while SIP flows do not significantly predict the Nifty 50. Impulseresponse analysis in the source analysis points to a one-to-two-month delay between an equity-market shock and the subsequent response in SIP activity. Taken together, the findings are consistent with an extrapolativeexpectations interpretation: recent market performance appears to shape subsequent retail participation more strongly than aggregate SIP flows shape the index. The paper discusses what this procyclical pattern could mean for investor behaviour, market stability and financial-literacy policy.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用印度AMFI的月度SIP数据和Nifty 50总回报指数（2019年1月至2024年12月），通过VAR和Granger因果检验发现：股市回报显著预测后续SIP资金流入，而SIP流入不能显著预测股市回报，脉冲响应显示股市冲击对SIP活动有1-2个月的滞后影响，支持外推性预期的解释。
AI.research_question: 更强的股市回报是否导致家庭增加SIP参与，还是SIP资金流本身有助于预测后续市场回报？
AI.motivation: 印度系统性投资计划（SIP）的快速扩张改变了散户参与共同基金的结构，理解市场回报与SIP参与之间的因果关系对投资者行为、市场稳定和金融素养政策具有重要含义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 外推性预期（extrapolative expectations）理论——近期市场表现塑造后续散户参与行为。
AI.method: 使用印度共同基金协会（AMFI）月度SIP贡献数据和Nifty 50总回报指数（TRI），时间跨度为2019年1月至2024年12月，采用向量自回归（VAR）和Granger因果检验框架，并进行脉冲响应分析。
AI.findings: （1）Nifty 50回报对SIP资金流具有统计显著的预测能力；（2）SIP资金流不能显著预测Nifty 50；（3）脉冲响应分析显示股市冲击后SIP活动有1-2个月的响应延迟；结论支持外推性预期解释，即市场表现塑造后续散户参与，而非SIP流塑造指数。
AI.theory_contributions: 为外推性预期理论在印度的实证研究提供证据，验证了市场回报与零售投资者参与之间的单向因果关系方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了SIP参与的顺周期性特征，为投资者行为教育、市场稳定监管和金融素养政策制定提供参考依据。

title: Transit in Rem Judicatam The Merger of the Cause of Action in the Judgment under Indian Law, with a Census of the Indian Authorities
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Transit in Rem Judicatam The Merger of the Cause of Action in the Judgment under Indian Law, with a Census of the Indian Authorities
detail.abstract: This article examines the doctrine of merger, expressed in the Latin maxim transit in rem judicatam. Under that doctrine, once a competent court gives judgment on a cause of action, the cause of action ends. It is replaced by a new and higher right, the right on the judgment itself. The article asks a simple question. Is merger a rule of substantive law, or only a procedural bar, and what follows from the answer? The method is doctrinal and comparative. The Roman root of the doctrine is traced through litis contestatio. The English law is traced from King v Hoare to the United Kingdom Supreme Court in Virgin Atlantic and Nasir v Zavarco. The Indian law is then examined in the courts' own words. The article contributes the first census of every located Indian decision that uses the maxim, from the Madras High Court in 1883 to the Supreme Court in 2025 and the High Courts in 2024 and 2025. The census shows that the maxim entered Indian law through two separate channels, a merger channel descending from King v Hoare and an estoppel channel descending from Thoday v Thoday, and that the two are often mixed. The article defends two claims. Merger is substantive and distinct from every estoppel. Indian courts have applied it correctly for a century and a half, but have rarely named it, and the settlement cases from Kishorilal Gupta to Nathani Steels are merger reasoning in the dress of novation. The strongest objection is stated and answered.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"合并原则"（merger doctrine，拉丁文谚语 transit in rem judicatam），即一旦有管辖权的法院对某诉因作出判决，该诉因即告终止，被判决本身所创造的新权利取代。文章采用教义性比较法方法，从罗马法的 litis contestatio 追溯至英国法（从 King v Hoare 到英国最高法院在 Virgin Atlantic 和 Nasir v Zavarco 案）再到印度法。文章贡献了首部所有使用该谚语的印度判决普查（1883年马德拉斯高等法院至2025年最高法院及2024-2025年高等法院），证明该谚语通过两个独立渠道进入印度法——源自 King v Hoare 的合并渠道和源自 Thoday v Thoday 的禁反言渠道，且二者经常被混淆。文章提出两个主张：合并是实体法规则，区别于一切禁反言；印度法院一个半世纪以来一直正确适用它但很少点名，从 Kishorilal Gupta 到 Nathani Steels 的和解案件实为披着更新（novation）外衣的合并推理。文章还陈述并回答了最强反对意见。
AI.research_question: 合并原则（merger doctrine）究竟是实体法规则还是仅是程序上的障碍？这一答案会带来什么后果？
AI.motivation: 合并原则在普通法系中历史悠久且被广泛使用，但其法律性质（实体法 vs 程序法）从未被系统澄清，且印度法院在使用该谚语时与禁反言（estoppel）规则经常混淆，需要加以厘清。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合并原则（merger doctrine / transit in rem judicatam）、禁反言（estoppel）、更新（novation）、既判力理论。
AI.method: 教义性（doctrinal）与比较法（comparative）方法，辅以实证普查（census）：追溯罗马法 litis contestatio 根源，梳理英国法从 King v Hoare 到 Virgin Atlantic 和 Nasir v Zavarco 案，并系统普查1883年至2025年所有使用该谚语的印度判决。
AI.findings: （1）该谚语通过两个独立渠道进入印度法：源自 King v Hoare 的合并渠道与源自 Thoday v Thoday 的禁反言渠道，二者常被混用；（2）合并是实体法规则，且区别于一切禁反言；（3）印度法院一个半世纪以来一直正确适用合并原则但极少点名，和解案件（Kishorilal Gupta 至 Nathani Steels）实为合并推理披着更新外衣。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统论证合并原则属于实体法而非程序障碍，并将其与禁反言明确区分；首次提供印度法中该谚语使用的完整普查，揭示其双源进入路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 通过普查印度1883-2025年相关判决，为法院澄清合并与禁反言、更新的关系提供清晰指引，并纠正和解案件中被误称的"更新"实为"合并"推理。

title: Dynamic Parallelism-Based FIFO Queues for Efficient GPU Task Scheduling

detail.title: Dynamic Parallelism-Based FIFO Queues for Efficient GPU Task Scheduling
detail.abstract: The rapid growth of GPU computing has created a strong demand for scheduling mechanisms capable of handling irregular, dynamically generated, and highly concurrent workloads. Traditional GPU execution models generally assume that the amount of work is known before a kernel is launched, which can create inefficiencies when tasks are produced during execution. Dynamic parallelism provides an alternative by allowing GPU-resident threads to generate additional GPU work without repeatedly returning control to the CPU. This capability is particularly relevant to task scheduling, where newly generated tasks must be stored, organized, and distributed among large numbers of GPU threads. This article examines a dynamic parallelismbased first-in-first-out (FIFO) queue architecture designed to support efficient GPU task scheduling. The proposed approach combines device-side kernel launching, concurrent queue operations, atomic synchronization, hierarchical buffering, and adaptive task generation to create a scheduling mechanism suitable for irregular workloads. The queue is designed around the principle that tasks should be inserted and consumed directly on the GPU while maintaining FIFO ordering and minimizing unnecessary host-device synchronization. The methodology considers queue organization, task representation, enqueue and dequeue procedures, synchronization mechanisms, memory management, dynamic kernel generation, and workload balancing. Particular attention is given to contention because a globally shared queue can become a performance bottleneck when thousands of GPU threads attempt to access the same control variables simultaneously. A hierarchical design using local queues and a global FIFO structure is therefore discussed as a means of reducing contention. The article also analyzes the advantages and limitations of dynamic parallelism, including launch overhead, memory consumption, synchronization costs, queue overflow, and unpredictable execution concurrency. The discussion demonstrates that dynamic parallelism-based FIFO queues can provide a flexible foundation for GPU task scheduling, especially for graph traversal, adaptive numerical algorithms, recursive computations, irregular simulations, and other applications in which work is generated progressively. The effectiveness of such an architecture ultimately depends on balancing scheduling flexibility with synchronization overhead and memory-system efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一种基于动态并行机制的FIFO队列架构，用于GPU任务调度。该架构结合设备端内核启动、并发队列操作、原子同步、分层缓冲和自适应任务生成等机制，以支持不规则、动态生成和高并发的GPU工作负载。文章重点分析了全局共享队列的争用问题，并提出采用局部队列加全局FIFO结构的分层设计来降低争用。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种基于动态并行机制的FIFO队列架构，以高效支持GPU上不规则、动态生成且高并发的任务调度？
AI.motivation: 传统GPU执行模型假设内核启动前工作量已知，但实际中存在任务在执行过程中动态生成的情况，这会导致效率低下。动态并行允许GPU驻留线程在不返回CPU的情况下生成额外GPU工作，但需要有效的队列机制来存储、组织和分发新生成的任务。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态并行（Dynamic Parallelism）、FIFO队列架构、原子同步机制、分层缓冲设计、任务调度理论
AI.method: 概念性设计研究方法——提出并分析一种基于动态并行机制的GPU FIFO队列架构，包括队列组织方式、任务表示、入队/出队流程、同步机制、内存管理、动态内核生成和工作负载均衡等设计要素，并对争用问题和限制因素进行深入分析。
AI.findings: 基于动态并行机制的FIFO队列可以为GPU任务调度提供灵活的基础，特别是在图遍历、自适应数值算法、递归计算和不规则模拟等渐进生成工作的应用中。其有效性取决于调度灵活性与同步开销、内存系统效率之间的平衡；分层设计（局部队列+全局FIFO）可有效降低全局队列争用问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地分析了动态并行在GPU任务调度中的应用架构，揭示了全局共享队列在多线程并发访问下的争用瓶颈，并提出分层队列设计作为降低争用的理论解决方案；同时全面梳理了动态并行的优缺点（启动开销、内存消耗、同步成本、队列溢出、执行并发不可预测性等）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为GPU任务调度提供了基于动态并行FIFO队列的实用架构设计指南，涵盖队列组织、同步机制、内存管理和负载均衡等关键实现细节，适用于图遍历、自适应数值算法、递归计算、不规则模拟等实际工业应用场景。

title: Agentic Artificial Intelligence and Systemic Financial Risk: A Complex-Systems Framework for Emerging-Market Supervision

detail.title: Agentic Artificial Intelligence and Systemic Financial Risk: A Complex-Systems Framework for Emerging-Market Supervision

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships that could be perceived to have influenced this work.

detail.abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence systems-models that plan, invoke tools, retain memory, and execute multi-step actions with limited human supervision-have moved from experimental pilots to production infrastructure inside major banks and trading firms during 2025-2026. This monograph argues that the systemic-risk consequences of this shift cannot be understood through financial regulation alone, nor through computer-science accounts of agent architecture alone: they require a complex-systems lens that treats interaction topology, cognitive opacity, and objective divergence among autonomous agents as structural properties of the financial network itself. Building on classical network models of systemic risk and recent work on agentic architectures in finance, the monograph develops a framework linking autonomy depth, infrastructure concentration, and supervisory observability to the emergence of correlated, machine-mediated instability. It then examines how existing regulatory instruments-the EU AI Act, the Digital Operational Resilience Act, Basel-style model-risk frameworks, and Financial Stability Board guidance-address (or fail to address) these dynamics, and identifies a specific gap in emergingmarket and Latin American supervisory frameworks, which remain largely technology-neutral and reactive rather than agent-aware. The monograph closes with a proposed supervisory framework adapted to the institutional and resource constraints of emerging-market regulators. This is a conceptual and analytical work; it does not report new empirical estimation and should be read as a synthesis and framework-building exercise, not as a validated predictive model.

AI.tldr: 本专著探讨了2025-2026年间人工智能体系统从试点转向生产基础设施后，对金融系统性风险的影响。作者主张不能仅从金融监管或计算机科学角度理解这一转变，而需要采用复杂系统视角，将交互拓扑、认知不透明性和目标分歧视为金融网络的结构性属性。基于经典系统性风险网络模型和金融智能体架构的最新研究，作者构建了将自主性深度、基础设施集中度和监管可观测性与机器介导的相关不稳定性联系起来的分析框架，并评估了现有监管工具（欧盟AI法案、DORA、巴塞尔模型风险框架、FSB指引）的适用性，识别了新兴市场和拉美监管框架的缺口，最后提出了适应新兴市场监管者制度和资源约束的监管框架。
AI.research_question: 智能体AI系统在金融业生产化部署过程中，如何产生系统性风险？现有金融监管框架能否有效应对这些风险，特别是新兴市场监管体系中存在哪些缺口？
AI.motivation: 2025-2026年间，智能体AI系统已从实验试点转向主要银行和交易公司的生产基础设施，但对其系统性风险后果的理解仍不充分。现有研究要么局限于金融监管视角，要么局限于计算机科学对智能体架构的讨论，缺乏一个跨学科的综合分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 复杂系统理论、经典系统性风险网络模型、智能体架构金融应用研究、自主性深度与基础设施集中度等概念框架
AI.method: 概念性与分析性研究：基于复杂系统视角的文献综合与框架构建。通过整合网络模型、智能体架构研究和监管制度分析，构建新的分析框架，并对照评估现有监管工具。
AI.findings: 1) 智能体AI的系统性风险需要从交互拓扑、认知不透明性和目标分歧三个结构性维度来理解；2) 自主性深度、基础设施集中度和监管可观测性与机器介导的相关不稳定性存在关联；3) 现有监管工具（EU AI Act、DORA、巴塞尔模型风险框架、FSB指引）在应对这些动态方面存在不足；4) 新兴市场和拉美监管框架存在特定空白——它们仍然大体上是技术中立和被动反应的，而非智能体感知的。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将自主性深度、基础设施集中度和监管可观测性三个维度与系统性风险联系起来的综合分析框架，弥合了金融监管研究与计算机智能体架构研究之间的理论鸿沟，为理解机器介导的金融不稳定性提供了新的结构化视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴市场和拉美监管机构提供了一套适应其制度和资源约束的智能体感知监管框架建议；同时对现有国际监管工具的适用性进行了批判性评估，指出其在智能体AI时代的局限。

title: Contingent Winners: Forecast Scale and Model Rankings in Volatility Forecasting

detail.title: Contingent Winners: Forecast Scale and Model Rankings in Volatility Forecasting

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declare no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This is research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Deep learning is widely reported to rival or beat GARCH for volatility forecasting, but such verdicts usually omit some of the conditions that produced them. Using daily data for the S&P 500, Nikkei 225, Gold and EUR/USD, we show that the volatility regime of the model-selection window sets a deep model's forecast scale. Scale is the mean forecast divided by the mean realised variance, a quantity computed after the fact rather than a property of the model. Hyperparameters are chosen against that window, which is how the regime carries through. The effect holds on all four assets for three architectures, in eleven of twelve asset-seed cells each. Three further conditions decide the winner in our study. The random seed moves the selected configuration and with it which network wins. The evaluation loss reverses the ranking on identical forecasts, GARCH being the more accurate under QLIKE and the less accurate under squared and absolute error. Under a model confidence set that reversal separates on the Nikkei 225, while on the S&P 500 only GARCH's side of it does. The third condition is whether the forecasts were rescaled before scoring, a step rarely reported. Giving each model one multiplicative constant, fitted out of sample, removes most of the validation-regime gap. It also removes GARCH's QLIKE advantage on the equity indices altogether. Both effects are tested by intervention and not inferred. Which model wins is contingent on conditions such as the asset, and on how the model was selected, scored and scaled.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地检验了深度学习模型在波动率预测中优于GARCH的结论，发现这一结论高度依赖于模型选择窗口的波动率制度、随机种子、评估损失函数以及预测值是否重缩放等条件。实验显示，在S&P 500、Nikkei 225、黄金和EUR/USD四个资产上，深度模型的预测尺度由选择窗口的波动率制度决定，且评估损失函数可以完全逆转模型排名，重缩放预测值则消除了大部分制度差距和GARCH在QLIKE下的优势。研究通过干预实验而非推断来验证这些效应，表明"哪个模型胜出"是一个高度情境依赖的结果。
AI.research_question: 深度学习模型在波动率预测中优于GARCH的结论在何种条件下成立？模型选择窗口的波动率制度、随机种子、评估损失函数和预测值缩放如何影响模型间的相对排名？
AI.motivation: 以往研究普遍报告深度学习在波动率预测上优于或媲美GARCH，但这些结论往往忽略了产生这些结果的具体条件。本文旨在揭示这些被忽略的条件如何系统性影响模型比较结论的可信度与可复现性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 波动率预测模型比较框架，涉及GARCH类模型与深度学习架构（三种架构）在四种资产（S&P 500、Nikkei 225、黄金、EUR/USD）上的预测绩效评估，以及模型置信集（Model Confidence Set）等统计检验方法。
AI.method: 本文使用日度数据进行实证研究。核心方法包括：（1）在模型选择窗口内通过超参数选择来确定深度模型的配置；（2）计算预测尺度（平均预测值除以平均实现方差）；（3）比较不同评估损失函数（QLIKE、平方误差、绝对误差）下的模型排名；（4）采用模型置信集进行统计推断；（5）通过干预实验（预测值重缩放）而非推断来验证制度效应和评估损失效应。
AI.findings: （1）模型选择窗口的波动率制度决定深度模型的预测尺度，该效应在四种资产的三种架构（共12个资产-种子组合中的11个）中均成立。（2）随机种子会改变被选择的配置以及获胜的网络。（3）评估损失函数在相同预测上会逆转排名：GARCH在QLIKE下更准确，而在平方误差和绝对误差下则相反。（4）模型置信集下的逆转在Nikkei 225上显著，而在S&P 500上GARCH侧更显著。（5）预测值的重缩放（每个模型一个乘性常数，样本外拟合）消除了大部分验证制度差距，也完全消除了股权指数上GARCH的QLIKE优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文对波动率预测模型的比较方法论做出重要贡献：（1）揭示并严格证明模型选择窗口的波动率制度会通过超参数选择传递到深度模型的预测尺度，这是此前文献忽略的系统性偏差来源。（2）证明评估损失函数的选择可以完全逆转模型排名，提供了对现有"深度学习优于GARCH"结论的方法论批评。（3）通过干预实验而非推断来验证效应，为模型比较研究确立了更严谨的方法论标准。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为实务中波动率预测模型的选择提供了重要警示：模型比较结论高度依赖于数据划分窗口、评估指标和预处理方式，实践中需谨慎对待单一的"最优模型"结论。（2）证明预测值重缩放是一种简单有效的操作，可以消除大部分由验证窗口制度带来的偏差，为实务人员提供了可直接应用的改进手段。（3）提醒研究者和实务者在报告波动率预测结果时需明确披露模型选择条件、随机种子、评估损失和缩放步骤。

title: Grooves in Neural Manifolds: A Summary of the Argument and the Experimental Evidence

detail.title: Grooves in Neural Manifolds: A Summary of the Argument and the Experimental Evidence
detail.abstract: This paper summarizes Grooves in Neural Manifolds (Roth, 2026b). The book develops a claim from a fifty-year research program: human concept learning and the internal geometry of trained language models are one mechanism, not two. The mechanism is low-dimensional attractor structure shaped by reinforcement. This paper states the mechanism. It shows how the mechanism dissolves, rather than solves, the symbolic binding problem identified by Hayes-Roth and McDermott (1978). It reports the evidence for the framework's central applied claim: instilling behavioral concepts as positive learned attractors outperforms suppression-based methods such as reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF). The advantage holds on accuracy and on resistance to social pressure to violate a constraint. In a controlled pilot on a 3-billion-parameter open model, positive concept training reached 94.4% accuracy on governance safety cases. A punishment-analog condition reached 77.8%. An untrained control reached 47.2%. The trained model transferred with no loss of accuracy to two of three untrained domains. A second experiment found that a single named value concept, trained without case-specific examples, passed every case in a standard five-scenario moral psychology test battery. The paper closes by naming the claims the argument depends on and what would refute each one. It directs readers to the book for the full fifty-four-chapter treatment and to two technical companion papers for complete experimental detail.

AI.tldr: 本文总结了Roth (2026b)的专著《神经流形中的沟槽》，主张人类概念学习与训练语言模型的内部几何是同一机制——由强化塑造的低维吸引子结构。该机制解消（而非解决）了符号绑定问题，并证明正向概念吸引子训练优于RLHF等抑制性方法，在准确率和抵抗社会压力方面均表现更优。
AI.research_question: 人类概念学习与训练语言模型的内部几何机制是否本质上是同一机制？如果是，该机制如何解消符号绑定问题，且正向概念吸引子训练是否优于抑制性方法（如RLHF）？
AI.motivation: 源自一个五十年研究项目的核心主张：概念学习与语言模型内部几何是同一机制，而非两种机制。作者希望阐明这一机制，并验证其核心应用主张——正向吸引子训练比抑制性方法更有效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 低维吸引子结构理论（由强化塑造）；人类概念学习与语言模型内部几何的统一机制框架；符号绑定问题的重新诠释（解消而非解决）。
AI.method: 理论阐述与对照实验相结合。包括：(1) 3B参数开源模型上的受控试点实验，比较正向概念训练、惩罚类比条件和未训练对照组；(2) 跨领域迁移测试；(3) 单一命名价值概念在标准五场景道德心理学测试组上的测试。
AI.findings: (1) 正向概念训练在治理安全案例上达到94.4%准确率，惩罚类比条件77.8%，未训练对照组47.2%；(2) 训练模型在三个未训练领域中的两个实现了零损失迁移；(3) 单一命名价值概念通过标准五场景道德心理学测试组中的所有案例。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出人类概念学习与语言模型内部几何是同一机制的理论主张；解消（而非解决）Hayes-Roth和McDermott (1978)提出的符号绑定问题；为概念学习研究提供了一个统一的低维吸引子框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明正向概念吸引子训练在准确率和抵抗社会压力方面优于RLHF等抑制性方法，为AI安全对齐提供了更有效的训练范式；展示了正向训练的跨域迁移能力和对单一命名概念的泛化能力。

title: Esports in Indian Schools: An Independent Exploratory Study on Student and Parental Readiness

detail.title: Esports in Indian Schools: An Independent Exploratory Study on Student and Parental Readiness
detail.abstract: This paper reports an exploratory study I carried out to understand how Indian students, parents and schools respond when esports is introduced as an extracurricular activity. The idea came up in conversation with a national federation and a national school education board, both of whom I work with, but the research itself is my own: independently designed, run and written up, not commissioned or authored by either institution. Esports currently holds no place in the school board's curriculum; the aim was to test the water before any curricular conversation begins. Ten schools across the Delhi NCR region, a mix of government and private institutions, hosted the activity for a little over 700 students, using five titles chosen for their range: Battlegrounds Mobile India, Valorant, FIFA 26, Chess.com and Tekken 9. Parents arrived sceptical, particularly about BGMI and Valorant, titles that carry a good deal of existing stigma in India. A short educational seminar, paired with letting parents try the games themselves, shifted a meaningful share of that scepticism. The paper reads these findings against six recent international studies on esports in education to work out what an Indian school system would need to get right before going further, and closes with recommendations for schools and education authorities considering a similar step.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了一项探索性研究，旨在了解印度学生、家长和学校对将电子竞技引入课外活动的反应。研究在德里NCR地区的10所公立和私立学校开展，涉及700多名学生，使用五款游戏。研究发现家长最初对部分游戏持怀疑态度，但通过教育讲座和亲身体验，显著转变了态度。论文结合六项国际研究，为印度学校系统推进电子竞技提出建议。
AI.research_question: 当电子竞技作为课外活动引入印度学校时，学生、家长和学校如何反应？
AI.motivation: 电子竞技目前未纳入印度学校委员会的课程体系，作者旨在课程讨论开始前进行"试水"探索，了解各方利益相关者的态度与阻力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 论文引用了六项近期关于电子竞技教育的国际研究作为比较与参照框架。
AI.method: 探索性研究设计，在德里NCR地区10所（公立与私立混合）学校进行，覆盖700多名学生，选用五款题材各异的游戏（Battlegrounds Mobile India、Valorant、FIFA 26、Chess.com、Tekken 9），通过教育讲座与家长亲自体验游戏的方式观察态度转变。
AI.findings: 家长最初对BGMI和Valorant等带有社会污名的游戏持怀疑态度；通过简短的家长教育讲座并结合让家长亲自试玩游戏，显著转化了相当比例的怀疑态度。
AI.theory_contributions: 补充了电子竞技教育研究中关于印度这一新兴情境的证据，揭示了文化污名（尤其是对特定游戏类型）如何影响家长接受度，以及体验式干预对态度转变的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度学校和教育管理机构提供了推进电子竞技课外活动前需要解决的关键问题清单与具体建议，也为考虑类似举措的其他教育系统提供了可参考的路径。

title: Household Share Of Corporate Profits, MPC Heterogeneity, And A Structural Break In The Consumption: Turkey 2010-2024, With Mexican Comparative Evidence

detail.title: Household Share Of Corporate Profits, MPC Heterogeneity, And A Structural Break In The Consumption: Turkey 2010-2024, With Mexican Comparative Evidence
detail.abstract: This working paper re-estimates the household share of corporate profits and the long-run consumption function for Türkiye on quarterly data 2010Q1-2024Q4, and replicates the exercise on Mexican OECD data. We report two independent findings. First, the household share of corporate profits recomputed from Turkish institutional sector accounts is well below the advanced-economy value that post-Keynesian calibrations of peripheral economies typically import. This gap propagates multiplicatively into the effective profit-MPC, narrowing the wage-profit MPC differential in a direction that is always biased against a wage-led classification. Second, two independent endogenous-break procedures date a single structural break in the long-run consumption function inside the 2021-2022 negative-real-rate window. On a pre-/post-crisis split at 2018Q1, the bootstrap confidence intervals on the two income elasticities do not overlap, so single-regime specifications spanning the full window average across two different consumption regimes. The Mexican application detects an analogous break. We do not settle the wage-led/profit-led status of the Turkish consumption channel. The full-sample wage-share coefficient is negative (γ =-0.49), but this is a between-regime artefact: within each sub-sample the coefficient is positive and statistically silent, so neither the wage-led nor the profit-led prediction is recoverable at quarterly frequency. Both findings are logically prior to, and weaker than, any demand-regime classification. The contribution is methodological but consequential. Prior single-regime estimates with imported parameters rest on two choices that the data reject independently. We therefore propose a calibration protocol that re-anchors the household share locally and admits endogenous structural breaks, as the minimum standard for peripheral demand-regime work.

AI.tldr: 本文基于土耳其2010Q1-2024Q4季度数据（并以墨西哥OECD数据复现），重新估计了公司利润的家庭份额及长期消费函数。研究发现两个独立结果：一是土耳其家庭持有的公司利润份额远低于后凯恩斯主义外围经济体校准中常进口的发达经济体数值，该缺口乘数性地传导至有效利润边际消费倾向（MPC），缩小工资-利润MPC差异且始终不利于工资主导型分类；二是两种独立的内生断点程序均在2021-2022负实际利率窗口内识别出长期消费函数的单一结构断点。全样本工资份额系数为负（γ=-0.49），但这是跨区间伪影——各子样本内系数为正且统计不显著，因此在季度频率下无法恢复工资主导或利润主导的预测。本文贡献具有方法论性质：提出以本地重锚家庭份额并纳入内生结构断点的校准协议，作为外围经济体需求体制研究的底线标准。
AI.research_question: 土耳其的家庭持有公司利润份额及长期消费函数如何被重新估计？已有的单体制估计与进口参数假设是否被数据拒斥？
AI.motivation: 后凯恩斯主义对外围经济体需求体制的校准通常直接进口发达经济体的家庭利润份额参数，且采用跨越全样本的单体制消费函数估计。本文旨在检验这些做法是否被数据支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 后凯恩斯主义需求体制理论（工资主导/利润主导分类）、消费函数理论、有效利润MPC概念
AI.method: 使用土耳其机构部门账户重新计算家庭利润份额；采用两种独立的内生断点检测程序识别结构断点；使用bootstrap置信区间比较分段收入弹性；以墨西哥OECD数据作为复现检验。
AI.findings: （1）土耳其家庭利润份额远低于进口的发达经济体数值，该缺口乘数性传导至有效利润MPC，始终偏向不利于工资主导分类的方向；（2）两种断点程序均在2021-2022负实际利率窗口内识别出单一结构断点；（3）2018Q1前后分段的两收入弹性bootstrap置信区间不重叠，单体制估计为跨两个消费体制的平均值；（4）全样本工资份额系数为负（γ=-0.49）是跨区间伪影，子样本内系数为正且统计不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 表明此前单体制估计加进口参数的外围需求体制研究建立在两个被数据独立拒绝的前提之上；提出应允许消费函数存在内生结构断点并本地化校准家庭利润份额。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出外围经济体需求体制研究的校准协议：本地重锚家庭利润份额、纳入内生结构断点，作为最低方法论标准。

title: Sectoral Reallocation, Monetary Policy, and the Zero Lower Bound
affiliations: Department of Economics, Aichi University

detail.title: Sectoral Reallocation, Monetary Policy, and the Zero Lower Bound
detail.abstract: This paper studies monetary policy in response to sectoral reallocation in a multisector New Keynesian model with production networks, labor adjustment frictions, and an occasionally binding zero lower bound (ZLB). Motivated by the large reallocation of demand from services to goods during the COVID-19 pandemic, we examine both a simple reallocation shock and an empirical reallocation wedge constructed from U.S. data. We find that sectoral reallocation does not by itself generate a binding ZLB under policy rules that respond only to inflation. Instead, the ZLB can arise endogenously when monetary policy responds strongly to activity in the expanding goods sector, whereas responding to activity in the contracting services sector generates qualitatively different interest-rate dynamics. These results suggest that monetary policy under sectoral reallocation depends importantly on which side of the reallocation the central bank attempts to stabilize.

AI.tldr: 本文研究部门再分配背景下的货币政策，构建了一个包含生产网络、劳动力调整摩擦和偶发性零利率下限（ZLB）的多部门新凯恩斯模型。研究发现，仅对通胀做出反应的货币政策规则下，部门再分配本身不会触发ZLB；但当货币政策对扩张的商品部门活动做出强烈反应时，ZLB会内生出现，而对收缩的服务部门活动做出反应则产生定性不同的利率动态。
AI.research_question: 部门再分配（如COVID-19期间需求从服务向商品的大规模转移）如何影响最优货币政策？货币政策对再分配不同侧（扩张部门vs收缩部门）的反应会产生怎样的利率动态和零利率下限效应？
AI.motivation: COVID-19疫情期间发生了从服务到商品的大规模需求再分配，这为研究部门再分配冲击下的货币政策设计提供了独特的现实动机。现有研究较少关注再分配冲击与零利率下限之间的内生互动关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多部门新凯恩斯模型（multisector New Keynesian model），包含生产网络（production networks）、劳动力调整摩擦（labor adjustment frictions）和偶发性零利率下限（occasionally binding ZLB）。
AI.method: 构建包含生产网络和劳动力调整摩擦的多部门新凯恩斯模型，结合一个简单的再分配冲击以及从美国数据构造的经验再分配楔子（empirical reallocation wedge）进行模拟分析。
AI.findings: （1）在仅对通胀做出反应的货币政策规则下，部门再分配本身不会触发ZLB；（2）当货币政策对扩张的商品部门活动做出强烈反应时，ZLB会内生出现；（3）对收缩的服务部门活动做出反应则产生定性不同的利率动态。政策效果关键取决于央行试图稳定再分配的哪一侧。
AI.theory_contributions: 将部门再分配冲击与零利率下限的内生出现联系起来，扩展了多部门新凯恩斯模型框架下的货币政策理论研究，揭示了政策对不同部门活动反应的不对称性效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行在面临重大部门再分配（如疫情冲击）时如何选择货币政策反应目标提供政策启示：稳定扩张部门与稳定收缩部门会导致截然不同的政策结果。

title: Private Credit or Bank Debt? Persistence in Lender Type among U.S. Public Firms

detail.title: Private Credit or Bank Debt? Persistence in Lender Type among U.S. Public Firms
detail.abstract: Is private credit a temporary substitute for bank credit or a persistent financing source for particular segments of firms? This paper follows U.S. public firms whose first observed origination is with a private credit lender (PC-first firms) or a bank (bank-first firms). Within two years, subsequent new agreements are predominantly with lenders of the same type as the origination lender: among PC-first firms, 23.0% obtain one with a private credit lender and 2.7% with a bank; among bank-first firms, 20.4% with a bank and 2.0% with a private credit lender. A majority of PC-first firms with a new private credit agreement obtain one with a different private credit lender; this persistence is not explained solely by individual lender relationships. At origination, PC-first firms are smaller and less profitable than bank-first firms and have lower asset tangibility. Results are consistent with sorting of firms across lender types rather than temporary substitution.

AI.tldr: 本文通过追踪美国上市公司的首次贷款来源（私人信贷或银行），发现企业在后续融资中高度倾向于继续使用同类型的贷款方，表明私人信贷并非银行信贷的临时替代品，而是特定企业群体的持续性融资来源。
AI.research_question: 私人信贷是银行信贷的临时替代品，还是特定企业群体的持续性融资来源？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对私人信贷与银行信贷的关系存在争议，需要实证检验私人信贷究竟是暂时性的融资选择还是具有持久性的融资渠道。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业融资渠道选择理论；信贷市场分类匹配理论（sorting）
AI.method: 基于美国上市公司样本，将企业分为PC-first（首次融资来自私人信贷）和bank-first（首次融资来自银行）两组，追踪其两年内后续融资协议的贷款方类型，并进行比较分析。
AI.findings: （1）PC-first企业中23.0%后续从私人信贷机构获得新贷款，而仅2.7%从银行获得；（2）bank-first企业中20.4%继续从银行获得，仅2.0%从私人信贷机构获得；（3）多数获得新私人信贷协议的PC-first企业选择了不同的私人信贷机构，说明持续性并非由个别人际关系驱动；（4）PC-first企业在成立之初规模更小、盈利能力更低、有形资产比率更低。
AI.theory_contributions: 从实证角度支持了企业按特征在不同类型贷款机构间进行"分类匹配"的理论，反驳了私人信贷仅是银行信贷临时替代品的观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管者、投资者和企业融资决策者理解私人信贷市场的功能定位提供了实证依据；表明私人信贷服务的是银行信贷难以覆盖的特定企业群体，具有独立且持续的融资功能。

title: The Indivisibility of Option Replication and Portfolio Theory: Uncovering the Mechanics of the Moore Option Pricing Model
affiliations: University of Toledo

detail.title: The Indivisibility of Option Replication and Portfolio Theory: Uncovering the Mechanics of the Moore Option Pricing Model

keywords: Internal Rate of Return (IRR) JEL Classification G12 (Asset Pricing)

detail.abstract:
This paper provides an empirical and theoretical re-examination of options cross-sectional pricing by demonstrating that the options surface can be systematically modeled as a log-linear weighted portfolio rate asset in the Moore Option Pricing Model. The Moore Option Pricing Model is a variable drift Fokker Planck derived pricing model that simply solves the basic Black Scholes model for the interest rate with a unity optimal variance that is defined operationally optimal. It is a homomorphic mapping between Real space constrained by boundary condition and the Fokker Plack Space. Rather than treating contingent claims as speculative black boxes requiring strike-specific stochastic variance parameters, our framework demonstrates that the contract cross-section is fully explained by a native, natural log-additive two-component vector field: an active leverage-constrained equity replication leg and a continuous probabilistic boundary funding constraint.
The fundamental architectural conclusion of this study is that a cross-sectional mapping of options via a dynamic underlying drift variable is strongly supported by the empirical evidence. We argue that the Black Scholes mapping is not a rational homomorphism. The real space does not logically map into the space defined by the Black Scholes model. The drift rate must vary with the option rate though time, it cannot be just the risk free rate. This framework represents the most rational and logical method of mapping option pricing via a continuous Fokker Planck operator container. By moving the underlying replication assets out of raw scale coordinates and into a native, natural log-linear matrix space under a strict structural zero intercept (alpha = 0), the design matrix allows localized microstructure friction and floor execution noise to share the spatial envelope across the continuous surface, establishing a robust, structure-preserving pricing relationship across the strike gradient.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并实证检验了Moore期权定价模型，该模型将期权横截面系统性地建模为对数线性加权组合收益率资产，通过变量漂移的Fokker-Planck算子将期权定价从Black-Scholes框架转换到一个"原生对数线性矩阵空间"中。该框架认为期权横截面由两个成分的向量场完全解释：主动的杠杆约束权益复制腿和连续的概率边界融资约束。实证证据强烈支持通过动态底层漂移变量进行期权横截面映射的架构性结论。
AI.research_question: 期权横截面定价能否通过一个变量漂移的系统化模型（Moore期权定价模型）被完整解释？Black-Scholes模型是否构成理性的同态映射？
AI.motivation: 现有Black-Scholes框架将期权视为需要逐一行权价特定随机方差参数的"投机黑箱"，且其将真实空间映射到期权定价空间的过程并非理性的同态映射——漂移率必须随期权收益率随时间变化，而不能仅仅是无风险利率。本文旨在提供一个更理性、更逻辑的期权定价映射方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: Moore期权定价模型（变量漂移Fokker-Planck衍生定价模型）、Black-Scholes模型、同态映射理论、Fokker-Planck算子、对数线性加权组合收益率资产框架。
AI.method: 经验与理论相结合的再检验方法：将期权面系统建模为对数线性加权组合收益率资产，在严格的结构零截距（alpha=0）约束下，将底层复制资产从原始尺度坐标移至原生日对数线性矩阵空间，利用设计矩阵在连续面上共享局部微观结构摩擦与执行噪音的空间包络。
AI.findings: （1）期权横截面可由"主动杠杆约束权益复制腿"和"连续概率边界融资约束"两个成分的向量场完全解释；（2）通过动态底层漂移变量的期权横截面映射获得强经验证据支持；（3）Black-Scholes映射不是理性的同态映射，真实空间不能逻辑映射到Black-Scholes模型定义的空间；（4）漂移率必须随期权收益率随时间变化，不能仅为无风险利率。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提出Moore期权定价模型作为更理性的期权定价映射框架；（2）论证Black-Scholes模型并非理性同态映射；（3）构建了原生对数线性矩阵空间下的结构保持定价关系，为期权横截面定价提供了新的理论架构。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）通过将局部微观结构摩擦和地板执行噪音纳入连续表面的空间包络，实现了跨行权价梯度的稳健结构保持定价关系；（2）将期权面系统性建模为对数线性加权组合，为实践中的期权定价和风险管理提供了更简洁统一的工具。

title: Tauberian Bayes Factors
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and

detail.title: Tauberian Bayes Factors
detail.abstract: We develop a unified asymptotic theory of Bayes factors in which the central analytical tool is the Tauberian theorem. A marginal likelihood is a Laplace transform of the prior with respect to the local behaviour of the likelihood, and hence every asymptotic statement about statistical evidence is an Abelian-Tauberian statement in the sense of Karamata (1930) and Wiener (1932): the index of regular variation of the prior at the null hypothesis is transferred, through the transform, to the polynomial rate of the Bayes factor, while slowly varying factors of the prior appear as slowly varying corrections to the evidence. This single principle organises the Schwarz approximation, Bartlett's paradox, the information paradox for g-priors, the boundary-mode Laplace approximations of Erkanli (1994), the non-local priors of Johnson and Rossell (2010), and the logarithmic behaviour of the horseshoe prior of Carvalho, Polson and Scott (2010). We show that a one-sided boundary constraint acts as a half-moment prior: the coefficients of the boundary Laplace expansion are half-moments of the Gaussian, whose surviving odd terms generate the half-integer powers of n-1/2 that distinguish Erkanli's expansions from the interior case. The horseshoe's logarithmic pole at the origin is identified as a regularly varying singularity of index zero, which both regularises the Savage-Dickey ratio and attenuates Bartlett's paradox by a slowly varying factor. We derive a new tilting identity for Zellner's g-prior which expresses the Bayes factor as a tilted moment of the random shrinkage weight, from which the information-consistency condition of Liang et al. (2008) follows as a Karamata Tauberian statement. Finally, regular variation places Bayes factors in direct correspondence with extreme value theory: the Fréchet domain of attraction of the prior predictive is inherited from the prior through Breiman's lemma, and heavy-tailed priors, illustrated by explicit Cauchy, Student-t and horseshoe calculations, deliver bounded influence and the resolution of prior-likelihood conflict.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种统一的贝叶斯因子渐近理论，核心分析工具是Tauberian定理。文章将边际似然视为先验关于似然局部行为的拉普拉斯变换，从而将贝叶斯因子的所有渐近陈述统一为Abelian-Tauberian形式：先验在零假设处的正则变化指数通过变换转移到贝叶斯因子的多项式速率上。该统一原理组织了Schwarz近似、Bartlett悖论、g先验的信息悖论、Erkanli边界模式拉普拉斯近似、Johnson和Rossell的非局部先验以及horseshoe先验的对数行为，并通过正则变化理论与极值理论建立直接联系。
AI.research_question: 如何建立统一的贝叶斯因子渐近理论框架，以解释和整合多种看似不同的贝叶斯因子行为（如Schwarz近似、Bartlett悖论、信息悖论、边界模式近似、非局部先验和horseshoe先验）？
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯因子是贝叶斯模型选择的核心工具，但其渐近行为在文献中以多种零散、看似无关的结果形式呈现。作者试图寻找一个统一的数学原理来组织这些结果，揭示它们共同的深层结构，并为新结果（如倾斜恒等式、极值理论联系）提供推导基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: Tauberian定理（Karamata 1930; Wiener 1932）、正则变化理论（regular variation）、拉普拉斯变换、Abelian-Tauberian对偶、Breiman引理、极值理论（Fréchet吸引域）、Savage-Dickey密度比
AI.method: 理论推导方法。作者利用Tauberian定理将边际似然表示为拉普拉斯变换，分析先验在零假设邻域的局部行为（正则变化指数和慢变化因子）如何通过变换转移到贝叶斯因子的渐近行为。具体包括：边界拉普拉斯展开（半矩生成）、horseshoe先验的对数奇点分析、g先验的倾斜恒等式推导、以及通过Breiman引理建立与极值理论的联系。
AI.findings: （1）所有贝叶斯因子的渐近行为都可以统一在Abelian-Tauberian框架下，先验的正则变化指数转移到贝叶斯因子的多项式速率；（2）单侧边界约束等价于半矩先验，边界拉普拉斯展开的系数是高斯分布的半矩，其奇数项产生n的-1/2半整数幂，区分Erkanli展开与内部情形；（3）horseshoe先验在原点的对数极点被识别为指数为零的正则变化奇点，既正则化了Savage-Dickey比率又通过慢变化因子减弱了Bartlett悖论；（4）为Zellner的g先验推导出新的倾斜恒等式，将贝叶斯因子表示为随机收缩权重的倾斜矩，Liang等人（2008）的信息一致性条件作为Karamata Tauberian陈述自然得出；（5）正则变化使贝叶斯因子与极值理论直接对应，重尾先验（Cauchy、Student-t、horseshoe）通过Breiman引理产生有界影响并解决先验-似然冲突。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了贝叶斯因子渐近理论的统一框架，将分散的文献结果（Schwarz近似、Bartlett悖论、信息悖论、Erkanli边界展开、非局部先验、horseshoe先验）整合到单一Tauberian原理之下；首次将正则变化理论和极值理论系统引入贝叶斯因子分析，建立了先验尾部行为与贝叶斯证据之间的精确数学对应关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为贝叶斯模型选择中先验的选择提供了理论指导：重尾先验（Cauchy、Student-t、horseshoe）能够提供有界影响并解决先验-似然冲突问题；统一框架使研究者能够预测不同先验下贝叶斯因子的渐近行为，从而更理性地设计先验；信息一致性的新推导为g先验的使用提供了更清晰的理论基础。

title: Public Health Emergencies and Executive Power in Nepal: Balancing Liberty and Security in a Fragile Federal System

detail.title: Public Health Emergencies and Executive Power in Nepal: Balancing Liberty and Security in a Fragile Federal System
detail.abstract: Case Study Overview This case study examines Nepal's use of emergency executive powers as a nascent federal democracy facing the COVID-19 pandemic. It is about the tension between protecting public health, which is a kind of collective security, and protecting individual freedoms, the heart of liberty. This case shows how the federal government used ordinary laws, not the formal emergency powers of the Constitution, to impose sweeping restrictions. This choice brought consequences for civil liberties, intergovernmental coordination and vulnerable groups. The study uses available data to show the extent of the health, economic and social impact. It ends with practical recommendations for strengthening Nepal's legal and institutional framework for future public health emergencies.

AI.tldr: 本研究以尼泊尔为案例，考察了新兴联邦民主国家在COVID-19疫情期间使用紧急行政权力的情况，揭示了联邦政府通过普通法律而非宪法正式紧急权力实施广泛限制措施的实践，以及由此对公民自由、政府间协调和弱势群体产生的后果，并提出加强公共卫生应急法律和制度框架的建议。
AI.research_question: 尼泊尔作为新兴联邦民主国家，在COVID-19疫情期间如何运用紧急行政权力？这种运用在公共卫生保护与个人自由之间产生了怎样的张力？
AI.motivation: 新兴联邦民主国家在公共卫生危机中如何在集体安全（公共卫生）与个人自由之间取得平衡是一个重要但研究不足的问题。尼泊尔的案例揭示了正式宪法紧急权力与实际行政实践之间的差距，以及其产生的多重后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集体安全与个人自由之间的张力理论；联邦制下的权力分配与政府间协调理论；紧急状态下的法治与行政权力理论。
AI.method: 案例研究方法，利用可得数据（健康、经济和社会影响数据）进行分析。
AI.findings: 尼泊尔联邦政府选择使用普通法律而非宪法正式紧急权力来实施广泛限制措施；这种做法对公民自由、政府间协调和弱势群体产生了负面影响；健康、经济和社会各层面均受到不同程度的冲击。
AI.theory_contributions: 补充了新兴联邦民主国家在公共卫生危机中紧急权力运用的理论理解，揭示了正式法律框架与实际行政实践之间的偏离及其理论意涵。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼泊尔及其他类似新兴联邦民主国家提供了关于加强公共卫生应急法律和制度框架的具体实践建议，有助于未来公共卫生紧急事件的有效应对。

title: The Mathematics of the Rose: Rhodonea Curves, Golden Angles, and Parametric Blooms
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: The Mathematics of the Rose: Rhodonea Curves, Golden Angles, and Parametric Blooms
detail.abstract: We describe the mathematics behind drawing a rose. Three constructions are developed in increasing dimensional sophistication. First, the classical rhodonea (rose) curves r = a cos(kθ) of Guido Grandi, whose petal count obeys a parity rule; we give the petal-counting theorem with proof, compute areas and arc lengths, exhibit the curves as two-phasor Fourier objects, and discuss the rational/irrational dichotomy in the frequency k through Weyl equidistribution. Second, the phyllotactic placement of petals at successive multiples of the golden angle 2πφ-2 ≈ 137.5 • , whose optimality is a theorem in Diophantine approximation: the golden ratio's continued fraction [1; 1, 1,. .. ] makes it the worst-approximable irrational (Hurwitz), the three-gap theorem of Steinhaus controls the resulting spacings, and the same rotation underlies low-discrepancy point sets used in quasi-Monte Carlo. Third, a full three-dimensional parametric surface that curls a logarithmically opening spiral of deformed petals into a photorealistic bloom. The rose thus sits at the intersection of Fourier analysis, Diophantine approximation, ergodic theory, and differential geometry-a case study in how simple generative rules compose into organic complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文用数学语言完整描述了玫瑰花的绘制过程，从二维经典 rhodonea 曲线出发，经由黄金角叶序排列，最终构建出三维参数化曲面模型，展示了从简单生成规则到有机复杂性的数学之美。
AI.research_question: 如何用严格的数学工具（Fourier分析、丢番图逼近、遍历理论、微分几何）来描述和构建从二维到三维的玫瑰花绘制模型？
AI.motivation: 玫瑰花形状横跨多个数学分支（Fourier分析、丢番图逼近、遍历理论、微分几何），是研究简单生成规则如何组合成有机复杂性的典型案例。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经典rhodonea曲线理论（花瓣计数定理、面积与弧长计算）、Fourier分析（双相量表示）、Weyl等分布定理、黄金角叶序理论（连分数、Hurwitz定理、Steinhaus三间隙定理）、低差异点集理论（准蒙特卡洛方法）、三维参数曲面与微分几何。
AI.method: 采用三层次逐渐增加维度复杂性的构造方法：1）经典rhodonea曲线的数学推导与证明；2）黄金角叶序排列的丢番图逼近分析；3）三维参数化曲面建模实现照片级真实感的玫瑰花渲染。
AI.findings: 1）rhodonea曲线的花瓣数量遵循奇偶性规则，给出花瓣计数定理及其证明；2）黄金角的叶序最优性可由Hurwitz定理证明（黄金比是最难逼近的无理数），Steinhaus三间隙定理控制花瓣间距；3）同一旋转在准蒙特卡洛低差异点集中也有应用；4）三维模型将对数螺旋的变形花瓣卷成逼真的花朵。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Fourier分析、丢番图逼近、遍历理论与微分几何统一于玫瑰花这一具体对象，建立了从经典平面曲线到三维参数曲面的系统性数学框架，玫瑰花位于这些数学分支的交叉点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为计算机图形学中的花卉生成提供数学基础，低差异点集与准蒙特卡洛方法的联系具有数值计算价值，为程序化生成有机形态提供了可复现的数学模型。
