title: A New Social Contract: How an AI Sovereign Wealth Fund Could Boost Economic Security
affiliations: University of British Columbia (UBC) - Department of Psychology, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A New Social Contract: How an AI Sovereign Wealth Fund Could Boost Economic Security

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: AI is driving record investment while Canada's income gap reaches its widest measured level, a pairing that we treat as the technology's signature, since AI substitutes for labour and concentrates capital. Rather than compete with the U.S. on compute, Canada should build on its comparative advantage in research talent, public trust, and distributive institutions by creating an AI sovereign wealth fund that pays every citizen a dividend, not one that merely finances AI firms. The paper proposes capitalizing it through equity warrants on compute subsidies and procurement, a data-centre energy levy, and an annual dilution levy paid in newly issued shares; governing it at arm's length on the CPP Investments model, with payouts capped at long-run real returns; and distributing proceeds as a basic income paired with personal AI-skills accounts. Canadian evidence from Mincome, Ontario's pilot, and the New Leaf Project supports the dividend's design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出加拿大应建立AI主权财富基金，通过股权认股权证、数据中心能源税和年度稀释税等机制筹资，以CPP Investments模式进行独立治理，并将收益以基本收入和AI技能账户形式分配给每位公民，以应对AI加剧的收入不平等问题。
AI.research_question: 加拿大应如何设计AI主权财富基金，以在AI加剧收入不平等的背景下，利用本国比较优势实现AI红利的公平分配？
AI.motivation: AI正推动创纪录的投资，同时加拿大的收入差距达到有测量以来的最宽水平。AI替代劳动并集中资本，加拿大若与美国在算力上竞争并无优势，应转向利用研究人才、公众信任和分配制度等比较优势。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI替代劳动与资本集中的特性分析；主权财富基金理论；基本收入理论；比较优势理论
AI.method: 规范性政策设计与制度分析，结合加拿大历史经验证据（Mincome、安大略试点、New Leaf Project）进行论证支持。
AI.findings: 提出通过股权认股权证（对算力补贴和采购）、数据中心能源税、年度稀释税（以新发行股份支付）等方式为基金筹资；以CPP Investments模式进行独立治理，派息上限为长期实际回报；以基本收入搭配个人AI技能账户的方式分配收益。加拿大Mincome、安大略试点和New Leaf Project的证据支持该红利分配设计。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI主权财富基金与公民红利分配相结合，提出了一种区别于单纯资助AI企业的政策框架，拓展了AI治理与再分配制度设计的理论视野。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加拿大提供了具体的AI红利分配政策方案，包括筹资机制、治理结构和分配方式的实操设计，可供政策制定者参考实施。

title: From Signal to Substrate: Architecture, Irreversibility, and the Capital Economics of Custom Silicon
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: From Signal to Substrate: Architecture, Irreversibility, and the Capital Economics of Custom Silicon
detail.abstract: Hardware partitioning is commonly treated as an engineering decision: identify a computational bottleneck, estimate the performance or energy benefit of specialization, and determine whether the function belongs in software, programmable logic, or fixed silicon. That framing is incomplete. Moving computation toward dedicated hardware converts flexibility into commitment. Algorithms, dataflows, security assumptions, workload forecasts, interfaces, manufacturing dependencies, and supplier choices begin accumulating non-recurring engineering cost, verification effort, package constraints, capacity reservations, inventory exposure, and lifecycle obligations. Architecture is therefore also a capital-allocation discipline. This paper proposes a framework for deciding what deserves to become hardware by examining four questions: whether specialization creates measured technical advantage; whether the underlying computation is sufficiently persistent; whether risk-adjusted lifetime economics justify greater irreversibility; and whether the resulting implementation is manufacturable, supplyable, trustworthy, and deployable. The resulting question is not simply what can become silicon. It is what deserves to become irreversible.

AI.tldr: 本文提出硬件划分不仅是工程决策，更是一种资本配置纪律。作者提出一个框架，通过四个关键问题（技术优势、计算持续性、风险调整后的生命周期经济学、可制造性与可部署性）来决定什么计算值得被固化到硬件中，将问题从"什么能变成硅"转变为"什么值得变得不可逆"。
AI.research_question: 什么计算值得从软件/可编程逻辑转化为专用硬件？即什么值得变得不可逆？
AI.motivation: 传统的硬件划分仅被当作工程决策（识别瓶颈、估算性能或能效收益），忽略了将计算移向专用硬件会引入非重复性工程成本、验证负担、封装约束、产能预留、库存风险和生命周期义务等，本质上是将灵活性转化为承诺，因此需要更完整的决策框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将硬件架构视为资本配置纪律（capital-allocation discipline），强调灵活性到承诺（flexibility into commitment）的转化视角。
AI.method: 提出概念性分析框架，通过四个核心问题来评估硬件化的合理性：（1）专业化是否创造可衡量的技术优势；（2）底层计算是否足够持久；（3）风险调整后的生命周期经济性是否支持更大的不可逆性；（4）实现方案是否可制造、可供应、可信赖且可部署。
AI.findings: 硬件划分的决策框架应超越单纯的性能/能量估算，同时考虑技术优势、计算持久性、生命周期经济学以及可制造性和可部署性等维度。
AI.theory_contributions: 将硬件架构决策重新定义为资本配置问题，将"可逆性"概念引入硬件划分理论，提出了系统化的四问评估框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为硬件架构师和决策者提供了评估硬件化决策的系统性框架，帮助避免因忽视不可逆成本和风险而导致的错误投资决策。

title: When Text Becomes Tradable: Financial-domain Language Models and the Asymmetric Absorption of News in Agricultural Futures Markets
affiliations: University of Kent - Kent Business School,  and University of Kent, Kent Business School

detail.title: When Text Becomes Tradable: Financial-domain Language Models and the Asymmetric Absorption of News in Agricultural Futures Markets
detail.abstract: We ask whether large-language-model (LLM) embeddings of media news predict agricultural commodity futures returns and, if so, where the predictability resides. Using daily news on fourteen CBOT and ICE contracts from 2009 to 2023, we estimate a two-stage textual regression that maps pre-trained transformer embeddings to next-day returns via ridge regression, benchmarking against other text-based methods and non-text commodity-factor predictors across thirteen vectorisation models, including parameter-matched general-purpose baselines. The strongest text-based long-short portfolio, Araci's FinBERT on full news stories, attains an annualised Sharpe ratio near 2.5, and the tradable edge is sharply localised. First, it is concentrated in financially specialised pretraining: only the finance-domain (FinBERT) encoders retain economically large, statistically significant long-short Sharpe ratios after transaction costs, and only on full stories rather than headlines. Second, its informativeness is asymmetric and state-dependent across the portfolio legs: the short-leg Sharpe ratio is significantly higher on high-volatility days (around 3, versus about 1.4 unconditionally), confirmed by a block-bootstrap test, consistent with news predicting downside risk. Third, predictability accrues at the daily horizon (sub-daily strategies underperform), consistent with staggered absorption of dispersed news. These signals are not spanned by known commodity factors: after controlling for price, momentum, and carry benchmarks, the FinBERT long-short portfolio retains an annualised alpha of about 23% (t ≈ 5.9). Predictability is also materially stronger for grains than soft commodities.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLM）的媒体新闻嵌入是否能够预测农产品期货收益，并定位了预测力的来源。基于2009至2023年CBOT和ICE的14种合约日度新闻数据，使用两阶段文本回归将预训练transformer嵌入映射到次日收益，研究发现财经领域预训练的FinBERT模型在全新闻故事上的多空组合年化Sharpe比率接近2.5，且该预测力在短期腿、高波动日及日度频率上集中体现，扣除交易成本后仍具显著alpha。
AI.research_question: 大规模语言模型的新闻嵌入能否预测农产品期货收益？如果可以，预测力具体存在于何处（哪些模型、哪些文本、哪些条件下）？
AI.motivation: 农产品期货市场的信息传播与定价效率是重要议题，而LLM文本嵌入为新闻信息提取提供了新工具。现有研究多关注股票市场，对商品市场尤其是农产品期货中LLM嵌入预测力的系统性检验尚属空白，且缺乏对预测力来源（模型选择、文本粒度、市场状态、时域频率）的精细解剖。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有效市场假说（信息吸收与价格调整）、文本挖掘与自然语言处理理论、行为金融学中的注意力与有限关注理论、风险溢价与下行风险定价理论。
AI.method: 两阶段文本回归：先用预训练transformer嵌入对新闻文本进行向量化，再通过岭回归将嵌入映射到次日收益；对比13种向量化模型（含参数匹配的通用基线），构建文本驱动多空组合，并进行交易成本调整、块自助检验、因子模型alpha检验及多维度异质性分析。
AI.findings: （1）最强文本多空组合（FinBERT+全新闻故事）年化Sharpe约2.5；（2）预测力集中在财经领域预训练模型中，且仅在全新闻故事而非标题上显著；（3）预测力不对称且依赖状态：短期腿在高波动日Sharpe约3（无条件约1.4）；（4）预测力在日度频率上最强，日内策略表现更差；（5）扣除非文本因子基准后年化alpha约23%（t≈5.9）；（6）谷物类预测力强于软商品类。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）系统性地将LLM文本嵌入预测力研究拓展至农产品期货市场；（2）精确定位了预测力在模型类型（财经专用vs通用）、文本粒度（全故事vs标题）、市场状态（波动率高低）、时间维度（日度vs日内）上的分布，丰富了文本定价文献；（3）通过块自助检验确认了状态依赖的不对称预测力，为下行风险定价理论提供新证据；（4）证明文本信号未被已知商品因子所跨越，说明新闻信息具有独立定价内容。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为农产品期货投资者提供了基于LLM新闻嵌入的可交易策略（扣费后仍具显著Sharpe与alpha）；（2）指导实务中模型选择：应优先使用财经领域预训练模型（FinBERT）并采用全新闻故事而非标题；（3）为风险管理者提供高波动期下行风险预警信号的工具；（4）对农产品市场信息效率评估与监管具有参考意义。

title:
What Problems does the Theory Solve? 
An Applied Meta-theory for Strategic Management Working Paper Version 1.04

detail.title:
What Problems does the Theory Solve? 
An Applied Meta-theory for Strategic Management Working Paper Version 1.04

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests, personal relationships, or affiliations that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is a conceptual and theoretical work based exclusively on published literature and the author's scholarly analysis. It did not involve human participants, personal data, patient data, experiments, surveys, interviews, or case-study subjects requiring ethics approval or informed consent.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
Strategic management has accumulated several powerful and mutually competing theories of the firm and no principle for deciding which applies when. This paper argues that the absence is structural rather than accidental, and proposes a way to repair it.

The field's founding object was the general manager's diagnostic act – the characterization of a situation prior to any response. That object is also the one most resistant to the identification standards through which the field earned its scientific standing, and so the field migrated away from it one defensible step at a time, toward phenomena downstream of diagnosis that could be estimated cleanly. The diagnostic act is still taught in every strategy classroom and performed by every executive. It has no cumulative theory.

The primitive proposed here is the productive problem: a gap between a purpose and a combination that would serve it and does not yet exist. Because a routine is a technology in Arthur's sense, governance, growth, and coordination problems are one species of object individuated by purpose – which is why the classes the field already studies can be dimensioned by type, boundary, and residence rather than filed under the theory that named each one.

The central claim is a level inversion. Existing theories explain how firms solve problems; none says what problems the theory itself solves. The mechanism of selection is boundary conditions: a theory's assumptions are the outer edge of its competence, and the first task is not a problem-to-theory mapping but an audit of where each theory's predictive power deteriorates. The objective is not which theory is universally true, but which exhibits the greatest predictive competence for a diagnosed class of problem.

The overlaps are where this begins, and the evidence is already collected. Comparative "horse race" studies have tested rival theories against each other on the same problems for thirty years and reported the draws as inconclusive – because a tournament has only one output, a ranking. Read as jurisdiction findings instead, that literature is a partial and unintended audit that requires no new data to reinterpret.

What follows is therefore an applied meta-theory: its object includes the field's own theories, and its output is a decision a manager can act on. It replaces nothing. Esto no es una invención; es una sistematización – an ordering of what the field already knows around the primitive that makes it usable.

AI.tldr: 本文认为战略管理领域缺乏一种决定何时适用哪种理论的元原则，这一缺失是结构性的而非偶然的。论文提出以"生产性问题"（productive problem）作为基本单元，通过层级倒转（level inversion），将现有理论从"解释企业如何解决问题"转向"审计各理论自身解决问题的能力边界"，从而建立一种应用的元理论。作者主张将现有的"赛马"比较研究重新解读为司法管辖（jurisdiction）发现，以无需新数据的方式对领域进行系统化整理。
AI.research_question: 战略管理领域积累了多个互相竞争的企业理论，但缺乏决定何时适用何者的原则，如何修复这一结构性缺失？
AI.motivation: 战略管理领域的奠基对象是总经理的诊断行为（对情境的事先表征），但该对象因难以满足识别标准而被逐步回避，导致诊断行为虽被广泛教授和实践却缺乏累积理论。现有理论各自解释企业如何解决问题，却没有理论说明该理论自身解决什么问题，存在认识论层面的空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以"生产性问题"（目的与服务该目的但尚不存在的组合之间的差距）为原始单元；借鉴Arthur的技术概念将惯例视为技术；提出层级倒转——从问题到理论的映射转向边界条件审计；以司法管辖（jurisdiction）框架重新理解理论之间的竞争关系。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性方法：提出元理论框架，通过对现有30年比较"赛马"研究的重新解读（从排名输出重新诠释为司法管辖发现）来支持论点，无需新数据。
AI.findings: 领域之所以缺乏统一原则，是因为其从诊断行为这一无法干净估计的原始对象逐步迁移至下游可估计的现象；理论的假设即其能力的边界；治理、增长与协调问题可按目的（类型、边界、居所）维度分类而非按理论归类；现有赛马研究的"无决定性结果"应被重新解读为各理论各有管辖领域的证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"生产性问题"作为统一原始单元，实现层级倒转——将理论本身作为分析对象，建立判断理论适用性的元原则；提出"边界条件作为选择机制"和"司法管辖"视角以取代问题-理论一一映射的思维。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供可操作的决策工具：通过审计各理论在其假设边界内的预测能力，决定面对特定诊断问题时应采用哪一理论框架，产出管理者可直接行动的依据。

title: Convergence as a Mitigation Strategy: How Synchronized Global Adoption of Clean Technologies Reduces Systemic Risk

detail.title: Convergence as a Mitigation Strategy: How Synchronized Global Adoption of Clean Technologies Reduces Systemic Risk
detail.abstract: Climate commentary treats a world cost collapse and a world generation share as synchronized adoption, and treats synchronized adoption as systemic-risk mitigation. Neither step survives a country file. Solar photovoltaic levelised cost in the IRENA world series fell 90 percent between 2010 and 2024. Solar-plus-wind reached 15 percent of world electricity, from 1.8 percent. World fossil CO2 rose 16 percent in the same window, to 38.6 gigatonnes. In a balanced reading of Ember and Energy Institute generation files, Global Carbon Budget territorial emissions, IRENA capacity, and the IEA Global EV Data Explorer via Our World in Data, we score 202 countries on two clocks. Power: solar-plus-wind at or above 8 percent of electricity, on a grid that already reaches 80 percent of the population. Fossil-exit: an 8-point fall in the fossil share of electricity since 2010 with the residual at or below 75 percent, or a fossil share already at or below 55 percent. Share-sync is both clocks on a lag of seven years or less. Twenty-one countries clear it, covering 2.35 billion people and 53 percent of scored territorial CO2. Drop China and the same cell holds 19 percent of the tonnes. Deep exit-fossil electricity at or below 40 percent-holds 9 percent of the tonnes. The tonne club of seventeen countries that each hold at least 1 percent of scored CO2 accounts for 81 percent of the file. Four of them are share-synced: China, the United States, Germany, and Australia. India is powerahead, at 10.5 percent solar-plus-wind and 77.5 percent fossil electricity. Russia, Iran, and Indonesia are absent. Sub-Saharan Africa has one share-sync country in forty-eight. Crosscountry dispersion of solar-plus-wind shares rose from 2.6 points in 2010 to 14.7 in 2024. The club clustered. The tail did not join. A cheap module is not a retired tonne. A mix clock that China and Germany close in the same decade is not a mitigation of the residual-tonne geography.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了气候评论中将"全球成本下降"和"全球发电占比提升"等同于"同步转型"，并将同步转型等同于"系统性风险缓解"的两种错误推论。通过对202个国家的多源数据（Ember、能源研究所、全球碳预算、IRENA、IEA等）进行实证分析，作者构建了"电力时钟"和"化石退出时钟"两个衡量指标，发现仅有21个国家实现了"份额同步"（两个时钟间隔不超过7年），覆盖23.5亿人口和53%的领土CO2排放。研究揭示全球能源转型呈现"俱乐部聚集、尾部未跟进"的分化格局，强调"便宜的组件不等于退役的碳吨位"。
AI.research_question: 全球太阳能光伏成本暴跌和发电份额上升能否等同于各国同步实现能源转型？同步转型是否真的意味着系统性气候风险得到缓解？
AI.motivation: 气候评论界普遍将全球层面的成本下降和发电份额增长视为能源转型的同步推进，并将此视为系统性风险的缓解。但全球汇总数据掩盖了各国的巨大差异，作者旨在通过国家级数据检验这一乐观叙事的真实性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于能源转型的"时钟"概念框架，区分"电力时钟"（太阳能+风电占电力8%以上且电网覆盖80%人口）和"化石退出时钟"（化石发电份额自2010年下降8个百分点且残余≤75%，或化石份额已≤55%），并以此定义"份额同步"为两个时钟间隔不超过7年。
AI.method: 对202个国家进行实证评分，整合多个权威数据源（Ember、Energy Institute、Global Carbon Budget、IRENA、IEA Global EV Data Explorer via Our World in Data），构建两个时钟指标并计算跨国离散度。
AI.findings: (1) 仅21个国家实现份额同步，覆盖23.5亿人口和53%的领土CO2；(2) 剔除中国后仅占19%排放；(3) 17个"吨位俱乐部"国家占81%排放，其中仅4个（中国、美国、德国、澳大利亚）实现份额同步；(4) 印度电力领先但化石份额仍高（77.5%）；(5) 俄、伊、印尼缺席；(6) 撒哈拉以南非洲48国仅1个同步；(7) 太阳能+风电份额跨国离散度从2.6点升至14.7点——俱乐部聚集，尾部未跟进。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战并证伪了"成本下降=同步转型"和"同步转型=风险缓解"两个隐含假设，提出以国家级"时钟"和"份额同步"概念替代全球层面的简单叙事，揭示了全球能源转型的非同步性和地理分化结构。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了一套基于国家级数据的转型评估框架，明确指出中国和德国虽在同一十年内接近"混合时钟"，但并未缓解残余排放的地理分布问题，提示国际气候政策需关注"吨位俱乐部"之外的排放集中国（如印度）以及转型落后的尾部国家。

title: Wildfire Smoke, Recreation Losses, and Gateway Community Revenue
affiliations: , University of Wyoming, University of Wyoming, University of Wyoming, University of Wyoming and University of Wyoming

detail.title: Wildfire Smoke, Recreation Losses, and Gateway Community Revenue
detail.abstract: Wildfire smoke now accounts for roughly one quarter of all fine particulate matter (PM 2.5) in the United States and conditions are expected to worsen, yet smoke's consequences for outdoor recreation and recreation-dependent local economies remain poorly understood. We estimate the causal effect of wildfire smoke on daily visitation to national parks across the continental United States and on consumer spending at gateway community businesses surrounding those parks. Leveraging plausibly exogenous variation in park-level smoke-attributable PM 2.5 , combined with high resolution mobile phone-derived visitation counts, we find that smoke reduces park visitation at all but the most modest pollution levels, with declines as large as 42.4% on Very Unhealthy or Hazardous air quality index days. Smoke on a given day also suppresses future visitation, consistent with anticipatory trip cancellations. Travel cost modeling suggests that mean annual consumer surplus losses amount to approximately $13.6 million in foregone recreation. High-resolution business-level spending data show that severe smoke at nearby parks reduces gateway community revenue, while moderate smoke may increase it. We decompose these effects by their central mechanisms: park visitation losses, park visitor within-day substitution, and spatially correlated local smoke exposure. Revenue losses are not offset by subsequent increases in spending at later dates. These findings reveal significant disruptions to outdoor recreation demand and the tourism-dependent communities that rely on it.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国本土国家公园的高分辨率手机定位访问量数据与烟雾归因PM2.5数据，因果识别了野火烟雾对公园游客访问量及周边门户社区消费支出的影响。研究发现烟雾显著减少公园访问量（空气质量极不健康或危险天数最高下降42.4%），且具有跨天的负向溢出效应；烟雾导致的年均消费者剩余损失约1360万美元。严重烟雾减少门户社区收入，中等烟雾反而可能增加收入，且收入损失无法通过后续消费弥补。
AI.research_question: 野火烟雾对美国国家公园户外游憩需求以及依赖旅游的门户社区经济会产生怎样的因果影响？
AI.motivation: 野火烟雾目前约占美国PM2.5总量的四分之一，且预计会进一步恶化，但其对户外游憩和游憩依赖型地方经济的后果仍未得到充分理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 旅行成本模型（Travel Cost Modeling）作为福利评估框架，结合空气污染对户外需求的影响机制（即时需求抑制、预期性行程取消等）。
AI.method: 利用公园层面烟雾归因PM2.5的外生变异，结合高分辨率手机定位游客访问量数据，进行因果估计；辅以高分辨率企业层面支出数据进行机制分解（公园访问损失、公园游客当日替代、空间相关的本地烟雾暴露）。
AI.findings: （1）烟雾在几乎所有污染水平下都减少公园访问量，极不健康或危险AQI日最高下降42.4%；（2）当日的烟雾会抑制未来访问，符合预期性行程取消；（3）年均消费者剩余损失约1360万美元；（4）严重烟雾减少门户社区收入，中等烟雾可能增加收入；（5）收入损失无法通过后续消费增长弥补。
AI.theory_contributions: 将空气污染的经济影响研究拓展到户外游憩需求领域，首次系统量化了野火烟雾对美国国家公园游憩价值的损失，并识别了旅行成本框架下烟雾的跨期需求抑制效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了野火烟雾对游憩经济影响的量化证据，揭示了依赖旅游的门户社区面临的收入风险，对公园管理、空气质量政策与旅游经济的适应规划具有重要参考价值。

title: Cameroon’s First WAFCON Title and the Sports Diplomacy Conversion Gap: From Symbolic Capital to Institutional Execution

detail.title: Cameroon’s First WAFCON Title and the Sports Diplomacy Conversion Gap: From Symbolic Capital to Institutional Execution
detail.abstract: Cameroon's 3 - 0 victory over Malawi in the final of the 2026 CAF Women's Africa Cup of Nations (WAFCON) in Rabat delivered the country's first continental title. It secured direct qualification for the 2027 FIFA Women's World Cup. Beyond its sporting significance, the result provides a timely case study through a recurring public policy problem can be examined: the conversion of high-visibility sporting success into durable diplomatic, institutional, and gender development outcomes. This paper introduces the Sports Diplomacy Conversion Gap, defined as the distance between the symbolic, reputational and diplomatic value generated by sporting achievement and the institutional, financial and organizational capacity mobilized to convert that value into sustained outcomes. It further distinguishes symbolic gender signaling, referring to narratives of visibility, recognition, and empowerment, from institutional gender transformation, referring to changes in financing, professional pathways, coaching systems, safeguarding, youth development, infrastructure, competition structures, and governance. Cameroon's journey is analytically instructive, especially as they had initially been eliminated by Algeria in the conventional qualifying pathway, Cameroon subsequently entered the expanded 16-team WAFCON field following CAF's decision to enlarge the competition and provide additional places to qualifying teams eliminated in the final round. The team then converted institutional access into competitive performance, reached the semi-finals and secured World Cup qualification before eventually winning the continental championship. This paper argues that the policy significance of the title should be assessed not through celebration or visibility alone, but through the institutional conversion that follows. Sporting achievement generates symbolic capital; institutions determine whether that capital becomes durable capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文以喀麦隆在2026年非洲女足国家杯夺冠为契机，提出"体育外交转化缺口"概念，分析高曝光度体育成功能否转化为持久的外交、制度及性别发展成果，并区分"象征性性别信号"与"制度性性别转型"。
AI.research_question: 高可见度的体育成功能否以及如何转化为持久的外交、制度和性别发展成果？具体而言，体育成就产生的象征性价值与将其转化为持久成果的制度能力之间存在怎样的"转化缺口"？
AI.motivation: 喀麦隆在2026年WAFCON夺冠提供了研究体育成就向公共政策成果转化的独特案例，政策界和学术界往往聚焦于庆祝和可见性，而忽视了制度性转化这一深层问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 体育外交转化缺口（Sports Diplomacy Conversion Gap）；象征性性别信号（symbolic gender signaling）与制度性性别转型（institutional gender transformation）的区分；象征性资本（symbolic capital）理论。
AI.method: 案例研究法，以喀麦隆女足在2026年非洲女足国家杯夺冠的历程为分析对象，梳理其从预选赛出局到凭借赛制扩容获得参赛资格、晋级四强、获得世界杯资格并最终夺冠的完整路径。
AI.findings: 体育成就产生象征性资本，但制度决定该资本能否转化为持久能力；喀麦隆将制度性参赛机会转化为竞技表现，但其政策意义应通过后续制度转化来评估，而非仅通过庆祝或可见性评估。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出"体育外交转化缺口"这一概念，为评估体育成就的政策价值提供了新的分析框架；明确区分象征性性别信号与制度性性别转型，深化了体育与性别发展关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估体育成就后续价值的分析工具，强调应关注赛事扩容、基础设施、教练体系、青年发展、治理结构等制度要素，而非仅关注赛事胜利本身。

reference: ZEW – Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No. 26-035
title: When Facts Fail: Experimental Evidence on Perceptions and Preferences toward Chinese Investments in Germany
affiliations: , City University of New York (CUNY) - CUNY Graduate Center, German Institute for Economic Research (DIW Berlin) and ZEW Mannheim

detail.title: When Facts Fail: Experimental Evidence on Perceptions and Preferences toward Chinese Investments in Germany

publicationDetails.detailsText: ZEW – Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No. 26-035

detail.abstract: Can correcting large misperceptions about foreign economic exposure change preferences over economic integration? We study this question in a high-stakes setting, Chinese direct investment in Germany, with a survey experiment embedded in the German SocioEconomic Panel (N = 2,365) and a comparative survey in China (N = 2,000). Germans overestimate Chinese FDI more than 30-fold (perceived 33% vs. actual 1%) and evaluate it far less favorably than EU or US investment, while Chinese respondents view German FDI positively. We test the effects of three randomized interventions on attitudes: a factual correction and two narrative framings. Factual information improves stated perceptions of the economic benefits of Chinese FDI by about 0.2 standard deviations, positive narratives produce smaller gains, and negative narratives leave these perceptions unchanged, consistent with already-low baseline beliefs. Yet these changes in perceptions do not translate into changes in preferences over foreign investors. In conjoint choices between hypothetical investment proposals, Chinese investors are 40 percentage points less likely to be chosen than otherwise identical EU investors, and respondents require a Chinese acquirer to save about 40% more jobs than an EU or US acquirer before viewing the offers as equivalent; both estimates remain statistically unchanged across all treatment arms. These results demonstrate that brief informational interventions cannot reshape entrenched attitudes toward investment from geopolitically distant partners, though they can improve assessments of its instrumental benefits.

AI.tldr: 本文通过德国社会经济面板（N=2,365）和中国对比调查（N=2,000）中的调查实验，研究纠正关于外国经济暴露的大幅误判是否能改变对经济一体化的偏好。研究发现德国人将中国对德直接投资高估逾30倍（感知33% vs 实际1%），事实纠正信息能将对中国FDI经济利益感知提升约0.2个标准差，但偏好层面的改变微乎其微——中国投资者被选中的概率比同等欧盟投资者低40个百分点，且需要多挽救约40%的就业岗位才能被视为等价，这些差异在所有实验干预组中均无显著变化。
AI.research_question: 纠正对外国经济暴露的大幅误判，能否改变民众对经济一体化的偏好？
AI.motivation: 在高度政治化的环境中，民众对经济一体化的态度可能基于严重失真的认知（如对来自地缘政治远方的外国直接投资规模的巨大高估）。本文旨在检验：提供事实信息能否不仅改善感知，更能改变对经济一体化的实际偏好。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息纠正与态度改变的理论，区分"工具性收益感知"与"深层态度偏好"两个层面，认为信息干预可能影响前者但难以撼动后者。
AI.method: 在德国社会经济面板（SOEP）中嵌入调查实验（N=2,365），并在中国进行对比调查（N=2,000）；设计三种随机干预：事实纠正、正面叙事框架、负面叙事框架；通过联合分析（conjoint experiment）测量对投资方的选择偏好。
AI.findings: （1）德国人高估中国对德FDI逾30倍；（2）事实纠正可将对中国FDI经济利益感知提升约0.2个标准差，正面叙事效果较小，负面叙事无效果；（3）感知变化未转化为偏好变化：中国投资者被选概率比欧盟投资者低40个百分点，需多挽救约40%就业岗位才等价，且在所有干预组间无统计差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了信息干预的"感知-偏好"脱节：纠正错误认知可以改善民众对经济利益的工具性评估，但无法改变对地缘政治远方伙伴的深层投资偏好，说明经济一体化偏好具有较强的态度惯性。
AI.practical_contributions: 对政策制定者和投资者具有启示意义：简短的信息干预不足以重塑公众对外资的深层态度，改善对地缘政治远端国家投资的公众接受度需要更系统、长期的政策沟通策略。

reference: TRR 266 Accounting for Transparency Working Paper Series No. 248
title: The Proprietary Cost of Machine-Readable Financial Reporting: Evidence from ESEF
affiliations: Paderborn University, Paderborn University and TRR 266 Accounting for Transparency

detail.title: The Proprietary Cost of Machine-Readable Financial Reporting: Evidence from ESEF

publicationDetails.detailsText: TRR 266 Accounting for Transparency Working Paper Series No. 248
publicationDetails.journalName: TRR 266 Accounting for Transparency Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: The European Single Electronic Format (ESEF) requires issuers to tag annual reports with the IFRS Taxonomy and to anchor each firm-authored statement concept extension to a standard IFRS concept since 2020. This anchoring requirement distinguishes the European regime from the U.S. XBRL setting. Using 6,496 ESEF filings from 27 EU and EEA countries over 2020 to 2024, we study corporate disclosure informativeness and proprietary cost implications under this regime. Disclosure-period return volatility rises more with earnings news in filings that carry more anchored statement extensions, consistent with these firm-specific extensions being informative. More profitable firms use fewer anchored statement extensions compared to their industry peers, consistent with high economic-rent firms reducing their proprietary disclosure costs. The results are stronger where national regulatory quality is higher, where the national filing infrastructure makes the report machine-accessible, and where the firm is more exposed to China. As the European Single Access Point (ESAP) is scheduled to make ESEF annual reports centrally accessible across the EU from July 2027, our evidence on the proprietary costs of disclosure speaks directly to the policy implications of machine-readable financial reports in the EU.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2020至2024年间27个欧盟及欧洲经济区国家的6,496份ESEF申报文件，研究了欧洲单一电子格式（ESEF）要求下企业将年度报告标记为IFRS分类法并进行概念锚定的强制性规定对信息披露信息含量和专有成本的影响。研究发现，带有更多锚定报表扩展（ASE）的文件其披露期收益波动率随盈利新闻上升更多（信息更丰富），而高盈利企业相对同行使用更少的锚定报表扩展（降低专有成本）。该效应在监管质量更高、国家申报基础设施使报告机器可读、以及企业对中国敞口更大的情况下更为显著。
AI.research_question: 在ESEF强制性锚定要求下，企业特定报表概念扩展（锚定申报扩展）如何影响信息披露的信息含量和专有成本？
AI.motivation: ESEF要求自2020年起用IFRS分类法标记年度报告，并将每个公司自创的报表概念扩展锚定到标准IFRS概念，这一锚定要求使欧洲制度区别于美国XBRL环境。随着欧洲单一访问点（ESAP）计划于2027年7月实现ESEF年度报告的中央可访问性，理解机器学习可读财务报告的专有成本具有重要政策意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息披露专有成本理论、信息含量理论（收益波动率与盈利新闻的关系）
AI.method: 利用2020至2024年间27个欧盟及欧洲经济区国家的6,496份ESEF申报文件进行实证分析，通过收益波动率对盈利新闻的响应衡量信息含量，并检验企业盈利能力与锚定报表扩展使用数量的关系，同时考察监管质量、机器可读基础设施和中国敞口等调节因素。
AI.findings: （1）带有更多锚定报表扩展的文件在披露期内收益波动率随盈利新闻上升更多，表明企业特定扩展具有信息含量；（2）高利润企业相比行业同行使用更少的锚定报表扩展，表明高经济租金企业降低专有披露成本；（3）上述效应在监管质量更高、国家申报基础设施使报告机器可访问、企业对中国敞口更大的情况下更为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 将XBRL/机器可读报告研究从美国环境拓展到具有锚定要求的欧洲制度环境，为信息披露专有成本理论提供了欧洲情境下的新证据，并揭示了制度因素（监管质量、基础设施）对披露策略的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为ESAP政策实施提供了关于机器可读财务报告专有成本的经验证据，有助于欧盟监管机构评估集中获取ESEF年报的政策影响，同时为企业理解锚定披露策略的竞争后果提供参考。

title: Institutional Coordination and the Making of Corporate Value: A Nested Valuation Framework for China's A-Share Market

detail.title: Institutional Coordination and the Making of Corporate Value: A Nested Valuation Framework for China's A-Share Market
detail.abstract: Financial economics possesses well-developed theories of how investors price corporate fundamentals, but comparatively little to say about how those fundamentals themselves come into being in economies where industrial development is coordinated through sustained state and institutional action. This paper develops the Nested Valuation Framework (NVF), an analytical architecture linking institutional coordination, productive capability, corporate fundamentals, investor expectations and market capitalisation. Two operational concepts, Institutional Visibility and the Fractal Investment Clock, explain respectively how institutionally generated productive capability becomes incorporated into investor expectations, and why this incorporation proceeds asynchronously across sectors. The framework is illustrated, rather than tested, through three episodes in China's A-share market: semiconductor industrial policy, the 'new quality productive forces' strategy, and renewable energy. The paper argues that the NVF extends, rather than displaces, established valuation theory, and it closes by specifying the operational definitions, propositions and falsification conditions required to convert the framework into a testable research programme.

AI.tldr: 本文提出嵌套估值框架（NVF），将制度协调、生产能力、公司基本面、投资者预期与市场资本化纳入统一分析架构，用以解释在由国家与制度协调主导的工业发展经济体中，公司基本面（即生产力）是如何产生的。框架通过两个操作性概念——制度可见性与分形投资时钟——分别解释制度驱动的生产能力如何进入投资者预期，以及为何这一过程在部门间异步推进。文章以中国A股市场三个案例（半导体产业政策、"新质生产力"战略、可再生能源）加以阐释而非检验，并给出将该框架转化为可检验研究方案所需的操作性定义、命题与证伪条件。
AI.research_question: 在有持续国家与制度行动协调产业发展的经济体中，公司基本面的形成机制是什么？制度协调产生的生产能力如何被纳入投资者预期并反映于市场资本化，且为何这一纳入过程在部门间是异步的？
AI.motivation: 金融经济学拥有成熟的投资者如何为公司基本面定价的理论，但对于在由国家与制度行动协调的产业经济体中，这些基本面本身如何产生，却少有理论论述。本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 嵌套估值框架（NVF）：连接制度协调、生产能力、公司基本面、投资者预期与市场资本化的分析架构；两个操作性概念——制度可见性（Institutional Visibility）与分形投资时钟（Fractal Investment Clock）。
AI.method: 理论建构与阐释性案例研究（illustrative case study），而非实证检验。通过中国A股市场三个案例（半导体产业政策、"新质生产力"战略、可再生能源）对框架进行阐释说明。
AI.findings: 三个案例表明：制度生成的产能以部门间异步的方式被纳入投资者预期——半导体产业政策、新质生产力战略和可再生能源展现出不同的"制度可见性"水平与投资时钟节奏。作者在结尾给出了框架转化为可检验研究方案所需的操作性定义、命题与证伪条件。
AI.theory_contributions: NVF是对既有估值理论的扩展而非替代，它弥补了金融经济学对制度协调经济体中基本面生成机制的阐释空白，将制度因素引入公司估值分析的理论链条。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解国家主导产业政策（如中国式产业战略）如何影响股市估值提供分析工具，有助于投资者和政策制定者理解产业政策向资本市场传导的机制与时间节奏。

title: Passive Investors are Indeed Passive Monitors
affiliations: University of Utah - David Eccles School of Business, University of Miami Herbert Business School, The University of Hong Kong and University of Utah - Department of Finance

detail.title: Passive Investors are Indeed Passive Monitors
detail.abstract: The rise of passive investing raises the question of whether passive funds monitor management as effectively as active funds.  Gormley and Kim (2026) argue that Heath et al. (2022)'s methodology for answering this question is biased and propose four changes. Three are econometrically invalid. Two share a flaw with Appel, Gormley, and Keim (2016, 2019): they condition on ex-post information about how firms respond to treatment—one selects the sample on post-treatment index assignments, the other controls for post-treatment market capitalization. The third imposes an unsupported symmetry restriction. The fourth, already proposed by Wei and Young (2025), does not change the conclusions. Even after adopting all four, their governance estimates largely agree with Heath et al. (2022) and contradict Appel et al. (2016). Furthermore, their headline claim that passive ownership has not displaced active ownership is contradicted by third-party data showing near one-for-one displacement; thus, either their specification is biased, or it cannot identify the governance effects of passive ownership.

AI.tldr: 本文反驳了Gormley和Kim（2026）对Heath等人（2022）方法论的四项批评，指出其中三项在计量上无效，并提出被动投资治理效应的证据仍支持Heath等人结论。
AI.research_question: Gormley和Kim（2026）对Heath等人（2022）研究被动基金管理监督效率的方法论批评是否成立？被动所有权是否有效替代了主动所有权？
AI.motivation: 被动投资的兴起引发被动基金与主动基金在监督管理层方面是否同样有效的争论，而Gormley和Kim（2026）声称Heath等人（2022）的方法论存在偏差，需要评估这些批评的合理性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于计量经济学因果推断理论，涉及样本选择偏差、事后条件问题（ex-post conditioning）以及对称性约束假设等计量识别问题。
AI.method: 逐一审查Gormley和Kim（2026）提出的四项方法论修改，评估其计量有效性，并利用第三方数据验证其关于主动所有权转移的声明。
AI.findings: 四项修改中三项在计量上无效；其中两项与Appel等人（2016）存在共同缺陷，即基于事后信息（事后指数归属和市值）条件化样本。即便全部采纳四项修改，治理估计仍与Heath等人（2022）一致，而与Appel等人（2016）相矛盾。Gormley和Kim声称被动所有权未取代主动所有权的主张与第三方数据显示的近一比一替代相矛盾。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了被动所有权对管理层监督效果的计量识别问题，指出基于事后结果条件化样本的方法论缺陷，为被动投资治理效应的实证研究提供了方法论上的甄别。
AI.practical_contributions: 为被动基金管理监督效率的争论提供了更清晰的证据基础，帮助投资者和监管者理解被动投资扩张对公司治理的实际影响。

title: Reform of Financing for the Merah Putih Village and Urban Village Cooperatives in West Papua to Achieve Transparency and Economic Justice in West Papua Province
affiliations: , Universitas Musamus Merauke, Papua, indonesia, STIM Publik Makassar and Wira Bhakti College of Economics

detail.title: Reform of Financing for the Merah Putih Village and Urban Village Cooperatives in West Papua to Achieve Transparency and Economic Justice in West Papua Province
detail.abstract: Merah Putih Village/Kelurahan Cooperatives (Koperasi Desa/Kelurahan Merah Putih KDKMP) are intended to strengthen community-based economic institutions in Indonesia. This study examines financing governance in KDKMP in West Papua, focusing on institutional capacity, information transparency, regulatory alignment, digital governance, and member participation. A descriptive qualitative case-study design is employed using interviews, observation, documentation, and policy review. The empirical material covers government actors, cooperative managers, Business Assistants (BA), Project Management Officers (PMO), community representatives, and cooperative stakeholders. The analysis follows data reduction, data display, and conclusion drawing. The findings indicate a gap between formal institutional expansion and substantive governance capacity. Across 831 cooperatives reported in the 2025 SIMKOPDES data, 202 had NIB, 667 had NPWP, and 213 had conducted RAT in 2025. Field evidence further indicates geographic and logistical constraints, incomplete administrative requirements, regulatory uncertainty, limited managerial capacity, uneven information disclosure, weak connectivity, and incomplete digital reporting. The study argues that digital governance should complement not substitute for institutional capacity. Based on the findings, a transparent financing framework is proposed combining policy alignment, proportional financing, transparent funding flows, digital reporting, capacity building, member participation, oversight, and local adaptation. The contribution is an empirically grounded policy framework for understanding how a national cooperative program is translated into local institutional practice in a geographically complex region.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于西巴布亚地区的描述性定性案例研究，考察印尼Merah Putih村级合作社（KDKMP）的融资治理实践，发现正式制度扩张与实质性治理能力之间存在显著差距，并提出一个结合政策对齐、比例融资、透明资金流动、数字报告、能力建设、成员参与、监督和本地适应的透明融资框架。
AI.research_question: 西巴布亚地区KDKMP合作社的融资治理如何运作？制度能力、信息透明度、监管对齐、数字治理和成员参与方面存在哪些问题与挑战？
AI.motivation: KDKMP旨在加强印尼社区经济机构，但在地理复杂区域（西巴布亚），正式制度扩张与实质治理能力之间可能存在差距，需要实证研究来理解国家合作项目如何转化为地方制度实践。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合作社治理理论、制度能力理论、数字治理理论
AI.method: 描述性定性案例研究设计，采用访谈、观察、文献和政策审查方法；样本涵盖政府行为者、合作社管理者、商业助理（BA）、项目管理官员（PMO）、社区代表和合作社利益相关者；分析遵循数据缩减、数据展示和结论归纳。
AI.findings: 831家合作社中，仅202家拥有NIB，667家拥有NPWP，213家进行了2025年RAT；存在地理和物流限制、行政要求不完整、监管不确定性、管理能力有限、信息披露不均衡、连接性薄弱、数字报告不完整等问题；数字治理应补充而非替代制度能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出基于实证的透明融资框架，揭示国家合作计划在地理复杂区域的本地制度转化机制，深化了对合作社融资治理中制度能力与数字治理关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了包含政策对齐、比例融资、透明资金流动、数字报告、能力建设、成员参与、监督和本地适应八要素的透明融资框架，可指导地理复杂区域合作社的治理优化。

reference: 115 California Law Review __ (forthcoming 2027)
title: Anti-Coercion Beyond the Spending Clause
affiliations: New York University School of Law

detail.title: Anti-Coercion Beyond the Spending Clause
detail.abstract:
NFIB v. Sebelius announced a constitutional anti-coercion principle: the federal government may neither directly commandeer state capacity, nor indirectly coerce states to give that capacity up. Yet, for all the headlines the opinion generated, the conventional understanding remains that anti-coercion applies only to exercises of the spending power. The federal government, however, offers a variety of inducements to states beyond conditional spending. And under the second Trump administration (though not exclusively in it), Washington has innovated novel methods of inducing state cooperation, including criminally investigating state and local officials who refuse to cooperate with its immigration enforcement agenda, refusing to deliver ballots in states that will not hand over voter data, and even surging armed agents into cities with disfavored policies.

This Article provides a systematic account of the broader federal inducement toolkit and reinterrogates both the scope and measure of anti-coercion. As to scope, it challenges the conventional understanding that NFIB’s anti-coercion rule is a Spending Clause constraint and argues instead that it is a federalism constraint. The principle is best understood as one manifestation of a more general anti-circumvention principle immanent in states’ structural entitlements under the Tenth and Eleventh Amendments. Relocating anti-coercion means that it applies beyond conditional spending legislation, covering executive conditions, non-spending inducements, and potentially inducements that indirectly target states.

As to measure, I argue that drawing the line between permissible pressure and impermissible coercion requires accounting for the institutional particulars of federal-state bargaining rather than, as current doctrine and scholarship do, analogizing states to private bargainers. States are not private individuals, but public representative institutions; the constitutional entitlements they trade are structural safeguards rather than individual rights; and they bargain within a constitutional matrix of both horizontal and vertical separation of powers. 

These two interventions do not solve every coercion puzzle, but they situate debate about federalism's rules of engagement on firmer conceptual terrain that is also more faithful to the institutional realities of our federalism. And they bring into view inducements that conventional coercion theories have difficulty evaluating.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了联邦政府诱使州政府合作的各种工具，挑战了NFIB v. Sebelius案中反胁迫原则仅适用于支出权力的传统理解，主张该原则应被视为基于第十和第十一修正案的联邦主义约束，而非仅限支出条款。同时提出衡量胁迫的标准应考虑联邦与州讨价还价的制度特殊性，而非将州类比为私人谈判者。
AI.research_question: 联邦政府的反胁迫原则（anti-coercion）应适用于何种范围？如何界定允许的压力与不允许的胁迫之间的界限？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为反胁迫原则仅适用于联邦支出权力的有条件拨款，但联邦政府实际使用多种超越支出条件的诱因手段（如刑事调查、拒绝选票递送、派遣武装人员等），尤其是第二届特朗普政府期间创新了多种胁迫州政府合作的方法，因此需要对反胁迫原则的范围与衡量标准进行重新审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以联邦主义（federalism）为核心理论框架，依托宪法第十修正案（保留给州的权利）和第十一修正案（州主权豁免）所蕴含的结构性权利，提出一个"反规避原则"（anti-circumvention principle），并借鉴横向与纵向分权理论来理解联邦与州之间的制度性讨价还价。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析（doctrinal normative analysis）：系统梳理联邦政府的各类诱导工具，重新解释NFIB案的宪法原理，并通过制度分析（institutional analysis）来重构反胁迫的衡量框架。
AI.findings: （1）反胁迫原则不应仅被理解为支出条款（Spending Clause）的约束，而应定位为联邦主义约束，适用于超越有条件支出的行政条件、非支出性诱导以及间接针对州的诱导手段。（2）衡量胁迫与允许性压力的界限时，应摒弃将州类比为私人谈判者的做法，而应认识到州是公共代表机构、其交易的宪法权利是结构性保障而非个人权利、且其在横向与纵向分权的宪法矩阵中讨价还价。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）挑战并修正了NFIB案反胁迫原则仅适用于支出权力的主流学术理解，将其重新定位为联邦主义原则；（2）提出了"反规避原则"作为更一般的理论框架，统一解释第十和第十一修正案中的结构性权利；（3）为衡量胁迫提供了新的制度性理论框架，纠正了现有学说将州类比为私人谈判者的理论局限。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为评估联邦政府使用非支出性诱导手段（如刑事调查、行政制裁、执法行动等）合宪性提供了分析框架；（2）对第二届特朗普政府时期的联邦与州关系实践具有直接的政策指导意义；（3）使传统胁迫理论难以评估的新型联邦诱导手段进入可审查的视野。

title: Why Cultural Care in Out-of-Home Care Depends on Systems - Not Goodwill: Strengthening Cultural Identity for Multicultural Children Through Practice, Supervision, and Leadership
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Western Sydney University - Translational Health Research Institute, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Australian Catholic University

detail.title: Why Cultural Care in Out-of-Home Care Depends on Systems - Not Goodwill: Strengthening Cultural Identity for Multicultural Children Through Practice, Supervision, and Leadership
detail.abstract: Children’s sense of belonging, identity, and wellbeing are shaped by their cultural experiences and connections, yet how out-of-home care systems support the cultural identities of multicultural children is limited. This study addresses this gap by examining how organisational structures, leadership behaviours, and knowledge-building processes strengthen cultural care and uphold children’s cultural rights, drawing on international comparison across five national systems.A qualitative, interpretive design combined two sequential stages. Stage 1 was a secondary analysis of knowledge artefacts from an international Churchill Fellowship; Stage 2 comprised six follow-up interviews with seven senior leaders from out-of-home care sector organisations across the same five jurisdictions. Reflexive thematic analysis examined how organisational conditions shape the translation of cultural knowledge into practice.Findings show that cultural care is widely valued but structurally fragile, sustained more often by individual commitment than by organisational capability. Four key patterns emerged: cultural care depends on individual practitioners as conduits; risk-aversion silences cultural inquiry; organisational machinery (leadership, supervision, accountability) determines whether cultural intent becomes embedded; and cultural data infrastructure is essential for accountability. Strengthening cultural care as a safeguarding responsibility requires clearer role expectations, shared accountability, and leadership-driven system approaches rather than reliance on individual goodwill.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过跨五个国家系统的国际比较，考察组织架构、领导行为和知识构建过程如何强化寄养照护中多元文化儿童的文化照护与文化权利。研究发现文化照护虽被广泛重视但在结构上脆弱，更多依赖个人承诺而非组织能力，四个关键模式揭示了文化照护从个人善意转向组织系统责任的需要。
AI.research_question: 寄养照护系统如何通过组织架构、领导行为和知识构建过程来支持多元文化儿童的文化身份及文化权利？
AI.motivation: 儿童的文化体验和联结塑造其归属感、身份认同和福祉，但关于寄养照护系统如何支持多元文化儿童的文化身份的研究非常有限，存在研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文化照护理论、组织知识构建理论（知识转化为实践的机制）
AI.method: 质性、诠释性研究设计，包含两个连续阶段：阶段一为对国际Churchill Fellowship知识产物的二次分析；阶段二为对五个国家寄养照护机构七位高级领导者的六次后续访谈。采用反思性主题分析。
AI.findings: 文化照护虽被广泛重视但在结构上脆弱，更多依靠个人投入而非组织能力支撑。四个关键模式：（1）文化照护依赖个别实践者作为传导渠道；（2）风险规避使文化探究沉默化；（3）组织机制（领导、督导、问责）决定文化意图能否嵌入实践；（4）文化数据基础设施对问责至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了文化照护从"个人善意"转向"组织系统责任"的理论转换路径，阐明了组织条件（领导行为、督导机制、问责体系）如何决定文化知识向实践转化的成败，拓展了文化照护作为保障责任的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为寄养照护系统提供实践建议：需要更明确的角色期望、共享问责机制以及领导驱动的系统方法，而非依赖个人善意来保障多元文化儿童的文化权利。强调文化数据基础设施建设对问责的重要性。

title: The Same Distribution, a Different Direction: Temporal Irreversibility in Global Equity Returns

detail.title: The Same Distribution, a Different Direction: Temporal Irreversibility in Global Equity Returns

keywords: Global Equity Markets Show more lines

detail.abstract: Reversing a return series leaves its empirical distribution unchanged. Its mean, variance, skewness, kurtosis, quantiles, and Wasserstein distance from the original sample are therefore identical. Yet the risk process need not be unchanged, because negative returns may precede volatility expansions more often than volatility expansions precede negative returns. We use this exact distribution-preserving transformation to study daily S&P 500, FTSE 100, Nikkei 225, and Hang Seng returns from January 2000 through June 2026. Temporal direction is measured by the difference between two mixed third moments, averaged over lags one through five. The forward-time statistic is positive in all four markets-0.339, 0.317, 0.320, and 0.364-and remains significant after Holm correction across the four primary tests. Reversing each series changes the statistic's sign while leaving marginal Wasserstein distance exactly zero. Randomizing return signs while preserving the magnitude sequence centers the statistic at zero in 2,000 replications (p = 0.0005 in every market). The direction remains positive across bandwidth, bootstrap, past-only standardization, lag, episode-deletion, subsample, and winsorization checks. Of 36 prespecified robustness tests, 31 pass a 5% Benjamini-Hochberg false-discovery-rate threshold and 13 survive the stricter Holm family-wise correction. Distributional risk measurement is therefore incomplete without an ordering-sensitive layer: the same return distribution can encode a different direction of risk propagation.

AI.tldr: 本文利用收益率序列反转后边际分布不变的性质，通过混合三阶矩的差值测量时间方向性，发现四大股票市场（S&P 500、FTSE 100、Nikkei 225、Hang Seng）均存在显著的正向风险传播方向——负收益更可能先于波动率扩张出现。该方向性在多种稳健性检验中保持稳健，表明分布性风险度量需补充顺序敏感层。
AI.research_question: 在同一收益率边际分布下，风险过程的时间方向性是否可测且显著？即负收益与波动率扩张之间存在何种因果顺序关系？
AI.motivation: 传统风险度量仅依赖边际分布（均值、方差、偏度、峰度等），但这些统计量在时间反转下不变。然而风险过程可能具有时间方向性——负收益可能更频繁地先于波动率扩张发生，而非相反。因此需要一种保持分布不变但能捕捉顺序信息的度量方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于分布保持变换（时间反转）与混合三阶矩的时间方向性度量框架，结合稳健性检验（Holm校正、Benjamini-Hochberg FDR）的统计推断框架。
AI.method: 使用分布保持的时间反转变换；测量混合三阶矩差值（滞后1至5期的均值）；采用Wasserstein距离验证边际分布不变性；通过随机化收益率符号进行置换检验（2000次重复）；实施36项预设稳健性检验（带宽、bootstrap、标准化、滞后、删段、子样本、winsorization等）。
AI.findings: 四大市场的正向时间统计量均显著为正（0.339、0.317、0.320、0.364），Holm校正后仍显著；反转序列使统计量变号且Wasserstein距离恰好为零；随机化检验中统计量中心为零（p=0.0005）；36项稳健性检验中31项通过5% FDR阈值，13项通过更严格的Holm校正。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了边际分布相同时风险过程仍可具有不同时间方向性的理论洞见；提出混合三阶矩差值作为分布保持的时间方向性度量工具；表明分布性风险测量理论需补充顺序敏感层。
AI.practical_contributions: 为风险管理实践提供了超越传统分布统计量的方向性风险度量指标；对投资者和政策制定者理解市场风险传播机制（负收益→波动率扩张）具有实践意义；提供了可操作的稳健性检验框架。

title: Buy Box and Price Parity: Competitive Effects and Consumer Welfare in Online Marketplaces
affiliations: , Dartmouth College - Tuck School of Business and New York University (NYU) - Department of Information, Operations, and Management Sciences

detail.title: Buy Box and Price Parity: Competitive Effects and Consumer Welfare in Online Marketplaces
detail.abstract: Amazon's Buy Box (now the Featured Offer) grants selected sellers prominent placement that substantially increases visibility and sales. Buy Box eligibility partly depends on whether a seller's Amazon price is no higher than the product's rival-platform price, effectively imposing an implicit price parity rule. This practice has drawn regulatory scrutiny: the FTC argues that it stifles competition and harms consumers by compelling sellers to raise prices on rival platforms to maintain eligibility. We develop a game-theoretic model of a dominant platform enforcing the eligibility-linked price parity rule. Unlike contractual Most-Favored-Nation clauses, implicit parity lets sellers opt out when compliance is costly, generating an endogenous response absent from standard parity models. Analyzing both single-seller and two-seller market structures yields the following findings. First, where parity binds, its price effects depend on market structure: under a single seller, it lowers the dominant platform's price but raises the rival's, whereas under competing sellers, it lowers both prices. Second, under multi-homing, welfare effects hinge on seller compliance rather than on the direction of prices: parity raises consumer welfare when Buy Box eligibility is retained, but lowers it when compliance costs induce opt-out, even as both prices fall; welfare also falls when the seller single-homes on the dominant platform. Third, parity never raises the dominant platform's commission revenue under competing sellers. Our findings challenge the view that parity rules uniformly harm consumers. Eligibility-linked price parity can improve welfare when the seller complies while multi-homing, but backfires when the seller opts out or single-homes. Blanket prohibitions therefore risk suppressing the rule where it is pro-competitive.

AI.tldr: 本文构建博弈论模型分析亚马逊Buy Box（现为Featured Offer）隐含的价格平价规则。该规则要求卖家在亚马逊上的价格不高于竞争对手平台的价格，否则失去Buy Box资格。研究发现价格效应取决于市场结构：单一卖家时降低主导平台价格但提高竞争对手价格；竞争卖家时同时降低两者价格。福利效应取决于卖家是否合规而非价格方向：多归属且合规时提高消费者福利，退出或单归属时降低福利。平价规则在竞争卖家下从不会提高主导平台佣金收入。结论挑战了平价规则必然损害消费者的观点。
AI.research_question: 主导平台实施的与资格挂钩的隐含价格平价规则（eligibility-linked price parity rule）对平台价格、消费者福利和平台收入有何影响？其影响机制与传统合同式最惠国条款有何不同？
AI.motivation: 亚马逊Buy Box的价格平价规则已引发监管审查（FTC认为其抑制竞争并损害消费者），但与传统合同式MFN条款不同，隐含平价规则允许卖家在合规成本高时选择退出，产生内生性反应。现有标准平价模型未考虑这一机制，需要新的理论分析来评估其竞争效应和福利效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型（game-theoretic model），涵盖单一卖家和双卖家市场结构，分析隐含价格平价规则下的均衡定价与卖家合规决策。
AI.method: 构建主导平台执行资格挂钩价格平价规则的博弈论模型，对比单一卖家和两个卖家的市场结构，分析卖家合规/退出的内生选择及其价格与福利后果。
AI.findings: （1）平价约束生效时，单一卖家结构下降低主导平台价格、提高竞争对手价格；竞争卖家结构下同时降低两者价格。（2）多归属时福利效应取决于卖家合规与否：保持Buy Box资格时提高消费者福利，合规成本导致退出时降低福利（即使两个价格都下降）；卖家单归属主导平台时福利也下降。（3）竞争卖家结构下，平价规则从不提高主导平台佣金收入。结论挑战了平价规则统一损害消费者的观点：卖家合规且多归属时隐含平价可改善福利，但退出或单归属时适得其反，全面禁止可能抑制具有促进竞争作用的规则。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将隐含价格平价（资格挂钩）与传统合同式MFN条款区分建模，揭示卖家可退出（opt-out）的内生反应机制；证明市场结构（单一vs竞争卖家）对平价规则价格效应和福利效应的决定性影响；推翻平价规则必然损害消费者的传统观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为FTC等监管机构对亚马逊Buy Box平价规则的审查提供理论依据，指出全面禁止（blanket prohibition）可能适得其反——应区分卖家合规/退出与单归属/多归属情形，精准监管。

title: A Data Eligibility Protocol Screens Curb Records for Queue Priority Decisions
affiliations: Hanyang University

detail.title: A Data Eligibility Protocol Screens Curb Records for Queue Priority Decisions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The study uses openly available transportation records and does not involve human participants or identifiable personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no financial support for the research, authorship, or publication of this paper.

detail.abstract: Transportation agencies collect curb occupancy and event records, but these records may not identify the queue required by a priority rule. This paper develops an auditable data-eligibility prescreen for nonpreemptive next-berth priority among transit, freight, and ride-hailing vehicles. The method tests whether data identify one opening and an eligible request queue. Conditional on that gate, a single-server priority index, a first-come, first-served (FCFS) activation test, and interval uncertainty classify policy activation. Domain incompatibility, measurement incompleteness, and decision indeterminacy are distinguished. Two datasets demonstrate the protocol. At two Barcelona loading areas, multiple vehicles appear in 96.0% and 69.3% of occupancy observations, so whole-facility occupancy cannot validate one opening. In Seattle, a minimum of two events per class retains seven marked-space-days and 212 focal service completions. Minimums of one, three, and five retain 20, two, and zero space-days. Complete-event dwell occupies 13.3% of monitored time. Completion-based dwell ratios imply cost-ratio thresholds of 0.288 for transit/freight, 0.894 for transit/ride-hailing, and 3.108 for freight/ride-hailing. Exact site-day deletion makes one threshold cross the equal-cost boundary, while a class-coding change reverses part of the equal-cost order. Neither archive observes attempted arrivals, waits, social cost weights, implementation costs, or policy effects. Consequently, these data cannot support deployment. The protocol assigns unsupported geometry, incomplete measurement, and uncertain appraisal to a changed model, additional request data, or pilot evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种可审计的数据资格预筛选协议，用于评估交通设施数据是否足以支持非抢占式"下一泊位优先"规则的政策部署。该协议通过检验数据是否能识别单一开放泊位和合格的请求队列，区分领域不兼容、测量不完整和决策不确定性三种问题。在巴塞罗那和西雅图的实证中，数据均无法支持该优先规则的部署。
AI.research_question: 交通机构收集的泊位占用和事件记录能否充分支持非抢占式下一泊位优先规则（适用于公交、货运和网约车）的政策部署？
AI.motivation: 交通机构收集的泊位占用和事件记录可能无法识别优先规则所需的队列信息，导致基于不充分数据的政策部署决策存在风险。需要一个可审计的预筛选方法来检验数据资格。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非抢占式优先排队理论；单服务器优先指数；先到先服务（FCFS）激活检验；区间不确定性分析
AI.method: 提出一个多阶段数据资格预筛选协议：(1) 检验数据能否识别单一开放泊位和合格请求队列；(2) 在通过该门控后，使用单服务器优先指数、FCFS激活检验和区间不确定性对政策激活进行分类；(3) 区分领域不兼容、测量不完整和决策不确定性三种数据缺陷类型。并在巴塞罗那和西雅图的真实数据集上进行验证。
AI.findings: (1) 在巴塞罗那两个装载区，96.0%和69.3%的占用观测中出现多辆车，因此整个设施的占用数据无法验证单一开放泊位。(2) 在西雅图，每类至少两个事件保留了7个标记空间日和212个焦点服务完成；最少一、三、五个事件分别保留20、2和0个空间日。(3) 完成事件占监测时间的13.3%。(4) 基于完成时间的停留比隐含成本比阈值：公交/货运为0.288，公交/网约车为0.894，货运/网约车为3.108。(5) 精确站点日删除使一个阈值跨越等成本边界，类编码变更使等成本排序部分反转。(6) 两个数据集都未观测到到达尝试、等待、社会成本权重、实施成本或政策效果，因此无法支持部署。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数据资格检验提供了系统化的可审计预筛选协议框架，将排队优先规则的理论要求转化为可操作的数据充分性检验条件，并明确区分了三种数据缺陷类型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为交通机构提供了在部署优先规则前的数据审计工具，帮助识别数据不足的领域并给出改进方向（更改模型、补充请求数据、试点评估），避免基于不充分数据的政策部署风险。

title: The Unarmed Mind and the Armed Mind: A Philosophical Concept of Power, Naivety, and Psychological Armament

detail.title: The Unarmed Mind and the Armed Mind: A Philosophical Concept of Power, Naivety, and Psychological Armament
detail.abstract: This paper proposes two related philosophical concepts: The Unarmed Mind and The Armed Mind. Both begin from a realist premise: power is a persistent feature of human relations, whether or not an individual chooses to acknowledge it. The Unarmed Mind is a condition in which an individual fails to adequately recognize power as a persistent force within human relations and, consequently, lacks sufficient understanding of the mechanisms through which power is acquired, exercised, preserved, and used against them. By contrast, the Armed Mind is a condition in which an individual recognizes power as a persistent force within human relations, understands the mechanisms through which it is acquired, exercised, preserved, and lost, and deliberately develops the capacity to navigate those mechanisms. The distinction rests not on intelligence or morality, but on awareness and capability. Drawing from the political realism of Niccolò Machiavelli, Friedrich Nietzsche’s treatment of power and human motivation, later thought on power and strategy, and findings from psychological research, this paper examines how naivety toward leverage, dependency, incentives, status, perception, persuasion, and competing interests can leave individuals vulnerable within ordinary human relationships. It further argues that ignorance of power does not place an individual outside power relations; it merely limits their ability to participate in them deliberately. The Armed Mind is therefore presented not as a doctrine of universal distrust or ruthlessness, but as a form of psychological armament: the ability to recognize power, protect against its exercise by others, cultivate it where advantageous, and employ it deliberately in pursuit of chosen ends. The paper ultimately advances a Machiavellian proposition at the center of the framework: to remain ignorant of power is not to remain outside of it, but to participate in it at a disadvantage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"无武装心智"与"武装心智"两个哲学概念，主张权力是人类关系中的持续现实，忽视权力并不会使人置身于权力关系之外，只会令其在参与权力关系时处于不利地位。论文基于马基雅维利、尼采等人的政治现实主义及心理学研究，论证对权力机制的无知会使个体在普通人际关系中变得脆弱，而"武装心智"则是一种能够识别、抵御、培育并审慎运用权力的心理武装。
AI.research_question: 个体对权力的无知是否使其置身于权力关系之外？"无武装心智"与"武装心智"如何区分，以及忽视权力机制会给个体在人际关系中带来怎样的不利影响？
AI.motivation: 许多人在日常生活中对权力持有天真的态度，认为自己可以回避或超脱于权力关系之外。然而，权力是人类关系中持续存在的现实，忽视它并不会使人脱离权力关系，反而使人在其中处于劣势。论文旨在揭示这种"权力天真"的脆弱性，并提出一种更具自觉性的心理状态框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 马基雅维利的政治现实主义、尼采关于权力与人类动机的论述、后续关于权力与战略的思想，以及心理学研究中的相关发现。核心区分轴为"意识与能力"（awareness and capability），而非智力或道德。
AI.method: 概念哲学分析：提出并界定"无武装心智"与"武装心智"两个概念，通过整合政治现实主义传统、哲学思想与心理学研究证据进行理论推演与论证。
AI.findings: 对权力（杠杆、依赖、激励、地位、感知、说服、利益竞争等机制）的天真无知会使个体在普通人际关系中变得脆弱；对权力的无知并不能将个体置于权力关系之外，只会限制其有意参与权力关系的能力。"武装心智"被提出为一种心理装甲形式，而非普遍不信任或冷酷的教条。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"无武装心智"与"武装心智"这一对原创性哲学概念，将权力认知纳入个体心理状态的框架，推进了以"意识与能力"而非"智力与道德"作为权力素养划分标准的理论路径，并形成一个以马基雅维利命题为核心的理论命题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为个体提供了识别权力、抵御他人权力运用、在有利处培育权力以及审慎追求目标的方法论启示，帮助人们在日常人际关系中摆脱被动劣势，实现有意识的权力参与。

title: Beyond Autonomy: The Role of Millennial Leadership, Job Crafting, and Mentorship in Transforming Corporate Culture to Retain Gen Z Talent

detail.title: Beyond Autonomy: The Role of Millennial Leadership, Job Crafting, and Mentorship in Transforming Corporate Culture to Retain Gen Z Talent
detail.abstract:
At present, the global corporate workforce is grappling with immense challenges brought on by rapid advancements in technology and shifting workplace norms, and the presence and emergence of Generation Z (Gen Z)—those born between 1997 and 2012—as a significant workforce demographic is undeniable (Pew Research Center, 2019). While previous generations have faced their share of corporate workplace challenges and transformations, there is a lack of empathy towards the younger generation workforce, who face scepticism regarding their work ethic, commitment levels, and inability to adapt to long-established ways of working (Deloitte, 2024). This perception can diminish an organisation’s ability to retain emerging talent, and MNCs need to adapt their organisational cultures more holistically. Unlike older generations, Gen Z workers—who have grown up and been socialised in a digital landscape—bring unique expectations and values to the workplace. Their natural predilection for autonomy, authenticity, career growth, and social responsibility calls for a revaluation of traditional management practices (Deloitte, 2024) (Kwartawaty, Ismail, & Martadi, 2024). 

This paper posits that the successful retention of Gen Z employees isn’t brought about solely by meeting their demands for a more hands-on approach, but by fostering an environment that elicits job crafting and mentorship as integral aspects of an organisation’s culture.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨跨国企业如何有效留住Z世代员工，认为仅满足其需求不够，关键在于营造促进工作重塑（Job Crafting）和导师制（Mentorship）的组织文化。
AI.research_question: 跨国企业如何通过组织文化中的工作重塑和导师制来有效留住Z世代员工？
AI.motivation: Z世代已成为劳动力市场的重要群体，但其工作伦理、承诺度和适应能力常遭质疑，这种认知偏差削弱了企业留住新兴人才的能力。跨国企业需要更全面地调整组织文化以适应这一代人独特的价值观和期望。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代际理论（世代差异视角）、工作重塑理论（Job Crafting）、组织文化理论
AI.method: 基于文献综述的理论性论文，结合Deloitte（2024）等实证报告和学术研究进行论证。
AI.findings: 成功留住Z世代员工并非仅靠满足其对自主性、真实性、职业成长和社会责任的需求，而应通过营造激发工作重塑和导师制的组织文化来实现。
AI.theory_contributions: 将工作重塑和导师制概念引入Z世代人才保留研究，提出组织文化层面的整合性理论视角，弥补了以往仅从需求满足角度探讨的局限。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨国企业管理者提供具体的人才管理启示，即通过构建支持工作重塑和导师制的组织文化来提升Z世代员工的留任率。

title: Division of Labor and the Survival Value of PnL per Token

detail.title: Division of Labor and the Survival Value of PnL per Token
detail.abstract: A model can be more capable than every competitor and nevertheless disappear from most economic production. We formalize this claim in a competitive economy of prediction tasks in which standardized units of compute ("tokens") are itinerant: at zero switching cost they may move between tasks and may instantiate whichever available algorithm they choose. Mobility generates a no-arbitrage condition under which marginal profit-and-loss per token is equalized across all active uses of compute, and any technology offering a strictly smaller return on the same subcontractible task receives zero execution share. As the division of labor becomes progressively finer, execution is therefore selected by task-conditional marginal economic productivity per standardized unit of compute-not by generic capability. We exhibit an explicit equilibrium in which a generalist that is strictly more capable than every specialist on every task nonetheless has compute market share tending to zero, and we give sufficient conditions, in both directions, relating asymptotic execution share to membership of the active productivity frontier. Measurement follows from the same accounting: a market-scoring-rule prediction mechanism pays each entry its marginal contribution at the state it faced, and for a sole frontier supplier on one task at its competitive scale, average PnL per token equals the shadow price of compute divided by the elasticity of task value with respect to effective compute, so at a common shadow price it ranks task-level productivity exactly when that elasticity declines with crowding, as it does under log production; administered deployment or mixed scarcity regimes can invert the unconditioned quotient, and an arbitrary model-level lifetime quotient has no such representation without additional structure. The model supplies no canonical taskinvariant scalar quality: any aggregate PnL-per-token ranking embeds a task distribution and deployment weighting, measuring the economic niches a model occupies.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个预测任务的竞争性经济模型，证明一个在所有任务上都比所有竞争者更强大的通用模型，其计算市场份额仍可能趋近于零。执行份额由任务条件边际经济生产率决定，而非通用能力决定。
AI.research_question: 为什么一个在所有任务上都更强大的通用模型，可能在经济生产中消失（计算市场份额趋近于零）？
AI.motivation: 挑战"模型能力越强则经济影响力越大"的直觉假设，揭示在分工细化的竞争经济中，能力与市场份额之间的复杂关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争性预测任务经济模型、无套利条件、边际生产率理论、市场评分规则、影子价格理论
AI.method: 理论建模与形式化证明。构建标准化计算单元（token）可自由流动的竞争性经济，推导无套利均衡条件，并给出显式均衡构造。
AI.findings: （1）在无套利条件下，任何在可分包任务上提供严格更低回报的技术将获得零执行份额；（2）存在显式均衡，其中严格更强大的通用模型市场份额趋近于零；（3）执行份额由任务条件边际生产率决定；（4）市场评分规则下，每token的平均PnL可衡量任务级生产率，但对模型级排名不具有任务不变性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"能力≠市场份额"的形式化理论，建立计算经济中执行份额决定于边际经济生产率而非通用能力的分析框架，并阐明了模型质量度量的任务依赖性与分布嵌入性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI模型的经济价值评估提供理论依据：任何模型级PnL-per-token排名都内嵌了任务分布和部署权重，应基于模型占据的经济生态位来评估，而非依赖单一标量质量指标。

title: Governing Beyond the State: Customary Authority and the Co-Production of Political Order in Africa
affiliations: African Research Network (ARN)

detail.title: Governing Beyond the State: Customary Authority and the Co-Production of Political Order in Africa
detail.abstract: African political systems are frequently evaluated through the institutional architecture of the modern state, with bureaucratic capacity, statutory law, administrative reach, and centralized authority serving as primary indicators of governance effectiveness. Such an approach, however, risks overlooking the institutional plurality through which political order is actually produced. Across much of Africa, customary authorities continue to exercise substantial normative influence over land, dispute resolution, community organization, social cohesion, and local development. Their persistence raises a fundamental question for political sociology: should customary authority be interpreted primarily as a substitute for weak state institutions, or can it constitute a complementary component of contemporary state capacity? This article develops a comparative argument through two contrasting institutional configurations in Africa: customary governance in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo and constitutionalized chieftaincy in Ghana. Drawing upon the Dual-Legitimacy Institutional Interplay Model (DLII), the article conceptualizes eastern DRC as a case of Customary-Led Statecraft, in which limited formal state reach coexists with substantial customary normative authority, and Ghana as a case of Symbiotic Hybridity, in which comparatively strong formal institutions coexist with constitutionally recognized and socially embedded customary institutions. The comparison demonstrates that customary authority cannot be understood simply as an institutional residue or as evidence of state absence. Its political significance depends upon the institutional relationship established between customary legitimacy and formal state authority. The article argues that the central problem in African governance is therefore not the coexistence of formal and customary institutions but the absence, presence, and quality of mechanisms that connect them. These mechanisms include institutional recognition, epistemic translation, jurisdictional coordination, institutional arbitrage, constitutional accountability, and mutual adaptation. The article further argues that customary institutions can contribute to political order without necessarily becoming state institutions, while the state can strengthen its capacity without eliminating customary authority. The resulting conception of governance is one of institutional co-production, in which different sources of authority contribute distinct capacities to a common political order. The article concludes by proposing a new paradigm of African state-building based not on institutional substitution but on accountable institutional integration.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比刚果民主共和国东部和加纳两种截然不同的制度配置，提出非洲政治秩序中习惯权威不应被视为国家制度孱弱的替代品，而可构成国家能力的互补要素。文章提出"双重合法性制度互动模型"（DLII），将东刚果概念化为"习惯主导的国家治理"，将加纳概念化为"共生混合"，并主张非洲治理的核心问题在于连接正式制度与非正式制度的机制的质量与有无，而非二者的并存本身。
AI.research_question: 习惯权威究竟应当被解读为弱国家制度的替代品，还是可以构成当代国家能力的互补组成部分？在非洲不同制度情境下，正式国家权威与习惯权威之间的关系如何塑造政治秩序的生产？
AI.motivation: 现有非洲政治研究过度依赖现代国家的制度架构（官僚能力、成文法、行政覆盖、中央集权）来评估治理成效，忽视了非洲大陆广泛存在的习惯权威在土地、纠纷解决、社区组织、社会凝聚力和地方发展中持续发挥的规范影响力，导致对政治秩序真实生产机制的理解存在盲区。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双重合法性制度互动模型（DLII），将制度间关系视为关键分析维度，涵盖制度承认、认知转译、管辖权协调、制度套利、宪政问责和相互适应等连接机制。
AI.method: 比较分析方法，选取非洲两种相对照的制度配置案例：刚果民主共和国东部的习惯治理（习惯主导的国家治理）与加纳的宪法化酋长制度（共生混合），进行跨案例对比研究。
AI.findings: 习惯权威不能简单地被理解为制度残余或国家缺位的证据；其政治意义取决于习惯合法性与正式国家权威之间建立的制度关系。正式制度与习惯制度的并存本身不是非洲治理的核心问题，关键在于连接机制的缺失、存在与否及其质量。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"制度共同生产"的治理概念，论证习惯制度无需成为国家制度即可为政治秩序做出贡献，国家也能在不消除习惯权威的前提下增强自身能力；提出以"可问责的制度整合"取代"制度替代"的新范式，丰富了政治社会学关于国家能力与制度多元性的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲国家建设提供了一种新范式，强调通过制度整合机制（而非制度消除或替代）来协调正式权威与习惯权威，为政策制定者处理习惯治理与国家治理关系提供了分析框架和实践指引。

title: What Business Owes Democracy: Three Moral Grounds for Corporate Democratic Responsibility
affiliations: and Dresden University of Technology

detail.title: What Business Owes Democracy: Three Moral Grounds for Corporate Democratic Responsibility
detail.abstract: Democratic backsliding is on the rise, yet the role of corporations in defending democracy remains underexplored. In this paper, we develop a normative account of corporate democratic responsibility (CDR) as a distinct form of responsibility grounded in freedom understood as protection against arbitrary domination and in an understanding of democracy as institutionalized opposition to tyranny. We identify three moral grounds for CDR: leverage, arising from corporations' capacity to influence democratic discourse and institutions; complicity, resulting from silence or selective engagement amid democratic backsliding; and rectification, a backward-looking responsibility rooted in past harms or omissions. Together, these grounds form a context-sensitive framework that clarifies when and why firms in liberal democracies have moral reasons and, under non-ideal conditions of democratic erosion, pro tanto duties to actively support democracy. By shifting the focus from harm avoidance to context-dependent forms of engagement, our contribution reframes debates on corporate responsibility and advances normative scholarship.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种规范性的"企业民主责任"（CDR）理论，基于免受任意支配的自由观以及将民主视为制度化的反暴政机制的理解，识别出杠杆、共谋和矫正三个道德基础，为企业何时以及为何应积极支持民主提供了情境敏感的框架。
AI.research_question: 在民主倒退日益加剧的背景下，企业在捍卫民主方面承担何种道德责任？具体而言，企业民主责任的规范性基础是什么？何时以及在何种条件下企业有理由或义务积极支持民主？
AI.motivation: 民主倒退现象日益严重，但企业在捍卫民主中的角色仍未被充分探索。现有关于企业责任的讨论多聚焦于避免伤害，缺乏对企业如何积极支持民主的系统性规范分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以"免受任意支配的自由"（非支配自由）为规范性根基，结合"民主作为制度化的反暴政"的理论理解，构建企业民主责任（CDR）的概念框架。
AI.method: 规范性理论研究/规范性论证方法：通过概念分析和道德哲学论证，识别并论证企业民主责任的三个道德基础（杠杆、共谋、矫正），并构建情境敏感的责任框架。
AI.findings: 企业民主责任包含三个道德基础：杠杆责任（源于企业影响民主话语和制度的能力）、共谋责任（源于民主倒退期间的沉默或选择性参与）、矫正责任（基于过去伤害或不作为的追朔性责任）。这些基础共同构成情境敏感框架，表明自由民主国家的企业在非理想的民主侵蚀条件下具有支持民主的"初步义务"（pro tanto duties）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将企业责任争论的焦点从"避免伤害"转向"情境依赖的参与形式"，为企业民主责任提供了独立的规范性论证，推动了企业责任领域的规范学术研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业在民主倒退情境下的行动决策提供道德指引，明确了企业何时有道德理由（甚至义务）积极支持民主制度与话语，有助于企业在非理想条件下做出负责任的选择。

title: AI-Driven Visual Testing for Reliable Enterprise Software: A Three-Layer Framework Integrating Perceptual Detection, Semantic Validation, and Adaptive Self-Healin
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of the Witwatersrand

detail.title: AI-Driven Visual Testing for Reliable Enterprise Software: A Three-Layer Framework Integrating Perceptual Detection, Semantic Validation, and Adaptive Self-Healin

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare the sole authorship of research paper
declarations.ethicsApproval: I declare the sole authorship of research paper
declarations.funderStatement: I declare the sole authorship of research paper

detail.abstract: Enterprise software teams increasingly rely on continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines that ship user-interface (UI) changes at a pace traditional visual quality assurance cannot match. Functional test suites routinely pass while users still encounter layout shifts, clipped elements, and rendering defects, failures that are structurally invisible to logic-only testing. This paper develops an integrative conceptual framework for AI-driven visual testing, synthesizing computer-vision-based visual regression research with the parallel literature on selfhealing test automation. Building on Rajaseakaran Nair's (2026) computer-vision and AI-driven framework for enterprise UI validation at scale, together with peer-reviewed research on deeplearning GUI testing, Vision Transformer-based visual comparison, and industry evidence on enterprise visual-testing platforms, the paper proposes a three-layer framework, Perceptual Detection, Semantic Validation, and Adaptive Self-Healing, describing how modern AI-driven visual testing systems move beyond brittle, pixel-diff-based validation toward context-aware, lowmaintenance UI quality assurance. The framework is illustrated through disclosed, non-empirical proof-of-concept scenarios spanning web and mobile enterprise applications. The analysis does not report primary experimental or production data. The paper discusses theoretical, engineering, and organizational implications for enterprise QA practice and proposes an agenda for empirical validation, including attention to unresolved research gaps such as the limited integration of semantic visual verification with DOM-based self-healing.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个AI驱动视觉测试的整合概念框架，提出三层架构：感知检测、语义验证和自适应自修复，旨在超越传统像素差异对比的脆弱性，实现上下文感知、低维护的企业UI质量保证。论文通过非实证的概念验证场景进行说明，并提出了未来实证验证的研究议程。
AI.research_question: 企业软件团队如何在持续集成/持续交付（CI/CD）快速迭代的背景下，构建AI驱动的视觉测试框架以解决传统功能测试无法捕获的UI渲染缺陷（如布局偏移、元素裁剪等）？
AI.motivation: 传统功能测试套件虽能通过，但用户仍会遇到布局偏移、元素裁剪和渲染缺陷等问题，这些缺陷在逻辑测试中结构性不可见。CI/CD的快速交付节奏使传统视觉质量保证无法跟上，亟需新的概念框架来指导AI驱动的视觉测试实践。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了计算机视觉视觉回归测试研究与自修复测试自动化文献，基于Rajaseakaran Nair（2026）的企业UI验证框架，以及深度学习GUI测试、Vision Transformer视觉比较和行业视觉测试平台的相关研究。
AI.method: 概念性研究方法：通过综合已有文献与行业证据，提出三层概念框架（感知检测、语义验证、自适应自修复），并通过非实证的、已公开的概念验证场景（涵盖Web和移动企业应用）加以说明。未报告一手实验或生产数据。
AI.findings: 提出了三层框架：1）感知检测层——利用计算机视觉技术识别视觉异常；2）语义验证层——实现上下文感知的视觉语义验证；3）自适应自修复层——结合自修复机制实现低维护的QA。框架展示了从脆弱的像素差异验证向上下文感知、低维护UI质量保证的转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合了视觉回归测试与自修复测试自动化两个并列的研究脉络，构建了系统性的概念框架；识别了当前研究缺口，即语义视觉验证与基于DOM的自修复之间的有限整合；为后续实证研究提供了理论议程。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业QA实践提供了理论、工程和组织层面启示；通过概念验证场景展示了框架在Web和移动企业应用中的适用性；为CI/CD环境下企业视觉质量保证实践提供了可操作的架构蓝图。

title: AI Ecosystem Interfaces as Orchestration Mechanisms for Public Value Creation

detail.title: AI Ecosystem Interfaces as Orchestration Mechanisms for Public Value Creation

declarations.ethicsApproval: The authors declare that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract:
Despite growing interest in AI-enabled governance and ecosystem coordination, existing public value frameworks provide limited explanation of how intelligent technologies orchestrate multi-stakeholder value co-creation across complex institutional environments. This study proposes the AI Ecosystem Interface as an intelligent socio-technical orchestration mechanism that facilitates communication, resource integration, and adaptive coordination among market actors, stakeholders, and policymakers within a shared valuecreation network.

 Drawing upon Marshallian value theory, Stakeholder Theory, Platform Ecosystem Theory, and Service-Dominant Logic, the study develops a conceptual framework that explains how AI-enabled coordination supports the creation, realisation, and perception of public value. The framework positions the AI Ecosystem Interface as an embedded orchestration layer that aligns stakeholder interests, facilitates ecosystem coordination, and supports adaptive governance processes. 

The study contributes to public value and ecosystem governance literature by conceptualising AI ecosystem interfaces as intelligent orchestration mechanisms for multistakeholder value co-creation. It further extends existing theories of value creation by integrating economic, stakeholder, ecosystem, and service perspectives within a unified model of AI-enabled public value creation.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出"AI生态系统接口"（AI Ecosystem Interface）作为一种智能社会技术编排机制，用于解释智能技术如何在复杂制度环境中协调多方利益相关者共同创造公共价值，并基于多种理论构建了统一的概念框架。
AI.research_question: 智能技术如何在复杂制度环境中编排多方利益相关者的价值共创，以实现公共价值的创造、实现与感知？
AI.motivation: 尽管AI驱动的治理和生态系统协调日益受到关注，但现有公共价值框架难以充分解释智能技术如何在复杂制度环境中协调多方利益相关者的价值共创过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 马歇尔价值理论、利益相关者理论、平台生态系统理论、服务主导逻辑
AI.method: 概念性研究（Conceptual Study），基于多种理论构建概念框架
AI.findings: 提出了AI生态系统接口这一智能编排机制，将其定位为嵌入式编排层，能够协调利益相关者利益、促进生态系统协调并支持适应性治理过程，从而解释公共价值的创造、实现与感知。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过将AI生态系统接口概念化为多方利益相关者价值共创的智能编排机制，为公共价值和生态系统治理文献做出贡献；同时将经济学、利益相关者、生态系统和服务视角整合到统一的AI赋能公共价值创造模型中，拓展了现有价值创造理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和市场参与者提供了关于如何利用AI作为协调机制来促进跨多利益相关者的公共价值共创的框架性指导。

title: Decision-Focused Observation Scheduling for Satellite Conjunction Assessment

detail.title: Decision-Focused Observation Scheduling for Satellite Conjunction Assessment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study used simulated conjunction data and involved no human participants or animals.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: A conjunction warning must be resolved into a maneuver decision under finite tracking capacity: only a few of the available observation opportunities can be spent before closest approach. Standard practice selects the observations that most reduce orbital state uncertainty, a criterion indifferent to the decision the estimate will serve. We analyse the decision-focused alternative in the linearised encounter-plane model, where the posterior covariance and the covariance of the posterior mean are exact complements, and three results follow from it. The collision probability is a martingale in the observation filtration, so no schedule reduces expected risk and admissible objectives are dispersion measures. The first-order surrogate (the risk gradient contracted with the resolved covariance, equivalently c-optimal design) is an expansion in a parameter tied to the information collected, and performs worse than random selection. In the small-hard-body limit both moments of the future collision probability are available in closed form, and the resulting criterion decomposes into encounter-plane D-optimal design plus a risk correction that vanishes as the posterior tightens. Over 20,000 simulated conjunctions with an exhaustive combinatorial optimum, exhaustive selection under the closed-form criterion reduces expected Bayes loss by 3.8% to 4.1% relative to D-optimality and comes within 1.4% of the exact optimum at roughly a twelfth of its cost, while D-optimality improves on the best data-independent rule by 21% to 35%. The ordering is stable as the maneuver cost ratio is swept across the operational band. The advantage concentrates in conjunctions that appear safe and disappears under a mis-specified prior.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在有限跟踪能力下，航天器交会警告必须被解析为机动决策时的观测选择问题。作者在线性化相遇平面模型中分析了决策导向（decision-focused）的观测选择方法，发现碰撞概率是观测流下的鞅（因此无法通过观测调度降低期望风险），一阶代理（风险梯度与协方差收缩，等价于c-optimal设计）表现不如随机选择，而在小硬体极限下闭式准则可分解为相遇平面D-optimal设计加上随后验收紧而消失的风险修正项。通过20,000次模拟交会（含穷举组合最优），闭式准则相比D-optimality降低期望贝叶斯损失3.8%-4.1%，并以约1/12的成本达到精确最优的1.4%以内，优势集中在看似安全的交会情形，且先验误设时优势消失。
AI.research_question: 在有限跟踪能力下（最近接近前只能使用少量观测机会），如何选择观测使得机动决策的风险最小化？标准的协方差缩减准则是否最优？
AI.motivation: 标准做法选择最能减少轨道状态不确定性的观测，但该准则对估计所服务的决策不敏感。作者质疑这一"决策无关"的观测选择准则，探索决策导向的替代方案在数学上是否成立及是否更优。
AI.theoretical_framework: 线性化相遇平面模型；后验协方差与后验均值协方差互补关系；鞅理论（碰撞概率为观测流上的鞅）；最优实验设计理论（c-optimal、D-optimal设计）；贝叶斯损失框架；小硬体极限渐近分析。
AI.method: 理论分析结合大规模数值模拟：推导碰撞概率的鞅性质、一阶代理的级数展开、小硬体极限下闭式准则；通过20,000次模拟交会与穷举组合最优进行对比验证。
AI.findings: 1) 碰撞概率是观测流上的鞅，任何观测调度都无法降低期望风险，因此可行的目标是分散度度量；2) 一阶代理（c-optimal设计）表现比随机选择更差；3) 小硬体极限下闭式准则在20,000次模拟中相比D-optimality降低期望贝叶斯损失3.8%-4.1%，以约1/12的计算成本达到精确最优的1.4%以内；4) D-optimality相比最优数据无关规则改进21%-35%；5) 排序在机动成本比扫描下稳定；6) 优势集中在看似安全的交会中，先验误设时优势消失。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 证明碰撞概率为鞅，从根本上阐明观测选择无法降低期望风险的定理性结论；2) 揭示决策导向的一阶代理（c-optimal设计）在交会场景中的失效性，提供机理分析；3) 在小硬体极限下推导出闭式决策导向准则的精确分解结构，连接了最优实验设计与风险决策理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提出闭式决策导向观测选择准则，在工程可行的计算成本下显著优于标准D-optimal做法；2) 明确D-optimality相比数据无关规则的优势幅度（21%-35%），为实际操作提供基线；3) 指出决策导向方法的适用边界（先验误设时优势消失），指导实际工程部署条件。

title: Venture Capital Syndicate Centrality and Follow-On Financing: Evidence from UK Fintech, 2019-2021
affiliations: and

detail.title: Venture Capital Syndicate Centrality and Follow-On Financing: Evidence from UK Fintech, 2019-2021
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether the network centrality of a venture capital syndicate predicts follow-on financing outcomes for early-stage fintech companies in the United Kingdom. Using a dataset of 368 institutional seed and Series A rounds completed between January 2019 and December 2021, constructed from PitchBook and cleaned to retain only institutional investors, we build a bipartite VC-to-company co-investment network, project it onto a VC-to-VC adjacency graph, and compute degree, betweenness, and eigenvector centrality for each investor. Syndicate-average centrality scores are estimated against a binary follow-on funding outcome within 24 months using a Cox proportional hazards framework, with degree centrality specified as the primary measure. We find that a one-standard-deviation increase in average syndicate degree centrality is associated with a 33 per cent higher hazard of raising a follow-on round (HR = 1.330, p = 0.016), after controlling for deal size, round stage, year, and foreign investor presence. Betweenness and eigenvector centrality, treated as secondary specifications given their high correlation with degree centrality, are directionally consistent but statistically underpowered. An exploratory test of foreign venture capital participation shows a positive but inconsistent association with follow-on speed, reaching only marginal significance in one of three specifications and constrained by incomplete investor nationality data; we treat this as motivation for future work rather than a confirmed finding. The paper provides the first empirical test of the Hochberg, Ljungqvist and Lu (2007) centrality-performance framework in UK fintech and introduces syndicate-average centrality as an alternative to lead-investor centrality in markets where deal leadership is diffuse.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了英国早期金融科技公司的风险投资辛迪加网络中心性是否能够预测后续融资结果。基于2019年1月至2021年12月间368轮种子轮和A轮融资数据，构建二分网络并计算度数、中介和特征向量中心性，采用Cox比例风险模型发现，辛迪加平均度数中心性每增加一个标准差，后续融资风险率提高33%（HR=1.330, p=0.016）。这是首次将Hochberg等人（2007）的中心性-绩效框架应用于英国金融科技领域，并引入辛迪加平均中心性作为市场领导地位分散时的替代指标。
AI.research_question: 风险投资辛迪加的网络中心性是否能够预测英国早期金融科技公司的后续融资结果？
AI.motivation: 现有文献（如Hochberg et al., 2007）已在美国市场验证了VC网络中心性与投资绩效的关系，但这一框架尚未在英国金融科技领域得到实证检验。此外，英国市场投资领导地位较为分散，传统的牵头投资者中心性指标适用性有限，需要开发替代性度量方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会网络理论中的网络中心性理论（Hochberg, Ljungqvist & Lu, 2007）中心性-绩效框架，具体包括度数中心性、中介中心性和特征向量中心性三种网络度量指标。
AI.method: 构建VC-公司二分共投网络并投影为VC-VC邻接图，计算度数、中介和特征向量中心性；以辛迪加平均中心性为自变量，使用Cox比例风险模型估计24个月内后续融资的概率；控制交易规模、轮次阶段、年份和外资投资者参与；度数中心性为主度量，中介和特征向量中心性为辅助度量。
AI.findings: 辛迪加平均度数中心性每增加一个标准差，后续融资风险率提高33%（HR=1.330, p=0.016）；中介和特征向量中心性与度数中心性高度相关，方向一致但统计上效力不足；外资VC参与的探索性检验结果正向但不一致，仅在三种设定中的一种达到边际显著，数据的国籍信息不完整。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将Hochberg等人（2007）的中心性-绩效框架实证检验于英国金融科技领域；引入辛迪加平均中心性作为市场投资领导地位分散时对牵头投资者中心性的替代指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 为早期金融科技创业者选择风险投资伙伴提供网络中心性维度的决策参考；为投资机构评估联合投资策略提供实证依据；为政策制定者理解金融科技融资生态的网络结构提供洞见。

title: Integrating the Svensson Model of the U.S. Treasury Yield Curve and the High Frequency VIX Microstructure for Systemic Risk Management

detail.title: Integrating the Svensson Model of the U.S. Treasury Yield Curve and the High Frequency VIX Microstructure for Systemic Risk Management
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a novel systemic risk management that integrates the daily-frequency Svensson model of the U.S. Treasury yield curve with the minutely high-frequency Svensson model of the VIX microstructure.
