title:
The Behavioral Migration Model:
 A Multi-level Process Theory of Behavioral Change, Economic Transformation, and Capital Reallocation

detail.title:
The Behavioral Migration Model:
 A Multi-level Process Theory of Behavioral Change, Economic Transformation, and Capital Reallocation
detail.abstract: The Behavioral Migration Model (BMM) is proposed as a multi-level process theory explaining how technological innovation may contribute to long-term economic transformation through changes in recurring human and organizational behavior. The model distinguishes relatively stable recurring societal functions from the evolving methods used to perform them and identifies Behavioral Migration as the point at which a technology-enabled method becomes the dominant and socially expected behavior within a defined population. The theory integrates insights from innovation diffusion, technology acceptance, socio-technical transitions, innovation resistance, evolutionary economics, structural transformation, and capital-allocation research. It proposes a cyclical process in which technological innovation creates behavioral alternatives; perceived value and behavioral resistance shape adoption and normalization; Behavioral Migration is followed by Economic Migration; and sustained economic reorganization may contribute to Capital Reallocation, which can in turn support subsequent innovation. The model does not claim that its individual constructs are wholly novel. Its proposed contribution lies in integrating and ordering established insights within a behaviorcentered, multi-level architecture that links technological possibility to societal normalization, economic restructuring, and financial reallocation. The paper develops theoretical propositions, boundary conditions, and a future research agenda for empirical testing and refinement of the model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出行为迁移模型（BMM），这是一个多层次过程理论，解释了技术创新如何通过改变反复出现的人类和组织行为，促进长期经济转型。模型区分了相对稳定的社会功能与不断演化的执行方法，识别出"行为迁移"作为技术赋能力法成为特定人群主导和社会期望行为的转折点，并构建了从技术创新到经济转型的循环递进过程。
AI.research_question: 技术创新如何通过改变人类和组织行为，实现长期的经济转型？
AI.motivation: 现有研究分散于创新扩散、技术接受、社会技术转型等多个领域，缺乏一个以行为为中心的、多层次的整合框架来解释技术创新与长期经济转型之间的机制联系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了创新扩散、技术接受、社会技术转型、创新抵抗、演化经济学、结构转型和资本配置研究等理论观点。
AI.method: 理论构建方法，通过提出理论命题、边界条件和未来研究议程来建立模型。
AI.findings: 提出了一个循环过程：技术创新创造行为替代方案→感知价值和行为抵抗塑造采纳与规范化→行为迁移随后引发经济迁移→持续的经济重组促进资本再配置→进而支持后续创新。
AI.theory_contributions: 该模型的贡献不在于提出全新的个体概念，而在于将已有观点整合并排序到一个以行为为中心的多层次架构中，将技术可能性与社会规范化、经济重组和金融再配置联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和管理者提供了理解技术推动经济转型路径的分析框架，并为未来实证检验和模型完善指明了方向。

title: A Structural Coverage Buffer and the Cross-Section of Bank Failures

detail.title: A Structural Coverage Buffer and the Cross-Section of Bank Failures
detail.abstract: A structural model of fire sales in banking implies a solvency boundary that separates banks whose mapped asset base covers outside funding from those whose mapped asset base does not. We map this theory-derived boundary to U.S. commercial bank balance sheets and evaluate it against realized failures. Four quarters before failure, coverage falls short for 49 percent of failed-bank observations against 16 percent of contemporaneous at-risk observations in the same quarters, and the gap persists in the full sample and outside the Global Financial Crisis period. Conditional on the accounting mapping, the zero cutoff is fixed by the model's solvency condition rather than selected to maximize failure discrimination. The empirically informative feature is whether the boundary is crossed. This classification is invariant to how a fixed asset base is split into liquid and harder-to-liquidate legs, so it does not depend on the accounting partition. Distance from the boundary is far less robust, being partition-sensitive and carrying only weak-to-moderate within-state information. The undercovered state is not absorbing: about one-third of undercovered bank-quarter observations return above the line the following quarter. A valuation extension highlights a different source of fragility among the 2023 interest-rate-loss cases: marking held-to-maturity securities to market lowers the asset base itself. Consistent with its role as a broad summary of bank solvency, the book capital ratio provides stronger overall failure discrimination. The structural boundary instead supplies a theory-imposed cutoff within an explicitly defined balance-sheet mapping.

AI.tldr: 本文通过银行挤兑的火灾销售（fire sales）结构模型推导出一个偿付能力边界，将该边界映射到美国商业银行资产负债表上，检验其对银行倒闭的预测能力。研究发现，在倒闭前四个季度，49%的倒闭银行观测值低于该边界，而同期处于风险中的银行仅有16%。该边界具有理论驱动的零截断点，不依赖会计分类方式，且被覆盖不足的状态并非吸收态（约三分之一的下季度回归线上）。对2023年利率损失案例的分析表明，按市值计价持有至到期证券会降低资产基础本身，凸显出不同的脆弱性来源。
AI.research_question: 理论推导的银行偿付能力边界能否有效映射到美国商业银行资产负债表，并预测银行实际倒闭？
AI.motivation: 现有银行风险预测多依赖经验选择的阈值或会计指标，缺乏理论驱动的结构性边界。本文旨在将火灾销售模型推导出的偿付能力条件与银行实际资产负债表数据相结合，检验其区分倒闭银行与存活银行的能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 火灾销售结构性模型（fire sales structural model），基于银行抵押资产覆盖面与外部融资的偿付能力条件推导出偿付能力边界。
AI.method: 将理论推导的偿付能力边界映射到美国商业银行资产负债表，采用实证分类方法比较倒闭银行与同期风险银行在该边界两侧的分布；分析边界距离的稳健性（是否受资产流动性拆分方式影响）；通过估值扩展分析2023年利率损失案例；并与账面资本比率进行预测能力比较。
AI.findings: （1）倒闭前四季度，49%的倒闭银行低于边界，而仅16%的同期风险银行低于边界，差距在全样本及金融危机外期间持续存在；（2）边界截断点由模型偿付条件决定而非数据选择，分类结果不依赖于资产在流动性与非流动性部分之间的会计划分；（3）与边界的距离对会计分割敏感，预测信息较弱；（4）被覆盖不足状态并非吸收态，约1/3的银行下季度回归线上；（5）2023年利率损失案例中，持有至到期证券按市值计价会降低资产基础本身，构成不同的脆弱性来源；（6）账面资本比率整体判别力更强，结构性边界提供理论驱动的截断点。
AI.theory_contributions: 将火灾销售均衡理论的偿付能力条件转化为可直接映射到银行资产负债表的实证边界，为理论驱动的银行偿付能力衡量提供了操作化框架；证明了分类结果对会计分割方式的稳健性，深化了对银行脆弱性边界的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管者提供理论驱动的银行偿付能力预警指标，可与账面资本比率互补使用；揭示持有至到期证券的市值计价对资产基础的侵蚀效应，对2023年利率风险案例具有警示意义；为倒闭早期预警提供结构性筛查工具。

title: Weighting Uncertainty in Egypt-Africa Logistics-Hub Assessment: A BWM-TOPSIS Robustness Study

detail.title: Weighting Uncertainty in Egypt-Africa Logistics-Hub Assessment: A BWM-TOPSIS Robustness Study
detail.abstract: Multi-criteria logistics-hub assessments can produce seemingly precise rankings even when candidate ordering is sensitive to contested weighting assumptions. This study evaluates weighting uncertainty rather than attempting to select a location. Ten named candidate labels are compared through a fully synthetic decision matrix covering market and port access, inland connectivity, security, green performance, distributor reach, skills, reverse logistics, and land cost. A balanced Best–Worst Method/TOPSIS reference scenario is compared with market-led, green-circular, and security-resilience weight structures. Reference-scenario scores range from 0.352 to 0.604, while Spearman correlations with alternative scenarios range from 0.552 to 0.964. The variation demonstrates that candidate ordering is not invariant to strategic priorities. The contribution is a robustness workflow for diagnosing weight dependence, rank reversal, and evidence requirements. No site is recommended because the values are generated and no audited GIS, financial, environmental, or stakeholder data were used.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过完全合成的决策矩阵，比较了十个候选物流枢纽在不同权重情景下的排名稳健性。参考情景下得分范围为0.352至0.604，与替代情景的Spearman相关系数在0.552至0.964之间，表明候选排序对战略权重假设高度敏感。论文贡献在于提出了一套诊断权重依赖性和排名反转的稳健性工作流程，但未推荐任何具体选址。
AI.research_question: 多标准物流枢纽评估中，候选排序对权重假设的敏感性如何影响评估结果的可靠性？如何系统性地诊断和报告这种权重不确定性？
AI.motivation: 传统多标准物流枢纽评估往往产生看似精确的排名，但当候选排序对备受争议的权重假设敏感时，这种精确性具有误导性。本研究旨在评估权重不确定性而非试图选择具体选址。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多准则决策分析（MCDA），Best-Worst Method (BWM)，TOPSIS方法，权重敏感性分析理论
AI.method: 采用完全合成的决策矩阵，覆盖市场与港口可达性、内陆连通性、安全性、绿色绩效、分销商覆盖、技能、逆向物流和土地成本八个维度。设定平衡BWM/TOPSIS参考情景，并与市场导向、绿色循环、安全韧性三种替代权重结构进行比较，使用Spearman秩相关分析排名一致性。
AI.findings: 参考情景下十个候选的得分范围为0.352至0.604；与替代情景的Spearman相关系数介于0.552至0.964之间，表明不同战略优先级下候选排序存在显著变化，排名并非对权重假设不变。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一套用于诊断权重依赖、排名反转和证据需求的稳健性工作流程，为多准则物流选址评估提供了方法论框架上的贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 没有推荐任何具体选址，因为使用合成数据且缺乏经审计的GIS、财务、环境或利益相关者数据。实践贡献在于为决策者提供了识别评估结果对权重假设敏感性的诊断工具。

title: The Economics of Clean Technology Diffusion: How Low-Carbon Innovation Spreads across Economies

detail.title: The Economics of Clean Technology Diffusion: How Low-Carbon Innovation Spreads across Economies
detail.abstract:
Cost collapse is treated as diffusion. It is not. Solar photovoltaic levelised cost in the IRENA world series fell from
42 cents per kilowatt-hour in 2010 to 4 cents in 2024. Modules fell from 2.44 dollars per watt to 26 cents. Solar’s
share of world electricity rose from 0.15 percent to 6.9 percent. That is a real clock. It is a traded-goods clock. In a
balanced reading of Ember and Energy Institute generation files, IRENA capacity, and the IEA Global EV Data
Explorer via Our World in Data, the extensive margin closed and the intensive margin did not. Among countries
with a 2024 generation file, 77 percent had crossed 1 percent solar, against 1.5 percent in 2010. Forty-eight percent
had crossed 5 percent, against none. On a 217-country latest-available cross-section, 58 percent are extensive on
solar and 31 percent are intensive, meaning 5 percent of electricity on a grid that already reaches 80 percent of the
population. China holds 48 percent of installed solar capacity, against 2.5 percent in 2010, and 39 percent of solar
terawatt-hours. Sub-Saharan Africa holds 13 gigawatts and 10 watts per person, against 505 watts in high-income
economies. Developing-country solar’s share of electricity is uncorrelated with income. Watts per person is not.
Electric vehicles occupy a third map. China is 53 percent of new car sales and 65 percent of world units. Nepal is 68
percent of a thin car market at 0.9 percent solar. The United States is 10 percent electric on 17 percent solar-plus-
wind. Nine developing countries occupy a hardware club — intensive on at least two of solar, wind, and electric
vehicles — covering 1.98 billion people, of which China is 1.41 billion. Fifty-one developing countries occupy
none. IEA Energy Technology Perspectives puts China’s share of clean-technology manufacturing value at
about 70 percent, modules above 80, wafers at 95. A cheap module is not a watt. A watt is not a system. Low-carbon
innovation spreads as manufactured hardware sitting on complementary capital. Treating Wright’s law as a diffusion
law is how a price gets counted as African adoption.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地指出"成本下降被视为技术扩散"这一常见错误认知。通过分析太阳能光伏（IRENA数据）和电动汽车（IEA数据）的全球分布，作者展示：尽管太阳能成本急剧下降（从2010年42美分/千瓦时降至2024年4美分），但发展中国家的实际采用率与收入无关，硬件制造集中在中国（占清洁技术制造价值约70%），便宜的模块不等于实际采用。作者主张低碳创新的扩散本质是"制成品硬件搭载互补资本"，而非简单的成本扩散。
AI.research_question: 太阳能光伏和电动汽车的成本下降是否等同于技术在全球（尤其是发展中国家）的扩散？
AI.motivation: 成本大幅下降（太阳能从42美分降至4美分）常被误读为技术正在全球"扩散"，但实际上需要区分"价格下降"与"实际采用"，尤其要审视发展中国家的真实能源转型程度。
AI.theoretical_framework: Wright's law（莱特定律）——成本下降与产量关系的经验法则；"广泛边际"（extensive margin，多少国家开始采用）与"集约边际"（intensive margin，采用深度）的区分；技术扩散理论批判。
AI.method: 基于多源数据的描述性统计分析：IRENA太阳能容量数据、Ember和Energy Institute发电数据、IEA Global EV Data Explorer，以及217个国家的横截面数据比较。
AI.findings: (1) 广泛边际已闭合：77%有2024年发电数据的国家太阳能占比超过1%（2010年仅1.5%），48%超过5%（2010年为0）；但集约边际未跟上。(2) 中国占全球48%的太阳能装机容量和39%的太阳能太瓦时，而撒哈拉以南非洲仅130亿瓦特、人均10瓦（高收入国家人均505瓦）。(3) 发展中国家的太阳能电力占比与收入不相关，但人均瓦特数与收入相关。(4) 电动汽车呈现不同格局：中国占新车销售53%，尼泊尔68%，美国10%。(5) 51个发展中国家在太阳能、风能、电动车三方面均无密集型采用。(6) 中国占清洁技术制造价值约70%，模块制造超80%，硅片达95%。
AI.theory_contributions: 批判性地挑战了将成本下降（Wright's law）等同于技术扩散的理论假设，提出技术扩散应理解为"制成品硬件搭载互补资本"的过程，而非单纯的价格传递。区分了"广泛边际"和"集约边际"，为技术扩散研究提供了更精细的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策启示：不能仅以设备价格下降来评估能源转型进展；发展中国家需要关注配套基础设施（互补资本）建设而非仅依赖进口廉价设备；提醒国际社会注意清洁技术供应链高度集中在中国的地缘政治与能源安全含义。

title: The Relationship Between Organizational Employees and their Leaders Mildo dos Santos

detail.title: The Relationship Between Organizational Employees and their Leaders Mildo dos Santos
detail.abstract: The relationship between employees and leaders plays a crucial role in organizational performance and the internal climate of a company. Effective leadership can promote employee engagement, increase job satisfaction, and stimulate professional development, creating an environment of mutual trust and collaboration. Assertive communication, when used clearly and objectively, is essential to avoid misunderstandings and strengthen the bond between leaders and teams. In addition, recognition of individual and collective employee efforts contributes to maintaining high motivation, demonstrating that the work performed is valued. Leaders who are able to inspire their teams become agents of change and transformation, capable of aligning employees' personal objectives with organizational goals. However, when relationships between leaders and subordinates are fragile or poorly managed, conflicts, demotivation, and even increased turnover may arise, harming the work environment and company results. Investing in the continuous development of leadership competencies, as well as in the construction of an inclusive and participatory organizational culture, is fundamental to strengthening these relationships. In this way, it is possible to create a space where trust, collaboration, and alignment of objectives are constant elements, promoting the organization's sustainable success.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了员工与领导者之间关系对组织绩效和内部氛围的重要性，分析了有效领导、自信沟通、员工认可等因素如何促进信任与合作环境，同时也指出关系脆弱时可能带来的冲突、消极情绪和高离职率等负面影响。
AI.research_question: 领导者与员工之间的关系如何影响组织绩效和内部氛围？通过哪些机制可以加强这种关系以促进组织的可持续发展？
AI.motivation: 领导与员工关系是组织成功的关键因素，但这一关系既可能带来积极效益（如提高敬业度和满意度），也可能因管理不善导致冲突、消极和人员流失。理解并强化这一关系对组织可持续发展至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 领导力理论、组织行为学中的员工敬业度与工作满意度理论、沟通理论、组织文化理论
AI.method: 本文为概念性/综述性研究，通过理论分析与论述方式探讨领导与员工关系的各个维度及其影响。
AI.findings: 有效领导能促进员工敬业度、提升工作满意度并激发职业发展；自信且清晰的沟通有助于避免误解、增强领导者与团队的联结；对员工个人和集体努力的认可能维持高动机水平；具有激励能力的领导者能成为变革推动者，使员工个人目标与组织目标保持一致。反之，关系脆弱会导致冲突、消极情绪和人员流失增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合了领导力、沟通、激励和组织文化等多维度理论视角，系统阐述领导者与员工关系的积极作用机制与负面后果。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调持续投资领导力能力发展的重要性，建议构建包容性和参与性的组织文化，以强化信任、协作和目标一致性，促进组织可持续成功。

title: The Lean Government How Governments Can Move at AI Speed without being Governed by AI

detail.title: The Lean Government How Governments Can Move at AI Speed without being Governed by AI
detail.abstract: Governments are adopting artificial intelligence inside institutions designed for a slower technological and administrative era. The immediate gains are real, but automating documents, searches, and workflows does not resolve the deeper constraint: institutional latency, the time and friction between a change in society and the state's ability to understand it, decide, act, measure consequences, and correct course. This article proposes the Lean Government as an operating model for closing that gap. Its cycle is Sense, Simulate, Decide, Deliver, Measure, and Correct. It also identifies an emerging deployment gap between frontier capability and institutional adoption. Closing it requires a translation layer that can connect public missions, model capabilities, secure architecture, procurement, workflow redesign, workforce adoption, evaluation, and accountable authority. Artificial intelligence can strengthen every stage, but public authority must remain human, lawful, contestable, and accountable. Society scale simulation should become an instrument of public reasoning, not a source of sovereignty. The decisive competition in government AI will concern institutional capacity and mission delivery, not model access alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"精益政府"（Lean Government）作为缩小制度时滞的操作模型，其循环为"感知-模拟-决策-交付-衡量-纠正"六个环节。文章指出前沿AI能力与机构采纳之间存在"部署鸿沟"，弥合它需要构建连接公共使命、模型能力、安全架构、采购、工作流再造、劳动力采纳、评估和问责权限的"翻译层"。AI可强化各环节，但公共权力必须保持人性化、合法、可争议与可问责。社会规模模拟应成为公共推理的工具而非主权来源，政府AI竞争的关键在制度能力与使命交付。
AI.research_question: 政府如何在保持公共权威人性化、合法、可争议、可问责的前提下，利用人工智能缩小制度时滞（社会变化与国家理解、决策、行动、衡量、纠错之间的时间与摩擦）？
AI.motivation: 政府正在将人工智能引入为较慢的技术与行政时代设计的制度中，短期收益虽真实，但自动化文件、搜索和工作流并未解决更深层的约束——制度时滞。文章旨在提出一个操作系统模型来弥合这一差距，并应对前沿能力与机构采纳之间的部署鸿沟。
AI.theoretical_framework: 精益政府（Lean Government）运营模型，其循环为Sense（感知）、Simulate（模拟）、Decide（决策）、Deliver（交付）、Measure（衡量）、Correct（纠正）六个阶段；以及"部署鸿沟"概念与"翻译层"框架。
AI.method: 概念性/规范性分析文章，提出操作模型（周期六阶段）与框架（翻译层），无实证数据。
AI.findings: AI可强化（Sense到Correct）每一环节，但公共权威必须保持人性化、合法、可争议和可问责；社会规模模拟应成为公共推理的工具而非主权来源；政府AI的决定性竞争在于制度能力与使命交付，而非单纯的模型获取。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"精益政府"这一新的概念性运营模型，将精益管理思想引入政府AI语境；提出"部署鸿沟"概念，揭示前沿能力与机构采纳之间的结构性差距；提出"翻译层"作为弥合该鸿沟的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府AI部署提供可操作的六阶段循环（感知-模拟-决策-交付-衡量-纠正）；指出弥合部署鸿沟所需的七个连接要素（公共使命、模型能力、安全架构、采购、工作流再造、劳动力采纳、评估与问责权限），为政策制定者提供实践路径。

title: Calibration-Aware Conditional Synthetic Augmentation under Explicit Feasibility Constraints: Repeated Validation on Mobile and Sensor Miscarriage-Risk Records
affiliations: Università degli Studi di Milano-Bicocca - UNIVERSITA' DI MILANO BICOCCA,  and University of Milano-Bicocca

detail.title: Calibration-Aware Conditional Synthetic Augmentation under Explicit Feasibility Constraints: Repeated Validation on Mobile and Sensor Miscarriage-Risk Records

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: No Funding received for this research.

detail.abstract: Synthetic tabular data are increasingly used for augmentation and privacyoriented data access, but their value for probabilistic risk prediction cannot be inferred from distributional resemblance or discrimination alone. We evaluated a calibration-aware conditional synthetic augmentation framework for miscarriage-risk prediction from repeatedly collected mobile and healthcaresensor records. A conditional Wasserstein generative adversarial network with gradient penalty was conditioned on the binary outcome and prespecified age and body-mass-index strata. Its objective combined adversarial learning with moment matching, correlation preservation, raw-domain feasibility, and label-consistency penalties. Generative and predictive hyperparameters were selected on a dedicated tuning partition using constrained Bayesian optimization and then locked for 20 repeated held-out evaluations. In each repetition, elastic-net logistic models were fitted to real records alone or to real plus 4,000 synthetic records. Recalibration was estimated only from a separate real-data calibration partition, and all metrics were evaluated on held-out real records. Synthetic augmentation did not change discrimination: mean AUC was 0.641 for both training strategies, with a paired difference of 0.000 (0.000, 0.000). It produced small improvements in Brier score (-0.001), log loss (-0.002), absolute calibration-slope error (-0.248), and 10-bin equal-width ECE (-0.071). Tie-preserving 10-bin ACE decreased by -0.007, but its resampling interval included zero (-0.016 to 0.002; adjusted Wilcoxon p = 0.751). Differences largely disappeared after Platt or temperature calibration. No Bayesian-optimization candidate satisfied all feasibility constraints; mean classifier two-sample-test AUC was 0.612, mean pre-projection domain-violation rate was 87.5%, and the nearest-neighbour memorization proxy was 0.022%. Conditional augmentation therefore acted as a modest regularizer for the uncalibrated predictor, but it neither improved ranking nor yielded a generator that naturally respected the prespecified feature domain. Because the data comprise repeated records and were split at record level, the findings are methodological and do not establish clinical deployment readiness.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了一种基于条件生成对抗网络的合成数据增强框架在流产风险预测中的应用。研究发现，合成数据增强虽能小幅改善未校准预测器的校准指标（如Brier分数、对数损失等），但未能提升判别性能（AUC无差异），且在特征域约束上表现不佳（87.5%的域违规率），说明条件增强仅起到适度的正则化作用，不构成临床部署的成熟方案。
AI.research_question: 合成表格数据增强是否能提升基于移动与医疗传感器重复记录数据的流产风险概率预测性能，特别是校准能力（而非仅判别能力）？
AI.motivation: 合成表格数据广泛用于数据增强和隐私保护数据访问，但其对概率风险预测的价值不能仅从分布相似性或以判别能力（AUC）推断，校准性能同样关键。现有研究缺乏对校准感知的条件合成增强框架的系统评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 条件Wasserstein生成对抗网络（CWGAN-GP）、对抗学习与矩匹配、相关保留、原始域可行性与标签一致性惩罚相结合的多目标生成框架；弹性网络逻辑回归用于预测；Platt与温度校准作为再校准方法。
AI.method: 采用条件Wasserstein GAN与梯度惩罚，以二元结局和年龄及BMI分层为条件，结合多目标损失。使用约束贝叶斯优化选择生成与预测超参数，并在20次重复留出评估中锁定。比较仅真实数据与真实+4000条合成数据的弹性网络逻辑模型，使用独立校准分区进行再校准，在留出真实数据上评估所有指标。
AI.findings: 合成增强对判别性能无影响（两种策略AUC均为0.641，配对差异为0.000）；在Brier分数（-0.001）、对数损失（-0.002）、绝对校准斜率误差（-0.248）和10-bin ECE（-0.071）上有小幅改善；ACE减少-0.007但置信区间含零（p=0.751）；差异在Platt或温度校准后基本消失。无贝叶斯优化候选满足所有可行性约束，域违规率达87.5%，记忆代理指标为0.022%。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文揭示了条件合成数据增强对概率预测的价值难以从分布相似性或判别指标推断，须评估校准维度；同时指出即使采用先进约束优化，GAN生成器仍难以天然满足预设特征域约束，为合成数据在医学预测中的方法论边界提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究提示在流产风险预测中，合成数据增强可作为未校准预测器的适度正则化手段，但不能提升排序能力（AUC），且生成器质量不能满足部署要求。同时指出由于数据为重复记录且按记录级分割，结果仅具方法论意义，不构成临床部署就绪的证据。

title: Three-Layer Climate Risk Absorption in China's Corporate Bond Market: Diagnostic Evidence from Interbank Medium-Term Notes

detail.title: Three-Layer Climate Risk Absorption in China's Corporate Bond Market: Diagnostic Evidence from Interbank Medium-Term Notes
detail.abstract: We study the institutional channels through which climate risk is absorbed before reaching the primary-market coupon of Chinese interbank medium-term notes (MTNs). We develop a three-layer absorption framework—credit ratings, third-party guarantees, and implicit state support—and implement its diagnostic protocol on a fully public, reproducible 12-city prototype that combines 4,130 NOAA station-day weather records for 2024 with 1,667,274 ChinaBond rating-curve observations for 2020–2025. Three results emerge. First, rating-implied funding costs are sharply compressed at the AAA end (2.23–2.31%) and dispersed at the A end (8.56–10.90%), mirroring the issuer-level rating compression documented for the 1,468-MTN universe. Second, physical climate exposure sorts significantly across all three institutional layers: AAA status, state ownership, and guarantee flags each separate climate risk at the 5% level, and all three comparisons survive Benjamini–Hochberg false-discovery-rate correction. Third, a one-standard-deviation increase in physical climate risk is associated with a 3.01-percentage-point higher rating-implied coupon (R² = 0.67; HC1 p < 0.001) that is robust across seven pre-specified variations of the extreme-day thresholds, the yield tenor, the polar-city sample, mid-tier rating assignments, and CRI weights, and the guarantee and rating interactions carry the predicted negative absorption signs. A 5,000-draw placebo permutation confirms that the interaction sign template is not an artifact of arbitrary flag assignment, while making explicit that confirmatory interaction inference requires the 1,468-MTN companion sample. The results locate the climate-pricing null of primary markets in the rating–guarantee–ownership architecture rather than in investor inattention, with direct implications for disclosure-based climate policy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究气候风险在中国银行间中期票据一级市场票面利率被吸收的制度渠道，提出了"信用评级-第三方担保-隐性国家支持"三层吸收框架，并基于12个城市的数据原型进行诊断性检验。结果发现气候风险主要被评级-担保-所有权架构所吸收，而非投资者注意力不足，且气候风险显著定价于评级隐含融资成本中。
AI.research_question: 气候风险在到达中国银行间中期票据一级市场票面利率之前，是通过哪些制度渠道被吸收的？气候风险是否以及如何通过信用评级、第三方担保和隐性国家支持这三层机制影响评级隐含融资成本？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多关注气候风险在二级市场的定价，而对一级市场中气候风险被制度性渠道吸收的机制缺乏系统性理解。本文旨在区分气候定价的"制度吸收"假说与"投资者注意力不足"假说，为基于信息披露的气候政策提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三层气候风险吸收框架：第一层为信用评级机制，第二层为第三方担保机制，第三层为隐性国家支持机制（含国有所有权）。该框架基于气候风险信息在到达最终票面利率定价前被多层制度安排逐级吸收的理论逻辑。
AI.method: 构建12个城市的公开可复现数据原型：整合2024年4,130条NOAA气象站日度天气记录与2020-2025年1,667,274条中债估值曲线数据。采用三层吸收框架的诊断协议，包括AAA端/A端评级隐含成本对比、三层机构的物理气候暴露排序检验（含Benjamini-Hochberg FDR校正）、回归分析（含七种预设定稳健性检验变体）以及5,000次安慰剂置换检验。
AI.findings: （1）评级隐含融资成本在AAA端高度压缩（2.23-2.31%），在A端高度分散（8.56-10.90%），与1,468只中期票据全样本的发债主体评级压缩现象一致；（2）物理气候暴露在三层制度渠道中均显著排序，AAA状态、国有所有权和担保标识均在5%水平上区分气候风险；（3）物理气候风险每增加一个标准差，评级隐含票面利率上升3.01个百分点（R²=0.67，HC1 p<0.001），且在七种预设定变体下保持稳健；（4）担保与评级交互项呈现预期的负向吸收符号，5,000次安慰剂置换确认该符号模板并非任意标识分配的伪影。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文将气候风险定价的零假设从一级市场的投资者注意力不足重新定位到评级-担保-所有权架构之中，为理解气候风险在制度层面的逐级吸收机制提供了新的理论框架与实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果对基于信息披露的气候政策具有直接启示：若要改善气候风险在一级市场的定价，政策着力点应放在制度架构（评级、担保、所有权）的信息传递上，而非仅关注投资者注意力。同时为监管者评估气候风险的系统性暴露提供了可操作的三层诊断协议。

title: Adaptive Governance under Climate Stress: Institutions that Update Policies Dynamically as Environmental Conditions Shift

detail.title: Adaptive Governance under Climate Stress: Institutions that Update Policies Dynamically as Environmental Conditions Shift
detail.abstract:
Adaptive governance is emerging as a necessary replacement for legacy, static policy systems that cannot keep pace with accelerating climate volatility, technological disruption, and interconnected global crises. As the document states, “traditional, static policy frameworks [are] obsolete” under conditions of non‑linear environmental change and systemic polycrisis.

This report develops a quantitative macro‑systems model in which governance behaves as a continuously computing algorithm rather than a fixed legal manuscript. Institutions integrate biophysical sensor networks, multi‑agent AI orchestration, and parametric policy triggers to minimize reaction latency and maintain system symmetry. Key mechanisms include automated fiscal stabilizers, dynamic zoning linked to real‑time sea‑level telemetry, algorithmic energy‑grid pricing, and autonomous agricultural redundancy protocols. These systems emulate the thermodynamic efficiency of biological networks by processing environmental feedback continuously and adapting locally before global failure cascades occur.

The document outlines a phased 2026–2050 roadmap transitioning institutions from sensor‑driven “shadow systems” to fully symmetrical macro‑systems capable of autonomous policy execution. Case studies across coastal resilience, energy grids, and agriculture demonstrate how dynamic policy updating reduces systemic risk, compresses economic shocks, and leverages cost‑curve declines in compute and sensor technologies to make adaptive governance feasible even for emerging economies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将治理视为"持续计算算法"的定量宏观系统模型，通过生物物理传感器网络、多智能体AI编排和参数化政策触发器取代传统静态政策框架，实现自适应治理。文章给出了2026-2050年的分阶段路线图，并通过沿海韧性、能源电网和农业等案例论证了动态政策更新如何降低系统性风险。
AI.research_question: 如何用动态的自适应治理系统取代传统静态政策框架，以应对气候波动、技术颠覆和全球互联危机？
AI.motivation: 传统静态政策框架在非线性环境变化和系统性多重危机（polycrisis）条件下已被证实"过时"（obsolete），无法跟上加速变化的速度，亟需新的治理模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 借鉴生物网络的热力学效率原理，将治理视为持续计算算法而非固定的法律文本；基于系统对称性（system symmetry）理论和反馈处理机制。
AI.method: 定量宏观系统建模；提出机构集成生物物理传感器网络、多智能体AI编排和参数化政策触发器的架构；案例研究（沿海韧性、能源电网、农业）；分阶段2026-2050路线图。
AI.findings: 动态政策更新可降低系统性风险、压缩经济冲击；计算和传感器技术的成本曲线下降使自适应治理对新兴经济体也可行；自动化财政稳定器、动态分区、算法能源定价和农业冗余协议等机制具有可行性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将治理概念从静态法律范式转向计算/算法范式，引入了政策"反应延迟最小化"和"系统对称性维持"的理论框架，并借用热力学/生物网络效率原理为适应性治理提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了可操作的2026-2050实施路线图，包括从传感器驱动的"影子系统"到完全对称的自主政策执行宏观系统的过渡路径；通过具体案例和成本可行性分析为政策制定者提供了实践指南。

title:
Leader Self-Interest and Self-oriented Behavior: 
A Conceptual Study of Constructive and Destructive Leadership

detail.title:
Leader Self-Interest and Self-oriented Behavior: 
A Conceptual Study of Constructive and Destructive Leadership
detail.abstract: Leadership research has mainly focused on task-oriented and people-oriented leadership behaviors. However, leaders are also influenced by their own personal and professional interests, such as career growth, reputation, job security, recognition, promotion, and status. Existing research has examined related ideas, including self-serving and exploitative leadership. These studies have generally focused on the harmful effects of leaders putting their own interests before others. This paper takes a broader conceptual approach. It examines Self-Oriented Behavior (SOB) as leadership behavior influenced by a leader's own personal or professional interests. The paper proposes that self-oriented behavior does not necessarily produce the same outcome in every situation. It may produce constructive outcomes when the leader's self-interest encourages behavior that also benefits employees or the organization. It may produce destructive outcomes when the pursuit of self-interest harms employees, the organization, or other stakeholders. The paper proposes a conceptual relationship between situational conditions, leader selfinterest, Self-Oriented Behavior, and organizational and employee outcomes. It also proposes that Self-Oriented Behavior can exist together with task-oriented and people-oriented behaviors. The paper does not claim that leader self-interest is a completely new area of research. Instead, it proposes a way to examine the relationship between leader self-interest, leadership behavior, context, and consequences. Future empirical research is needed to determine whether Self-Oriented Behavior can be reliably distinguished from existing leadership constructs.

AI.tldr: 本文从更广泛的概念视角审视领导者的自我导向行为（Self-Oriented Behavior, SOB），提出领导者的自我利益（如职业发展、声誉、晋升等）并不必然导致负面结果——在特定情境下可能产生建设性成果，在其他情境下则可能产生破坏性后果。论文构建了情境条件、领导者自我利益、自我导向行为与组织及员工结果之间的概念关系框架。
AI.research_question: 领导者的自我利益如何通过自我导向行为（SOB）影响组织和员工结果？这种影响在不同情境下是否会产生不同后果？
AI.motivation: 现有领导力研究主要关注任务导向和人员导向行为，而忽视领导者自身利益（如职业成长、声誉、晋升等）对领导行为的影响。已有关于自私领导和剥削性领导的研究仅聚焦于领导者将自身利益置于他人之上的有害后果，缺乏更全面的概念框架来理解领导者自我利益可能产生的多样性结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文采用概念性研究方法，提出自我导向行为（SOB）作为受领导者个人或职业利益影响的领导行为概念，并建立情境条件、领导者自我利益、自我导向行为与组织和员工结果之间的概念关系模型。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性研究方法，通过文献综合和理论推理提出概念框架与命题。
AI.findings: 自我导向行为在不同情境下可能产生建设性或破坏性结果：当领导者的自我利益鼓励的行为同时有利于员工或组织时产生建设性结果；当追求自我利益损害员工、组织或其他利益相关者时产生破坏性结果。自我导向行为可以与任务导向和人员导向行为并存。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓宽了领导力研究的理论视角，将领导者自我利益纳入领导行为分析框架；提出自我导向行为并非单一负面构念，其结果取决于情境条件；为理解领导行为提供了更全面的概念框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织在选拔、评估和发展领导者时提供参考，帮助识别领导者自我利益在不同情境下可能产生的积极或消极影响；为组织设计领导者激励机制提供理论依据。

title: How Network Effects Shape Firm Entry Strategies

detail.title: How Network Effects Shape Firm Entry Strategies
detail.abstract: There is a common presumption that network effects intensify firms' race to enter first as they seek to secure an incumbency advantage. We explore this possibility in an infinite-horizon model in which two vertically differentiated firms decide whether and when to enter a growing market. Incumbency advantage arises endogenously from consumer beliefs in the post-entry pricing subgame: whenever multiple equilibria exist, consumers coordinate on a focal firm. We compare alternative specifications of focality dynamics. When focality is locked into the first entrant, network effects indeed amplify inefficient early entry. However, when focality adapts quickly to recent market outcomes, network effects can instead mitigate premature entry for sufficiently patient firms by weakening the low-quality firm's preemption incentive. This effect can be surprisingly pronounced in a growing market. With sufficiently patient firms and strong enough network effects, adaptive focality can tilt the entry race in favor of the high-quality firm even more than a focality structure that always favors it.

AI.tldr: 本文研究网络效应对企业进入市场时机的影响。在一个无限期界模型中，两家纵向差异化企业决定是否及何时进入成长中的市场。网络效应是否加剧抢先进入取决于"焦点性"（focality）的动态演变方式：若焦点锁定在首入者，网络效应确实加剧低效的过早进入；若焦点随市场结果快速调整，网络效应反而可能缓解低质量企业的抢先进入激励，甚至在高耐心企业和强网络效应下，使进入竞赛更有利于高质量企业。
AI.research_question: 网络效应是否会加剧企业的抢先进入竞赛？焦点性（focality）的动态演变如何影响这一结果？
AI.motivation: 已有研究普遍认为网络效应会加剧企业抢先进入以获取在位优势，但这一结论可能过于笼统，忽略了消费者信念协调机制（焦点性）的动态变化对均衡结果的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 无限期界进入博弈模型；纵向差异化竞争；事后定价子博弈中的多重均衡与消费者协调；焦点性（focality）动态
AI.method: 构建无限期界理论模型，两家纵向差异化企业决定进入时机；在位优势内生于消费者信念在事后定价子博弈中协调于焦点企业；比较不同焦点性动态设定（锁定式vs.自适应式）下的均衡结果
AI.findings: （1）当焦点性锁定于首入者时，网络效应确实加剧低效的过早进入；（2）当焦点性快速适应近期市场结果时，网络效应可缓解低质量企业的抢先进入激励（对足够耐心的企业）；（3）在成长市场中该效应可能非常显著；（4）在高耐心和强网络效应下，自适应焦点性比"始终偏向高质量企业"的焦点性结构更能使进入竞赛偏向高质量企业。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"网络效应必然加剧抢先进入"的普遍假设，揭示了焦点性动态是决定网络效应方向的关键机制，丰富了进入时机与网络效应交叉领域的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业进入时机决策和反垄断/竞争政策制定提供启示：网络效应的竞争效应并非单向的，需考虑消费者协调信念的动态演变。

title: The Gate Ledger: A Public Panel of Realized Repurchase-Offer Outcomes for U.S. Semi-Liquid Funds, 2012-2026

detail.title: The Gate Ledger: A Public Panel of Realized Repurchase-Offer Outcomes for U.S. Semi-Liquid Funds, 2012-2026
detail.abstract: Semi-liquid investment vehicles-interval funds, tender-offer closed-end funds, and non-traded business development companies (BDCs)-offer periodic, capped repurchases rather than daily redemption. When investors request more than the cap, the fund accepts tenders only pro rata: redemptions are gated. Whether and how hard this binds is a recognized financial-stability question, but the realized outcomes are scattered across thousands of non-standardized shareholder reports and are sold, lagged and incomplete, by commercial vendors. This paper contributes the measurement: a public, machine-readable, EDGAR-sourced, row-auditable cross-vehicle panel-deterministically reproducible from its committed extraction outputs, with the row extraction itself LLM-assisted-of realized repurchase-offer outcomes (offer percentage, shares tendered, percent tendered, fill ratio, and proration) for U.S. semi-liquid funds, 2012-2026. From 568 SEC filings we extract 1,033 provenance-quoted offer rows across 140 funds, identifying 264 realized proration events, with clean quality-assurance flags (0 fill values out of bounds; 0 rows lacking a verbatim source quote). Every row is auditable against its cited filing, and a primary-source audited gold set-30 filings drawn by a pre-registered seeded stratified rule, adjudicated against the original EDGAR documents with a verbatim quote and character offset behind every field-puts measured numbers on data quality: pooled field accuracy 0.882 (95% CI 0.845-0.910), shares repurchased 0.974 and %tendered 0.961, but offer pct only 0.763 and filing-level gating incidence 27/30 = 0.90, all materially below what an earlier blind modelvs-model check implied for the first and last of these. Of 63 disagreements, 42 are omissions of values the filing states plainly and exactly one is a claim the filing contradicts: the panel under-reports rather than invents. We make no new mechanism claim-the run/gating mechanism is established theory (Chen et al., 2010; Goldstein et al., 2017; Vives, 2014). We do report what the panel measures: proration is pervasive where it is observable; among prorated offers the directly-measured median honored fraction (from disclosed share counts) is 0.54, which we separate throughout from a percent-layout proxy (median 0.23) used where share counts are absent (of 264 events, 79 are directly measured, 128 proxy, 57 prose-only). The two bases differ by selection, not proxy error: on the 71 events that disclose both, the proxy and the directly-measured fill agree to a median difference of 0.0001 (largest single-event gap 4.9pp), so the proxy is empirically near-unbiased. The central constraint is instead that BDC severity is not machine-readable: none of the non-traded BDCs report tendered/requested share counts in the structured repurchase tables (nor is there an XBRL tag for it, which we verified against a gating BDC's actual facts), so the panel's count-based fill is null for exactly the vehicle class at the center of the 2026 stress. Reading seven BDC filings end to end for the audit sharpens this: the claim holds for the tables, but 3 of those 7 registrants state tendered share counts elsewhere in the same document—Blue Owl’s two funds file a standardized subsequent-events paragraph giving per-class tendered counts and the accepted-of-tendered percentage verbatim— and 6 of 7 disclose enough to determine the realized fill in some form. The BDC constraint is one of structuring, and part of it is a gap in our own extraction rather than in the disclosure. A deterministic, reproducible census of the 13 non-traded BDCs’ results-note prose recovers the severity nonetheless. As originally run, that census was wrong, and this abstract states the corrected counts. The census reported exactly three gated offers, all Q1-2026, with no other disclosed gate in five years and HPS never gating. A primary-document audit of all 59 determinate cells (§6.7) finds one census cell mislabelled (Golub, recorded as full honor; requests for 8.5% against a 5% offer, accepted pro rata effective 1 May 2026, realized fill 0.588 — a 1.8% [0.3%, 9.4%] mislabelling rate) and a coverage hole (HPS, no panel row after 2023Q4; requests for 9.25% against a 5% offer, realized Q1-2026 fill 0.541). The 2026 stress produced at least five gates among ten funds, not three — four in Q1-2026 proper and Golub’s accepted 1 May — and HPS, named in an earlier version of this abstract as never gating, gated.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个基于EDGAR的、机器可读的、可逐行审计的美国半流动性基金（间隔基金、要约式封闭式基金和非交易型BDC）回购要约结果面板数据（2012-2026），涵盖568份SEC文件、1033行记录、140只基金、264个实际按比例配给事件。通过预注册审计证明数据质量良好但非完美，并发现2026年压力期至少有5次门控（而非3次），HPS基金实际发生了门控。
AI.research_question: 半流动性投资工具（间隔基金、要约式封闭式基金、非交易型BDC）的赎回门控（redemption gating）在实际中的发生频率和严重程度如何？如何系统性地度量这些分散在非标准化股东报告中的实际结果？
AI.motivation: 赎回门控是否以及如何生效是公认的金融稳定问题，但实际结果分散在数千份非标准化股东报告中，商业数据供应商提供的数据滞后且不完整。缺乏系统性的、可审计的实证度量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 赎回/门控机制理论（Chen et al., 2010; Goldstein et al., 2017; Vives, 2014）——投资者先到先得导致挤兑和门控的经典理论框架。
AI.method: 基于EDGAR的LLM辅助行提取方法：从568份SEC文件中提取1,033条带来源引用的回购要约记录；采用预注册的分层随机抽样（30份文件）进行金标审计，用逐字引用和字符偏移对每个字段进行审查；构建确定性可复现的跨载体面板数据。
AI.findings: （1）数据质量：合并字段准确率0.882，回购股数0.974，投标比例0.961，但要约比例仅0.763，文件级门控发生率27/30=0.90；（2）按比例配给在实际中普遍存在，直接测量的中位兑现比例为0.54（代理变量为0.23）；（3）2026年压力期至少有5次门控（Q1四次加Golub 5月1日），非此前报告的3次；HPS实际上发生了门控（Q1-2026兑现比例0.541）；（4）非交易型BDC的严重程度不可机器读取，是其结构性披露限制。
AI.theory_contributions: 为赎回/门控理论提供了首个系统性的、可审计的实证面板数据；表明门控并非理论抽象而是实际普遍发生的现象；纠正了此前关于2026年压力期BDC门控数量的错误认知。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个公开的、机器可读的、可复现的半流动性基金回购结果面板数据；揭示了非交易型BDC信息披露的结构性不足（如无XBRL标签）；为监管者和投资者评估金融稳定风险提供了可靠的数据基础。

title: From City Proxies to Legal Entities: How Measurement Choices Change Climate-risk Inference in Chinese Corporate Bonds

detail.title: From City Proxies to Legal Entities: How Measurement Choices Change Climate-risk Inference in Chinese Corporate Bonds
detail.abstract: Empirical climate-finance results often travel from geographic proxies to firm-level claims without a direct audit of what changes during that transport. This paper conducts such an audit for Chinese corporate bonds. Its starting point is a deliberately constructed twelve-city diagnostic, not a bondpricing estimate: 2024 weather indicators and assigned credit categories generate a positive association with a rating-implied three-year coupon. The design is then transported to a frozen universe of 1,468 Chinese interbank medium-term notes issued by 165 listed legal entities during 2010-2025. Four bridges are examined separately: geographic support and aggregation, constructed versus observed outcomes, benchmark-yield decomposition, and weather-source completeness. Under harmonized outcomes and exposures, city-year, issuer-year, and bond-level estimates are all negative and statistically indistinguishable from zero. In the five-city common-support sample, the observed-coupon coefficient is statistically detectable under restricted wild-cluster inference (p=0.0225), whereas the corresponding issue-premium estimate is only marginal (p=0.0710). Complete ERA5 temperature data preserve a positive association inside the prototype. Separately, a literal city-specific all-day precipitation-percentile count has no cross-city variation under complete daily coverage. The evidence shows that the prototype and full-sample results are not contradictory: they answer different estimands. City proxies are useful diagnostic devices, but their coefficients should not be transported as legal-entity bond-pricing estimates without explicit outcome, support, and data-source bridges.

AI.tldr: 本文对中国企业债券进行了一次"从地理代理到企业层面"的气候金融推断审计，构建了一个十二城市诊断原型后，将其结果迁移到2010-2025年间1,468只中国银行间中期票据的完整样本中。通过分别检验地理支持与聚合、构建结果与观测结果、基准收益率分解、天气数据来源完整性四座"桥梁"，发现当结果变量和暴露度统一后，城市-年份、发行人-年份和债券层面的估计均为负且与零无显著差异。证据表明原型与全样本结果并不矛盾——它们回答的是不同的估计目标。
AI.research_question: 气候金融研究中，从地理代理变量到企业层面债券定价推断的"运输"过程中，哪些环节会导致系数含义发生变化？原型诊断结果能否直接外推为企业层面的债券定价估计？
AI.motivation: 实证气候金融研究常常将地理代理变量的回归结果直接解释为企业层面的结论，但缺乏对两者之间转换链条的系统性审计。本文旨在填补这一方法论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 估计目标（estimand）框架；地理代理到企业层面的推断桥梁理论（地理支持与聚合、构建vs观测结果、基准收益率分解、天气数据完整性）
AI.method: 采用"原型-迁移"审计设计：首先构建一个刻意构造的十二城市诊断（使用2024年天气指标与信用类别对评级隐含三年期票息进行回归），然后将该设计迁移到1,468只中国银行间中期票据（165家上市法人，2010-2025）的完整样本中，分别考察四座桥梁。
AI.findings: (1) 在统一的结果变量和暴露度下，城市-年份、发行人-年份和债券层面的估计均为负且统计上与零无差异；(2) 五城市共同支持样本中，观测票息系数的受限野聚类推断p=0.0225（统计显著），但对应的发行溢价估计仅为边际显著（p=0.0710）；(3) 完整的ERA5温度数据保留了原型内部的正相关；(4) 逐日降水百分位计数在完整日度覆盖下无跨城市变异。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文提出了气候金融中"估计目标"（estimand）的区分框架，阐明地理代理系数与企业层面债券定价估计是两个不同的估计目标，不应被混同。为地理代理到企业层面的推断建立了一个可操作的四桥梁审计方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为气候金融研究者和政策制定者提供了方法论警示：地理代理系数不能直接作为法律实体债券定价估计使用，除非明确建立结果变量、共同支持和数据来源的桥梁；为债券定价中的气候风险纳入提供了更严谨的估计指引。

title: A Land-Based Caloric Framework for Assessing and Predicting Household Food Security in Rural Ethiopia
affiliations: University of South Africa and University of South Africa

detail.title: A Land-Based Caloric Framework for Assessing and Predicting Household Food Security in Rural Ethiopia

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval has been obtained from University of South Africa, College of Human Sciences, Research Ethics Review Committee. The ethical approval reference number is: 64039498_CREC_CHS_2024
declarations.funderStatement: University of South Africa

detail.abstract: Food insecurity represents a critical human security in the global south, where recurrent climatic shocks, structural vulnerabilities, and limited anticipatory capacities expose rural households to severe livelihood risks. In protracted agrarian contexts such as Ethiopia, the inability to predict and respond to food insecurity in a timely manner can result in significant consequences for human wellbeing and survival. This study examines household food security using a calorie-based analytical framework that integrates own-farm production and income-based food access within a land size-stratified modelling approach. Quantitative data were collected from 420 randomly selected rural households, complemented by qualitative interviews with key informants. Household caloric availability was estimated by converting crop production and net income into kilocalorie equivalents and assessed using a modified Foster-Greer-Thorbecke index anchored to the Sphere minimum standard of 2,100 kcal per person per day. The findings indicate that 60.2% of households were food insecure during the September 2023-August 2024 reference period, with substantial caloric deficits among affected populations. Binary logistic regression results identify farmland size, household size, and livestock ownership as key determinants of food security, with land emerging as a central productive asset shaping household resilience. Stratified analysis reveals clear disparities in caloric adequacy across landholding categories, enabling identification of the most vulnerable groups. Building on these results, the study proposes a land-value-based caloric prediction framework capable of forecasting food insecurity under changing production, income, and price conditions, while providing a practical and data-efficient tool to support anticipatory food security interventions in Ethiopia. Significance of main findings This study demonstrates that food insecurity in rural Ethiopia is deeply rooted in structural inequalities, particularly landholding size and household composition, rather than solely climatic shocks. By integrating farm production and income into a unified caloric framework, it reveals substantial hidden deficits in household food access. The study's key contribution lies in the development of a land-based predictive model that enables forward-looking identification of vulnerable populations. This approach enhances analytical precision and provides a practical, scalable tool for strengthening early warning systems, improving targeting, and supporting anticipatory interventions in data-constrained humanitarian settings.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过卡路里分析框架评估埃塞俄比亚农村家庭粮食安全状况，发现60.2%的家庭在2023年9月至2024年8月期间面临粮食不安全，并基于土地价值开发了一个能够预测粮食不安全的预警模型。
AI.research_question: 埃塞俄比亚农村家庭粮食安全的决定因素是什么？如何构建一个能够预测和预警粮食不安全的分析框架？
AI.motivation: 全球南方地区面临反复的气候冲击、结构性脆弱性和有限的预测能力，使农村家庭遭受严重的生计风险。在埃塞俄比亚等长期农业社会中，无法及时预测和应对粮食不安全会对人类福祉和生存产生重大后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于卡路里的分析框架，整合自有农场生产和收入为基础的粮食获取，采用土地面积分层建模方法，并使用修正的Foster-Greer-Thorbecke指数。
AI.method: 采用混合方法：从420个随机选取的农村家庭收集定量数据，辅以关键知情人定性访谈。将作物生产和净收入转换为千卡等值评估卡路里可得性，使用以Sphere最低标准（每人每天2100千卡）为基准的修正FGT指数，并运用二元逻辑回归和分层分析。
AI.findings: 60.2%的家庭在参考期内粮食不安全，卡路里赤字显著。农田面积、家庭规模和牲畜拥有量是粮食安全的关键决定因素，土地是塑造家庭韧性的核心生产性资产。分层分析揭示了不同土地持有类别之间卡路里充足率的明显差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 将农业生产和收入整合到统一的卡路里框架中，揭示了家庭粮食获取中大量隐藏的赤字；开发了基于土地的预测模型，能够前瞻性地识别脆弱人群。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种实用、可扩展的工具，用于加强早期预警系统、改善目标定位，并支持数据受限人道主义环境中的预测性干预。

title: Fiscal Federalism Revisited: Autonomy, Investment, and Economic Flexibility in Nepal

detail.title: Fiscal Federalism Revisited: Autonomy, Investment, and Economic Flexibility in Nepal
detail.abstract: Nepal adopted a federal constitution in 2015 and started the implementation of federalism in earnest after the 2017 elections. The new system is divided into three levels of government one federal government, seven provincial governments and 753 local governments. The paper revisits fiscal federalism in Nepal through three interlinked issues: the autonomy of subnational governments, their capacity to invest in public goods and services and the economic resilience of the federal system as a whole. The study based on available data shows that Nepal's fiscal federalism is still highly centralized in terms of revenue collection while expenditure responsibilities have been devolved to provinces and local governments. Subnational governments have weak own-source revenues and are highly dependent on federal transfers. There is little capital investment and it is poorly implemented owing to inadequate planning, delays in procurement and limited technical capacity. Heavy reliance on remittances, a narrow tax base, recurrent natural disasters and external shocks such as the COVID-19 pandemic challenge economic resilience. The paper ends with recommendations for improving fiscal autonomy, investment efficiency and building longterm economic resilience in Nepal’s federal arrangement.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了尼泊尔自2015年联邦宪法颁布及2017年选举后实施的财政联邦制，通过三个相互关联的议题（地方政府自治、公共物品投资能力、整体经济韧性）进行分析，发现尼泊尔财政联邦制在收入集权与支出分权之间存在严重失衡，地方政府自有财源薄弱、高度依赖联邦转移支付，资本投资不足且执行效率低下，经济韧性面临多重挑战，并据此提出改善财政自治、投资效率和长期经济韧性的政策建议。
AI.research_question: 尼泊尔联邦制下的财政联邦主义运行状况如何？具体包括：次国家级政府的财政自治程度、其投资于公共物品和服务的能力，以及整个联邦系统的经济韧性。
AI.motivation: 尼泊尔在2015年通过联邦宪法并于2017年选举后正式开始实施联邦制，建立了三级政府结构（1个联邦政府、7个省级政府和753个地方政府），然而新体制下的财政安排存在诸多挑战，有必要对其实施效果进行系统性审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政联邦主义理论，涉及财政分权、政府间转移支付、财政自治与经济韧性等相关理论框架。
AI.method: 基于现有可得数据进行实证分析，从财政自治、投资能力和经济韧性三个维度对尼泊尔财政联邦制进行系统评估。
AI.findings: （1）收入征管高度集中，支出责任已下放至省级和地方政府，形成收支不匹配；（2）次国家级政府自有收入薄弱，严重依赖联邦转移支付；（3）资本投资规模小且实施质量差，原因包括规划不足、采购延迟和技术能力有限；（4）经济韧性面临严峻挑战，包括对汇款高度依赖、税基狭窄、频发的自然灾害以及新冠疫情等外部冲击。
AI.theory_contributions: 为财政联邦主义理论在发展中国家（尤其南亚地区）的应用提供了案例证据，揭示了联邦转型初期财政分权不匹配的典型困境。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼泊尔财政联邦制的完善提供具体政策建议，涵盖提升财政自治、改善投资效率与构建长期经济韧性三个维度，对类似发展中国家具有参考价值。

title: Explainable Artificial Intelligence for Dynamic Credit Risk Assessment: X-DyAR, an Additive Temporal Residual Fusion Framework for Financial Institutions

detail.title: Explainable Artificial Intelligence for Dynamic Credit Risk Assessment: X-DyAR, an Additive Temporal Residual Fusion Framework for Financial Institutions
detail.abstract: Credit risk models used at loan origination are typically built from applicant-level attributes observed at a single decision point, while economic conditions evolve and can alter the background probability of default. Adding external time series to a strong tabular model is technically non-trivial in regulated settings: naive fusion can introduce temporal leakage, opaque crosssource interactions can make explanations difficult to audit, and an external data outage can destabilize production predictions. This paper proposes X-DyAR (Explainable Dynamic Additive Residual Fusion), a concrete hybrid deep-learning method that augments a CatBoost applicationtime backbone with a gated recurrent unit (GRU) that learns a month-level residual log-odds adjustment from lagged macroeconomic trajectories. The architecture is additive by construction: the final logit equals the static CatBoost logit plus one dynamic source contribution. TreeSHAP decomposes the static component into applicant features, while the dynamic residual is an exact source-level contribution; their sum reconstructs the prediction to floating-point precision. A source-availability gate and source-level temporal dropout provide an exact fallback to the static model when the external source is entirely unavailable. We evaluate the method on a real Lending Club granting dataset with 1,347,681 loans and a common leakage-controlled cohort of 1,335,335 loans, fused with monthly U.S. unemployment, policy-rate, inflation, 10-year Treasury-yield, and yield-slope signals. Training uses loans through 2015, validation uses 2016, and all 225,277 loans from 2017-2018 form the out-of-time test. The best six-month X-DyAR model attains AUROC 0.68329, AUPRC 0.35520, Brier 0.15586, log loss 0.48209, and 15-bin ECE 0.01109, versus 0.68194, 0.35298, 0.15790, 0.48825, and 0.04109 for the strong static CatBoost baseline. The AUROC gain is deliberately reported as small rather than overstated; a paired bootstrap using 100 resamples of 25,000 test loans yields an empirical AUROC-difference interval of [0.00053, 0.00225]. Ablations, 3/6/12-month sensitivity, source-missingness stress tests, year-wise analysis, FICO-stratified analysis, and exact explanation-completeness checks show that the main benefit is a transparent, robust dynamic calibration layer rather than a dramatic within-year ranking improvement. The results support additive temporal residual fusion as a practical design pattern when financial institutions need dynamic probability adjustment without surrendering auditability or safe fallback behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出X-DyAR（可解释动态加性残差融合）方法，将CatBoost静态评分模型与GRU动态时序残差模型以加性方式融合，在保持可审计性和安全回退的同时，为贷款审批场景提供动态概率校准。在Lending Club真实数据集上验证，六个月的X-DyAR模型在AUROC等指标上小幅但显著优于强静态CatBoost基线，核心价值在于透明、稳健的动态校准层而非大幅的排序能力提升。
AI.research_question: 如何在监管严格的信贷审批场景中，安全地将外部宏观经济时序数据融入强静态表格模型，以动态调整违约概率，同时不损害可解释性、可审计性和生产稳定性？
AI.motivation: 信贷风险模型通常在单一决策点基于申请人属性构建，但经济环境变化会改变背景违约概率。将外部时间序列融入强表格模型存在技术难点：朴素融合会引入时间泄漏、不透明的跨源交互难以审计、外部数据中断会破坏生产预测稳定性。因此需要一种既能动态调整又保持可解释性和稳健性的融合方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 加性残差融合框架（Additive Residual Fusion）、可解释机器学习（TreeSHAP）、门控循环单元（GRU）、时序泄漏控制、源级可解释性。
AI.method: X-DyAR采用加性架构：最终logit = CatBoost静态logit + GRU动态残差logit。静态部分用TreeSHAP分解为申请人特征贡献，动态残差作为精确的源级贡献。设计源可用性门控和源级时序dropout实现外部源完全不可用时的精确回退到静态模型。在Lending Club数据集（1,347,681笔贷款）上使用月度美国失业率、政策利率、通胀、10年期国债收益率和收益率斜率信号进行训练与测试。
AI.findings: 最佳六个月X-DyAR模型AUROC 0.68329、AUPRC 0.35520、Brier 0.15586、log loss 0.48209、15-bin ECE 0.01109，优于静态CatBoost基线（0.68194/0.35298/0.15790/0.48825/0.04109）。配对bootstrap的AUROC差异区间为[0.00053, 0.00225]，提升幅度小但统计显著。消融实验和压力测试表明主要收益是透明稳健的动态校准层，而非大幅的年内排序提升。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并验证了加性时序残差融合作为一种实用性设计模式，为监管环境下的动态信用风险建模提供了理论框架，即在不放弃可审计性和安全回退的前提下实现动态概率调整。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供了可直接落地的混合深度学习方案：具有精确的可解释性（预测可分解到浮点精度）、外部数据中断时的安全回退机制、以及显著改善的校准性能（ECE从0.04109降至0.01109），兼顾监管合规和生产稳定性。

reference: Cambridge Elements in International Relations, Cambridge University Press, 2026, DOI: https://doi.org/10.1017/9781009638050
title: When Hedging Fails: Structural Uncertainty, Protective Options, and Geopolitical (Im-)Prudence in Smaller Powers' Behaviour
affiliations: University of New South Wales (UNSW)

detail.title: When Hedging Fails: Structural Uncertainty, Protective Options, and Geopolitical (Im-)Prudence in Smaller Powers' Behaviour

publicationDetails.detailsText: Cambridge Elements in International Relations, Cambridge University Press, 2026, DOI: https://doi.org/10.1017/9781009638050

detail.abstract: Hedging has been widely viewed as an optimal foreign policy for small and middle powers. However, hedging was more effective in some cases than others and turned out to be detrimental for some states. This Element contributes to the knowledge about hedging by explaining why some smaller powers can hedge successfully between competing great powers while others fail to and suffer serious harm. It develops a theoretical model consisting of international-systemic and state-level variables that determine hedging outcomes. It then tests the model using cases in the post-Soviet space and Southeast Asia exposed to great power rivalry but exhibiting different hedging outcomes. It shows that hedging failure occurs due to changes in three key variables-structural uncertainty, availability of protective options, and decisionmakers' geopolitical prudence-and interactions between them. The article highlights the limits to smaller power hedging and argues that hedging should not be taken for granted.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了中小国家在大国竞争中进行对冲（hedging）外交的有效性问题，解释了为何有些中小国家能成功对冲而另一些则失败并遭受严重损害。作者构建了一个包含国际体系层面和国家层面变量的理论模型，并通过后苏联空间和东南亚的案例进行检验，识别出导致对冲失败的三个关键变量：结构性不确定性、保护性选项的可获得性以及决策者的地缘政治审慎性。
AI.research_question: 为什么一些中小国家能够在竞争性大国之间成功进行对冲战略，而另一些国家却失败并遭受严重损害？
AI.motivation: 对冲被广泛视为中小国家的最优外交策略，但在实践中并非总是有效，有时甚至对某些国家产生反效果。现有研究未能充分解释对冲结果为何存在差异，因此需要系统性的理论框架来解答这一问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该模型整合了国际体系层面变量（结构性不确定性、保护性选项的可获得性）与国家层面变量（决策者的地缘政治审慎性），并强调三者之间的交互作用决定对冲成败。
AI.method: 理论模型构建加案例比较分析，选取后苏联空间和东南亚地区受大国竞争影响但呈现不同对冲结果的国家案例进行检验。
AI.findings: 对冲失败源于三个关键变量的变化及其交互作用：结构性不确定性、保护性选项的可获得性以及决策者的地缘政治审慎性。研究揭示了对冲战略的局限性，说明对冲不应被视为理所当然有效的策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了对冲战略研究中对结果差异解释不足的空白，提出了一个整合体系层面与国家层面变量的综合理论模型，并强调变量间的交互作用机制，丰富了中小国家外交战略的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中小国家决策者提供了对冲战略的边界条件和风险警示，帮助其认识到对冲并非万能策略，需根据结构性环境和自身条件审慎评估对冲的可行性。

title: Economic Freedom and Fertility Rates: Evidence from Cross-country Panel Data

detail.title: Economic Freedom and Fertility Rates: Evidence from Cross-country Panel Data

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that they have no conflict of interest relevant to the content of this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study used publicly available data and did not involve direct human participants, so no ethical approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: No specific funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: This study examines the causal relationship between economic freedom and fertility rates using crosscountry panel data. While fertility determinants are well-researched, the role of economic freedom remains underexplored. Applying fixed-effects instrumental variable (IV) analysis with regulatory quality as an instrument. I find robust evidence that economic freedom negatively impacts fertility, particularly in industrialised and high-income countries. Instrumental variable quantile regression reveals heterogeneous effects, characterised by declines in high-fertility countries, through the identification of three key transmission channels: higher income, lower female unemployment, and increased access to tertiary education. These findings advance understanding of how economic freedom shapes demographic trends, offering insights for sustainable development policies.

AI.tldr: 本文利用跨国面板数据，通过固定效应工具变量（IV）分析，以监管质量作为工具变量，实证检验经济自由与生育率之间的因果关系，发现经济自由对生育率有显著的负向影响，尤其在工业化和高收入国家表现明显，并通过收入提升、女性失业率下降和高等教育普及三个渠道发挥作用。
AI.research_question: 经济自由是否以及如何影响生育率？
AI.motivation: 生育率决定因素已有大量研究，但经济自由对生育率的作用尚未得到充分探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济自由理论、生育率决定理论
AI.method: 跨国面板数据的固定效应工具变量（IV）分析，以监管质量作为工具变量；辅以工具变量分位数回归（IVQR）考察异质性效应。
AI.findings: 经济自由对生育率有显著负向影响，尤其在工业化与高收入国家；分位数回归显示高生育率国家的下降更为明显；识别出三个传导渠道：收入提高、女性失业率下降、高等教育可及性增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 将经济自由纳入生育率决定因素的分析框架，拓展了经济制度与人口学交叉领域的研究；通过IV识别出因果效应，克服了以往研究的内生性问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为可持续发展和人口政策的制定提供实证依据，帮助政策制定者理解经济自由化进程对人口结构变化的潜在影响。

title: Artificial Intelligence Architecture for Data-Driven Economic Analysis
affiliations: International Islamic University Islamabad and International Islamic University Islamabad

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence Architecture for Data-Driven Economic Analysis
detail.abstract: This paper presents an artificial intelligence (AI) architecture for economic analysis, describing the integration of AI components from data inputs to decision outputs. Specifically, it exhibits a layered AI architecture comprising data layers, intelligence layers, and decision layers for key economic analysis, which progresses from traditional AI to generative AI and then to agentic AI. This paper demonstrates the integration of economic data, AI, and machine-learning models and applications that convert output into economic insights. It explores the transition from descriptive statistics to predictive insights, from predictive insights to economic narratives, and from economic narratives to autonomous decision-making. Further, it shows an economic evolution perspective on AI, from traditional AI to generative AI to agentic AI, which represents a shift in economic intelligence from static analysis to creative modeling and, eventually, to autonomous economic reasoning. Moreover, it develops country-specific use cases for AI-driven economic analysis, including inflation forecasting, financial and credit risk assessment, policy impact analysis, and fiscal allocation optimization with a focus on emerging economy such as Pakistan.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于经济分析的人工智能架构，从数据输入到决策输出整合了AI组件，构建了包含数据层、智能层和决策层的分层架构，展示了从传统AI到生成式AI再到智能体AI的演进路径，并通过巴基斯坦等新兴经济体的具体案例（通胀预测、金融信用风险评估、政策影响分析和财政分配优化）加以验证。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够整合数据、智能和决策的完整AI架构，以支持经济分析从描述性统计到自主决策的演进？
AI.motivation: 传统经济分析主要依赖描述性统计和静态模型，缺乏从数据到决策的端到端AI整合架构；同时AI技术（从传统AI到生成式AI再到智能体AI）的快速发展为经济分析提供了新的可能性，但缺乏系统性的架构框架来指导其应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分层AI架构理论（数据层-智能层-决策层）；AI演进理论（传统AI→生成式AI→智能体AI）；经济智能演进视角（静态分析→创造性建模→自主经济推理）
AI.method: 架构设计与概念性框架构建，辅以国家层面（巴基斯坦）的具体用例演示，涵盖通胀预测、金融和信用风险评估、政策影响分析和财政分配优化等实际应用场景。
AI.findings: 提出了一个完整的分层AI经济分析架构，实现了从描述性统计到预测性洞察、从预测性洞察到经济叙事、从经济叙事到自主决策的三阶段转换，并通过新兴经济体用例展示了该架构的可行性与应用价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地将传统AI、生成式AI和智能体AI整合到一个统一的分层经济分析架构中，提出了经济智能从静态分析到创造性建模再到自主推理的演进视角，为经济分析与AI的交叉研究提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和经济分析人员提供了可操作的AI经济分析架构蓝图；通过巴基斯坦等新兴经济体的具体用例，展示了AI在经济预测、风险评估、政策分析和财政优化中的实际应用价值，特别是在数据受限的发展中国家场景中。

reference: https://www.theigc.org/sites/default/files/2026-03/Al-Masaeid-Final-Report-March-2026.pdf
title:
Jordan's Employment and Unemployment 
Key Insights From Labour Market Panel Survey

detail.title:
Jordan's Employment and Unemployment 
Key Insights From Labour Market Panel Survey
detail.abstract: Jordan continues to struggle with some of the world's highest unemployment rates and lowest labour force participation. Despite investments in education and economic reforms, its labour market consistently underperforms globally. Evidence from Jordan and other countries confirms that labour-market underperformance is driven by multiple factors rather than a single cause, requiring a multi-pronged policy response. Achieving the first goal of the economic modernisation vision, which targets integrating over one million young Jordanians into the workforce by 2033, requires innovative ways of thinking about the challenges and new policy approaches, including strategies to address both unemployed and employed individuals, their characteristics, and employment mobility, grounded in evidence. Using the latest available data in Jordan, the labour market panel survey (JLMPS) 2025, this study analyses the characteristics of the employed and unemployed to identify the specific interventions needed to support these national objectives at the micro level.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用约旦2025年劳动力市场面板调查（JLMPS）数据，对就业者和失业者的特征进行微观分析，旨在识别支持约旦经济现代化愿景中"2033年前将超过100万青年约旦人纳入劳动力队伍"目标所需的针对性政策干预措施。
AI.research_question: 约旦就业者和失业者各自具有哪些特征？这些特征指向哪些具体的微观层面政策干预措施，以支持约旦将100万青年纳入劳动力的国家目标？
AI.motivation: 约旦长期面临全球最高失业率和最低劳动力参与率之一，尽管进行了教育投资和经济改革，劳动力市场表现依然不佳。过往证据表明劳动力市场表现不佳由多重因素驱动，需要多管齐下的政策回应，因此需要基于最新数据的实证分析来指导政策制定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场分割理论、人力资本理论、就业流动性分析框架
AI.method: 使用约旦劳动力市场面板调查（JLMPS）2025年最新数据，对就业者和失业者特征进行描述性和比较性统计分析，识别就业与非就业群体的关键特征差异。
AI.findings: 约旦劳动力市场表现不佳由多种因素共同驱动而非单一原因所致；就业者和失业者具有不同的特征组合，需要有针对性的差异化干预策略；应同时关注失业者和在职者的特征及就业流动性问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了发展中国家（尤其是中东地区）劳动力市场微观分析的实证研究，为多因素驱动的劳动力市场失灵理论提供了约旦的最新证据支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为约旦经济现代化愿景中"2033年整合100万青年进入劳动力队伍"的目标提供了基于证据的微观层面政策建议，有助于制定针对失业者和在职者的差异化干预措施，支持就业流动性改善。

title: Does Gatekeeper Regulation Benefit Small Businesses? Seller-level Evidence from the EU Digital Markets Act
affiliations: Hangzhou Dianzi University and

detail.title: Does Gatekeeper Regulation Benefit Small Businesses? Seller-level Evidence from the EU Digital Markets Act
detail.abstract: Did the EU Digital Markets Act (DMA) raise the revenue of the small businesses it was designed to protect? We build two complementary seller-level panels around the DMA’s March 2024 compliance deadline: a marketplace panel following roughly 25,000 third-party sellers monthly across nine Amazon marketplaces (four treated EU sites; the UK, US, Canada, Mexico, and Japan as controls), with revenue imputed from externally calibrated sales rank curves; and an official-accounts panel linking 24,700 sellers to registry financials through legally mandated identity disclosure. Both layers return a precisely estimated zero for the first 2.3 posttreatment years: the marketplace estimate is +1.0 log point (SE 3.1), with an exact permutation p of 0.90 across all 126 treatment assignments, and the exposure gradient runs against the self preferencing channel: sellers most exposed to Amazon’s first-party presence fared relatively worse. We also document two ways early DMA evaluations can manufacture positive effects, pooling over differential pre-trends and relying on small control pools, and show that seller financial visibility varies twelvefold across the euro area, so official data alone observe an unrepresentative minority of larger sellers.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了两个互补的卖家层面面板数据，评估欧盟《数字市场法案》(DMA) 对小型企业收入的影响。结果显示，在DMA合规截止日期后的前2.3年内，四届受影响的欧盟亚马逊市场上的小型卖家收入增长恰好为零（精确估计），且暴露梯度与自我优待渠道相悖。文章还揭示了早期DMA评估可能制造正面效应的两种方式，以及官方数据在欧元区的不均衡覆盖问题。
AI.research_question: 欧盟《数字市场法案》(DMA) 是否提高了其旨在保护的小型企业的收入？
AI.motivation: DMA是欧盟针对大型数字平台（守门人）的重要监管立法，其核心目标之一是保护小型企业免受平台自我优待等行为的侵害。然而，DMA的实际经济影响缺乏严格的实证评估。已有评估可能因方法论缺陷（如合并差异前趋势、依赖小型对照组）而得出误导性结论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于DMA自我优待条款的监管经济学理论，以及平台市场中的守门人行为理论；利用差异中差异（DID）和置换检验的因果推断框架。
AI.method: 构建两个互补的数据面板：(1) 市场面板：追踪约25,000名第三方卖家在9个亚马逊市场（4个欧盟受治疗站点，英国、美国、加拿大、墨西哥、日本为对照组）的月度数据，收入从外部校准的销售排名曲线中推算；(2) 官方账户面板：通过法律要求的身分披露，将24,700名卖家与其注册财务数据关联。采用置换检验评估统计显著性。
AI.findings: 两个数据层面均精确估计出DMA后2.3年内收入变化为零：市场面板估计值为+1.0对数点（标准误3.1），在126种治疗分配中的精确置换p值为0.90。暴露梯度与自我优待渠道相悖——最受亚马逊自营业务影响的卖家反而表现相对更差。此外，发现早期DMA评估可能通过合并差异前趋势和使用小型对照组来制造正面效果；欧元区卖家财务可见性差异达12倍，官方数据仅观察到代表性不足的大型卖家少数群体。
AI.theory_contributions: 为DMA监管效果提供了首个严格的大样本因果证据，表明DMA在短期内并未实现其提升小型卖家收入的目标；提出了早期政策评估中常见的方法论陷阱（差异前趋势合并、小对照组问题）并展示了其如何产生误导性结论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟政策制定者提供了DMA短期效果评估的重要证据基础，指出需要更长时间窗口和更稳健的方法来评估DMA；揭示了官方监管数据在欧元区覆盖不均的问题，为改进数据基础设施提供建议；对平台监管合规决策具有参考价值。

title: The Economics of Climate Adaptation in the Age of Compounding Risks: How fiscal systems, sovereign spreads, and public‑investment efficiency shape national resilience trajectories

detail.title: The Economics of Climate Adaptation in the Age of Compounding Risks: How fiscal systems, sovereign spreads, and public‑investment efficiency shape national resilience trajectories
detail.abstract:
Climate adaptation is commonly framed as an engineering challenge, but the report demonstrates that its true binding constraint is financial. Climate shocks propagate through a compounding fiscal‑financial loop in which disasters widen sovereign spreads, higher spreads erode fiscal space, and reduced fiscal space suppresses adaptation investment—raising exposure to the next shock. This resilience trap means that vulnerability is priced into sovereign credit before losses occur, amplifying risk for countries least able to bear it. As the report notes, “the shortfall is not a funding nuisance; it is the mechanism by which physical climate risk converts into fiscal and financial risk.”

The report identifies three subsystems that jointly determine national resilience trajectories:

  1. Fiscal capacity—the ability to absorb shocks without crowding out development.

  2. Sovereign cost of capital—the spread channel through which climate risk raises borrowing costs.

  3. Public‑investment efficiency—the conversion rate of adaptation finance into real protection.

Empirical evidence shows rising catastrophe losses, a widening global protection gap, and a persistent climate‑vulnerability premium in sovereign spreads. Public‑investment inefficiency—estimated at roughly 30% leakage—further constrains resilience. Together, these forces create a self‑reinforcing equilibrium that traps vulnerable states in deteriorating fiscal positions.

The report outlines three intervention points that can break the loop: climate‑resilient debt instruments, risk‑transfer mechanisms, and efficiency‑driven public‑investment reform. Case studies from Barbados, Ecuador, and St Vincent and the Grenadines show that re‑engineering sovereign liabilities—via debt‑for‑nature swaps, contingent debt clauses, and parametric insurance—can materially expand fiscal space when shocks strike.

The report concludes with a typology that maps countries by sovereign‑spread levels and investment efficiency, revealing four distinct resilience trajectories. Its binding directive: “Treat climate adaptation as a balance‑sheet problem before an infrastructure problem.”

AI.tldr: 本文档论证气候适应的真正约束并非工程挑战，而是金融约束。气候冲击通过"财政-金融复合循环"传导：灾害扩大主权利差，利差侵蚀财政空间，财政空间不足抑制适应投资，进而加大下一次冲击的暴露度，形成"韧性陷阱"。报告识别了财政能力、主权资本成本和公共投资效率三个子系统，并提出气候韧性债务工具、风险转移机制和效率驱动的公共投资改革三个干预点，以打破这一自我强化的恶性循环。
AI.research_question: 气候适应为何在财政金融层面失败？如何打破气候风险向财政与金融风险的传导循环，从而提升脆弱国家的气候韧性？
AI.motivation: 传统上将气候适应视为工程问题，但实际上真正的瓶颈在于金融约束。气候脆弱性在损失发生前就已通过主权利差被定价，形成"资金缺口即风险传导机制"的恶性循环，导致最无力承担风险的国家反而被放大风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: "韧性陷阱"框架：灾害→主权利差扩大→财政空间侵蚀→适应投资减少→暴露度上升→下一次灾害更严重，形成自强化均衡。该框架包含三个子系统：财政能力、主权资本成本（利差渠道）、公共投资效率。
AI.method: 基于实证证据分析（灾害损失数据、全球保护缺口、主权利差中的气候脆弱性溢价）和案例研究（巴巴多斯、厄瓜多尔、圣文森特和格林纳丁斯），构建国家韧性轨迹的类型学分类。
AI.findings: （1）公共投资效率低下，约30%的投入存在泄漏；（2）气候脆弱性溢价持续存在于主权利差中；（3）灾害损失上升与全球保护缺口扩大并存；（4）通过债务换自然互换、或有债务条款和参数保险等主权负债重构手段，可在冲击发生时实质性地扩大财政空间；（5）按主权利差水平和投资效率可识别出四种不同的国家韧性轨迹。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"韧性陷阱"概念，揭示资金缺口不仅是融资问题，更是物理气候风险转化为财政与金融风险的核心机制；将气候适应重新定义为资产负债表问题而非基础设施问题，为气候金融研究提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出三个可操作的干预点：气候韧性债务工具、风险转移机制、效率驱动的公共投资改革；提供主权负债重构的具体政策工具（债务换自然、或有债务条款、参数保险）；构建国家韧性轨迹类型学，为政策制定者提供分类施策的决策框架。

title: Climate‑Tech Diffusion and Inclusive Growth: How Adaptation Technologies Reshape Productivity, Inequality, And Resilience in Emerging Markets

detail.title: Climate‑Tech Diffusion and Inclusive Growth: How Adaptation Technologies Reshape Productivity, Inequality, And Resilience in Emerging Markets
detail.abstract:
Adaptation technology is emerging as one of the most powerful yet under‑utilized levers for inclusive growth in a warming world. Although climate change reduces global incomes and disproportionately harms tropical, low‑income economies, the technologies that avert these damages—stress‑tolerant seed, irrigation, cooling, early‑warning systems, and climate‑resilient infrastructure—deliver their highest marginal returns exactly where incomes are lowest. As the report states, “adaptation technology is the rare class of innovation whose benefits are structurally tilted toward the poor” and “the binding constraint on inclusive growth under climate change is not the availability of adaptation technology but the governance of its diffusion.”

The report demonstrates that adaptation’s productivity dividend is large and well‑documented: avoided losses, higher yields, preserved labor productivity, and sharply reduced mortality. Yet these gains remain unrealized at scale because diffusion consistently fails at the stages of affordability, adoption, and complementary investment. Credit constraints, insecure land tenure, information gaps, gender disparities, and risk aversion filter out precisely the households and firms that would benefit most. As a result, adaptation gaps become inequality engines, widening productivity differences between adopters and non‑adopters and pushing vulnerable populations toward poverty traps.

Through case studies—from drought‑tolerant maize in Sub‑Saharan Africa to Bangladesh’s cyclone‑preparedness system—the report shows that inclusive outcomes emerge only when the diffusion channel is deliberately engineered to be pro‑poor. The synthesis introduces the adaptation diffusion funnel, a five‑stage model explaining where leakage occurs and how policy can close it. The conclusion is direct: adaptation is not a technology problem but a governance problem, and inclusive growth depends on treating every adoption decision as a distributional intervention.

AI.tldr: 本报告指出，适应技术是气候变化下包容性增长最有力但尚未充分利用的杠杆之一。适应技术对低收入经济体的边际回报最高，其传播瓶颈并非技术可用性，而是治理问题。报告提出"适应扩散漏斗"五阶段模型，解释扩散失败发生在可负担性、采纳和互补投资等环节，主张包容性增长取决于将每次采纳决策视为再分配干预。
AI.research_question: 适应技术为何未能在全球范围内实现大规模扩散，以及如何通过治理机制使适应技术的传播偏向穷人，从而实现气候变化下的包容性增长？
AI.motivation: 气候变化对低收入热带经济体造成不成比例的损害，而适应技术（耐旱种子、灌溉、冷却、预警系统、气候韧性基础设施）在这些地区恰恰有最高的边际回报。然而这些技术并未得到大规模采用，扩散失败成为不平等加剧的重要引擎，需要系统性分析扩散瓶颈并设计亲穷人的传播机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 适应扩散漏斗模型（五阶段模型），涵盖可负担性、采纳、互补投资等扩散环节的泄漏点分析；扩散经济学与分配正义理论的结合。
AI.method: 综合报告/案例研究法，通过撒哈拉以南非洲耐旱玉米、孟加拉国气旋防备系统等多个案例，比较包容性结果与排他性结果产生的条件。
AI.findings: 适应技术的生产力红利巨大且有充分文献支持（避免损失、提高产量、保持劳动生产力、大幅降低死亡率），但这些收益未能大规模实现。扩散在可负担性、采纳和互补投资阶段系统性失败，原因包括信贷约束、土地使用权不稳定、信息鸿沟、性别差异和风险厌恶。这些因素恰好过滤掉最需要受益的家庭和企业，使适应差距成为不平等引擎，推动弱势群体陷入贫困陷阱。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"适应扩散漏斗"五阶段模型，将适应技术的扩散问题系统化理论化，确立"适应不是技术问题而是治理问题"的核心命题，将采纳决策重新概念化为再分配干预工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供可操作的扩散瓶颈诊断框架和政策干预方向，通过案例证明亲穷人扩散渠道设计的可行性与有效性，指导在实践中将适应技术传播纳入包容性增长战略。

title: Unveiling the Metamorphosis of Worldwide Power Commerce Configurations During the Heart of the SARS-CoV-2 Crisis
affiliations: Harbin Industry University

detail.title: Unveiling the Metamorphosis of Worldwide Power Commerce Configurations During the Heart of the SARS-CoV-2 Crisis
detail.abstract: The catastrophic biological crisis originating in late 2019 precipitated unprecedented macroeconomic disruptions, violently reconfiguring the cross-border exchange architectures of conventional fossil commodities. This investigation meticulously maps the topological metamorphosis of planetary power commerce—specifically isolating unrefined petroleum, anthracite, and methane—trapped within the most volatile temporal windows of the global blockades. Deploying advanced complex systems theory and processing high-frequency, monthly transactional ledgers spanning from the final month of 2019 through the conclusion of 2021, we mathematically decode the microscopic structural mutations governing international resource logistics. The empirical outcomes definitively confirm a severe planetary contraction in aggregate commercial volume, executing alongside a dangerous hyper-concentration of logistical burdens upon a microscopically small fraction of active bilateral pipelines. Furthermore, the algorithmic evaluations expose profound systemic asymmetries dictated directly by sovereign macroeconomic wealth; high-income nations successfully monopolized topological centrality and secured vastly denser clustering networks when benchmarked against marginalized lower-income economies. Crucially, the architectural topographies of specific commodities experienced radically divergent evolutionary trajectories during the biological storm. The global methane matrix suffered catastrophic structural instability, forcing its supreme export epicenter to violently migrate from the Middle Eastern theater toward the West African coast, before finally fracturing and dispersing between the United States and the Russian Federation.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用复杂系统理论与高频月度贸易数据，系统分析了2019年底至2021年底疫情期间全球三大化石能源（原油、煤炭、天然气）跨境贸易网络的拓扑结构演变，发现全球贸易总量严重收缩、贸易通道高度集中化，且高收入国家在拓扑中心性和聚类密度上占据绝对优势，同时不同能源商品呈现出截然不同的结构性演化路径。
AI.research_question: 新冠疫情引发的全球封锁期间，国际化石能源贸易网络（原油、煤炭、天然气）的拓扑结构发生了怎样的微观结构突变？不同收入层级国家间存在怎样的系统性不对称？不同能源商品的结构演化轨迹是否存在显著差异？
AI.motivation: 新冠疫情作为自2019年底爆发的灾难性生物危机，对全球宏观经济和跨境能源贸易架构造成了前所未有的冲击，但现有研究缺乏对这一时期国际能源贸易网络微观结构变异的高频、系统性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 复杂系统理论（Complex Systems Theory），具体应用于国际贸易网络分析、拓扑结构演化研究以及能源地缘经济分析。
AI.method: 采用复杂系统理论与算法分析方法，处理2019年12月至2021年12月的高频（月度）国际交易数据，对原油、煤炭、天然气三类化石能源的跨境贸易网络进行拓扑结构解码与微观结构突变分析。
AI.findings: （1）全球能源贸易总量严重收缩；（2）物流负担高度集中于一极小比例的双边贸易通道上，呈危险的超集中化态势；（3）高收入国家成功垄断拓扑中心性并拥有更密集的聚类网络，与低收入经济体之间存在显著系统性不对称；（4）不同能源商品结构演化轨迹截然不同，其中天然气网络遭受灾难性结构不稳定性，其最大出口中心从中东迁移至西非海岸，最终在美国与俄罗斯联邦之间分裂分散。
AI.theory_contributions: 将复杂系统理论拓展应用于公共卫生危机情境下的全球能源贸易网络分析，揭示了危机期间贸易网络拓扑结构演变的深层规律，丰富了国际资源物流网络在极端冲击下的结构突变理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解疫情封锁期间全球能源供应链的动态脆弱性提供实证依据，揭示了贸易通道超集中化的风险以及不同收入国家在能源获取能力上的结构性不平等，有助于制定更具韧性和公平性的能源贸易政策。

title: Orthogonal Residual Benchmarking for Learned Business and Economic Rankings

detail.title: Orthogonal Residual Benchmarking for Learned Business and Economic Rankings
detail.abstract: Adjusted rankings are now produced in many business and economic settings, from firms compared within markets to schools, hospitals, regions, banks and public programs compared after observable context has been taken into account. The common workflow is simple: estimate a benchmark, subtract its fitted value, average the remaining residuals by unit and report a ranking. That workflow becomes statistically fragile when the benchmark is learned with a flexible regression or machine-learning method, because local first-stage error can enter the residual score differently across units. I formalize this problem as a semiparametric ranking problem and propose Orthogonal Residual Benchmarking (ORB), a cross-fitted residualization procedure that removes the first-order effect of benchmark learning from adjusted-performance scores. The analysis derives identification, Neyman orthogonality, asymptotic linearity, covariance estimation and pairwise ranking inference. A Monte Carlo exercise shows lower score error than naive residual means and linear adjustment, with ORB interval coverage approaching the nominal level. The aim is not to introduce another prediction algorithm, but to give learned residual rankings an inferential foundation.

AI.tldr: 本文正式化了当基准模型通过灵活回归或机器学习方法学习时，调整排名统计脆弱性的问题，并提出正交残差基准化（ORB）方法——一种交叉拟合残差化程序，从调整绩效得分中消除基准学习的一阶效应，为学习残差排名提供推断基础。
AI.research_question: 当基准模型通过灵活回归或机器学习方法估计时，如何为调整后的绩效排名提供统计推断基础？
AI.motivation: 调整排名在商业和经济领域广泛使用（企业、学校、医院、银行等），但常见的"估计基准→减去拟合值→对残差取平均→排名"工作流在基准模型使用灵活机器学习方法时统计上变得脆弱，因为局部第一阶段误差可能在不同单位间以不同方式进入残差得分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 半参数排名问题形式化；Neyman正交性
AI.method: 提出正交残差基准化（ORB），一种交叉拟合残差化程序；推导了识别、Neyman正交性、渐近线性、协方差估计和配对排名推断；并通过蒙特卡罗模拟验证。
AI.findings: 蒙特卡罗实验表明，ORB的得分误差低于朴素残差均值和线性调整方法，且ORB的区间覆盖率接近名义水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 将调整排名问题形式化为半参数排名问题，建立基于Neyman正交性的推断框架，为机器学习基准下的排名推断提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供ORB这一实用方法，使使用灵活回归或机器学习基准的调整排名具有可靠的推断性质，且不引入新的预测算法，便于实际应用。
