“Our central composite forecast estimates that Asia's GDP share will rise from approximately 49% in 2025 to a peak of 55‑56% around 2060‑2070…” “…Under severe climate‑damage scenarios (RCP 8.5), Asia's GDP share could fall below 40% by 2100…”

Core findings

  • Model A (optimistic convergence): Asia peaks near 61% of global GDP by 2100.

  • Model B (demographics‑adjusted): Asia peaks at 55–56% mid‑century, then declines to ~53%.

  • Model C (capital‑constrained): Asia peaks at ~53% around 2050, falling to ~47% by 2100.

  • Composite forecast: Inverted‑U shape, peaking ~2065, ending ~53% in 2100.

Drivers of uncertainty

  • TFP growth, working‑age population dynamics, and climate change account for >70% of inter‑model variance.

  • Severe climate scenarios (RCP 8.5) impose large downside risk, potentially reducing Asia’s share by 14 percentage points.

Contribution

The paper provides a transparent, replicable multi‑model comparison with explicit uncertainty quantification, offering a long‑run forecast horizon to 2100.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个多模型预测框架（标准Solow-Swan收敛模型、人口增强Solow模型和资本约束模型），整合联合国人口预测、固定资本形成总额轨迹、全要素生产率收敛估计和气候损失叠加数据，预测亚洲在全球GDP（购买力平价）中的份额直至2100年。核心发现是亚洲GDP份额将呈倒U型走势，在2060-2070年间达到55-56%的峰值，随后回落至2100年的约53%。在严重气候情景（RCP 8.5）下，亚洲份额可能低于40%。
AI.research_question: 到2100年，亚洲在全球GDP（PPP）中的份额将如何演变？不同模型设定（标准收敛、人口调整、资本约束）下的预测结果有何差异？气候损害对亚洲经济份额的下行风险有多大？
AI.motivation: 亚洲作为全球经济增长的核心引擎，其长期经济份额的演变对全球经济格局、地缘政治平衡和国际经济政策具有深远影响。现有研究缺乏一个透明、可复制且覆盖到2100年的多模型比较框架来系统量化亚洲GDP份额的不确定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以Solow-Swan增长模型为核心理论框架，包括：1）标准的条件收敛模型（Model A）；2）在Solow模型中引入人口结构变化（工作年龄人口动态）的扩展模型（Model B）；3）引入资本约束（GFCF轨迹）的模型（Model C）。并结合TFP收敛理论和气候变化经济影响框架。
AI.method: 构建三种互补的经济增长预测模型：（1）乐观收敛模型——假设亚洲TFP向发达国家收敛；（2）人口调整模型——整合联合国人口预测中的工作年龄人口动态；（3）资本约束模型——基于固定资本形成总额轨迹限制资本积累。模型整合了UN人口预测、GFCF轨迹、TFP收敛估计和气候损失叠加（包括RCP 8.5严重气候情景），并通过复合预测生成综合估计。
AI.findings: 1) 模型A（乐观收敛）：亚洲份额到2100年峰值接近61%；2) 模型B（人口调整）：本世纪中叶峰值55-56%，随后回落至约53%；3) 模型C（资本约束）：约2050年峰值53%，2100年降至约47%；4) 复合预测呈倒U型，约2065年达到峰值，2100年结束于约53%；5) TFP增长、工作年龄人口动态和气候变化是跨模型方差的主要来源（>70%）；6) RCP 8.5严重气候情景可能使亚洲份额减少14个百分点，2100年可能低于40%。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将三种不同的经济增长模型设定（标准Solow、人口增强Solow、资本约束模型）统一应用于亚洲全球份额的长期（至2100年）预测，提供了跨模型比较和显式的不确定性量化框架，识别出TFP、人口和气候是主要不确定性驱动因素，丰富了长期经济增长预测方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了亚洲经济份额长期演变的透明、可复制的多情景预测，明确了气候政策（RCP 8.5 vs 更温和情景）对亚洲经济地位的重大影响（14个百分点的差距），有助于各国进行长期经济规划和气候应对策略制定。

title: When the Scenario Outlives the Bond: Measuring Horizon Bias in Climate Credit Stress Tests

detail.title: When the Scenario Outlives the Bond: Measuring Horizon Bias in Climate Credit Stress Tests
detail.abstract: Climate stress tests translate scenario paths into portfolio losses, but the scenario horizon can outlive the instruments being stressed. This paper isolates one implementation choice: whether sector-level shocks are censored at each security's contractual exit. The frozen universe contains 822 Chinese interbank medium-term notes issued by 116 listed legal entities and outstanding at year-end 2025. Holding the NGFS CLIMACRED path, legal-issuer mapping, and portfolio weights fixed, a horizon-blind maximum-loss rule exceeds its maturity-aware counterpart by 0.081–0.253 percentage points across three short-term scenarios. The gap is concentrated in bonds exiting within two years, remains positive in all 5,000 issuer resamples and leave-one-issuer-out exercises, survives a conservative sector-remapping envelope, and can reorder sector rankings. Mean and cumulative variants preserve the positive maximum-loss direction. A terminal-year statistic, which compares different calendar years, is positive in two scenarios and negative in DIRE; the set-inclusion property guaranteeing a non-negative maximum-loss gap does not extend to that statistic. Legal-maturity and first-call variants form a separate modeling margin. For regulators, the result shows why runoff and reinvestment conventions should be explicit in climate stress templates. This is a measurement contrast, not a forecast, causal estimate, realized loss, or claim about market mispricing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究气候压力测试中一个具体的实施选择：行业冲击是否在每只证券的合约到期日被截断。基于822只中国银行间中期票据（116家上市法人发行主体），在固定NGFS CLIMACRED情景路径、法人映射和组合权重的情况下，无地平线（horizon-blind）最大损失规则比考虑到期日的规则高出0.081-0.253个百分点，且该差距在5,000次重抽样和留一法人检验中均稳健存在。
AI.research_question: 气候压力测试中，行业冲击是否应在每只证券的合约到期时被截断（censored at contractual exit），这一实施选择如何影响组合损失的估计结果？
AI.motivation: 气候压力测试将情景路径转化为组合损失，但情景的时间跨度可能超过被压力测试的金融工具的存续期。这一"地平线错配"问题在现有压力测试模板中往往未得到明确处理，可能导致损失估算的系统性偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候压力测试方法学；最大损失规则（maximum-loss rule）；到期意识与到期盲视的损失度量对比；NGFS CLIMACRED情景框架；集合包含性质（set-inclusion property）。
AI.method: 以2025年末存续的822只中国银行间中期票据为样本（116家上市法人），固定NGFS CLIMACRED情景路径、法人映射和组合权重，对比"无地平线最大损失"与"到期感知"两种损失规则；通过5,000次发行人重抽样、留一发行人检验、保守行业重映射包络和敏感性分析进行稳健性验证。
AI.findings: （1）无地平线最大损失规则比到期感知规则高出0.081-0.253个百分点（三个短期情景）；（2）差距集中在两年内到期的债券；（3）差距在5,000次重抽样和留一发行人检验中保持为正；（4）保守行业重映射下仍稳健；（5）可改变行业排名；（6）均值与累积变体保持正向最大损失方向；（7）终期年统计量在两个情景为正、在DIRE情景为负，集合包含性质不适用该统计量；（8）法律到期日与首次赎回变体构成独立的建模边际。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文明确指出现有气候压力测试文献中"情景地平线与工具存续期错配"的理论空白，识别出"到期截断"这一被忽视的实施选择是损失差异的重要来源，并证明集合包含性质仅适用于最大损失差额而非所有统计量（如终期年统计量）。
AI.practical_contributions: 对监管机构而言，本研究揭示了气候压力测试模板中应明确"到期/再投资"（runoff and reinvestment）惯例的必要性；该差异属于测量对比而非预测、因果估计、实际损失或市场错误定价的主张，为监管模板设计提供操作层面的校准依据。

title: The Thermodynamics Of Global Growth: Surplus‑Energy Constraints And The Emerging Limits Of 21st‑Century Economic Expansion

detail.title: The Thermodynamics Of Global Growth: Surplus‑Energy Constraints And The Emerging Limits Of 21st‑Century Economic Expansion
detail.abstract:
Economic growth in the 21st century is increasingly constrained by the physical laws governing energy conversion, entropy, and spatial complexity. This report reframes macroeconomic expansion as an entropic process driven by the dissipation of dense hydrocarbon energy and bounded by declining global Energy Return on Investment (EROI). As the world transitions from high‑density fossil fuels to diffuse renewable energy systems, the margin of surplus energy narrows, exposing structural vulnerabilities across food, manufacturing, financial, and geopolitical systems. The document demonstrates that traditional production models omit the fundamental role of exergy, noting that “capital and labor are…mechanisms for transforming raw energy into ordered societal structure” and that “every dollar of GDP generated requires a precise, calculable throughput of physical energy” .

Using multi‑agent simulations built on the Fraktál engine and statistical‑mechanical modeling, the analysis maps how thermodynamic limits shape GDP scaling, urban geometry, supply‑chain resilience, and regional development trajectories. Declining EROI, rising spatial entropy, and the thermodynamic rigidity of heavy industrial processes collectively generate a global polycrisis, wherein shocks propagate across tightly coupled systems once buffered by cheap energy. The report argues that long‑term resilience and poverty reduction depend on aligning financial expectations, technological diffusion, and urban design with hard physical constraints. Growth in a bound universe requires a strategic pivot toward thermodynamically efficient architectures, complexity management, and physics‑grounded macroeconomic planning.

AI.tldr: 本报告将21世纪宏观经济增长重新定义为熵增过程，指出经济增长受能源转换、熵和空间复杂性的物理定律约束。随着全球从高密度化石燃料转向低密度可再生能源，能源投资回报率（EROI）下降导致剩余能源边际收窄，暴露出粮食、制造、金融和地缘政治系统的结构性脆弱性。作者通过基于Fraktál引擎的多主体模拟和统计力学建模，论证了热力学限制如何塑造GDP规模、城市几何、供应链韧性和区域发展轨迹，并提出长期韧性和减贫必须与物理约束对齐。
AI.research_question: 在物理定律（能源转换、熵、空间复杂性）约束下，宏观经济扩张如何被视为熵增过程？EROI下降如何导致全球多重危机（polycrisis）及系统性脆弱性？
AI.motivation: 传统生产模型忽略了火用（exergy）的基础性作用，将资本和劳动视为内生增长要素，却未认识到它们是"将原始能源转化为有序社会结构的机制"。每单位GDP都需要精确、可计算的物理能量吞吐，而传统经济学模型对此视而不见，导致对经济韧性、增长极限和危机传播的误判。
AI.theoretical_framework: 热力学（熵增定律、能量转换）、能源投资回报率（EROI）、火用（Exergy）经济学、统计力学建模、空间熵与城市复杂性理论
AI.method: 基于Fraktál引擎的多主体模拟（multi-agent simulations）以及统计力学建模，分析热力学限制对GDP规模、城市几何、供应链韧性和区域发展轨迹的影响。
AI.findings: （1）EROI下降、空间熵上升和重工业过程的热力学刚性共同生成全球多重危机；（2）冲击在曾由廉价能源缓冲的紧密耦合系统中传播；（3）长期韧性和减贫取决于将金融预期、技术扩散和城市设计与硬性物理约束对齐。
AI.theory_contributions: 将熵增定律和热力学框架引入宏观经济学，重新定义经济增长为耗散密集碳氢能源的熵增过程，弥补传统生产模型对火用（exergy）和物理能量吞吐的忽略，为宏观经济学提供了物理学基础的理论拓展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供物理约束下的宏观规划框架：建议在经济战略中转向热力学高效架构、实施复杂性管理，并采用基于物理学的宏观经济规划，以应对能源转型期的系统性风险和多重重叠危机。

title:
Comparative PPP Wealth Benchmarks: 
When is a Crorepati a Millionaire?
A cross-country framework for India, Thailand, the United States, the United Kingdom, Mexico and China

detail.title:
Comparative PPP Wealth Benchmarks: 
When is a Crorepati a Millionaire?
A cross-country framework for India, Thailand, the United States, the United Kingdom, Mexico and China
detail.abstract: The terms "crorepati" and "millionaire" are commonly used as shorthand for substantial wealth, yet nominal currency conversion does not provide a meaningful crosscountry comparison of living standards. This paper develops a purchasing-power-parity (PPP) framework for comparing two benchmark wealth targets: (i) INR 10 million (₹1 crore) held in India and (ii) USD 1 million held in the United States. Using World Bank PPP conversion factors and crosscountry inequality evidence from the World Inequality Database / World Inequality Report 2026, the paper translates these wealth benchmarks into local purchasing-power equivalents for India, Thailand, the United States, the United Kingdom, Mexico and China. It then compares the resulting targets with income benchmarks at the national-average, top-10% and top-1% levels. A separate India-specific analysis uses income-distribution thresholds from the World Inequality Lab to distinguish the 90th-and 99th-percentile entry points from the average incomes of people already within the top 10% and top 1%. The paper finds that ₹1 crore has substantially greater domestic purchasing power than its market-exchange-rate dollar value suggests, but remains about half the purchasing-power value of a US$1 million American benchmark. The paper also shows why "years of income needed" must use an income denominator appropriate to the person being studied: the time required falls sharply as one moves from the median to the top 10% and top 1%.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个购买力平价（PPP）框架，用于比较印度₹1千万（1 crore）与美国100万美元两个财富基准的实际购买力。研究发现，₹1千万的国内实际购买力远超其市场汇率换算的美元价值，但仍仅为美国100万美元基准购买力价值的一半左右。此外，论文还分析了"需要多少年收入"这一指标如何因收入分位数（中位数、前10%、前1%）不同而显著变化。
AI.research_question: 如何通过购买力平价框架对不同国家的财富基准（印度₹1千万与美国100万美元）进行有意义的跨国比较，并评估其在各国的实际购买力水平？
AI.motivation: 名义货币换算不能提供有意义的跨国生活水平比较，需要使用购买力平价框架来准确衡量不同国家财富基准的实际价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 购买力平价（PPP）理论框架，结合世界不平等数据库（WID）的跨国不平等数据。
AI.method: 使用世界银行PPP转换因子和WID/世界不平等报告2026的跨国不平等数据，将财富基准转换为印度、泰国、美国、英国、墨西哥和中国的本地购买力等值，并与国家平均、前10%和前1%的收入基准进行比较。印度专项分析使用世界不平等实验室的收入分布阈值。
AI.findings: （1）₹1千万的国内实际购买力远超其市场汇率换算的美元价值；（2）但₹1千万仅为美国100万美元基准购买力价值的大约一半；（3）"需要多少年收入"必须使用与研究对象相匹配的收入分母，从中位数到前10%再到前1%，所需时间急剧下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 为跨国财富比较提供了基于PPP的系统性分析框架，补充了现有文献中仅依赖名义汇率或简单货币换算的不足。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、研究人员和公众提供了更准确理解不同国家财富基准实际购买力的工具，有助于更合理的跨国经济比较和财富门槛设定。

title: Reaction versus Prediction in Trade Execution: A Risk-Management Examination of Regime-Conditional Lead-Lag Signals in XAUUSD-XAGUSD
affiliations: Independent Inventor

detail.title: Reaction versus Prediction in Trade Execution: A Risk-Management Examination of Regime-Conditional Lead-Lag Signals in XAUUSD-XAGUSD
detail.abstract: Prior work on the correlation structure among gold (XAUUSD), silver (XAGUSD), and Bitcoin (BTCUSD) has established that intermarket leadership between assets is regime-conditional rather than fixed: silver has been documented to lead gold during momentum and rally phases owing to its higher beta and more speculative order flow, while gold reasserts leadership during pure safe-haven shocks (Sulistyardi, 2026). This regime-dependence has a direct but underexplored consequence for trade execution and risk management: a signal generated from a lead-lag relationship is only informative conditional on the prevailing regime holding, and that condition cannot be verified in advance. Drawing on the market-microstructure literature on support and resistance (Osler, 2000, 2003) and the behavioral finance literature on overconfident, forecast-driven trading (Odean, 1998; Barber & Odean, 2000, 2001), this paper argues that the resulting uncertainty is best resolved not by predicting which asset will lead and by how much, but by treating the lead-lag relationship as a probabilistic filter that raises the odds of a favorable reaction once price independently confirms structure at an empirically motivated reference zone. We contrast this reaction-confirmation approach with prediction-contingent execution, which acts on the leading asset's signal before the lagging asset confirms, and argue that the former is structurally lower-risk because stop-loss placement is anchored to a confirmed structural invalidation point rather than to a hypothesized future price path. A concrete illustrative trade example is provided, together with an exploratory, scale-independent case illustration (win rate, profit factor, payoff ratio, and R-multiple drawdown, expressed as ratios and percentages rather than absolute currency amounts, with a 95% confidence interval reported for the win rate) drawn from a live trade log, and an agenda for controlled empirical validation using Sharpe ratio, maximum drawdown, and per-trade risk (R-multiple) comparisons is proposed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种"反应-确认"式交易执行框架，用于黄金、白银和比特币之间的跨市场lead-lag关系交易。与传统的"预测-依赖"式执行不同，该框架将lead-lag关系视为概率过滤器，仅在价格独立确认结构性支撑/阻力位时才触发交易，从而将止损锚定在已确认的结构失效点上，降低交易风险。
AI.research_question: 在黄金、白银和比特币的跨市场lead-lag关系具有政权依赖性（regime-conditional）的前提下，交易执行应如何设计以降低风险？具体而言，是否应放弃预测哪个资产将领先及领先多少，转而采用基于反应确认的概率过滤式执行框架？
AI.motivation: 已有文献证实跨资产lead-lag关系是政权依赖的（如白银在动量阶段领先黄金，而黄金在避险冲击中恢复领先），但这种政权条件无法提前验证。因此，基于lead-lag信号的执行天然带有不确定性，现有研究对这种不确定性的交易执行后果探讨不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 市场微观结构理论中的支撑/阻力理论（Osler, 2000, 2003）；2) 行为金融学中关于过度自信与预测驱动交易的理论（Odean, 1998; Barber & Odean, 2000, 2001）；3) 跨市场lead-lag关系的政权依赖理论（Sulistyardi, 2026）。
AI.method: 1) 理论论证：对比反应-确认法与预测-依赖法的结构性风险差异；2) 提供具体示例交易说明；3) 基于实盘交易日志进行探索性、规模无关的案例验证（胜率、盈利因子、盈亏比、R倍数回撤，胜率报告95%置信区间）；4) 提出受控实证验证议程（Sharpe比率、最大回撤、每笔交易R倍数比较）。
AI.findings: 反应-确认式执行方法在结构上比预测-依赖式执行风险更低，因为止损位置锚定于已确认的结构失效点而非假设的未来价格路径。实盘交易日志的探索性案例提供了初步的支持性证据（以比率和百分比报告，胜率附带95%置信区间）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将lead-lag关系的政权依赖性与交易执行联系起来，提出从"预测资产领先"转向"将lead-lag作为概率过滤器"的范式转换，为跨资产交易中的不确定性管理提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为交易者提供了一种可操作的、结构上更低风险的跨资产交易执行框架；提供了基于实盘日志的探索性案例证据；提出了包含Sharpe比率、最大回撤和R倍数比较的受控验证议程。

title: The Fractal Defense Model: Why Do Individuals and Organizations Retaliate in Similar Ways?
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Fractal Defense Model: Why Do Individuals and Organizations Retaliate in Similar Ways?
detail.abstract:
This paper introduces the Fractal Defense Model (FDM) to explain why individuals and organizations, despite operating at different levels and possessing different resources, may produce functionally similar defensive responses to criticism, dissent, or problem-raising. Previous research on employee voice, organizational silence, workplace ostracism, whistleblowing retaliation, threat-rigidity, and organizational defensive routines has clarified important mechanisms of silence, exclusion, retaliation, and defensive contraction. Yet less attention has been given to why interpersonal withdrawal and organizational marginalization can assume functionally self-similar forms across levels.

FDM proposes that when problem-raising is redefined as a threat to an existing order, defensive responses may emerge at multiple levels through reduced contact, information restriction, limits on voice and access, role contraction, exclusion, sanction, and subsequent justification. The term fractal is used here as a conceptual metaphor rather than a mathematical claim. It refers to functional self-similarity across organizational levels: different actors may use different resources while reproducing a comparable defensive grammar.

The paper distinguishes Relational Erasure, in which interpersonal recognition, response, information exchange, and relational access are progressively reduced, from Occupational Erasure, in which organizational roles, professional access, participation, skill utilization, and evaluative opportunities are progressively narrowed. It also distinguishes defense from retaliation. Defense describes the actor-side logic of preserving self, authority, order, or legitimacy, whereas retaliation describes the target-side or functional consequences of those actions. When defensive responses across multiple levels converge on the same individual and cumulatively restrict voice, role, access, and recognition, the resulting pattern is conceptualized as Fractal Retaliation.

Furthermore, this study treats defensive responses at the individual and organizational levels not as isolated phenomena, but as forms of functional self-similarity that recur across organizational levels. In doing so, the FDM provides a framework for understanding silence, exclusion, formal sanctioning, retaliation, and organizational defense within a common cross-level perspective. The central question posed by the FDM is not whether defense itself is inherently desirable or undesirable. Rather, the crucial issue is whether, after defensive order has been restored, the organization still preserves channels through which problems can be recognized, dissent can be heard, and its own judgments and institutional arrangements can be revised.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了分形防御模型（FDM），用以解释为什么不同层级的个体和组织尽管拥有不同资源，却会对批评、异议或提出问题产生功能相似的防御性反应。FDM区分了关系性抹除与职业性抹除，并将防御与报复区分开来，提出当多层防御性反应汇聚于同一人时形成"分形报复"。该框架的核心关注点不是防御本身的好坏，而是防御秩序恢复后，组织是否仍保留倾听问题、容纳异议和修正自身制度的通道。
AI.research_question: 为什么不同层级的个体和组织会对批评、异议或提出问题产生功能上自相似的防御性反应？这种跨层级的防御性反应如何被概念化和理解？
AI.motivation: 已有研究分别阐明了员工建言、组织沉默、职场排斥、举报报复、威胁-刚性等机制，但鲜有研究关注人际退缩与组织边缘化为何在跨层级上呈现功能自相似的形式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分形防御模型（FDM）；功能自相似性（强调作为概念隐喻而非数学主张）；防御与报复的区分；关系性抹除与职业性抹除的区分；分形报复概念。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性论文，通过理论整合与概念建构提出新的分析框架。
AI.findings: FDM提出：当问题提出被重新定义为对现有秩序的威胁时，防御性反应可能在多个层面出现，表现为减少接触、信息限制、限制建言与接近权、角色收缩、排斥、制裁及随后的正当化；区分了关系性抹除（人际层面）与职业性抹除（组织层面）；区分了防御（行动者侧逻辑）与报复（目标侧后果）；提出分形报复概念。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个跨层级的整合视角，将沉默、排斥、正式制裁、报复和组织防御纳入共同的分析框架；引入"分形"作为功能自相似性的概念隐喻，丰富了组织防御的理论理解；建立了防御与报复的概念区分。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织实践提供了诊断工具：组织应关注防御秩序恢复后是否仍保留听取问题、容纳异议和修正制度的通道，以评估组织的健康程度。

title:
The Next Wave of Convergence
Digital-Industrial Complementarities and the Rise of Mid-Tier Growth Economies

detail.title:
The Next Wave of Convergence
Digital-Industrial Complementarities and the Rise of Mid-Tier Growth Economies
detail.abstract: Following the theoretical foundations laid in previous frameworks analyzing global technology diffusion (Hughes, 2025), this comprehensive research report models the emerging macroeconomic paradigm of "digital-industrial complementarity." As legacy cost-curves in clean energy and artificial intelligence compress simultaneously, mid-tier economies (e.g., India, Vietnam, Mexico, Indonesia) are capturing unprecedented multi-system resilience. By integrating quantitative macro-systems analysis with network geometry, we demonstrate that the historical prerequisite of pure manufacturing-led development is obsolete. Instead, economies leveraging hybrid digital orchestration pipelines over traditional heavy-industrial bases are experiencing accelerated convergence, fundamentally altering global supply chain gravity and polycrisis mitigation strategies for the 2030s. This extended analysis provides a granular breakdown of the computational, energetic, and geometric forces driving this transition.

AI.tldr: 本文基于先前全球技术扩散理论框架，提出了"数字-工业互补性"这一新兴宏观经济范式。研究认为，随着清洁能源与人工智能领域的传统成本曲线同时压缩，印度、越南、墨西哥、印度尼西亚等中端经济体正在获得前所未有的多系统韧性。通过整合定量宏观系统分析与网络几何方法，论证了纯制造业主导发展的历史前提已过时，利用混合数字编排管道叠加传统重工业基础的经济体正经历加速趋同，从根本上改变了2030年代全球供应链重心与多重危机缓解策略。
AI.research_question: 在全球清洁能源与人工智能成本曲线同时压缩的背景下，中端经济体如何通过"数字-工业互补性"范式实现多系统韧性并加速经济趋同？传统的制造业主导发展模式是否仍然有效？
AI.motivation: 传统经济分析框架假设制造业主导是发展中经济体实现追赶的必要前提，但这一假设在新兴技术扩散背景下已显过时。需要重新审视全球技术扩散与供应链格局变化，为2030年代提供更准确的宏观经济范式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Hughes（2025）的全球技术扩散理论框架，结合数字-工业互补性范式、定量宏观系统分析、网络几何理论。
AI.method: 整合定量宏观系统分析与网络几何方法的综合研究方法，对多系统中端经济体进行性能评估与趋势建模。
AI.findings: 纯制造业主导发展模式已过时；采用混合数字编排管道叠加传统重工业基础的经济体正在经历加速经济趋同；中端经济体正捕获前所未有的多系统韧性；全球供应链重心正在发生根本性改变。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并论证了"数字-工业互补性"作为新兴宏观经济发展范式，挑战了传统制造业主导发展的理论前提，将网络几何引入宏观经济趋同分析，扩展了全球技术扩散理论的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为2030年代多重危机（polycrisis）缓解策略提供新的分析框架；为发展中经济体制定发展战略提供实证依据；为全球供应链布局与政策制定提供方向性指导。

title: The Core Value of Public Policy Should be Equality
affiliations: University of Utah - College of Social & Behavioral Sciences - Department of Economics, University of Utah - College of Social & Behavioral Sciences - Department of Economics and University of Houston Law Center

detail.title: The Core Value of Public Policy Should be Equality

declarations.funderStatement: The authors are grateful to the Institute for New Economic Thinking for support

detail.abstract: Research in biology and anthropology shows that humans evolved in largely egalitarian small groups; occasional selfishness was punished. Aversion to inequality is thus an inherited human characteristic. In unequal societies, humans experience stress, leading to many social pathologies, as shown by extensive literature in epidemiology. Well-being can be increased by reducing inequality, independent of increases in GDP. This is obscured by current economic theories, which use unrealistic assumptions and an empirically completely unsupported "equity-efficiency tradeoff" to justify ignoring distribution. Finally, we show that public policy can have an enormous impact on income inequality and has done so in the past.

AI.tldr: 本文从生物学、人类学和流行病学等多学科视角论证，人类天生具有不平等厌恶的倾向，减少不平等能够独立于GDP增长提升幸福感。当前经济学理论基于不现实的假设和缺乏实证支持的"公平-效率权衡"来忽视分配问题，但公共政策事实上对收入不平等具有巨大且可验证的影响力。
AI.research_question: 减少收入不平等是否能够独立于经济增长提升人类福祉？当前经济学理论为何以及如何忽视了分配问题？公共政策能否有效影响收入不平等？
AI.motivation: 人类在生物学和人类学上天生厌恶不平等，而不平等社会会产生诸多社会病态；但主流经济学理论利用缺乏实证支持的"公平-效率权衡"来为忽视分配问题辩护，作者旨在反驳这一观点并论证政策干预的可行性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该论文整合了多个学科的理论视角：(1) 生物学和人类学中的进化心理学理论，认为人类在小型平等群体中进化，不平等厌恶是遗传特征；(2) 流行病学中的社会压力理论，表明不平等导致压力和社会病理；(3) 对主流经济学"公平-效率权衡"假设的批判性分析。
AI.method: 本文采用跨学科文献综述与理论分析方法，综合生物学、人类学、流行病学和经济学等多领域的研究证据，并通过历史政策案例论证公共政策对收入分配的显著影响。
AI.findings: (1) 不平等厌恶是人类进化遗留下来的内在特征；(2) 在不平等社会中，人们经历压力并产生多种社会病理，减少不平等（独立于GDP增长）可以提升幸福感；(3) 主流经济学的"公平-效率权衡"假设缺乏实证支持；(4) 公共政策在历史上对收入不平等有巨大且可证明的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文挑战了主流经济学中"公平-效率权衡"的核心假设，将其定性为"经验上完全没有支持的"假设，为经济学理论中重新审视分配问题提供了跨学科的理论基础，将不平等厌恶从道德议题转化为进化生物学和流行病学可证实的科学事实。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了减少收入不平等的理论与实证依据，证明公共政策（如历史上已实施的政策）能够有效缩小收入差距，从而提升社会整体福祉，而不必以牺牲经济增长为代价。

reference: Institute for New Economic Thinking Working Paper Series No. 251
title: Adam Smith and the Moral Foundations of Political Economy
affiliations: Sapienza University of Rome

detail.title: Adam Smith and the Moral Foundations of Political Economy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This Working Paper is a chapter from Alessandro Roncagli’s forthcoming study of the history of economic thought which will be published by Cambridge University Press

publicationDetails.detailsText: Institute for New Economic Thinking Working Paper Series No. 251
publicationDetails.journalName: Institute for New Economic Thinking Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Adam Smith's political economy is best understood as part of a broader inquiry into human beings and society, rather than as a narrow theory of market self-regulation. This paper situates The Wealth of Nations within Smith's wider intellectual project, including his writings on moral philosophy, rhetoric, jurisprudence, and scientific method. It emphasizes the complementarity between selfinterest and sympathy, the centrality of the division of labor to Smith's theory of economic development, and the role of institutions, justice, and public action in sustaining commercial society. The paper also revisits Smith's theories of value, prices, distribution, and competition, arguing against interpretations that assimilate Smith to modern general equilibrium theory or reduce the "invisible hand" to a doctrine of automatic market optimality. Smith emerges instead as a theorist of social interdependence, historical development, and institutional complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文主张亚当·斯密的政治经济学应被置于其更广泛的关于人类与社会的学术探究中理解，而非视为狭义的市场自我调节理论。文章将《国富论》置于斯密的道德哲学、修辞学、法学和科学方法等更宏大的智识项目中，强调自利与同情的互补性、劳动分工在经济发展中的核心地位，以及制度、正义与公共行动对商业社会维系的作用，并反对将斯密同化为现代一般均衡理论或将其"看不见的手"简化为自动市场最优性教条的解读。
AI.research_question: 亚当·斯密的政治经济学应如何在其整个智识体系中更准确地被理解？《国富论》中关于价值、价格、分配和竞争的理论应如何被诠释，才能避免被误解为现代一般均衡理论或市场自动最优性教条？
AI.motivation: 长期以来，斯密的《国富论》常被简化为市场自我调节理论的奠基之作，其"看不见的手"也被扭曲为自动市场最优性的教条。这种解读忽视了斯密思想的多维度性和他关于社会、历史与制度的深刻洞见，因此有必要还原斯密作为社会相互依存、历史发展和制度复杂性理论家的真实面貌。
AI.theoretical_framework: 斯密的思想体系涵盖道德哲学（自利与同情）、修辞学、法学（正义与制度）和科学方法等维度；其政治经济学框架以劳动分工为核心，强调自利与同情的互补性，以及制度、正义和公共行动在维持商业社会中的作用。
AI.method: 对斯密著作的文本解读与思想史分析，将《国富论》置于其道德哲学、修辞学、法学和科学方法等更广泛的学术项目中加以重新定位和阐释，并对流行的误读进行批判性反思。
AI.findings: 斯密的政治经济学不是狭义的市场自我调节理论，而是关于社会相互依存、历史发展和制度复杂性的理论。其"看不见的手"不应被解释为自动市场最优性教条，斯密的价值、价格、分配和竞争理论也不能被同化为现代一般均衡理论。
AI.theory_contributions: 纠正了对斯密政治经济学的简化解读，强调自利与同情的互补关系，重新确立了斯密作为社会理论家、历史发展理论家和制度复杂性理论家的学术地位，为理解古典政治经济学与当代经济学之间的关系提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 通过对斯密思想的准确还原，提醒现代经济政策制定者不能完全依赖市场自动调节机制，而应重视制度设计、正义原则和公共行动在维持商业社会正常运行中的关键作用。

title: Free at One Store, $40,000 a Year at the Next: The Break-Even Basket for DC Fast Charging at U.S. Convenience Stores

detail.title: Free at One Store, $40,000 a Year at the Next: The Break-Even Basket for DC Fast Charging at U.S. Convenience Stores

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author operates RightSite, a commercial EV-charging site-selection service that uses the tariff library and pricing methodology described in this paper; this constitutes a financial interest in the subject matter.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this work.

detail.abstract:
Standalone small-scale DC fast charging (DCFC) is not a viable business: the preceding study in this series found small operators cash-negative in effectively every scenario and year through 2036, concluding that small-format charging is rational only as a subsidized traffic amenity for a retail host. This paper quantifies that sentence for the host that matters most - the American convenience store, an industry of 151,975 stores that captures roughly 80% of U.S. consumer fuel purchases. A host does not need the charger to break even; it needs the charger's deficit to be smaller than the incremental in-store gross profit the charger recruits. We define the break-even basket - the dollars of in-store gross profit per charging session required to cover the charger's full cost - and compute it across the RightSite tariff library (332 encoded U.S. commercial rate schedules, 246 verified), at observed convenience-store utilization (about 12% port occupancy), under post-subsidy 2026 conditions: the federal 30C credit expired for property placed in service after June 30, 2026, while the restarted NEVI program still pays up to 80% of capital.

Results: at convenience-store traffic on a 350 kW port, the median conventional tariff prices electricity at $0.50/kWh - above the $0.49/kWh national average retail charging price before any capital or operating cost - against $0.27/kWh on EV-specific rates. The unfunded charger needs a median $9.67 of in-store gross profit per session on conventional tariffs and $3.36 on EV rates; with an 80% capital grant the median EV-rate charger needs $0.00 - it self-funds on charging revenue alone - while the median conventional-tariff charger still needs $4.80. Break-even occupancy is 9.5% on a granted EV rate, below today's convenience-store average, versus 23.5% unfunded on a conventional tariff - above today's national average and beyond all but the busiest U.S. markets. On the base-case utilization path the requirement worsens through a 2027-28 trough, then falls; by 2036 the median unfunded EV-rate requirement is $1.25 per session, while unfunded conventional-tariff sites still need $5.54. Whether a charger is free traffic or a paid amenity is knowable in advance from two documents: the utility tariff and the grant award.

AI.tldr: 本文量化了美国便利店（占美国消费者燃油购买约80%的151,975家门店）作为直流快充（DCFC）充电桩宿主的经济可行性。研究发现，充电桩无需自身盈利，只需其亏损小于其带来的店内毛利润增量。在2026年后补贴条件下（30C税收抵免到期，NEVI计划仍支付最高80%资本），在EV专用电价+80%资本补助下，中位充电桩仅靠充电收入即可自筹资金；而在常规电价且无补助下，需要每会话9.67美元的店内毛利润才能盈亏平衡，且盈亏平衡占用率达23.5%，高于全国平均水平。
AI.research_question: 对于美国便利店这类关键的零售宿主，直流快充充电桩需要带来多少店内毛利润才能实现盈亏平衡？在不同电价结构（常规电价 vs. EV专用电价）和补贴条件下（有无NEVI资本补助），这一盈亏平衡要求如何变化？
AI.motivation: 先前研究发现小型独立直流快充运营在几乎所有情景下都亏损，只有作为零售宿主的补贴性交通便利设施才合理。本文需要量化这一结论对最重要的宿主——美国便利店行业（151,975家门店，覆盖约80%美国消费者燃油购买）的具体经济含义，以指导充电桩部署决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 盈亏平衡分析框架：充电桩不需要自身盈利，只需要其亏损小于其吸引的店内毛利润增量。定义"盈亏平衡购物篮"（break-even basket）——每充电会话所需的店内毛利润美元数，用于覆盖充电桩的全部成本。
AI.method: 基于RightSite电价库（332个美国商业费率计划，其中246个经验证），结合便利店实际利用率（约12%端口占用率）、2026年后补贴条件（30C税收抵免到期、NEVI计划仍支付最高80%资本成本），计算不同电价和补贴组合下的盈亏平衡购物篮及盈亏平衡占用率。
AI.findings: （1）350kW端口在便利店流量下，常规电价中位数$0.50/kWh，高于全国平均零售充电价格$0.49/kWh；EV专用电价为$0.27/kWh。（2）无补贴时，常规电价需$9.67/会话店内毛利润，EV电价需$3.36。（3）有80%资本补助时，EV电价中位充电桩自筹资金（需$0.00），常规电价仍需$4.80。（4）有补助的EV电价盈亏平衡占用率9.5%，低于便利店平均水平；无补助常规电价需23.5%，高于几乎所有美国市场。（5）到2036年，无补助EV电价需求降至$1.25/会话，无补助常规电价仍需$5.54。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"盈亏平衡购物篮"这一分析框架，将充电桩盈利性分析从单站独立核算拓展为宿主商业生态的整体考量；将电价结构和补贴状态作为预测充电桩可行性的先验判别变量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国便利店行业提供可操作的投资决策指南：充电桩是否"免费引流"还是"付费便利设施"可通过两份文件（电价表+补助批复）提前预判；指导便利店运营者优先选择EV专用电价并争取NEVI资本补助，以最大化充电桩作为客流吸引物的价值。

title: Remittances, Household Consumption, and Financial Resilience During Economic Shocks
affiliations: Ulster University

detail.title: Remittances, Household Consumption, and Financial Resilience During Economic Shocks

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no financial or personal relationships that could have influenced, or could reasonably be perceived to have influenced, this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses secondary, anonymised household survey data and did not involve direct recruitment or interaction with human participants. Therefore, additional ethics approval was not required for this analysis.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper examines how international remittance flows influence household consumption smoothing and financial resilience during periods of macroeconomic stress, using household survey data from remittance-dependent economies across two recent shock periods: the COVID-19 pandemic (2020-2021) and the subsequent global inflationary episode (2021-2023). Comparing consumption volatility between remittance-receiving and non-receiving households, the analysis employs a differencein-differences framework alongside household fixed-effects regression to identify the causal effect of remittances on consumption stability and savings recovery. Results indicate that remittance-receiving households exhibit significantly lower consumption volatility and faster recovery in savings rates, suggesting remittances act as an informal insurance mechanism. The paper discusses policy implications for leveraging remittance channels as a complement to formal social safety nets in shock-prone economies.

AI.tldr: 本文利用COVID-19疫情（2020-2021）和全球通胀（2021-2023）两个冲击时期的家庭调查数据，采用双重差分法和家庭固定效应回归，研究发现汇款接收家庭在宏观经济压力期间消费波动显著更低、储蓄恢复更快，表明国际汇款作为非正式保险机制有助于家庭消费平滑和金融韧性。
AI.research_question: 国际汇款流动如何在宏观经济压力时期影响家庭消费平滑和金融韧性？
AI.motivation: 在宏观经济冲击频发背景下，汇款依赖型经济体的家庭面临消费波动和储蓄受损的风险，但汇款作为非正式保险机制的作用尚未得到充分因果识别。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非正式保险机制理论、消费平滑理论、家庭金融韧性框架
AI.method: 双重差分法（difference-in-differences）结合家庭固定效应回归，利用汇款接收家庭与非接收家庭的对照比较，识别汇款对消费稳定性和储蓄恢复的因果效应。
AI.findings: 汇款接收家庭表现出显著更低的消费波动性和更快的储蓄率恢复，表明汇款在宏观经济压力时期充当非正式保险机制，有助于家庭消费平滑和金融恢复。
AI.theory_contributions: 为汇款作为非正式保险机制提供因果证据，丰富了消费平滑理论和家庭金融韧性领域的实证研究，拓展了对汇款在宏观经济冲击中缓冲作用的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了利用汇款渠道作为正式社会安全网补充的政策启示，尤其对冲击频发经济体设计韧性增强政策具有参考价值。

title: Leading Under Uncertainty: Conviction Work and the Self-Regulation of Founder Confidence in Early-Stage Technology Ventures
affiliations: Duke Kunshan University

detail.title: Leading Under Uncertainty: Conviction Work and the Self-Regulation of Founder Confidence in Early-Stage Technology Ventures
detail.abstract: Founders of early-stage technology ventures face a tension that entrepreneurship research has documented on both sides but never theorized as such: their epistemic situation cannot warrant confident belief, yet their role demands the behavioral outputs of confidence-decisive action, persistent effort, emotional stability, and the skilled public performance of conviction to resource holders. This paper theorizes what happens in the middle. I define the epistemicbehavioral gap as the discrepancy between the confidence a founder's evidence warrants and the confidence the founder's functioning requires, and conviction work as the continuous, effortful self-regulatory process by which founders produce, repair, and perform a conviction state sufficient for decision and persuasion across that gap. I develop a dual-audience process modelthe conviction cycle-in which evidence events generate regulatory demands, founders deploy regulation strategies directed at the evidence, the self, the environment, or the audience, and the resulting performance of conviction recursively shapes private belief through audience responses that become new evidence. Building on this model, I derive a taxonomy of sixteen conviction work strategies, specify the characteristic pathology into which each strategy family tips when overused, and offer a principled account of the boundary between functional persistence and escalation of commitment: regulation remains functional while it operates on the founder's state and situation, and turns pathological when it begins to operate on the admissibility of evidence. Boundary conditions concerning uncertainty type, founder experience, team structure, and cultural display norms are specified, and an experience-sampling research agenda is proposed. The theory repositions founder confidence from a trait-like input to an ongoing, socially embedded regulatory accomplishment, and speaks beyond entrepreneurship to leadership under uncertainty generally.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"认知-行为差距"概念，指创始人证据所保证的信心与其角色功能所需信心之间的差距。作者将"信念工作"定义为创始人弥合这一差距、持续产生、修复和展演充足信念状态的自我调节过程，并构建了"信念循环"双受众过程模型，推导出十六种信念工作策略的分类体系，阐明功能性坚持与承诺升级之间的边界。
AI.research_question: 早期科技企业创始人在认知上无法获得充分证据支持的情况下，如何持续产生并展演足够的信念状态以支撑决策、坚持和对外说服？其机制与边界条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 创业研究分别记录了创始人面临的不确定性与表现出的信心行为，但从未将二者之间的张力理论化。本文旨在填补这一空白，系统理论化创始人"知道得不够却必须表现得自信"这一中间地带。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自我调节理论；认知-行为差距概念；信念循环双受众过程模型（证据事件→调节需求→调节策略→信念展演→受众反应成为新证据的递归过程）；承诺升级理论。
AI.method: 理论构建/概念性论文。基于过程模型推导出十六种信念工作策略的分类体系，并针对不确定性类型、创始人经验、团队结构和文化展示规范等提出边界条件及经验抽样研究议程。
AI.findings: (1) 提炼出认知-行为差距与信念工作两个核心概念；(2) 构建信念循环双受众过程模型；(3) 推导出十六种信念工作策略的分类学及每种策略家族过度使用时的典型病态；(4) 提出功能性调节与承诺升级的边界：当调节作用于创始人自身的状态和情境时为功能性，当开始作用于证据的可采纳性时则转为病态。
AI.theory_contributions: 将创始人信心从特质性输入重新定位为持续的、社会嵌入的调节性成就；首次系统理论化创始人的认知-行为张力；为功能性坚持与病态性承诺升级提供了原则性区分标准，拓展了不确定性领导力的理论适用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创始人提供了一套可识别的信念工作策略分类，帮助其自我监控调节策略的运用与病态倾向；为投资者、董事会等外部参与者理解创始人信心表现提供分析框架；该理论适用于一般性不确定情境下的领导实践，而非仅限于创业领域。

title: The ASEAN Growth Gradient: Why Vietnam Accelerates, Indonesia Stabilizes, and the Philippines Oscillates Across the Convergence Path

detail.title: The ASEAN Growth Gradient: Why Vietnam Accelerates, Indonesia Stabilizes, and the Philippines Oscillates Across the Convergence Path
detail.abstract:
The report introduces the ASEAN Growth Gradient, a framework explaining why Vietnam, Indonesia, and the Philippines—despite shared regional dynamics—follow sharply different macroeconomic trajectories. Drawing on structural data, institutional reforms, and export‑complexity trends, the study argues that emerging‑market convergence is no longer uniform but segmented into three developmental phases.

Vietnam occupies the Acceleration Phase, propelled by high‑value manufacturing FDI, rapid export‑complexity gains, and aggressive infrastructure expansion, though constrained by emerging energy bottlenecks. Indonesia sits in the Stabilization Phase, leveraging downstream industrial policies to transform volatile commodity sectors into integrated value chains and attract long‑term capital. The Philippines remains in the Oscillation Phase, where strong consumption and services growth coexist with manufacturing deficits and infrastructure gaps, producing cyclical volatility.

By mapping these economies along the gradient, the report provides a predictive lens for external‑shock vulnerability, optimal FDI strategies, and long‑run income trajectories. As global supply chains restructure and demographic dividends peak, the ASEAN Growth Gradient offers a more precise model for investors and policymakers seeking to navigate Southeast Asia’s increasingly divergent development paths.

AI.tldr: 该报告提出"东盟增长梯度"框架，解释越南、印度尼西亚和菲律宾尽管共享区域动态，却遵循截然不同的宏观经济轨迹。研究认为新兴市场趋同不再统一，而是分为三个发展阶段：越南处于加速期（高端制造FDI、出口复杂度提升），印尼处于稳定期（下游产业化政策），菲律宾处于波动期（消费服务业强劲但制造业和基础设施薄弱）。该框架为投资者和政策制定者提供了预测外部冲击脆弱性、最优FDI策略和长期收入轨迹的精准工具。
AI.research_question: 为什么同为东盟成员国、共享相似区域动态的越南、印度尼西亚和菲律宾，会呈现出截然不同的宏观经济轨迹？
AI.motivation: 传统的新兴市场趋同理论无法解释东盟内部日益分化的经济发展路径，亟需一个更精准的框架来理解和预测东南亚各国的差异化发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 东盟增长梯度（ASEAN Growth Gradient）框架，将新兴市场发展划分为三个阶段性相位：加速期（Acceleration Phase）、稳定期（Stabilization Phase）和波动期（Oscillation Phase）。
AI.method: 基于结构性数据、制度变革分析和出口复杂度趋势的综合研究。
AI.findings: 越南处于加速期，由高价值制造FDI、快速出口复杂度提升和激进基建扩张推动，但面临能源瓶颈；印尼处于稳定期，通过下游产业化政策将波动性大宗商品部门转化为整合价值链并吸引长期资本；菲律宾处于波动期，强劲的消费和服务业增长与制造业赤字及基建缺口并存，产生周期性波动。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了新兴市场趋同的均质化假设，提出分化且分段的发展模型，将发展阶段作为预测外部冲击脆弱性和长期收入轨迹的分析维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供预测外部冲击脆弱性和最优FDI策略的精准透镜；为政策制定者提供在全球供应链重构和人口红利见顶背景下导航东南亚分化发展路径的决策工具。

title: The Perceptual Failure Resilience Doctrine: Adversarial Machine Vision, Autonomous Vehicle Threat Convergence, and the Duty to Detect Sensor Disagreement in the United States National-Security Architecture

detail.title: The Perceptual Failure Resilience Doctrine: Adversarial Machine Vision, Autonomous Vehicle Threat Convergence, and the Duty to Detect Sensor Disagreement in the United States National-Security Architecture

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This manuscript is offered as an independent work of legal, national-security, technical, and systems scholarship. Its purpose is to identify a consequential vulnerability arising from institutional reliance on artificial-intelligence-mediated machine perception and to propose a framework for evaluating and mitigating that vulnerability within constitutional and statutory limits. The Perceptual Failure Resilience Doctrine is not advanced as an accusation against any manufacturer, technology provider, law-enforcement agency, governmental institution, autonomous-vehicle developer, or critical-infrastructure operator. Nor does it presume that the failure mechanisms examined herein are universal. Its purpose is to determine whether a plausible, high-consequence architectural dependency warrants formal assessment and proportionate remediation. The manuscript rests on a foundational distinction: machine perception is an interpretation of physical reality; it is not physical reality itself. A system may remain operational while its interpretation becomes incomplete or unreliable. Where protective functions depend upon that interpretation, computational non-recognition may become a failure of institutional awareness. The doctrine does not require technological infallibility. It asks whether high-consequence systems should preserve uncertainty, recognize meaningful disagreement, maintain residual awareness during failure, and prevent a single computational pathway from converting non-recognition into presumed physical absence. This manuscript concerns resilience, not prediction. It does not forecast attacks, identify adversaries, prescribe offensive methods, or provide operational guidance for exploitation. Its concern is architectural dependency. The appropriate response is disciplined assessment: identify the dependency, test it, measure consequence, evaluate mitigation, prioritize according to risk, and reassess as technology evolves. The doctrine is equally bounded by constitutional law. Technical vulnerability does not create governmental authority. Greater sensing capability does not itself justify prolonged tracking, unrestricted aggregation, indefinite retention, generalized suspicion, or coercive action. Detection, identification, suspicion, probable cause, and lawful intervention remain distinct states. The doctrine therefore rejects both institutional blindness and institutional overreach. Artificial intelligence tools were used for research assistance, source identification, organizational support, editing, language refinement, and drafting support. Their role was auxiliary. Artificial intelligence did not originate, formulate, or independently develop the Perceptual Failure Resilience Doctrine, the Sensor-Classifier Disagreement Principle, Perceptual Failure Without Notification, the Perceptual Resilience Test, or the doctrine’s constitutional and systems architecture. The doctrine’s formation, conceptual development, analytical judgments, and substantive conclusions remain attributable solely to Nicolin R. Decker. Artificial intelligence functioned as a research and editorial instrument, not as an author, co-author, legal authority, institutional reviewer, or endorsing party. All responsibility and liability for this manuscript rest solely with Nicolin R. Decker, including responsibility for its formulation, factual assertions, legal analysis, citations, interpretations, omissions, conclusions, recommendations, and publication. No artificial-intelligence provider, developer, operator, or associated institution assumes authorship, endorsement, validation, responsibility, or liability for the doctrine. The governing intent is simple: to strengthen institutional awareness where machine perception may fail while preserving the principle that greater technological capability must never become greater governmental authority by default.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This manuscript was prepared as an independent work of legal, national-security, technical, and systems scholarship. It did not involve human-subject research, clinical experimentation, collection of private identifiable information, intervention with research participants, or experimentation requiring institutional ethics review. The analysis is based upon publicly available legal authorities, governmental publications, technical standards, academic research, publicly reported demonstrations, historical materials, and other documentary sources. No individual was recruited, interviewed, surveyed, experimentally observed, or subjected to research procedures for purposes of developing the Perceptual Failure Resilience Doctrine. Accordingly, Institutional Review Board (IRB) or equivalent human-subject ethics approval was not sought because the research undertaken for this manuscript did not constitute human-subject research requiring such review. The manuscript nevertheless applies ethical constraints appropriate to national-security scholarship. Technical vulnerabilities are examined for defensive, institutional, and resilience purposes rather than to facilitate exploitation. The paper avoids unnecessary operational detail, distinguishes demonstrated evidence from inference, and does not treat technological capability as justification for expanded governmental authority. The author further recognizes that national-security necessity does not displace constitutional, legal, privacy, or civil-liberties obligations. Ethical responsibility therefore extends beyond research methodology to the manner in which proposed systems may be designed, tested, governed, and used. Responsibility for the ethical judgments, analytical boundaries, representations, omissions, and conclusions contained in this manuscript rests solely with Nicolin R. Decker.

detail.abstract:
Artificial intelligence increasingly mediates the relationship between physical reality and institutional awareness across automated license-plate recognition, vehicle classification, perimeter security, and related machine-perception systems. This paper identifies a distinct national-security vulnerability arising when computational non-recognition is treated as physical absence. It terms this condition Perceptual Failure Without Notification: a physically present object may fail to survive the machine-perception chain while the larger security architecture lacks an independent mechanism for recognizing that the failure itself is consequential.

The paper proposes the Perceptual Failure Resilience Doctrine (PFRD), which holds that no machine-perception system performing a high-consequence national-security function should possess unilateral authority to convert classifier failure into presumed physical absence when independent evidence of presence can reasonably be obtained. The accompanying Sensor-Classifier Disagreement Principle requires material contradiction between physical evidence and semantic non-recognition to become an observable security state rather than a silent null result.

PFRD develops a two-horizon resilience framework: software-based observability, telemetry, anomaly retention, disagreement detection, and human review in the near term; and risk-tiered independent sensing and multimodal fusion where consequence justifies additional physical redundancy. It further proposes a four-prong Perceptual Resilience Test based on Failure Observability, Independent Corroboration, Graceful Degradation, and Constitutional Constraint.

The doctrine is equally constitutional. Greater technical capability does not create greater governmental authority. Detection, identification, suspicion, historical aggregation, investigative use, and coercive action remain legally distinct. PFRD therefore incorporates Fourth Amendment limits, privacy-by-architecture, data minimization, bounded retention, access controls, auditability, lawful process, and accountable human judgment.

The paper ultimately advances bounded resilience as the appropriate national-security equilibrium: greater detection reliability + narrower information authority + accountable human judgment. Its central contribution is a systems doctrine for ensuring that machine-perception failure becomes observable, institutional awareness survives degraded conditions, modernization proceeds according to consequence, and technological resilience remains subordinate to constitutional law.

AI.tldr: 本文识别了人工智能机器感知系统中"感知失败无通知"（Perceptual Failure Without Notification）这一国家安全漏洞，即物理上存在的物体在机器感知链条中失败却未被系统察觉，并提出"感知失败韧性学说"（PFRD），要求高后果国家安全功能的机器感知系统不得单方面将分类失败转化为物理缺失的假设，同时建立可观测的失败状态、双层韧性框架和宪法约束机制，最终实现"更可靠的检测+更窄的信息权限+可问责的人类判断"的国家安全均衡。
AI.research_question: 当机器学习感知系统将"计算性未识别"当作"物理性缺失"处理时，会产生怎样的国家安全漏洞？如何设计一种系统学说来确保机器感知失败可被观测、制度认知在降级条件下仍能存续、现代化按后果推进且技术韧性从属于宪法法律？
AI.motivation: 人工智能日益中介物理现实与制度认知之间的关系，广泛应用于车牌识别、车辆分类、周界安全等机器感知系统。然而，当计算性未识别被视为物理缺失时，系统会静默丢失关键安全信号，而安全架构缺乏独立机制来识别这种失败本身的重要性，构成独特的国家安全漏洞。
AI.theoretical_framework: 感知失败韧性学说（PFRD）：机器感知系统不应拥有将分类失败转化为物理缺失的单方面权力；传感器-分类器分歧原则（Sensor-Classifier Disagreement Principle）：物理证据与语义未识别之间的实质矛盾应成为可观测的安全状态而非静默的空结果；双层韧性框架：近期以软件可观测性/遥测/异常保留/分歧检测/人工审查为主，远期以风险分级独立感知和多模态融合为主；四管齐下感知韧性测试：失败可观测性、独立佐证、优雅降级、宪法约束。
AI.method: 本文采用规范性/学说构建方法（doctrinal/conceptual analysis），提出系统的国家安全韧性框架与宪法分析框架。具体包括：提出感知失败韧性学说（PFRD）、传感器-分类器分歧原则、双层韧性框架（近远期）、四管齐下感知韧性测试、以及基于宪法限制（第四修正案、隐私架构、数据最小化、访问控制、可审计性、合法程序、可问责人类判断）的法律约束体系。
AI.findings: 1. 识别出"感知失败无通知"（Perceptual Failure Without Notification）作为独特国家安全隐患：物理存在对象可能未能在机器感知链中存活，而安全架构缺乏独立机制识别该失败的重要性。2. 提出PFRD：高后果国家安全功能的机器感知系统不得单方面将分类器失败转化为物理缺失假设。3. 构建传感器-分类器分歧原则，要求物理证据与语义未识别的矛盾成为可观测安全状态。4. 提出双层韧性框架与四管齐下感知韧性测试。5. 论证更强的技术能力不赋予更强的政府权力，检测、识别、怀疑、历史聚合、调查使用与强制行动在法律上保持区分。6. 提出"有界韧性"（bounded resilience）作为国家安全均衡：更大检测可靠性+更窄信息权限+可问责人类判断。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统化提出"感知失败无通知"这一概念，将机器学习失败问题从技术层面提升到国家安全制度层面。2. 提出"感知失败韧性学说"（PFRD）作为系统级学说，超越单一模型或算法的视角。3. 构建"传感器-分类器分歧原则"，将失败从静默空结果转化为可观测安全状态，贡献于人机交互与安全治理理论。4. 提出"有界韧性"（bounded resilience）概念，整合技术韧性与宪法约束，提供国家安全与法治平衡的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为国家安全机构提供可操作的双层韧性实施框架（近期软件措施+远期独立感知冗余）。2. 提供四管齐下感知韧性测试（失败可观测性、独立佐证、优雅降级、宪法约束），可用于系统评估与审计。3. 提供包含第四修正案约束、隐私架构、数据最小化、有界保留、访问控制、可审计性、合法程序和可问责人类判断的具体合规设计原则。4. 为政策制定者提供现代化推进的后果分级标准，确保技术升级与法律约束同步。

title: Economic evaluations of interventions for youth at risk: A critical literature review
affiliations: University of Sussex, School of Education and Social Work, University of Sussex and University of Sussex

detail.title: Economic evaluations of interventions for youth at risk: A critical literature review
detail.abstract: In recent years, constraints on the public purse have led to greater recognition of the importance of allocating social care resources based on rigorous research and evaluation. Despite an increase in experimental and quasi-experimental research into the impact of children's social care interventions over this period, there has been little attention to the development of robust methodologies for economic evaluation. This paper reports a critical review which identified, classified, and synthesized existing economic evaluations of interventions for young people aged 15-24 years. Only 12 articles met the inclusion criteria.Two costing approaches were identified: top-down and bottom-up. Bottom-up was potentially more accurate, since the costs could be linked to participants in the interventions. The most common outcomes were costings for reductions in criminal behaviour and improvement in quality of life. However, there were no outcomes related to employment, educational attainment, or housing, even though they are monetisable.Significant methodological limitations were identified which need to be addressed in future studies. The nature of control groups needs specification beyond ’service as usual’. The process by which outcomes are monetised needs to be explicit as there was a reliance on prior research or estimates without specific adjustments for the population or context. Many studies did not include a sensitivity analysis, or lacked confidence intervals, making it difficult to quantify uncertainty. There were a range of data constraints associated with attrition, missing or partial data. Bias concerns emerged due to the impossibility of double-masked trials and because intervention teams conducted their own evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本文对15-24岁青少年社会关怀干预的经济评估研究进行了批判性综述，识别、分类并综合了符合纳入标准的12篇文章。研究发现成本核算主要采用自上而下和自下而上两种方法，最常见的产出是犯罪行为减少和生活质量改善的成本核算，但缺乏就业、教育成就和住房等可货币化结果。研究揭示了对照组设定、结果货币化过程、敏感性分析缺失以及数据约束等重大方法论局限。
AI.research_question: 现有的针对15-24岁青少年社会关怀干预的经济评估研究有哪些？它们采用了什么方法？存在哪些方法论局限？
AI.motivation: 公共财政约束日益严峻，社会关怀资源分配需要基于严谨的研究和评估，但现有研究缺乏对经济评估的健全方法论的关注。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济评估理论框架，包括成本核算方法（自上而下与自下而上）、结果货币化、敏感性分析等方法论要素。
AI.method: 批判性综述（critical review），对现有经济评估研究进行识别、分类和综合，纳入15-24岁青少年社会关怀干预的经济评估研究。
AI.findings: 仅有12篇文章符合纳入标准；存在自上而下和自下而上两种成本核算方法，后者更准确；最常见的产出是犯罪行为减少和生活质量改善的成本核算；缺乏就业、教育成就和住房等可货币化结果；存在显著的对照组设定、货币化过程、敏感性分析、数据约束和偏见等方法论局限。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理并批判了青少年社会关怀干预经济评估的方法论现状，识别出关键方法论缺陷，为该领域未来的经济评估方法发展提供了理论基础和方向指引。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和实践者提供了现有经济评估证据的综合图景，指出了选择评估方法时需要注意的关键问题（如成本核算方法的选择、对照组的设定、敏感性分析的必要性），有助于更合理地分配有限的社会关怀资源。

title:
We are not Poor. We are being Kept Poor. 
Debt, De-industrialisation, Governance and the Structural Chain Stalling Cameroon's Development

detail.title:
We are not Poor. We are being Kept Poor. 
Debt, De-industrialisation, Governance and the Structural Chain Stalling Cameroon's Development
detail.abstract: Cameroon is not a poor country. It holds significant reserves of oil, natural gas, bauxite, cobalt and iron ore, possesses some of the most fertile agricultural land in Africa, and has a young, growing and largely bilingual population. Yet four decades after the peak of its industrial strength, its GDP per capita in 2024 remains below the level recorded in 1986. This paper argues that Cameroon's development challenges are not a collection of independent problems but a single interconnected chain in which debt mismanagement, governance failure, economic de-industrialisation and human capital loss each reinforce the next. Drawing on publicly available data, presidential decrees, national statistics, IMF and World Bank reports, and recent investigative journalism, the paper traces this chain across four interconnected pillars: debt and dependency, economic diversification, governance and accountability, and education and youth. The central finding is that Cameroon's development cannot be unlocked by addressing any one of these pillars in isolation. It requires simultaneous action across all four, beginning with the governance and enforcement conditions that make every other reform either possible or impossible. The paper identifies the SME environment as the single highest-leverage reform available to Cameroon today: it is both the private-sector engine that can replace the state-led industrialisation model that is no longer fiscally viable, and the domestic job market that gives the country's educated youth a reason to stay. The paper concludes with a chain analysis showing that honest debt management, governance accountability, economic diversification and education reform are not four separate policy agendas but four links in the same chain and that the chain is only as strong as its weakest link.

AI.tldr: 本文论证喀麦隆的发展困境并非一系列独立问题，而是一个由债务管理不善、治理失败、经济去工业化和人力资本流失相互强化形成的单一互联链条。论文识别出四大支柱（债务与依附、经济多元化、治理与问责、教育与青年），并提出中小企业环境是最具杠杆效应的改革抓手，最终强调四者需同步推进，链条强度取决于最薄弱环节。
AI.research_question: 喀麦隆的发展挑战为何不是相互独立的问题，而是相互关联、相互强化的发展链条？如何破解这一发展困局？
AI.motivation: 喀麦隆拥有丰富的自然资源和人力资源禀赋，但2024年人均GDP仍低于1986年水平，工业鼎盛时期40年后经济持续衰退。现有政策思路将发展问题视为孤立问题逐个解决，未能认识到其系统性和连锁性，需要整体性分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 发展困境的系统性链条理论：将债务管理、治理失败、经济去工业化和人力资本流失视为相互强化的因果链条；同时借鉴资源诅咒、治理与发展关系、制度经济学等相关理论视角。
AI.method: 基于公开可得数据的综合分析，包括总统法令、国家统计数据、IMF和世界银行报告以及近期调查性新闻报道，对四大互联支柱进行定性追踪和链式因果分析。
AI.findings: 1. 喀麦隆的发展问题构成单一互联链条，各部分相互强化；2. 仅解决单一支柱无法解锁国家发展，需四方面同时行动；3. 治理和执法条件是其他一切改革可能或不可能的前提；4. 中小企业环境是喀麦隆当前最高杠杆的改革抓手——既能替代财政上不可持续的国家主导工业化模式，又能为受教育青年提供国内就业机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"发展链条"分析框架，将看似独立的治理、经济、债务和教育问题整合为一个系统性因果模型，揭示各环节间的相互强化机制，并阐明治理是决定性前提条件、中小企业环境是最高杠杆点的理论判断。
AI.practical_contributions: 为喀麦隆和其他类似资源禀赋充足但发展停滞的国家提供政策启示：改革必须整体推进而非孤立进行；优先修复治理和执法条件；将中小企业发展作为替代国家主导工业化的核心引擎和留住青年人才的关键机制；强调债务管理的诚实性和问责制。

title: A Measurement Framework for Pine Resin (Pinus merkusii Jungh. et de Vriese) as a Non-Timber Forest Product: Characteristics, Data Collection Methods, and Carbon Potential
affiliations: and

detail.title: A Measurement Framework for Pine Resin (Pinus merkusii Jungh. et de Vriese) as a Non-Timber Forest Product: Characteristics, Data Collection Methods, and Carbon Potential

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study did not involve human participants, clinical trials, or animal experiments.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Pine resin (Pinus merkusii Jungh. et de Vriese) is one of the most strategic non-timber forest product (NTFP) commodities in Indonesia, the country ranking third worldwide as a pine resin producer after China and Brazil (Sukadaryati, 2014). Beyond its high economic value as a raw material for gum rosin and turpentine, resin-producing stands also play an important ecological role in carbon storage. This study develops a systematic measurement framework for pine resin as an NTFP across four aspects: the biological, chemical, and economic characteristics of the resin; field data-collection methods for stand and resin samples; approaches for measuring carbon content in biomass and resin; and integrated carbon potential calculations accompanied by sensitivity analysis of key assumptions. The framework is illustrated using secondary data from a case study of a 139.2-hectare productive pine stand in RPH Karangsambung, KPH Kedu Selatan, Central Java (Khoirina, 2024), combined with resin carbon-fraction values from elemental analysis of a subtropical pine species (Rodrigues-Honda et al., 2023). Results show a stand carbon stock of 255.29 tons C/ha (equivalent to approximately 937.50 tons CO2/ha), with annual resin production of 22,975.38 kg/ha containing approximately 9.46 to 13.14 tons C/ha/year of carbon depending on the resin carbon-fraction assumption used. The net carbon balance of the tapped stand is negative, but the stand's initial carbon stock can sustain this annual deficit for 20 to 29 years, exceeding a normal tapping rotation. At voluntary carbon market prices of USD 5-50 per ton CO2, the economic value of the stand's carbon stock is estimated at between IDR 10.1 billion and IDR 101.0 billion for the entire study area. The main contribution of this paper is a transparent, replicable measurement framework rather than a definitive claim about carbon potential, so that species-and site-specific values still need to be verified through direct field measurement and laboratory analysis before being used for investment or policy decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一套系统性的测量框架，用于评估松脂（Pinus merkusii）作为非木材林产品（NTFP）的碳汇潜力，涵盖生物、化学、经济特性、野外数据采集、碳含量测量及碳潜力综合计算等方面，并以中爪哇139.2公顷生产性松林的案例数据进行说明。结果显示林分碳储量为255.29吨C/公顷，松脂年产量含碳约9.46-13.14吨C/公顷/年，采脂林分的净碳平衡为负，但初始碳储量可支撑该年亏损20-29年，超过正常采脂轮伐期。文章强调其贡献在于提供透明可复制的测量框架，而非对碳潜力的确定性声明。
AI.research_question: 如何系统性地测量和评估松脂（Pinus merkusii）作为非木材林产品（NTFP）的碳储存潜力，并构建一套透明、可复制的测量框架？
AI.motivation: 松脂是印尼最重要的非木材林产品之一，不仅具有高经济价值（作为松香和松节油的原材料），其产脂林分在碳储存方面还发挥重要的生态作用。然而，目前缺乏一套系统性的测量框架来评估松脂作为NTFP的碳潜力，因此需要建立一个涵盖多方面（生物、化学、经济特性、数据采集、碳测量及敏感性分析）的综合测量体系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究基于林业碳计量理论和NTFP价值评估框架，整合了生物质碳测量方法、松脂碳含量元素分析、以及自愿碳市场定价机制等理论基础，通过碳储量核算、碳平衡分析和敏感性分析来评估松林的碳汇潜力。
AI.method: 本文采用框架构建与案例验证相结合的方法。首先构建涵盖四个方面的系统测量框架：(1)松脂的生物学、化学和经济特性；(2)林分和树脂样本的野外数据采集方法；(3)生物质和树脂碳含量的测量方法；(4)综合碳潜力计算及关键假设的敏感性分析。随后使用RPH Karangsambung地区139.2公顷生产性松林的二手数据进行案例演示，结合亚热带松树物种的元素分析碳分数值进行计算。
AI.findings: 研究结果表明：林分碳储量为255.29吨C/公顷（约937.50吨CO2/公顷）；松脂年产量为22,975.38公斤/公顷，根据不同的碳分数假设，含碳量约为每年9.46至13.14吨C/公顷；采脂林分的净碳平衡为负，但初始碳储量可维持该年度赤字20至29年，超过了正常采脂轮伐期；按自愿碳市场价格5-50美元/吨CO2计算，整个研究区域林分碳储量的经济价值估计在101亿至1010亿印尼盾之间。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文的理论贡献在于提出了一套透明、可复制的系统性测量框架，将松脂的生物学、化学和经济学特性与碳计量方法整合在一起，为后续非木材林产品碳潜力的标准化评估提供了方法论基础，填补了松脂在NTFP碳核算方面的框架空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 本文的实践贡献在于为决策者和投资者提供了评估松林碳汇经济价值的参考方法，展示了松脂林分在碳储存方面的生态服务价值与自愿碳市场的经济价值（101亿-1010亿印尼盾），同时强调物种和地点特异性的碳参数需要通过直接野外测量和实验室分析加以验证后才能用于投资或政策决策。

title: Quantile Restrictions, Revealed Rankings, and the Limits of Multinomial Choice

detail.title: Quantile Restrictions, Revealed Rankings, and the Limits of Multinomial Choice
detail.abstract:
This paper analyzes when choice probabilities reveal rankings of deterministic utility indices in semiparametric discrete choice models. It begins with binary choice, where quantile thresholds guarantee ranking recovery, and shows that such thresholds can arise either from behavioral departures from utility maximization (e.g., limited attention) under exchangeable unobservables, or from non-exchangeable unobservables under standard utility maximization. These behavioral and distributional routes are then extended to multinomial choice with J alternatives. Under limited attention, balance restrictions on attention probabilities yield global linear ranking partitions characterized by J(J-1)/2 two-coordinate representations. These partitions are robust to the distribution of unobservables and, given sufficient joint variation in the differences of utility indices, are also necessary. For J ≥ 4, conditions for more general multi-coordinate representations are provided. Absent the required attention restrictions, opposite rankings can produce overlapping probability images. Under non-exchangeable unobservables, a comparable distribution-uniform partition generally need not exist. 
Holding the distribution fixed, however, ranking recovery remains possible via an injective (generally nonlinear) map from normalized utility differences to choice probabilities under both behavioral and distributional extensions. Together, the results distinguish distribution-robust global ranking partitions from structural ranking recovery.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了半参数离散选择模型中，选择概率何时能够揭示确定性效用指数的排序。论文从二元选择出发，证明了分位数阈值可以保证排序恢复，并区分了两种途径：行为偏差（如有限关注）与不可交换不可观测项。随后将这两种途径扩展到J个选项的多项选择，刻画了全局线性排序划分的结构特征及其必要充分条件。
AI.research_question: 在半参数离散选择模型中，选择概率在什么条件下能够揭示确定性效用指数的排序？特别是，行为偏差（如有限关注）与不可交换不可观测项这两种途径对排序恢复的可行性有何影响？
AI.motivation: 离散选择模型中，研究者常常希望仅从观察到的选择行为中推断潜在效用结构的排序。然而，排序恢复的条件尚不清晰，尤其是当模型允许分布灵活设定（半参数）且可能存在行为偏离标准效用最大化假设时，排序是否可识别成为一个基础问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 半参数离散选择模型；效用最大化理论；有限关注理论；分位数阈值方法；可交换性/不可交换性假设
AI.method: 本文采用理论分析方法，通过构造分位数阈值条件，从二元选择推广到多项选择，利用注意力概率的平衡约束刻画线性排序划分，并证明其充分性与必要性条件，同时分析了非线性映射下的排序恢复。
AI.findings: （1）二元选择中，分位数阈值可从行为偏差或不可交换不可观测项两条路径产生；（2）有限关注下，平衡注意力约束可产生全局线性排序划分，由J(J-1)/2个二维表示刻画，且对不可观测项分布稳健，在效用差充分联合变化下也是必要条件；（3）J≥4时给出了更一般多坐标表示的条件；（4）缺乏注意力约束时，相反排序可产生重叠概率图像；（5）不可交换不可观测项下，分布一致的划分一般不存在，但固定分布时可通过非线性映射实现排序恢复。
AI.theory_contributions: 论文系统地刻画了有限关注行为模型与标准效用最大化模型在排序可识别性上的差异，揭示了行为偏差和分布假设两条路径在排序恢复中的等价性结构，并将二元选择的结果推广到一般多项选择，提供了全局线性排序划分的完整刻画。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实证研究者提供了在何种条件下可以放心地从选择数据中推断效用排序的指导；有助于选择合适的模型设定（是否允许有限关注或灵活分布），并理解不同设定下排序推断的稳健性与局限性。

title: Nonlinear Stock Price Detection in Stata
affiliations: and University of New Orleans - College of Business Administration

detail.title: Nonlinear Stock Price Detection in Stata
detail.abstract: This paper examines the profitability of technical analysis stock price pa6erns defined by five consecu:ve extrema, including head and shoulders, inverse head and shoulders, broadening, triangle, rectangle, double, and combina:on pa6erns. We develop an updated detec:on framework using Mata func:ons and batch files in Stata. We employ local polynomial regression of order one with a Gaussian kernel and cross-validated bandwidth on CRSP data, comple:ng the process in under three hours. Our findings indicate that the pa6erns are economically significant-top pa6erns produce nega:ve one-day returns, while bo6om pa6erns yield posi:ve one-day returns. Addi:onally, condi:oning on increased trading volume enhances bo6om pa6ern returns, and smaller sizes intensify the nega:ve returns of top pa6erns. We also demonstrate early pa6ern detec:on using Gradient Boosted trees, offering :mely forecasts and improved profitability compared to previous models. 3 Key Takeaways: 1. Technical stock price pa6erns of head and shoulders, inverse head and shoulders, broadening top, broadening bo6om, triangle top, triangle bo6om, rectangle top, and rectangle bo6om show posi:ve returns 1 day aQer a completed pa6ern for bo6om and nega:ve returns 1 day aQer a completed pa6ern for top 2. Pa6erns are found in a fixed 38-day window using smoothing technology. The process is updated to detect pa6erns on the Center for Research in Security Prices (CRSP) in 3 hours using Stata. 3. Sta:s:cal significance tes:ng shows that the returns are sta:s:cally different when a completed pa6ern is found compared to the average returns that occurred during the lookback period while the pa6ern was formed.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于五个连续极值点的技术分析股票价格形态（包括头肩顶、反向头肩、扩散、三角、矩形、双重顶底及组合形态）的盈利性，开发了基于Stata Mata函数和批处理文件的更新检测框架，使用一阶局部多项式回归和高斯核及交叉验证带宽对CRSP数据处理，在三小时内完成。研究发现这些形态具有经济显著性——顶部形态产生负的一日回报，底部形态产生正的回报，交易量条件化能增强底部形态收益，小市值公司加剧顶部形态的负收益。文章还展示了使用梯度提升树进行早期形态检测的能力。
AI.research_question: 技术分析中基于五个连续极值点定义的股票价格形态（如头肩顶、头肩底、扩散、三角、矩形、双重顶底及组合形态）是否具有经济意义上的盈利能力？能否通过更新、高效的检测框架在大型数据集上快速验证这些形态的统计显著性？
AI.motivation: 此前的技术分析形态检测方法效率低下，无法在大型数据集（如CRSP）上快速运行，且较老的检测框架需要数天才能完成。作者旨在开发一个能在3小时内完成检测的更新框架，并进一步探索形态预测的及时性（通过梯度提升树进行早期检测），以提升技术分析的实用性和盈利性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技术分析中的经典形态识别理论（头肩、三角、矩形等反转和延续形态），采用一阶局部多项式回归（高斯核、交叉验证带宽）进行价格平滑处理，并以统计显著性检验验证形态完成后的条件收益与回溯期平均收益之间的差异。
AI.method: 使用Stata中的Mata函数和批处理文件开发更新的形态检测框架，对CRSP数据采用一阶局部多项式回归（高斯核、交叉验证带宽）进行平滑处理，在固定38天窗口内检测形态。同时使用梯度提升树（Gradient Boosted Trees）进行早期形态检测，以提供及时预测。
AI.findings: 1. 顶部形态（头肩顶、扩散顶、三角顶、矩形顶）产生负的一日收益，底部形态（反向头肩、扩散底、三角底、矩形底）产生正的一日收益，经济上具有显著性。2. 增加交易量条件能增强底部形态的收益；较小市值公司会加剧顶部形态的负收益。3. 统计显著性检验表明，形态完成后的收益与形态形成回溯期内的平均收益存在统计显著差异。4. 梯度提升树的早期检测能提供及时预测并改善比之前模型更高的盈利能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了一个高效、可复现的形态检测框架（基于Stata Mata），显著缩短了大规模数据处理时间（从数天缩短至3小时内）。2. 验证了经典技术分析形态在CRSP数据上的统计显著性和经济显著性，为技术分析有效性提供了实证支持。3. 引入梯度提升树进行早期形态检测，将机器学习方法与传统形态识别结合起来，拓展了技术分析方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供了实践意义上的技术分析信号：顶部形态完成后次日做空（或规避），底部形态完成后次日做多可获得超额收益。2. 揭示了交易量和公司市值作为条件变量对形态盈利性的调节作用，帮助投资者优化交易策略。3. 梯度提升树的早期检测能力使投资者能在形态完全形成前获得预警信号，提升交易及时性和盈利能力。4. 开放了高效执行的Stata代码框架，便于实务界和学术界复用。

title: State Policy, Individual Odds: A Multilevel Analysis of Educational Financial Aid Receipt Among Young Adults with Experience in Foster Care
affiliations: University of Louisville and University of Illinois Chicago

detail.title: State Policy, Individual Odds: A Multilevel Analysis of Educational Financial Aid Receipt Among Young Adults with Experience in Foster Care

keywords: young adults with experience in foster care

detail.abstract: Young adults with experience in foster care (YFCE) often face major financial barriers to postsecondary education. Many states have created tuition waivers, scholarships, grants, direct-payment programs, or mixed/hybrid supports for this population, but it is unclear whether formal program presence is associated with individual aid receipt. Using four cohorts of the National Youth in Transition Database (NYTD) Outcomes survey (N = 29,291 at age 21; cohorts 2011, 2014, 2017, 2020) linked to NYTD Services records, we estimated multilevel logistic regression models of reported receipt of any educational financial aid as a function of demographics, independent living service receipt, and a time-varying indicator for whether a state had a foster-care-specific postsecondary support program with a documented formal authorization or establishment date by the Wave 3 observation year. The policy indicator captures formal program presence, not implementation quality or receipt of state-specific aid. At age 21, 19.3% of respondents reported receiving educational financial aid. In the multilevel model, female YFCE (OR = 1.74), Asian YFCE (OR = 3.34), and those who had received education financial assistance services (OR = 2.62) had higher odds of receipt. Aid receipt declined across cohorts, with the 2017 cohort showing the steepest drop. State-level variation accounted for 6.9% of the variance (ICC = .069), but formal state program presence was not associated with reported receipt of any educational financial aid (OR = 0.96, p = .558). Sensitivity checks that recoded uncertain policy entries and varied formal authorization timing produced the same conclusion.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用四波全国青年转衔数据库（NYTD）数据（21岁时N=29,291），通过多层逻辑回归模型检验州级寄养照护专属高等教育资助项目的存在是否与青年实际获得教育财政援助相关。结果显示，尽管19.3%的受访者报告获得了教育财政援助，且性别、种族和独立生活服务接受史显著影响援助获得，但州级正式项目的存在与个人援助获得之间无显著关联（OR=0.96, p=.558），敏感性检验也支持这一结论。
AI.research_question: 州级是否存在正式的寄养照护专属高等教育资助项目，与寄养照护经历青年（YFCE）实际获得教育财政援助之间是否相关？
AI.motivation: 许多州为寄养照护经历的青年设立了学费减免、奖学金、助学金、直接支付或混合型资助项目，但现有研究尚不清楚这些正式项目的存在是否真正转化为个体层面的援助获得，这关系到政策有效性的基础性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以多层（多水平）模型为方法框架，将个体层面因素（人口学特征、独立生活服务接受）与州级政策环境因素（正式项目存在与否）同时纳入分析，考察跨层次效应。
AI.method: 使用四波NYTD Outcomes调查数据（2011、2014、2017、2020队列，21岁时N=29,291）与NYTD Services记录关联，构建多层逻辑回归模型，以是否报告获得任何教育财政援助为因变量，以人口学特征、独立生活服务接受情况和随时间变化的州级政策指示变量为自变量。政策指示变量捕捉正式项目存在与否（有正式授权或设立日期），而非实施质量或具体州援助获得。另进行敏感性检验（重编码不确定政策条目、调整正式授权时间）。
AI.findings: （1）21岁时19.3%的受访者报告获得教育财政援助；（2）女性（OR=1.74）、亚裔（OR=3.34）和接受过教育财政援助服务的青年（OR=2.62）有更高的援助获得几率；（3）援助获得率随队列下降，2017队列降幅最大；（4）州级变异占总方差的6.9%（ICC=.069），但州级正式项目存在与教育财政援助获得无显著关联（OR=0.96, p=.558）；（5）敏感性检验均得出相同结论。
AI.theory_contributions: 该研究为政策供给与个体结果之间的"传导链条"提供了实证检验，揭示正式的州级政策存在并不自动等于个体层面的服务获得，丰富了关于政策覆盖与实际受益之间差距的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果提示政策制定者，仅仅建立正式资助项目可能不足以提高寄养照护经历青年的教育财政援助获得率，需要关注项目的实施质量、信息传播、申请支持等实践环节，而非仅停留在政策文本层面。

title: Early Detection of Recessions in U.S. Housing and Stock Market
affiliations: , University of New Orleans - College of Business Administration - Department of Economics and Finance and Marquette University

detail.title: Early Detection of Recessions in U.S. Housing and Stock Market
detail.abstract: This paper examines the poten:al bubbles in the housing and stock markets in the United States between 2000 to 2023 by applying :me series methods We test the Backwards Supremum Augmented Dickey-Fuller (BSADF) technique to detect real-:me housing bubbles in both the real and nominal housing market indices, as well as in U.S. stock prices. Our findings indicate evidence of bubbles in the U.S. housing market and raw stock markets prior to the iden:fica:on of a bubble using the price-todividend ra:o. We apply a moving average to the Generalized Supremum Augmented Dickey-Fuller (GSADF) technique to assess its effec:veness in :ming an early exit from bubbles. Our results reveal bubbles in the 2005-2007 housing market, 2008 across all markets, and the 2020-2022 price-to-dividend ra:o, with ongoing bubbles in other markets. The GSADF technique is effec:ve in :ming an early exit for the 2005 U.S. home price bubble, the 2008 U.S. price-to-dividend ra:o bubble, and the 2020 U.S. raw stock prices bubble. The economic implica:ons of these findings remain unclear, but further explora:on of these techniques could be valuable for iden:fying future bubbles. Notably, we detect a bubble in the 2020-2022 price-to-dividend ra:o in the U.S. that is no longer ac:ve.

AI.tldr: 本文运用时间序列方法（BSADF和GSADF技术）检验了2000至2023年间美国住房市场和股票市场中的潜在泡沫。研究发现，在价格-股息比率识别出泡沫之前，美国住房市场和原始股票市场就已出现泡沫迹象。GSADF技术配合移动平均在处理2005年住房市场泡沫、2008年价格-股息比率泡沫以及2020年原始股票价格泡沫的早期退出时机方面表现有效。
AI.research_question: 美国住房市场和股票市场在2000至2023年间是否存在资产泡沫？如何利用BSADF和GSADF时间序列技术实时检测和识别这些泡沫，并评估其早期退出时机的有效性？
AI.motivation: 资产泡沫对经济稳定具有重大影响，提前识别泡沫并掌握退出时机对于投资者和决策者至关重要。传统的价格-股息比率等指标可能滞后于泡沫的出现，需要更先进的时间序列检测方法来实时捕捉泡沫的形成和破裂。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资产泡沫理论、单位根检验理论、BSADF（Backwards Supremum Augmented Dickey-Fuller）技术、GSADF（Generalized Supremum Augmented Dickey-Fuller）技术
AI.method: 采用时间序列方法，具体运用BSADF技术对实际和名义住房市场指数以及美国股票价格进行实时泡沫检测；同时将移动平均应用于GSADF技术，以评估其在泡沫早期退出时机方面的有效性。
AI.findings: 研究发现：2005-2007年住房市场存在泡沫；2008年所有市场均出现泡沫；2020-2022年价格-股息比率出现泡沫（但已不再活跃），其他市场存在持续泡沫。GSADF技术在2005年美国房价泡沫、2008年价格-股息比率泡沫以及2020年原始股票价格泡沫的早期退出时机方面表现有效。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了BSADF和GSADF时间序列技术在实时检测资产泡沫方面的有效性，并展示了GSADF结合移动平均方法在泡沫早期退出时机判定上的应用价值，丰富了资产泡沫检测方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和决策者提供了更及时的泡沫检测和退出时机判断工具，有助于在泡沫破裂前采取预防性措施，从而减少经济损失。

title: Demurrage in the Age of Alternative Marine Fuels

detail.title: Demurrage in the Age of Alternative Marine Fuels
detail.abstract: By the end of 2021, maritime decarbonization had moved far enough to change commercial planning but not far enough to produce a complete contractual vocabulary for the time lost in using new fuels. LNG already had an international safety framework and port-bunkering practice. Methanol had received dedicated interim IMO safety guidance. Ammonia and hydrogen were prominent in decarbonization studies, while their fuel-specific safety rules were still being developed. At the same time, IMO had adopted its short-term greenhouse-gas measures and the European Commission had proposed FuelEU Maritime and an extension of emissions trading to shipping. The result was a foreseeable category of operational delay that conventional pollution-liability analysis did not answer. A vessel could lose time because fuel was unavailable at the nominated port, because bunkering could not be performed within the expected operational window, because a terminal or authority required additional safety controls, or because the ship, supplier, and port were not technically compatible. No spill or casualty was necessary. This article examines that pre-damage problem through the law of laytime and demurrage. It argues that traditional doctrine can price delay only after the charterparty has identified where the relevant time risk belongs. The emerging fuel transition therefore requires a contractual category of fuel-transition delay tied to control over vessel capability, fuel procurement, port nomination, bunkering arrangements, regulatory documentation, and operational readiness. The article uses only authorities available by the end of 2021 and presents the issue as a problem already visible at the beginning of the transition rather than one reconstructed from later regulation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了海事脱碳转型过程中产生的新型运营延误问题——燃料转型延误（fuel-transition delay），指出传统的污染责任分析无法涵盖此类延误，主张通过装卸时间与滞期费（laytime and demurrage）的法律框架，在租船合同中建立专门的合同类别，明确与燃料相关的延误风险归属。
AI.research_question: 在海事脱碳转型过程中，因新型燃料（LNG、甲醇、氨、氢）使用产生的运营延误（如燃料不可用、加注超时、安全管控新增、技术不兼容等），传统法律框架应如何通过装卸时间和滞期费制度进行定价与风险分配？
AI.motivation: 截至2021年底，海事脱碳已发展到改变商业规划但尚未形成完整合同语言的阶段。传统污染责任分析无法回答无泄漏、无伤亡情况下的运营延误问题，而此类延误不可避免且日益可见，需要新的合同法律框架予以应对。
AI.theoretical_framework: 装卸时间与滞期费法律（law of laytime and demurrage）；租船合同中的时间风险分配理论；污染责任与合同延误的区分框架。
AI.method: 法律分析（doctrinal legal analysis），基于截至2021年底可获得的法律权威（authorities）与监管发展（IMO短期温室气体措施、FuelEU Maritime提案、排放交易扩展）进行分析。
AI.findings: 传统法律体系只能在租船合同明确时间风险归属后才能对延误定价；燃料转型需要建立独立的"燃料转型延误"合同类别，与船舶能力控制、燃料采购、港口指定、加注安排、监管文件和运营准备等控制要素挂钩。
AI.theory_contributions: 将装卸时间与滞期费理论扩展到脱碳转型情境；提出"燃料转型延误"作为新的合同法律类别；弥合了污染责任分析与合同延误分析之间的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为租船合同当事方在燃料转型期提供合同起草和风险分配指引；帮助航运业在监管不确定时期建立可操作的延误定价机制；为LNG、甲醇、氨、氢等替代燃料的实际应用提供合同层面的法律准备。

title: Endogenous Money, Debt Maturity, and the Yield Curve: A Conditional Stock–Flow-Consistent Post-Keynesian Architecture
affiliations: Hanyang University

detail.title: Endogenous Money, Debt Maturity, and the Yield Curve: A Conditional Stock–Flow-Consistent Post-Keynesian Architecture

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses public aggregate data and does not involve human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: Coherent revaluation across maturities requires a valuation discipline, while stock–flow-consistent institutions identify money creation, duration holders, and the incidence of revaluation. This paper develops a conditional accounting–behavior–pricing architecture in which an administered overnight rate, endogenous bank credit, maturity-resolved Treasury portfolios, and affine bond prices coexist locally. A conditional local continuation result uses a composed total Jacobian to close the feedback from prices to holdings, revaluation, and subsequent stocks; its derivative separates direct quotation from induced stock-state channels. A corollary shows that accounting alone does not identify the sign or magnitude of duration responses. Calibrated state-contingency illustrations compare debt-maturity and asset-purchase interventions across inherited maturity and bank-capacity states. U.S. diagnostics test ATSM zero-return-exposure and zero-short-rate-loading restrictions, estimate predictive duration projections, and examine externally timed LSAP news. The private-duration full-pipeline 95-percent interval is [−11.41, 0.43] bp and the monthly LSAP full-pipeline interval is [−31.32, 6.28] bp, so both span zero. The exact-date daily yield regression is a same-market timing and aggregation diagnostic because the shock factor uses Treasury-market inputs. These results discipline the interpretation of cross-maturity pricing and incidence without identifying a causal or structural duration elasticity; the empirical exercises do not adjudicate the modeled bank-balance-sheet channel.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个条件会计-行为-定价架构，将管理隔夜利率、内生银行信贷、期限解析的国债组合与仿射债券价格局部共存，用于研究跨期限的重估一致性。通过复合总雅可比矩阵实现条件局部连续性结果，闭合价格到持仓、重估及后续存量的反馈回路。实证检验了ATSM的零收益暴露和零短期利率载荷限制，发现私人久期和LSAP的全管道区间均跨越零，表明结果不识别因果或结构性的久期弹性。
AI.research_question: 如何在一个统一的会计-行为-定价架构中，实现跨期限的一致性重估，并识别货币创造、久期持有者与重估归宿的分布？
AI.motivation: 跨期限的一致性重估需要估值纪律，而存量-流量一致的制度框架可以识别货币创造、久期持有者以及重估的分布影响。现有文献缺乏将管理利率、银行信贷、国债组合与债券定价整合的条件框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 存量-流量一致（stock-flow consistent）框架、仿射期限结构模型（ATSM）、条件局部连续性定理、总雅可比矩阵方法。
AI.method: 构建条件会计-行为-定价三层架构，使用复合总雅可比矩阵闭合反馈回路；通过导数分离直接报价渠道与引致存量状态渠道；进行校准的状态条件性情景分析；利用美国数据检验ATSM限制条件（零收益暴露、零短期利率载荷），估计预测性久期投影，并检验外部定时的LSAP新闻冲击。
AI.findings: 私人久期全管道95%区间为[−11.41, 0.43]基点，月度LSAP全管道区间为[−31.32, 6.28]基点，两者均跨越零；会计本身无法识别久期响应的符号或大小；精确日期的日度收益率回归是同一市场的时机和聚合诊断。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了条件局部连续性结果，利用复合总雅可比矩阵闭合价格-持仓-重估-存量的反馈回路；证明了会计本身无法单独识别久期响应的符号或大小，为跨期限定价与归宿解释提供了纪律约束。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者比较债务期限干预与资产购买干预在不同继承期限状态和银行能力状态下的效果提供了校准工具；对LSAP新闻冲击和久期效应给出了审慎的量化区间估计，避免过度解读估计值。

title: Dependency-Aware Aggregation of Heterogeneous Model Nowcasts for U.S. CPI Inflation: A Real-Data Walk-Forward Evaluation

detail.title: Dependency-Aware Aggregation of Heterogeneous Model Nowcasts for U.S. CPI Inflation: A Real-Data Walk-Forward Evaluation
detail.abstract: We test whether the dependency-aware Pi_L (lead-lag) aggregator of Stanisljevic (2026) improves U.S. CPI inflation nowcasting over a naive equal-weighted aggregate of heterogeneous model nowcasts, in a strict rolling walk-forward out-of-sample backtest on public FRED data. We build five heterogeneous one-step base nowcasters - a random walk, a 12-month climatology, an AR(6), a ridge regression on a lagged nine-series macro panel (core CPI, PPI, industrial production, payrolls, unemployment, housing starts, retail sales, consumer sentiment, fed funds), and a three-factor principal-component regression on the same panel - and aggregate them three ways: equal-weighted, inverse-MSE, and the Pi_L dependency penalty, whose lead-lag matrix L is estimated on data from the trailing window of base-learner forecasts (not hard-coded) and applied strictly out-of-sample. The backtest covers T=309 monthly forecasts, January 2000 to September 2025, for two estimands: headline CPI month-over-month (the hard target) and year-over-year. The honest finding is mixed-to-negative for the dependency penalty specifically, but positive for ensembling. On the MoM target the equal-weighted and Pi_L aggregates are the two best methods overall (RMSE 0.2640 and 0.2636 pp respectively) and both significantly beat the random walk (RMSE 0.3087 pp) under the nest-appropriate Clark-West test (CW = +4.71 and +4.70, one-sided p ~ 10^-6; standard Diebold-Mariano agrees, DM = -4.46 and -4.49, p < 10^-5) and have lower RMSE than every individual base learner - though the margin over the best learner, the AR(6), is not itself significant (DM = -1.34, two-sided p = 0.182; real-time arm -1.73, p = 0.084), and a 90% model confidence set (Hansen-Lunde-Nason T_max statistic, stationary bootstrap B = 10^4, same absolute-error loss) retains four methods in both arms - the three aggregates and the AR(6), eliminating the random walk, the climatology, the ridge and the factor learner - so what the data certify is that ensembling dominates the weaker learners and the RW benchmark, not that it dominates the best univariate learner, and the Pi_L penalty is statistically indistinguishable from naive equal-weighting (DM = -1.06, p = 0.29): on data-estimated dependency among model nowcasts the Pi_L weights are nearly uniform (0.186-0.213), so the penalty adds essentially nothing beyond the gains from simple averaging. On the YoY target the classic result holds: a plain AR(6) is the single best forecaster (RMSE 0.4097 pp) and the random walk (0.4516) beats the multi-learner aggregates (equal 0.6290, Pi_L 0.6294), which are dragged down by the climatology and factor learners that lag a trending series; Pi_L again ties equal-weighting.
