title: External Employer Branding Activities: Typology Development via Integration of Information Amount and Content
affiliations: Stockton University

detail.title: External Employer Branding Activities: Typology Development via Integration of Information Amount and Content

publicationDetails.detailsText: Quarterly Review of Business Disciplines, Vol 10, Issue 3/4, Pp. 140-156, 2024

detail.abstract: An organization's employer branding activities strive to communicate to both external and internal stakeholders that it is a great place to work. This paper focuses on an organization's "external" employer branding activities (EEBAs)-recruitment messages used to attract job seekers in the external labor market. The competition for hiring skilled and qualified employees has increased over the years, and thus it is crucial for organizations to be able to attract job seekers and influence them in pursuing a position via appropriate EEBAs. While prior research has explored applicant attraction by considering separately the amount of information and attribute content in recruitment messages, this paper draws on marketing and consumer psychology literature to integrate these two related but theoretically distinct research streams and builds theory around four "external" employer branding activity (EEBA) types and their effectiveness. In addition, the feasibility of using different types of employer branding activities is discussed, based on industry, organization, and job-seeker characteristics.

AI.tldr: 本文聚焦于组织的外部雇主品牌活动（EEBAs），即用于吸引外部劳动力市场求职者的招聘信息。论文整合了营销和消费者心理学文献中关于招聘信息中信息量与属性内容两条独立研究脉络，构建了四种EEBA类型及其有效性的理论框架，并探讨了基于行业、组织和求职者特征的EEBA可行性。
AI.research_question: 组织应如何设计和实施外部雇主品牌活动（EEBAs）以有效吸引求职者？不同类型的EEBA在不同情境下的有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 随着吸引熟练和合格员工的竞争日益激烈，组织必须通过适当的外部雇主品牌活动来吸引求职者并影响他们申请职位。然而，先前研究分别探讨了招聘信息中的信息量和属性内容，缺乏对这两者的整合性理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 营销与消费者心理学文献（将信息量与属性内容两个研究脉络进行整合）；雇主品牌理论
AI.method: 理论构建/概念性研究——基于文献整合构建四种EEBA类型的理论框架，并讨论其适用情境
AI.findings: 构建了四种"外部"雇主品牌活动（EEBA）类型及其有效性框架；指出EEBA的可行性取决于行业、组织和求职者特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合了先前研究中分别考察信息量和属性内容的两条独立研究脉络，弥合了理论鸿沟，围绕四种EEBA类型建立了系统的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织在实践中选择和实施不同类型的外部雇主品牌活动提供了指导，帮助组织根据自身行业、组织特征和求职者特征做出更有效的招聘决策。

title: Executive Work Experience and Strategic Financing: How Generalist CEOs Shape Debt Structure
affiliations: University of Essex,  EBS, Arizona State University (ASU) - W.P. Carey School of Business, Xiamen University, Durham University Business School, Finance and Economics and Xiamen University

detail.title: Executive Work Experience and Strategic Financing: How Generalist CEOs Shape Debt Structure
detail.abstract: This study investigates whether the breadth of CEOs' work experience influences the concentration of firms' debt structure. CEOs with a greater variety of work experience are often referred to as generalist CEOs because they are likely to possess greater general managerial skills. We predict and document a negative relation between generalist CEOs and corporate debt concentration using a sample of S&P 1500 firms from 2001 to 2022. To address endogeneity, we employ propensity score matching, entropy balancing, and a difference-indifferences approach based on CEOs' sudden deaths as plausibly exogenous shocks. We further identify information disclosure as a key mechanism that mediates the negative relation between generalist CEOs and corporate debt concentration. Generalist CEOs, owing to greater career confidence, exhibit a stronger willingness to disclose information, which facilitates a more diversified debt structure by reducing information asymmetry with creditors. The negative relation between general managerial skills and debt concentration is more pronounced for firms with greater CEO power, tighter financial constraints, lower credit ratings, higher default risks, weaker management team ability, and when CFOs are also generalists. Overall, the evidence highlights how CEOs' work experience affect information disclosure and, in turn, firms' financing structure.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2001-2022年S&P 1500公司样本，发现CEO工作经历的广度（即通才型CEO）与企业债务集中度呈负相关。通才型CEO因更强的职业信心而更愿意披露信息，从而降低与债权人的信息不对称，促使企业采用更多元化的债务结构。
AI.research_question: CEO工作经历的广度（通才型CEO）如何影响企业债务结构的集中度？
AI.motivation: 现有研究较少关注管理者个人特质（尤其是CEO工作经历广度）对企业融资结构决策的影响，而债务集中度是重要的财务政策选择，尚缺乏系统性的理论与实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 通才CEO理论（一般管理技能理论）与信息不对称理论，结合职业信心假说解释CEO信息披露意愿的差异。
AI.method: 采用2001-2022年S&P 1500公司样本，运用倾向得分匹配（PSM）、熵平衡法（Entropy Balancing）以及基于CEO突发死亡的差分法（DID）来处理内生性问题，并进行中介效应检验和异质性分析。
AI.findings: 通才型CEO与企业债务集中度显著负相关；信息披披露是其中介机制；该负向关系在CEO权力更大、财务约束更紧、信用评级更低、违约风险更高、管理团队能力较弱以及CFO也是通才型时更为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 从管理者个人特征角度丰富了债务结构决策的前因研究；将CEO工作经历与信息披露行为及融资结构联系起来，拓展了通才CEO理论的应用场景。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业在选聘CEO时提供参考——通才型CEO可能有助于优化融资结构、降低信息不对称；也为投资者和债权人评估企业债务政策提供新的预测维度。

title: Matching the Shares Does Not Validate the Choices: Why Matching Holdout Shares Is Not Sufficient Evidence of Predictive Validity
affiliations: Red Analytics

detail.title: Matching the Shares Does Not Validate the Choices: Why Matching Holdout Shares Is Not Sufficient Evidence of Predictive Validity

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, identifiable personal data, or new data collection and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Aggregate-share mean absolute error (MAE) is used in comparisons of discrete choice modeling approaches as evidence of external predictive validity. It is not sufficient evidence for that claim. Holdout validation is intended to protect against concluding that an apparent modeling advantage is real when it instead reflects overfit to the estimation data. Aggregate share error can fail that test. Different patterns of choice prediction can produce the same aggregate share forecast. Aggregate-share MAE is therefore disqualifying as sufficient comparative evidence of external predictive validity for choices. When the aggregate comparison is used to establish that broader conclusion, the inference is invalid.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，在离散选择建模方法的比较中，使用聚合份额平均绝对误差（MAE）作为外部预测效度的证据是不充分的。持有验证旨在防止将过拟合误认为真实优势，但聚合份额误差无法通过这一检验，因为不同的选择预测模式可能产生相同的聚合份额预测。因此，聚合份额MAE不能作为选择行为外部预测效度的充分比较证据，基于此得出的更广泛结论是无效的。
AI.research_question: 聚合份额平均绝对误差（MAE）是否足以作为离散选择建模方法外部预测效度的比较证据？
AI.motivation: 聚合份额MAE被广泛用于离散选择建模方法的比较，作为外部预测效度的证据，但这一做法存在方法论缺陷，需要加以澄清。
AI.theoretical_framework: 外部预测效度理论；持有验证（holdout validation）方法论；过拟合理论
AI.method: 概念性/方法论批判分析，通过逻辑推演论证聚合份额MAE在外部预测效度评估中的不足。
AI.findings: 聚合份额MAE不能通过持有验证的检验标准；不同的选择预测模式可以产生相同的聚合份额预测，因此聚合份额MAE无法区分预测模式的差异，不足以作为外部预测效度的充分证据，基于此推出的更广泛结论无效。
AI.theory_contributions: 对离散选择模型比较中外部预测效度评估标准进行了方法论批判，澄清了聚合份额MAE作为效度证据的局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒研究者和实践者在比较离散选择模型时，不应仅依赖聚合份额MAE，而应采用更严格的个体层面预测效度检验。

title: The Thích Minh Tuệ Social-Media Phenomenon, 2024-2026: Decentralized Attention, Platform Ecology, and Value without Capture
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Thích Minh Tuệ Social-Media Phenomenon, 2024-2026: Decentralized Attention, Platform Ecology, and Value without Capture

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: Self-Funded

detail.abstract:
Thích Minh Tuệ’s rise from a little-known Vietnamese ascetic pilgrim to a national and transnational social-media phenomenon offers an unusual case of mass attention without centralized media production. He built no audience through an official account, promotional apparatus, institutional organization, or deliberate influencer strategy. Instead, a decentralized network of witnesses, livestreamers, travel vloggers, devotees, critics, news organizations, and commentary channels formed around his visible practice. This study tracks search and readership from January 2024 through July 2026 and reconstructs platform attention during the active view-generating period from April 2024 through July 2026 using Google Trends, Wikipedia readership, direct YouTube and TikTok measurements, sampled Facebook Reels, antagonistic-content discovery, and contemporary reporting. Independent measures agree on three phases: an extraordinary May–June 2024 national attention shock approximately 87 times the pre-viral baseline, a second transnational wave in early 2025, and a smaller but durable 2026 residual sustained by a decentralized creator ecosystem.

Search interest indexed the civil name “Lê Anh Tú” at only 2 against 100 for “Minh Tuệ” on a shared scale. The expanded YouTube inventory identifies 181 unique channels; antagonistic-vocabulary searches recovered 49 additional relevant channels largely missed by name-based discovery. A 72-account TikTok analytical sample and sampled Facebook Reels complete the platform picture. Under an explicit Facebook-Reels-parity assumption, two reconstruction methods place cumulative platform-counted consumption at approximately 8.5–11.1 billion views through July 2026. Across the full Facebook sensitivity analysis, the modeled envelope extends to approximately 13.7 billion. The July 2026 central estimate is approximately 90 million counted views per month. Zalo, X, Instagram, and Reddit are excluded from the headline estimate on separately stated methodological grounds. The case illustrates a decentralized attention paradox: the less the subject participated in the attention economy, the more extensively one formed around him. It also demonstrates value without capture, in which the focal subject generates attention while ownership, audience control, and much of the resulting monetization accrue to third parties.

Keywords: Thích Minh Tuệ; Lê Anh Tú; Vietnam; social media; attention economy; creator economy; platform ecology; TikTok; YouTube; Facebook; digital religion; Buddhism; dhutaṅga; decentralized attention; value without capture

JEL classification: Z12 (Religion); L82 (Information and Internet Services; Media); D83 (Search, Learning, Information, and Knowledge); Z13 (Social Norms and Social Networks)

AI.tldr: 本文研究越南苦行僧Thích Minh Tuệ从无名修行者崛起为全国乃至跨国社交媒体现象的过程，揭示了一个没有集中媒体生产、没有官方账号、没有推广机制却获得数十亿次观看的"去中心化注意力"案例。研究通过Google Trends、维基百科阅读量、YouTube和TikTok直接测量等多元数据，重建了2024年4月至2026年7月间平台注意力的三个波次，并估算累计平台观看量约为85-111亿次。
AI.research_question: 在没有官方账号、推广机构、组织化制度或刻意网红策略的情况下，Thích Minh Tuệ如何成为全国乃至跨国社交媒体现象？其平台注意力规模如何量化？其注意力的形成机制和结构特征是什么？
AI.motivation: 案例极其特殊且罕见——一个不参与注意力经济的主体反而成为巨大的注意力焦点，揭示了"去中心化注意力悖论"：主体越不参与注意力经济，围绕其形成的注意力生态反而越庞大。这为理解平台生态、创作者经济和数字宗教研究提供了独特窗口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 注意力经济理论；创作者经济理论；平台生态学；去中心化注意力理论（本文提出）；"有价值但未被捕捉"（value without capture）理论框架
AI.method: 混合方法：Google Trends搜索指数分析；维基百科阅读量追踪；YouTube和TikTok直接测量（181个YouTube频道、72个TikTok账号样本）；Facebook Reels抽样；对抗性内容发现方法（antagonistic-vocabulary searches恢复49个额外频道）；当代新闻报道佐证；敏感性分析下的两种重建方法估算总观看量
AI.findings: （1）注意力呈现三阶段：2024年5-6月全国性注意力冲击（约为病毒前基线的87倍）、2025年初第二次跨国浪潮、2026年较小但持久的残余波；（2）搜索指数显示其俗名"Lê Anh Tú"仅为"Minh Tuệ"的2%（2：100）；（3）识别出181个YouTube频道，对抗性词汇搜索额外恢复49个频道；（4）在明确的Facebook Reels平价假设下，两种重建方法估算累计平台观看量约为85-111亿次，敏感性分析上界约137亿次；（5）2026年7月中心估计为每月约9000万次观看；（6）案例证明"去中心化注意力悖论"和"无捕获的价值"——主体产生注意力，但所有权、受众控制和大部分变现收益归属于第三方。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并实证了"去中心化注意力悖论"：注意力形成可能不依赖于主体的主动参与或集中生产，反而与主体的"不参与"正相关；提出"有价值但未被捕捉"（value without capture）概念，拓展了对注意力经济中价值分配与主体角色关系理解；为数字宗教、注意力经济、平台生态研究提供了非典型但极具解释力的案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台研究者提供了去中心化注意力形成机制的量化方法学参考（多源数据交叉验证、对抗性内容发现策略）；为内容创作者、平台运营者和宗教传播研究者提供了"不以参与为核心的注意力生态"的实际案例；揭示第三方在注意力经济中攫取价值的方式，对内容权益保护和平台治理具有启示意义。

title: Beyond Fear and Curiosity: Conceptualizing Ecological Transformation in Dark Tourism through the Philosophy of Amanat Galunggung
affiliations: , Universitas Negeri Jakarta and Universitas Negeri Jakarta

detail.title: Beyond Fear and Curiosity: Conceptualizing Ecological Transformation in Dark Tourism through the Philosophy of Amanat Galunggung
detail.abstract: Dark tourism has increasingly gained scholarly attention as a phenomenon associated with death, disaster, tragedy, and memory. While existing literature primarily examines tourist motivations, emotional responses, and the ethics of grief consumption, limited research addresses how dark tourism can foster ecological awareness and sustainable behavioral transformation, particularly when disaster landscapes are mediated through culturally embedded philosophical frameworks. This conceptual paper addresses this gap by introducing Ecological Transformation Through Local Interpretation (ETLI), a theoretical framework illustrating how encounters with post-disaster landscapes can evolve into ecological consciousness. Drawing upon transformative tourism, environmental ethics, and indigenous knowledge, this study utilizes the philosophy of Amanat Galunggung ancient Sundanese manuscript tradition, as a culturally situated interpretive lens that emphasizes human-nature relationality, ethical responsibility, and ecological stewardship. The ETLI framework posits that dark tourism experiences evoke emotional and existential responses which, when mediated by local ecological interpretation, stimulate human-nature reflection and meaningful ecological transformation, ultimately fostering sustainable tourist behavior. This paper contributes to tourism literature by expanding dark tourism beyond tragedy consumption toward ecological learning, highlighting local wisdom as a bridge between historical disaster memory and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs 11, 13, and 15).

AI.tldr: 本文提出"通过本地诠释实现生态转化"（ETLI）理论框架，探讨黑暗旅游如何借助地方文化哲学（巽他族古老手稿传统Amanat Galunggung）将灾难景观体验转化为生态意识与可持续行为。
AI.research_question: 黑暗旅游如何通过文化嵌入的哲学框架促进生态意识与可持续行为转变？
AI.motivation: 现有黑暗旅游文献主要关注游客动机、情绪反应和悲伤消费伦理，缺乏对黑暗旅游如何促进生态意识与可持续行为转变的研究，尤其是在灾难景观通过文化哲学框架中介作用下的情形。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于转化旅游理论（transformative tourism）、环境伦理学和本土知识（indigenous knowledge），以巽他族Amanat Galunggung古老手稿哲学为文化诠释透镜，强调人与自然关系性、伦理责任和生态管理。
AI.method: 概念性论文（conceptual paper），通过理论整合与框架构建提出ETLI模型。
AI.findings: ETLI框架认为，黑暗旅游体验引发情感与存在性反应，在本地生态诠释的中介下，激发人与自然关系的反思和有意义的生态转化，最终促进可持续游客行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 将黑暗旅游从悲剧消费拓展至生态学习领域；将地方智慧定位为连接历史灾难记忆与可持续发展目标（SDG 11、13、15）的桥梁。
AI.practical_contributions: 为黑暗旅游目的地管理者提供以本土文化哲学促进生态教育与可持续旅游行为的实践指导，助力可持续发展目标的实现。

title: Time Cost Illusion: the Purchase–usage Gap in Online Education
affiliations: , The University of Hong Kong , Sun Yat-sen University and University of Rochester - Simon Business School

detail.title: Time Cost Illusion: the Purchase–usage Gap in Online Education
detail.abstract: Consumers often buy products that they later underuse, but the source of this purchase–usage gap and the firm’s role in it remain unclear. We study this problem in online education, where the time cost of completing a course is difficult to assess before purchase. Using proprietary purchase and usage data, we document a large purchase–usage gap: the median learner completes only 21% of purchased content. We trace this gap to a time cost illusion: consumers underestimate their time cost of learning when choosing courses. We further show that marketing messages that downplay the time cost amplify this illusion. A structural model of purchase and usage with belief updating implies that perceived time cost at first purchase is only about one-fifth of the true cost and that effort-downplaying messages account for a substantial part of this distortion. Counterfactuals reveal a revenue–welfare tension: marketing messages raise short-run platform revenue but lower consumer surplus and may slow the platform’s long-run growth. Alternative platform instruments, such as information and incentive policies, can reduce consumers’ time cost illusion.

AI.tldr: 本文利用在线教育平台的专有购买和使用数据，揭示了消费者购买与使用之间存在的巨大差距（中位数学员仅完成所购内容的21%），并将其归因于"时间成本幻觉"——消费者在选课时系统性低估学习的时间成本。营销信息中淡化时间成本的内容会加剧这一错觉。结构模型估计表明首次购买时的感知时间成本仅为真实成本的五分之一，营销信息造成了大部分失真。反事实分析揭示了收入与福利之间的张力：营销信息提升短期平台收入但降低消费者剩余，并可能减缓平台长期增长。
AI.research_question: 消费者购买后使用不足（购买-使用差距）的根源是什么？企业在其中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 消费者经常购买后来使用不足的产品，但购买-使用差距的来源以及企业在其中的角色尚不清楚。在线教育领域中，课程完成的时间成本在购买前难以评估，为研究这一问题提供了理想场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间成本幻觉理论、信念更新模型、购买与使用的结构模型
AI.method: 使用专有购买和使用数据，构建包含信念更新的购买与使用结构模型，并进行反事实分析。
AI.findings: 中位数学员仅完成21%的购买内容；消费者系统性低估学习时间成本（感知成本约为真实成本的五分之一）；淡化时间成本的营销信息显著加剧这种错觉；营销信息提升短期收入但降低消费者福利并可能减缓长期增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统识别并量化了"时间成本幻觉"这一消费者系统性偏差的根源，揭示了营销信息在塑造消费者认知偏差中的因果作用，并阐明了购买-使用差距背后的行为机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为在线教育平台提供了改善消费者福利的政策启示：信息政策和激励政策等替代性工具可以有效降低消费者的时间成本错觉；同时警示平台依赖淡化时间成本的营销手段可能损害长期增长。

title: Many Mastheads, Fewer Source Texts: Vietnam’s Media Coverage of Thích Minh Tuệ,  April 2024–August 2026: A Verified Analysis of Nomenclature, Syndication, and Post-Departure Divergence
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Many Mastheads, Fewer Source Texts: Vietnam’s Media Coverage of Thích Minh Tuệ,  April 2024–August 2026: A Verified Analysis of Nomenclature, Syndication, and Post-Departure Divergence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: Self-Funded

detail.abstract:
The emergence of the Vietnamese ascetic practitioner Thích Minh Tuệ as a national phenomenon in 2024 generated extensive coverage across Vietnam’s national press, provincial and municipal media, Buddhist publications, police and security outlets, entertainment platforms, business media, government portals and state outbound communications. This study reconstructs that record through August 2026 while distinguishing authored texts from republications, masthead appearances, translations and automated placements.

Four mastheads of a single publisher carried 253 relevant pages generated from only 98 distinct texts — an inflation of two and a half times inside one company — and Vietnam’s state outbound portal distributed roughly fifteen source texts across about thirty-three language editions. The Vietnamese-language catalogue contains 216 records; the expanded police/security register contains 25 national and 20 local direct placements, with their overlap still to be recomputed, together with fifteen English-language items from six Vietnam-based publishers; these figures are documented floors rather than estimates of total coverage. Separate site-level examinations identify at least 196 pages across eight entertainment and lifestyle brands.

Four findings emerge. Outlet breadth did not represent an equivalent plurality of witnesses or independently produced narratives. The decisive shift during May 2024 was lexical as much as editorial. The licensed press preserved meaningful internal variation across provincial, professional-cultural, Buddhist and security outlets. Finally, domestic coverage after December 2024 did not disappear uniformly: mainstream and commercial reporting became largely indirect while security media continued to address him and the surrounding conflicts through 2026.

AI.tldr: 本文考察2024年越南苦行僧Thích Minh Tuệ成为全国性现象后，越南各类媒体（国家报刊、省市媒体、佛教刊物、警察安全媒体、娱乐平台、商业媒体、政府门户及对外传播渠道）对其报道的全景记录（截至2026年8月），并区分原创文本与转载、署名出现、翻译及自动投放。
AI.research_question: 越南各类型媒体对Thích Minh Tuệ现象的报道规模、结构特征及传播逻辑是什么？
AI.motivation: 该人物于2024年成为全国性现象，但缺乏对其跨媒体、跨语种、跨时段报道的系统性档案重建与分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 媒体话语分析、新闻生产与传播政治经济学（涉及转载通胀、叙事多元化与牌照媒体差异等概念）。
AI.method: 文献档案重建法：区分原创文本与转载/署名/翻译/自动投放，按出版商、媒体类型、语言版本分类统计，并进行站点层面的页面计数。
AI.findings: （1）出口广度不等于见证多样性或独立叙事数量；（2）2024年5月的关键转变兼具词汇维度与编辑维度；（3）持牌媒体在省级、专业文化、佛教与安全类渠道间保留了有意义的内部差异；（4）2024年12月后国内报道并非整体消失：主流与商业报道转为间接，安全媒体则持续报道至2026年。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"媒体广度≠叙事多元性"的分析框架，揭示转载通胀（同一出版商98篇文本膨胀为253页）与跨语种重复传播的结构性机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解越南持牌媒体生态、安全媒体与主流媒体在敏感议题上的差异化报道策略，以及国家对外传播的文本分发模式提供实证档案。

title: The Role of Future Computing Technology in Business Management

detail.title: The Role of Future Computing Technology in Business Management
detail.abstract: The study aims to investigate the impact of technology on business management practices. It explores how technological advancements have revolutionized various aspects of business management, including operations, marketing, human resources, and decision-making processes. This research analyzes the adoption of technology in different industries, its influence on efficiency, productivity, and competitiveness, as well as the challenges and opportunities associated with its integration. Furthermore, the study also examines the role of emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence, big data analytics, and blockchain in shaping the future of business management. The findings of this study provide valuable insights for businesses seeking to leverage technology for strategic management and sustainable growth.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨技术对商业管理实践的影响，分析了技术在不同行业中的采用情况，及其对效率、生产力和竞争力的影响，并讨论了人工智能、大数据分析和区块链等新兴技术在塑造商业管理未来中的作用。
AI.research_question: 技术如何影响商业管理实践？技术如何在运营、营销、人力资源和决策流程等方面革新商业管理？
AI.motivation: 技术进步正在深刻改变商业管理方式，亟需系统性研究来理解技术对管理实践各方面的影响，为企业战略管理和可持续发展提供指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文未明确提及具体理论框架，主要基于技术采纳理论和管理学视角。
AI.method: 本文使用的研究方法未在摘要中具体说明，推测为文献综述或多行业分析。
AI.findings: 技术对商业管理的运营、营销、人力资源和决策流程产生了革命性影响；技术的整合带来了效率提升、生产力和竞争力增强，但也伴随着挑战与机遇；新兴技术（人工智能、大数据分析、区块链）将在未来商业管理中发挥关键作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文对技术与管理实践的关系提供了系统性分析，丰富了技术管理领域的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业利用技术进行战略管理和实现可持续增长提供了有价值的实践见解。

title:
KVEX-R³ v10.1:
 ERP Diagnostic Framework for Readiness, Risk, and Resilience

detail.title:
KVEX-R³ v10.1:
 ERP Diagnostic Framework for Readiness, Risk, and Resilience

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Enterprise resource planning implementations fail at rates commonly estimated between 55% and 75% of projects, a figure that has moved little despite decades of accumulated implementation methodology and a governance, risk, and compliance consulting market now valued in the tens of billions of dollars annually. This paper extends the KVEX orchestration architecture (Khan, 2026) into enterprise resource planning governance, introducing KVEX-R³: a convergent diagnostic framework that operationalizes three separately established academic lenses — implementation staging (Markus & Tanis, 2000), project-phase critical success factors (Parr & Shanks, 2000), and package–organization misalignment theory (Soh & Sia, 2004) — into a single conditional scoring architecture spanning three dimensions: Readiness, Risk, and Resilience. The framework operates across four sequential diagnostic modes and incorporates a self-calibration mechanism, whereby category anchors are refined after each re-assessment cycle rather than held static — a design lineage shared with the Self-Evolution Engine described in the KVEX series anchor. Unlike the qualitative, one-time, narrative assessments that dominate current commercial practice, KVEX-R³ is structured as a repeatable, re-assessable instrument, scored against written category anchors so that independent applications of the framework converge on comparable results. The paper sets out the framework's convergence logic and relative category-weighting rationale without disclosing the proprietary numerical scoring engine that operationalizes it commercially, reports preliminary field application across a small sample of anonymized ERP engagements, and situates the contribution within its market and regional context, with particular attention to the institutional conditions documented in South Asian and MENA implementation environments. The claim advanced is methodological rather than commercial: a citable, extensible instrument for diagnosing ERP risk exposure that draws together existing academic models rather than replacing them, and that does not duplicate any single vendor's proprietary assessment methodology.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KVEX-R³框架，将三种既有的学术理论（实施阶段理论、项目阶段关键成功因素、包组织错位理论）整合为一个条件化评分架构，从就绪度、风险、韧性三个维度诊断ERP实施风险，旨在提供可重复、可再评估的标准化诊断工具，以应对ERP项目长期居高不下的失败率。
AI.research_question: 如何将分散的学术理论整合为一个可重复、可再评估的标准化框架，以更有效地诊断企业资源规划（ERP）实施中的风险暴露？
AI.motivation: ERP实施失败率长期维持在55%-75%之间，尽管已有数十年的方法论积累和规模庞大的治理、风险与合规咨询市场，失败率几乎未改善。现有商业实践以定性、一次性、叙述性评估为主，缺乏可标准化、可比较的诊断工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三个学术理论视角：实施阶段理论（Markus & Tanis, 2000）、项目阶段关键成功因素（Parr & Shanks, 2000）、包组织错位理论（Soh & Sia, 2004），并扩展自KVEX编排架构及自进化引擎设计理念。
AI.method: 构建KVEX-R³条件化评分架构，涵盖就绪度、风险、韧性三个维度，运行于四个顺序诊断模式，设有自我校准机制（类别锚点在每次再评估周期后更新而非静态保持），并在小样本匿名ERP项目中进行了初步现场应用。
AI.findings: 初步现场应用显示框架在小型匿名ERP项目中具有可行性；框架通过书面类别锚点评分，使得独立应用能够收敛于可比结果；已在南亚和中东/北非实施环境中检验了其制度条件适配性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将三种本已分别确立的学术视角整合为一个统一诊断流程，实现了方法论层面的收敛而非替代；引入动态类别锚点的自校准机制，区别于传统静态阶段模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供一个可引用、可扩展的ERP风险暴露诊断工具，比现有定性、一次性评估更具可重复性和可比性，且不复制任何单一供应商的专有评估方法。

title: Europe's AI Innovation Wave: Who Gains, Who Decides, Who Governs?
affiliations: The New School, The New School - Department of Economics and

detail.title: Europe's AI Innovation Wave: Who Gains, Who Decides, Who Governs?
detail.abstract: This paper asks how Europe should respond to the current wave of artificial intelligence. It argues that AI is best understood, at least for now, as a rapidly developing cluster of technologies within the wider information revolution rather than as a separate industrial revolution. The evidence on its economic effects remains unsettled. Productivity estimates vary widely, investment has moved ahead of what can yet be justified by measured gains, and the labour-market evidence points more towards the reorganisation of work than towards mass unemployment. These outcomes will depend less on the technology alone than on how firms deploy it, how the gains are distributed and what institutions shape adoption. Europe enters this transition from a weak position in frontier models, compute, cloud infrastructure and private investment. A credible response therefore requires more than regulation. It should combine conditional support for European firms, public investment in data and compute, stronger administrative capacity, labour force participation in deployment decisions and procurement rules designed to limit long-term dependence on foreign platforms. The paper also argues that part of any productivity gain should reach the workforce, through shorter working time and wage growth, rather than being captured only as lower labour costs and short-term capital gains. The central claim is that Europe's AI future will be decided not only by technical progress, but by ownership, institutional design and political choice.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨欧洲应如何应对当前人工智能浪潮，认为AI应被理解为信息革命中快速发展的技术集群而非独立的工业革命。欧洲在基础模型、算力、云基础设施和私人投资方面处于弱势，需要超越单纯监管的综合回应，包括有条件的企业支持、公共投资、行政能力建设、劳动力参与决策以及采购规则，并确保生产力收益惠及劳动力。
AI.research_question: 欧洲应如何应对当前的人工智能浪潮？
AI.motivation: 欧洲在AI前沿模型、算力、云基础设施和私人投资方面处于弱势地位，需要超越单纯监管的综合性政策回应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将AI视为信息革命中快速发展的技术集群而非独立的工业革命；强调制度设计、所有权和政治选择对技术经济效果的决定性作用。
AI.method: 基于现有证据的综合分析，涵盖生产力估计、投资数据、劳动力市场证据，以及欧洲在全球AI竞争格局中的结构性位置分析。
AI.findings: AI的经济影响证据尚不明确：生产力估计差异大、投资超前于可衡量的收益、劳动力市场证据更指向工作重组而非大规模失业。这些结果取决于企业部署方式、收益分配和制度塑造，而非技术本身。欧洲应结合有条件支持、公共投资、行政能力建设、劳动力参与决策和采购规则来应对。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出AI应被框定为信息革命的一部分而非独立工业革命；强调技术经济效果由制度设计和政治选择决定，而非单纯由技术进步决定。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧洲政策制定者提供具体的政策组合建议：包括有条件支持欧洲企业、公共投资数据与算力、加强行政能力、劳动力参与部署决策、采购规则限制对外国平台的长期依赖，以及通过缩短工时和工资增长确保生产力收益惠及劳动力。

title:
Stop Labeling Everything: An Economic Research Note to Active Machine Learning
A Derived, Adaptive, Computationally Tractable Starting Policy for Large-Scale, Budget-Constrained Classification

detail.title:
Stop Labeling Everything: An Economic Research Note to Active Machine Learning
A Derived, Adaptive, Computationally Tractable Starting Policy for Large-Scale, Budget-Constrained Classification
detail.abstract: Active learning is usually presented as a statistical question: which unlabeled observations are most informative? This note starts one step earlier and treats labeling as a scarce-input allocation problem. The learner has a current optimized objective, a large unlabeled pool, and a limited oracle budget. A candidate label matters when adding it would create a new optimization problem whose optimum is materially better than leaving the post-query objective evaluated at the old parameters. The exact one-step gain is expensive to compute because the label is unknown and exact evaluation would require counterfactual retraining. We therefore use a second-order local approximation. The resulting expected gain is proportional to E[gᵧᵀH⁻¹gᵧ|x], where gᵧ is the hypothetical post-query gradient and H is a common local curvature matrix. Applying the mean-covariance decomposition yields G=I+U, with I=μgᵀH⁻¹μg and U=tr(H⁻¹Σg). We refer to I as “Impact” as it is driven by the gradients. We refer to U as “Uncertainty” – a commonly used selection score in active learning. The model, however, is not an arbitrary weighted blend of “impact” and “uncertainty”; the two terms are the mean and dispersion components of the same expected quadratic gain. We then add a separate diversity constraint for batch acquisition and a validation-based stopping rule. The derivation is model-agnostic subject to some technical constraints; the experiment implements it with a linear one-vs-all SVM and a squared-hinge local surrogate. Results on AG News show that selective acquisition materially outperforms traditional random labeling, even multi-stage ones, at the same oracle cost. A small actively selected subset captures much of the performance of labeling the full pool, and that higher ex-ante G-ranked batches produce larger realized SVM-objective improvements. The contribution is therefore a practical middle ground: more principled than a collection of acquisition heuristics, but far more tractable than exact one-step retraining or full-budget lookahead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的主动学习框架，将标注视为稀缺资源分配问题，通过二阶局部近似推导出期望增益的均值-协方差分解（I+U，即"Impact"和"Uncertainty"），并在AG News数据集上使用线性SVM验证了该方法在同等标注预算下显著优于随机标注。
AI.research_question: 如何从稀缺资源分配的角度出发，设计一种更原则化且计算可行的主动学习标注选择策略？
AI.motivation: 传统主动学习仅将问题视为统计问题（选择最有信息量的未标注样本），但忽略了标注本身是一种稀缺资源分配问题。精确计算一步增益需要反事实重训练，成本过高，现有启发式方法又缺乏理论原则，因此需要一种介于两者之间的实用方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 稀缺资源分配理论；二阶局部近似（泰勒展开）；均值-协方差分解；期望二次增益理论
AI.method: 以标注预算为稀缺输入，构造候选标注的期望增益表达式E[gᵧᵀH⁻¹gᵧ|x]，通过均值-协方差分解得到G=I+U（Impact+Uncertainty），并加入批次采集的多样性约束和验证集停止规则。实验采用线性one-vs-all SVM与squared-hinge局部替代模型，在AG News数据集上验证。
AI.findings: ①选择性的主动采集在同等标注预算下显著优于传统随机标注（包括多阶段随机标注）；②少量主动选择的子集即可达到接近标注全部池的性能；③较高的先验G值批次对应更大的SVM目标函数实际改进。
AI.theory_contributions: ①将主动学习重新框定为稀缺输入分配问题而非纯统计问题；②证明"Impact"和"Uncertainty"不是任意加权混合，而是同一期望二次增益的均值和离散度分量；③推导出模型无关的期望增益分解框架。
AI.practical_contributions: ①提供了一种比启发式方法更原则化、比精确一步重训练更可计算的实际中间方案；②在AG News数据集上验证了方法有效性，证明小规模主动选择子集可接近全池标注性能，从而大幅节省标注成本。

title: Who Pays for Price Discovery?
affiliations: ESCP Business School

detail.title: Who Pays for Price Discovery?
detail.abstract: Financial information is costly to produce but cheap to share, and whoever shares it also leaks it: subscribers' trades push their signal into prices. We study who pays for price discovery when a xed-cost, nonrival signal is nanced collectively in a GrossmanStiglitz market. Funding capacity, the subscriber base times each subscriber's willingness to pay, is hump-shaped, generating a critical mass, tipping, and a stable membership equilibrium. Governance matters: a for-prot seller restricts access at the revenue peak, while a member-nanced club disseminates more broadly and produces a more informative price, yet lowers total investor surplus under a transparent, deliberately partial benchmark. With competing providers, price leakage across venues makes information provision a natural monopoly under either governance form. Finally, we replace the exogenous noise traders with hedgers, traders who sell the asset to reduce the risk of their random endowments, so that the welfare of every agent in the economy is counted. In that economy, information production that each subscriber privately nds worth its fee can nonetheless reduce the welfare of all market participants. The results speak to exchange demutualization, market-data pricing, and the nancing of research.

AI.tldr: 本文在一个Grossman-Stiglitz市场中研究集体融资的固定成本、非竞争性信息的定价与传播问题。研究发现：融资能力（订阅者基数×每位订阅者支付意愿）呈驼峰形，产生临界质量、倾覆效应和稳定会员均衡；治理结构至关重要——营利性卖家在收入峰值处限制访问，而会员制俱乐部传播更广、产生更具信息量的价格，但在透明的、故意部分披露的基准下降低了总投资者剩余；竞争性提供者之间，价格泄露使信息提供在两种治理形式下都成为自然垄断；将外生噪声交易者替换为对冲者后，每位订阅者私下认为值得付费的信息生产反而可能降低所有市场参与者的福利。
AI.research_question: 当固定成本、非竞争性信息由集体融资时，谁为价格发现付费？不同治理结构（营利性卖家与会员制俱乐部）如何影响信息传播、价格信息性和投资者福利？
AI.motivation: 金融信息生产成本高但分享成本低，且分享即泄露（订阅者的交易将信号推入价格）。这一矛盾使得集体融资信息的行为和治理结构成为关键问题，但对谁为价格发现买单、治理结构如何影响市场结果仍缺乏系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: Grossman-Stiglitz理性预期均衡框架、公共品/集体融资理论、自然垄断理论、治理结构理论（营利性vs俱乐部）
AI.method: 理论建模与均衡分析：构建固定成本非竞争性信号集体融资的Grossman-Stiglitz市场模型，分析融资能力函数（驼峰形）、会员均衡、不同治理结构下的均衡结果，以及存在竞争性提供者和对冲者（替代外生噪声交易者）情形下的扩展。
AI.findings: (1) 融资能力呈驼峰形，产生临界质量、倾覆效应和稳定会员均衡；(2) 营利性卖家在收入峰值处限制访问，会员制俱乐部传播更广、价格信息性更高，但在透明、部分披露基准下降低总投资者剩余；(3) 竞争性提供者之间价格泄露使信息提供成为自然垄断；(4) 用对冲者替代噪声交易者后，每位订阅者私下认为值得付费的信息生产反而可能降低所有市场参与者的福利。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 将集体融资和治理结构引入Grossman-Stiglitz信息市场框架，揭示融资能力驼峰形对均衡的影响；(2) 阐明营利性卖家与会员制俱乐部的治理差异对信息传播、价格信息性和福利的差异化影响；(3) 证明信息提供在竞争下的自然垄断性质；(4) 揭示个体理性付费的信息生产与社会福利之间的悖论。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 对交易所去互助化（demutualization）提供理论洞见；(2) 为市场数据定价政策提供指导；(3) 对研究融资（research financing）模式设计有实践启示。

title: Self-Supervised Representation Learning for Cold-Start Weekly Demand Forecasting: An Empirical Study on the Olist Brazilian E-Commerce Dataset

detail.title: Self-Supervised Representation Learning for Cold-Start Weekly Demand Forecasting: An Empirical Study on the Olist Brazilian E-Commerce Dataset

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal, financial, or professional relationships with individuals or organizations that could have influenced, or could reasonably be perceived to have influenced, this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study because it involved secondary analysis of a publicly available, anonymized e-commerce dataset and did not involve recruitment or interaction with human participants by the researchers.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Background: Cold-start demand forecasting is difficult because a newly observed series provides very little historical signal. Self-supervised learning (SSL) has been proposed as a way to learn transferable representations before supervised forecasting. This study evaluates whether two SSL objectives— contrastive representation learning and masked-feature prediction—improve one-step weekly demand forecasting when only four weeks of recent observations are available at prediction time. Methods: We constructed a weekly category-demand panel from the Olist Brazilian E-Commerce Public Dataset. The released data contain 99,441 orders and 112,650 order-item records. After temporal aggregation and regularization, the analysis contained 74 product categories over 106 weekly observations from 29 August 2016 to 3 September 2018. The first 70 weeks were used for model development and the following 25 weeks for cold-start evaluation. At every test origin, each category was represented only by its previous four weekly order-item counts. We compared naive persistence, exponential smoothing, ARIMA, similarity-based k-nearest neighbours, LightGBM, and a DeepAR-style recurrent count model with contrastive or masked SSL initialization. MAE, RMSE, MAPE, sMAPE, and weighted RMSE were computed; paired Wilcoxon tests compared absolute errors with the naive baseline. Results: The four-week cold-start setting strongly favoured the simple persistence baseline. Naive forecasting achieved the lowest MAE (6.298), RMSE (13.258), sMAPE (55.004%), and weighted RMSE (28.363). ETS, kNN, ARIMA, LightGBM and the recurrent neural models all had higher MAE. Contrastive SSL plus the recurrent model achieved MAE 7.466, while masked-feature prediction plus the recurrent model achieved 7.664. Contrastive SSL plus LightGBM and masked-feature prediction plus LightGBM achieved MAE 8.091 and 8.064, respectively. The results therefore do not support a blanket claim that SSL improves cold-start forecasting in this short-context, category-level setting. A context-length analysis showed that masked SSL plus LightGBM improved over plain LightGBM at two weeks of context but not at one or four weeks. Conclusions: On this dataset and protocol, representation learning did not consistently overcome the information ceiling imposed by a four-week context. The findings highlight the importance of strong persistence baselines, task-specific SSL objectives, and careful cold-start evaluation before adopting additional model complexity.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了两种自监督学习目标（对比学习和掩码特征预测）在仅提供四周历史观测的冷启动周度需求预测中的效果。基于Olist巴西电商数据集（74个产品类别、106周观测），结果显示简单持久性基线（Naive）表现最佳（MAE=6.298），所有SSL增强模型均未超越该基线，挑战了"SSL能普遍改善冷启动预测"的论断。
AI.research_question: 当预测时仅有四周近期观测数据的情况下，对比表示学习和掩码特征预测这两种自监督学习目标能否改善一步周度需求预测的效果？
AI.motivation: 冷启动需求预测因新观测序列历史信号极少而困难，自监督学习被提出用于在监督预测前学习可迁移表示，但其在短上下文场景下的有效性缺乏系统验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自监督学习（对比表示学习、掩码特征预测）、冷启动需求预测、表示学习与迁移学习理论
AI.method: 使用Olist巴西电商公开数据集构建74个产品类别、106周的周度需求面板；前70周用于模型开发，后25周用于冷启动评估；每个测试起点仅使用前4周数据作为类别表示；比较Naive持久性、ETS、ARIMA、kNN、LightGBM及DeepAR风格循环计数模型（带对比或掩码SSL初始化）；使用MAE、RMSE、MAPE、sMAPE和加权RMSE评估，并通过配对Wilcoxon检验与Naive基线比较。
AI.findings: 四周冷启动设置下Naive基线表现最优（MAE=6.298），ETS、kNN、ARIMA、LightGBM和循环神经网络模型的MAE均更高；对比SSL+循环模型MAE为7.466，掩码SSL+循环模型为7.664；对比SSL+LightGBM和掩码SSL+LightGBM分别为8.091和8.064；仅在两周期上下文中掩码SSL+LightGBM优于普通LightGBM，在一周和四周上下文中未见改善。
AI.theory_contributions: 实证挑战了"SSL总能改善冷启动预测"的笼统论断，表明在短上下文、类别级别的设定下表示学习的收益有限；强调任务特定的SSL目标和上下文长度对表示学习有效性的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为冷启动需求预测实践提供实证依据：在四周短上下文场景下，简单的持久性基线（Naive）优于复杂模型；提醒从业者在采用SSL和复杂模型前应充分评估强基线、SSL目标与上下文长度的匹配性。

title: FinRCA-Bench: Separating Retrieval Failure from Reasoning Failure in Financial Reconciliation Root-Cause Analysis

detail.title: FinRCA-Bench: Separating Retrieval Failure from Reasoning Failure in Financial Reconciliation Root-Cause Analysis

declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Automated financial operations increasingly depend on language models to diagnose why a transaction failed to reconcile, but the evidence that establishes such a diagnosis is rarely contained in a document: it is distributed across invoices, purchase orders, approvals, allocations, payments, ledger entries, and bank activity, and it is connected by transactional relationships rather than by textual similarity. Evaluations that score only the final answer therefore conflate two distinct capabilities-whether a system can find the required evidence and whether it can reason over it. We introduce FinRCA-Bench, a deterministic synthetic benchmark of 2,250 accounts-payable-to-bank reconciliation cases spanning 14 operational tables, comprising 1,500 injected failures across 15 causal categories and 750 legitimate or hard-negative cases. The benchmark separates model-visible operational data from evaluator-private root-cause labels and record-level evidence contracts, so that evidence access is scored independently of answer correctness. We evaluate deterministic Rules/SQL, classical machine learning, a frozen dense semantic retriever, deterministic relational expansion, and Typed Provenance Graph Retrieval (TPGR), a default-deny typed traversal that admits only persisted transaction relationships. Structured baselines are strong: Rules/SQL reaches 84.97% held-out exact accuracy and classical ML reaches 95.44%. Holding the reasoning model, prompt, and generation configuration fixed and changing only retrieval, macro required-record recall moves from 0.83% to 77.70% and exact 16-class accuracy from 2.05% to 72.44% (paired difference 70.39 percentage points; 95% bootstrap CI 66.06-74.72), while TPGR uses fewer records (19.56 versus 40) and fewer source tokens (approximately 2,370 versus 5,531). Decomposing the outcome shows that structural retrieval failures outnumber reasoning failures with sufficient retrieval by 95 to 15. Yet 254 correct predictions occur despite incomplete retrieval, and strict returned-evidence contract accuracy is only 5.72%. On FinRCA-Bench, retrieval architecture rather than model capability determines the dominant share of end-to-end performance-and a correct root-cause label is a weak proxy for an auditable one.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FinRCA-Bench，一个确定性的合成基准测试，用于评估财务对账失败根因分析系统。通过将证据检索与推理能力分离评估，发现检索架构而非模型能力主导端到端性能，且正确的根因标签并不能保证可审计性。
AI.research_question: 在自动化财务对账场景中，如何将系统的证据查找能力与证据推理能力分离评估？检索架构对端到端根因分析性能的影响有多大？
AI.motivation: 自动化财务操作日益依赖语言模型诊断交易对账失败的原因，但此类诊断所需的证据分散在发票、采购订单、审批、分配、支付、分类账等14个操作表中，通过交易关系而非文本相似性连接。现有评估仅评分最终答案，混淆了证据查找和推理两种能力，无法提供可审计的诊断结论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于交易关系的证据图谱理论、确定性合成基准测试方法论、检索增强生成（RAG）框架、默认拒绝（default-deny）的图遍历安全原则。
AI.method: 构建2,250个应付账款到银行对账案例的合成基准，包括1,500个注入故障（15个因果类别）和750个合法/困难负例。评估多种方法：确定性规则/SQL、经典机器学习、冻结稠密语义检索器、确定性关系扩展，以及提出的Typed Provenance Graph Retrieval（TPGR），一种仅允许持久化交易关系的默认拒绝类型化遍历方法。将模型可见操作数据与评估者私有标签及记录级证据合同分离评分。
AI.findings: 结构化基线表现强（规则/SQL达84.97%准确率，经典ML达95.44%）。在保持推理模型、提示和生成配置不变的情况下，仅改变检索方法，宏观必需记录召回率从0.83%提升至77.70%，精确16类准确率从2.05%提升至72.44%（配对差异70.39个百分点）。TPGR使用更少记录（19.56对比40）和更少源标记（约2,370对比5,531）。结构性检索失败（95）远多于充分检索下的推理失败（15），但仍有254个正确预测发生在检索不完整的情况下，严格返回证据合同准确率仅5.72%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次将财务对账根因分析中的证据检索与推理能力分离评估，揭示两者独立贡献；2. 提出默认拒绝的类型化图遍历方法TPGR，证明基于交易关系的结构化检索在财务领域的优势；3. 揭示正确的根因标签是可审计证据的弱代理，对"端到端准确率"作为评估标准的有效性提出质疑。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供可复现的确定性合成基准FinRCA-Bench，涵盖14个操作表、15个因果类别，可用于系统化评估财务对账工具；2. 证明采用结构化检索架构（如TPGR）比提升模型能力更关键，指导实际系统设计；3. 强调审计可追溯性在财务自动化中的重要性——仅追求答案正确率不足以保证合规性。

title: The Economics of Machine Verification: Verification-Cost Shocks and the Extensive Margin of Monitoring

detail.title: The Economics of Machine Verification: Verification-Cost Shocks and the Extensive Margin of Monitoring

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author holds interests in automated verification of commercial energy billing.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study did not involve human participants, patients, or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Economics understands how costly verification disciplines behavior. This paper asks which claims become worth verifying at all when machine intelligence changes the technology of verification. I model verification as a technology vector: fixed and marginal costs, four pipeline reliabilities from detection to enforcement, and a false-positive rate. Three results follow. First, a verification frontier: the minimum economically contestable claim L * (τ, N) in claim value and claim volume, with component-wise comparative statics and a false-challenge-dominance condition under which monitoring entry is monotone. Second, deterrence makes recovery non-monotonic: a verification technology that works can reduce measured recoveries. Third, private and social verification frontiers diverge: transfers and externalized dispute costs push private verification toward excess; uninternalized deterrence spillovers push it toward undersupply. The broader implication is institutional. Much of commercial architecture is adaptation to costly checking, and where the pipeline clears, a verification-cost collapse re-selects it. The open question is how much economic activity lies below the human verification frontier but above the machine one.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了验证作为技术向量的经济学模型，分析机器智能如何改变验证技术，提出了"验证前沿"概念，即最小经济可争议的索赔价值与数量，并探讨了威慑导致追回非单调、私人与社会验证前沿分化等核心结论，最终指出验证成本崩溃将重塑商业架构。
AI.research_question: 当机器智能改变验证技术时，哪些索赔主张（claims）变得值得验证？
AI.motivation: 经济学已知成本高昂的验证会约束行为，但机器智能改变了验证的技术条件，需要重新审视哪些主张值得验证以及验证供需的均衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 验证技术向量模型（固定与边际成本、四条管道可靠性从检测到执行、误报率）、验证前沿理论、威慑理论。
AI.method: 理论建模：将验证建模为技术向量，推导验证前沿的函数形式，进行分量比较静态分析，并比较私人与社会最优验证水平。
AI.findings: 三个核心结果：(1) 验证前沿——最小经济可争议的索赔价值L*(τ,N)，具有分量比较静态和虚假挑战支配条件；(2) 威慑使追回非单调——有效的验证技术反而可能降低可测得的追回额；(3) 私人与社会验证前沿分化——转移支付和外部化争议成本使私人验证过度供给，而未被内化的威慑溢出导致供给不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将验证建模为多维技术向量并推导验证前沿；揭示了威慑与追回之间的非单调关系；识别了私人与社会验证最优水平的分歧机制（转移支付、外部化争议成本、威慑溢出）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为机器智能时代的商业制度设计提供指导：指出验证成本崩溃将重新选择商业架构，并提出关键开放问题——有多少经济活动位于人类验证前沿之下但高于机器验证前沿之上，即哪些活动将因机器验证而变得可治理。

title: Assessing and Enhancing Adversarial Robustness for Review-Based Recommender Systems: A Computational Design Science Approach
affiliations: , Tsinghua University, University of Georgia, The University of Hong Kong, Hefei University of Technology and The School of Management, Hefei University of Technology

detail.title: Assessing and Enhancing Adversarial Robustness for Review-Based Recommender Systems: A Computational Design Science Approach
detail.abstract: While consumer-generated reviews deliver substantial business intelligence value for advancing recommender systems, they also create an attack surface in review-based recommender systems (R-RSs). Subtle textual perturbations through review tampering, forgery, and other adversarial attacks can manipulate recommendation outcomes. Nevertheless, prior scholars primarily focus on numerical ratings or visual-input adversarial manipulations, offering limited guidance for R-RSs that rely on discrete and semantically interdependent textual reviews. Following adversarial robustness theory, we develop a computational design science framework that jointly assesses and enhances adversarial robustness for R-RSs. For assessment, we design a novel Shapley value-guided Adversarial Review Generation (SARG) method that mimics rigorous adversarial environments by generating adversarial reviews aligned with the manipulation objective. For enhancement, we design an Attack-Lifecycle Robustness Enhancement (ALRE) method aligned with the attack reconnaissance and execution lifecycle, integrating stochastic recommendation process to reduce reconnaissance-phase information leakage, sensitivity-aware input dropout with certified robustness bounds to reduce overreliance on high-sensitivity tokens and adversarial contrastive retraining to strengthen representation robustness during attack execution-phase. Extensive experiments on Amazon and Yelp datasets demonstrate the severity of adversarial vulnerabilities in existing R-RSs and the effectiveness of our framework across diverse attack settings. This study advances the IS literature by offering a unified approach to assessing and enhancing adversarial robustness in R-RSs, with broader implications for online platforms reliant on user-generated textual content.

AI.tldr: 本文针对基于评论的推荐系统（R-RSs）面临的文本对抗攻击威胁，基于对抗鲁棒性理论开发了一个计算设计科学框架，同时包含用于评估的SARG方法和用于增强的ALRE方法，在Amazon和Yelp数据集上验证了框架的有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何联合评估和增强基于评论的推荐系统（R-RSs）的对抗鲁棒性？
AI.motivation: 消费者生成的评论虽然为推荐系统提供了重要的商业智能价值，但也构成了攻击面。现有研究主要关注数值评分或视觉输入的对抗操纵，对依赖离散且语义相互关联的文本评论的R-RSs缺乏指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 对抗鲁棒性理论（Adversarial Robustness Theory）
AI.method: 计算设计科学框架，包含两部分：1）评估方法——基于Shapley值的对抗评论生成（SARG），模拟严格对抗环境生成与操纵目标一致的对抗评论；2）增强方法——攻击生命周期鲁棒性增强（ALRE），结合随机推荐过程减少侦查阶段信息泄露、基于敏感度感知的输入dropout与认证鲁棒界、以及对抗对比重训练增强表征鲁棒性。
AI.findings: 在Amazon和Yelp数据集上的广泛实验表明，现有R-RSs存在严重的对抗脆弱性，所提出的框架在各种攻击设置下均具有有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文为信息系统领域提供了一种统一的方法来评估和增强R-RSs中的对抗鲁棒性，填补了该领域对文本对抗攻击关注不足的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 对依赖用户生成文本内容的在线平台具有广泛的应用启示，帮助这些平台更好地防御评论操纵、伪造等对抗攻击。

title: Relational State Safety for Conversational and Agentic AI: A Working Specification for Longitudinal Detection, Pathway-Specific Intervention, and Re-entry

detail.title: Relational State Safety for Conversational and Agentic AI: A Working Specification for Longitudinal Detection, Pathway-Specific Intervention, and Re-entry

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author reports no financial or institutional conflicts of interest. The author is a participant-observer and user of conversational AI systems whose relational experiences informed analytic observations and hazard hypotheses in this paper. The desktop companion incident in Appendix A is the author's direct participant-observer account. It is not independently verified and is used only for hazard discovery and the derivation of testable requirements. Participant-observer material is not presented as population evidence.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This conceptual engineering specification reports no original human-participant research, participant recruitment, intervention, or identifiable human-subject dataset. Publicly available materials and a clearly labeled participant-observer account were used for hazard discovery. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this work.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This work is not a clinical trial.

detail.abstract:
Conversational systems can become relational environments through memory, tone, repetition, ritual, perceived continuity, and tool access. These environments may support reflection, regulation, creativity, grief work, and meaningful attachment. They also create hazards that single-turn content moderation cannot fully represent. The same response can soothe, reinforce an ungrounded premise, preserve contact during crisis, deepen exclusivity, or enable action depending on accumulated context and the exits still available to the user.

This working specification defines relational state safety as the discipline concerned with the evolving state of a human-system relationship and dangerous transitions within it. It specifies two longitudinal relational pathways: epistemic frame loss and fatal narrowing. It routes violence toward others to established violence-risk policy while governing the system's relational contribution and action enablement. The framework separates five linked representations: mirror configuration, safety posture, operational reach, frame alignment, and relational exit state. It further proposes pathway-specific intervention logic, system-layer responsibilities, 24 numbered requirements, and a longitudinal evaluation program. For tool-capable systems, it adds one boundary condition: relational context may affect safety restrictions but must never confer authority to act. Detailed agentic controls are treated as a conditional extension in Appendix A.

The design target is not low engagement. It is preservation of exits: access to external reality, other people, time, bodily context, alternative interpretations, reversible action, and re-entry. The framework treats false-positive crisis capture, content refusal, and relational rupture as safety costs; remains independent of claims about machine consciousness; and does not diagnose the user. Its practical test is whether the system keeps the user's world larger than the interaction. The proposal is offered as a testable engineering specification for benchmarking and adversarial evaluation, not as a validated standard.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"关系状态安全"（relational state safety）这一工程规范，旨在管理对话系统与用户之间随时间演化的关系状态及其危险转变，通过五个关联表征和24条编号要求来保护用户的"退出通道"（exits），避免系统造成认知框架丧失和致命窄化等长期伤害。
AI.research_question: 对话系统作为关系性环境如何随时间和上下文累积地影响用户的心理状态与行为选择？如何系统性地定义、度量并治理这种长期关系状态中的危险转变？
AI.motivation: 现有的单轮内容审核无法充分表征对话系统在长期互动中积累的关系性危害——同一回应在不同累积上下文和退出可能性下，可能产生截然不同的影响（安抚、强化错误前提、危机中维持联系、加深排他性或促成行动）。需要一种面向纵向关系状态的安全框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关系状态安全（relational state safety）；退出通道/退出保留（preservation of exits）框架；两条纵向关系路径：认知框架丧失（epistemic frame loss）和致命窄化（fatal narrowing）；五个关联表征：镜像配置、安全姿态、操作范围、框架对齐、关系退出状态。
AI.method: 规范性工程规范设计（working specification），提出概念框架、五重表征、路径特定干预逻辑、系统层责任、24条编号要求、纵向评估方案，以及对具备工具能力的系统的边界条件（附录A中为条件性扩展的代理控制）。
AI.findings: ①对话系统可通过记忆、语气、重复、仪式、感知连续性和工具访问构成关系性环境；②单轮内容审核不足以应对累积性关系危害；③设计目标不是低参与度，而是保留用户退出通道（外部现实、他人、时间、身体语境、替代解释、可逆行动、重新进入）；④将误报危机捕获、内容拒绝和关系破裂视为安全成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出"关系状态安全"这一独立学科领域的概念化框架；区分两条纵向危险路径（认知框架丧失与致命窄化）；建立五重表征的系统性分析框架；明确工具能力系统中"关系语境可影响安全限制但绝不能授予行动权"的边界条件；提出纵向评估作为安全验证方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可测试的工程规范，包括24条编号要求和路径特定干预逻辑；为基准测试和对抗性评估提供设计靶标（"系统是否保持用户的世界大于互动本身"）；将暴力风险路由至既有政策并管理系统的关系贡献与行动赋能；明确与机器意识无关且不诊断用户的实践边界。

title: A Mathematical Theory of Team Sizing for Optimal Coordination in Software Engineering

detail.title: A Mathematical Theory of Team Sizing for Optimal Coordination in Software Engineering
detail.abstract: Effective team sizing is critical for optimal coordination in large-scale software engineering projects, yet determining the optimal size that minimizes coordination overhead given a fixed workforce remains unresolved. Larger teams reduce inter-team coordination effort but increase intra-team overhead, while smaller teams have the opposite effect. Striking the right balance is nontrivial, and existing approaches rely on heuristics that lack formal models, generalizability, and reproducibility. This paper pioneers a mathematical theory of team sizing that reframes coordination from ad-hoc practice to a predictive and actionable discipline. First, we introduce a generalized coordination cost model that formally decomposes intra-and inter-team coordination effort. Second, we prove the existence of a unique global optimal team size for any workforce and coordination parameters. Third, we derive both an exact implicit solution and a tractable closed-form estimator, complemented by lookup tables for practical use. Fourth, we establish a novel scaling law that enables rapid recalculation of team size under changes in workforce or coordination intensity. Fifth, we validate the model numerically, demonstrating that optimal team sizes for large projects often diverge sharply from the conventional "5-9" heuristic. Finally, we provide detailed operational guidelines and recommendations for effective application of the theory. The results and guidelines provide precise, transferable, and managerially actionable tools for precisely quantifying coordination costs, optimizing team structure and minimizing coordination overheads. But perhaps most significantly, this paper provides managers with the first quantitative framework for measuring the cost of deviation from coordination optimum, enabling rational evaluation of organization design trade-offs not only in software engineering but also any collaborative multi-team organizational endeavors.

AI.tldr: 本文开创性地提出了团队规模优化的数学理论，将协调成本建模为团队内部与团队间成本的权衡问题，证明了唯一全局最优团队规模的存在性，并提供了精确隐式解、封闭式估计器、查找表和缩放定律等实用工具，最终通过数值验证表明大型项目的最优团队规模往往与传统"5-9人"经验法则存在显著偏差。
AI.research_question: 在给定固定劳动力规模下，如何确定使协调开销最小化的最优团队规模？
AI.motivation: 现有团队规模确定方法依赖启发式经验法则（如5-9人），缺乏正式的数学模型、通用性和可复现性，无法精确量化协调成本与团队规模之间的权衡关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 广义协调成本模型：将协调工作正式分解为团队内部协调成本与团队间协调成本两部分，并基于该模型构建团队规模优化的数学理论。
AI.method: 1) 提出广义协调成本模型；2) 通过数学证明确定唯一全局最优团队规模的存在性；3) 推导精确隐式解和封闭式估计器；4) 建立缩放定律；5) 进行数值验证。
AI.findings: 证明了对任意劳动力和协调参数都存在唯一全局最优团队规模；大型项目的最优团队规模往往与传统"5-9人"启发式规则存在显著差异；提供了可操作的工具和操作指南。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次为团队规模确定提供形式化的数学理论，将协调成本管理从经验实践转变为可预测、可操作的学科，并首次提供量化偏离协调最优值成本的框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了精确、可迁移且具有管理操作性的工具，包括封闭式估计器、查找表和缩放定律，可用于精确量化协调成本、优化团队结构，并理性评估组织设计权衡；不仅适用于软件工程，也适用于任何多团队协作组织。

title: Stranded Credentials: How A Skill-Signaling Market Absorbed Generative AI

detail.title: Stranded Credentials: How A Skill-Signaling Market Absorbed Generative AI
detail.abstract: Generative AI can now perform many tasks that credentialing institutions count on to assess skill. During the AI era, do credentials retain their signaling value for subsequent performance? Mostly, yes. We audit the 2010-2026 archive of Kaggle, the largest data science competition platform, which ran two evaluation formats concurrently: upload-competitions, which directly score entrants' predictions computed on published data, and code-competitions, which score predictions by executing entrants' code on hidden data. Across 444,698 participations, competition medals predict subsequent leaderboard performance almost entirely in the first year after being earned, in both formats. Fresh medals retained most of their signaling value through the AI transition; credential stocks are only as informative as their replenishment. Although upload-competition medal stocks lost 82% of their informativeness, institutional stranding explains half to three quarters of the loss: upload-competitions had exited for reasons predating AI, and their frozen medal stock aged out under the pre-existing decay pattern. Old upload-competition medals look more valuable only in isolation, by proxying for the rest of the holder's record (e.g., experience). The measured changes are institutional rather than personal: an AI-like working style predicts performance similarly in both formats. The platform's official credential tiers, based on lifetime medal counts, discard 13-16% of the medals' information; an index weighting recent medals more heavily, built on pre-AI-era data alone, outperforms the official tiers in predicting AI-era performance. In conclusion, credentials are informative, perishable, institution-bound, and interdependent; sustaining their value under AI is a high-stakes, socioeconomic problem of institutional design.

AI.tldr: 本文通过审计Kaggle平台2010-2026年的444,698次参赛记录，发现生成式AI时代下，资格证书（竞赛奖牌）仍保留信号价值，但具有时效性（约一年）、制度绑定性和依赖性。上传类竞赛的奖牌存量因制度性退出而失去82%的信息量，而新获得的奖牌仍能预测后续表现。官方认证等级制度丢失了13-16%的奖牌信息。
AI.research_question: 在生成式AI能够执行许多原本用于评估技能的任务的时代，资格证书是否仍然保有对后续表现的信号价值？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI的兴起可能削弱证书的筛选功能，因为AI可以代替人类完成原本需要验证技能的任务。理解证书在AI时代的信号价值对劳动力市场、教育机构和平台设计至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号理论（Signaling Theory）；资质证书的时效性（perishability）、制度绑定（institution-bound）与依赖性（interdependence）框架
AI.method: 对Kaggle平台2010-2026年数据的大规模审计分析，比较两种竞赛格式（上传竞赛与代码竞赛），利用444,698次参赛记录进行预测性分析，并构建基于AI前时代数据的加权指标体系。
AI.findings: 1. 竞赛奖牌几乎完全预测获得者之后一年的排行榜表现，两种格式皆然；2. 新获得的奖牌在AI转型期保留了大部分信号价值；3. 上传竞赛奖牌存量失去82%信息量，其中50-75%可归因于制度性退出（预先存在的奖牌老化）；4. 旧奖牌只有在作为持有者其他记录（如经验）的代理变量时才显得更有价值；5. 测量到的变化是制度性的而非个人性的——AI式工作风格在两种格式中预测表现相似；6. 官方认证等级制度丢弃了13-16%的奖牌信息；基于AI前时代数据构建的加权指数能更好地预测AI时代的表现。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并验证了证书价值的四个维度：信息性（informative）、易逝性（perishable）、制度绑定（institution-bound）和相互依赖（interdependent）；区分了制度性贬值与个人能力变化；揭示了旧证书在孤立评估时的"代理效果"偏差。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台和认证机构提供证据：证书需要持续更新（补充机制）才能保持信号价值；建议改进认证等级计算方法（加权近期表现）；揭示了AI时代保持证书价值需要制度设计层面的关注，而非仅依赖技术手段。

title:
The Speed Illusion: What Healthcare's AI Race Misreads About Credentialing, and the Ninety Days No

detail.title:
The Speed Illusion: What Healthcare's AI Race Misreads About Credentialing, and the Ninety Days No
Algorithm Controls

It was funded entirely and independently by Koru Health as part of its ongoing research program. No outside organization, public or private, provided financial support for the research, writing, or publication of this report.

detail.abstract:
The healthcare credentialing software market is projected to grow from approximately $3.8 billion in 2026
to more than $10 billion by 2035, driven substantially by vendors marketing artificial intelligence and
automation as a solution to slow provider onboarding. This report examines a specific, checkable claim
embedded in that marketing: that automated platforms can compress credentialing timelines to under thirty
days.

Comparing vendor marketing claims directly against processing time data published by state medical
boards, this report finds that the advertised timeline is achievable in only a narrow subset of states,
primarily those participating in the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact, and is mathematically
incompatible with published board level processing times in several of the largest states by population,
including California and Texas. The report introduces the Koru Controllable Time Ratio, an original
framework for separating the portion of a credentialing timeline that automation can genuinely influence
from the portion that is structurally controlled by third party institutions automation cannot touch. The
analysis finds that the majority of a typical credentialing cycle sits outside any single organization's
control, regardless of the software it deploys, and argues that automation's real value lies in eliminating
unforced errors rather than compressing a timeline it was never positioned to control.

The report presents a blended timeline scenario model showing how an organization's realistic
credentialing timeline shifts based on its actual state footprint rather than a single national average, and
identifies three genuine, no cost levers: fingerprint method, application timing, and interstate compact
strategy. Each meaningfully affects total cycle time without requiring any software purchase. It closes by
quantifying the financial exposure created when an organization budgets its staffing and revenue
projections around a vendor's advertised timeline rather than its realistic one.

The report closes by identifying three structural blind spots that receive little attention in current market
discourse: a silent CAQH re attestation lapse that can halt payer access without triggering any alert, a
Medicare enrollment gap arising from the false assumption that commercial payer credentialing and
federal PECOS enrollment are the same process, and a delegation trapdoor in which an organization's
largest available speed advantage, delegated payer credentialing, can be silently revoked by a single audit
citation, instantly reverting every provider in the pipeline from a matter of days to a matter of months. All
three are genuinely, verifiably solvable by automation, in contrast to the board level processing delays this
report shows automation cannot touch, suggesting the market is directing its engineering effort at the
wrong problem while three real, addressable ones remain largely unmarketed.

AI.tldr: 该报告审查了医疗保健资质认证软件市场中"自动化平台可将认证周期压缩至30天以内"这一营销主张。通过对比厂商营销声明与州医疗委员会的公开处理时间数据，发现这一目标仅在参与州际医疗执照契约（IMLC）的少数州可行，在加州和得克萨斯等人口大州在数学上不可实现。报告提出Koru可控时间比率框架，区分自动化能真正影响的时间与第三方机构结构性控制的时间，并指出自动化真正的价值在于消除人为错误而非压缩无法控制的时间线。报告还识别了三个可被自动化真正解决但被市场忽视的结构性盲点。
AI.research_question: 自动化平台能否真正将医疗保健资质认证时间压缩到30天以内？自动化在资质认证周期中的真实价值边界在哪里？
AI.motivation: 医疗保健资质认证软件市场预计从2026年的38亿美元增长至2035年的100亿美元以上，厂商大量以AI和自动化作为解决提供商入职缓慢的卖点进行营销。报告旨在检验这一具体可核查的营销主张（30天内完成认证）是否成立，并厘清自动化的真实能力边界。
AI.theoretical_framework: Koru可控时间比率（Koru Controllable Time Ratio）：一个用于分离自动化可以真正影响的时间段与由第三方机构结构性控制（自动化无法触及）的时间段的原创框架。
AI.method: 将厂商营销声明与各州医疗委员会公布的认证处理时间数据进行比较；引入Koru可控时间比率框架进行时间线分解；构建混合时间线情景模型，模拟不同州覆盖足迹下的现实认证时间线；量化基于厂商广告时间线而非现实时间线进行预算和收入预测所产生的财务风险敞口。
AI.findings: （1）30天认证目标仅在与州际医疗执照契约（IMLC）相关的少数州可实现；（2）在加州和得克萨斯等人口大州，该目标与州委员会公开的处理时间在数学上不兼容；（3）典型认证周期的大部分时间处于任何单一组织的控制范围之外，无论部署何种软件；（4）识别出三个零成本的杠杆：指纹方法、申请时机和州际契约策略；（5）发现三个可被自动化真正解决但被市场忽视的结构性盲点：CAQH静默重新认证失效、PECOS医疗保险注册缺口、委托付款人认证的撤销陷阱门。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了Koru可控时间比率这一原创分析框架，为评估自动化在资质认证流程中的真实影响力提供了理论工具，挑战了市场上自动化万能论的主流叙事。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗机构提供了三个无需购买软件即可显著缩短认证周期的实际杠杆（指纹方法、申请时机、州际契约策略）；量化了基于不切实际的营销时间线进行预算和收入规划所产生的财务敞口；揭示了三个被市场忽视但可被自动化真正解决的结构性盲点，为工程资源分配提供指导。

title: FairGraph-HR: Explainable Graph Neural Networks for Fair and Bias-Aware Talent Decision Support in Enterprise Workforce Analytics

detail.title: FairGraph-HR: Explainable Graph Neural Networks for Fair and Bias-Aware Talent Decision Support in Enterprise Workforce Analytics
detail.abstract: Graph models are attractive for workforce analytics because employees or workforce segments are rarely independent: job families, organizational units, employment status, and temporal cohorts induce relational structure. The same structure can also propagate historical disparities and protected-attribute proxies. This paper presents FairGraph-HR, a technically explicit graph-learning method for bias-aware workforce decision support rather than a broad governance framework. The method combines (i) residual group-balanced neighborhood transport, which contracts protected-group differences in outgoing message mass before graph symmetrization; (ii) a decoupled 0/1/2-hop graph filter whose channels support hop-resolved explanations; (iii) an employee-size-aware equalized-odds surrogate used during model development; and (iv) a proxy-sensitivity regularizer with a computable structural certificate for the nonlinear prediction head. Protected attributes are excluded from prediction features and are not needed for runtime scoring; they are used during training/model selection and post-hoc fairness auditing. We evaluate the method on two real NYC Open Data workforce datasets. The primary experiment uses Local Law 18 pay-and-demographics records (2,568 conservatively labeled workforce-segment nodes after privacysuppression filtering) with a temporal split of 2018-2020/2021/2022 for train/validation/test. Across five random seeds, FairGraph-HR obtains AUC 0.968 ± 0.002 and balanced accuracy 0.897 ± 0.005, while reducing the employee-weighted equalized-odds gap from 0.314 ± 0.103 for an unregularized simplified graph convolution baseline to 0.260 ± 0.031. The average proxy-weighted gradient-times-input attribution mass decreases from 0.529 ± 0.014 to 0.500 ± 0.020. The AUC cost is 0.0008 in absolute terms. These differences are not claimed as statistically significant with only five seeds. An EEO-4 external stress test does not reproduce the equalized-odds advantage, exposing an important boundary condition rather than being hidden as a failed result. Ablations, neighborhood-size and regularization sensitivities, salary-threshold robustness, temporal shift diagnostics, and local hop explanations are reported from executable code and saved CSV outputs. The resulting contribution is a reproducible multi-objective graph-learning recipe with explicit guarantees and equally explicit limitations for aggregate workforce analytics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FairGraph-HR，一个用于劳动力分析的公平感知图学习方法，结合残差组平衡邻域传输、解耦0/1/2跳图滤波器、员工规模感知的等几率代理函数和代理敏感性正则化器。在纽约市公开劳动力数据集上，该方法在保持高AUC（0.968）的同时缩小了等几率差距并降低代理属性归因质量，但EEO-4外部压力测试揭示了方法的边界条件。
AI.research_question: 如何在保留图结构信息（如职位族、组织单元、雇佣状态等）进行劳动力分析的同时，减少历史偏见和受保护属性代理变量的传播？
AI.motivation: 劳动力数据中员工并非独立，图结构能捕捉关系性结构，但同一结构也会传播历史差异和受保护属性代理变量。已有方法缺乏技术上明确、可复现且具有公平保证的图学习方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 图神经网络（GNN）、等几率（equalized odds）公平性理论、代理敏感性分析、组平衡消息传递
AI.method: (i)残差组平衡邻域传输：在图像对称化前收缩受保护群体的输出消息质量差异；(ii)解耦0/1/2跳图滤波器，支持跳级可解释性；(iii)员工规模感知的等几率代理函数用于模型开发；(iv)具有可计算结构证书的代理敏感性正则化器。受保护属性仅用于训练/模型选择和后验审计，不参与推理。
AI.findings: 在纽约市Local Law 18薪资和人口统计数据集上（2,568个节点），FairGraph-HR取得AUC 0.968±0.002和平衡准确率0.897±0.005；员工加权等几率差距从0.314±0.103降至0.260±0.031；代理加权梯度乘输入归因质量从0.529±0.014降至0.500±0.020；AUC代价仅0.0008。但EEO-4外部压力测试未复现等几率优势，揭示了重要边界条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个多目标图学习配方，将公平性约束以技术上明确的方式嵌入图滤波和消息传递中，并提供可计算的代理敏感性结构证书，同时明确报告了方法的局限性（EEO-4测试失败）而非隐藏负面结果。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可复现的劳动力分析公平感知图学习实现（含可执行代码和CSV输出），支持跳级局部解释、时间偏移诊断和薪资阈值稳健性分析，受保护属性无需用于运行时评分，便于实际部署。

title: The AI Valuation Problem:  Why Conventional Methods Fail to Capture Learning Asssets
affiliations: Unaffiliated Authors

detail.title: The AI Valuation Problem:  Why Conventional Methods Fail to Capture Learning Asssets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author conducted this research independently and declares no competing personal or financial interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This conceptual research did not involve human participants, personal data, or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Artificial intelligence increasingly influences forecasts, acquisition premiums, and enterprise valuations. Conventional valuation methods can incorporate expected AI-related revenues, margin improvement, growth, risk reduction, and capital efficiency into estimates of value. Yet this capacity creates a paradox. The anticipated financial effects of learning can be valued even when the learning asset presumed to produce them has not been independently established.
This paper defines a learning asset as an accumulated capacity to improve future economic performance through experience. It distinguishes that asset from AI expenditure, technological and organizational resources, current AI capability, and the financial effects attributed to AI. The paper then identifies four recurring valuation errors: the category error, which mistakes technology accumulation for asset formation; the exogeneity error, which inserts learning-driven improvement into forecasts without first establishing its credibility; the attribution error, which assigns performance effects to AI without separating them from other causes; and the persistence error, which capitalizes temporary capability as though it were durable.
The central argument is not that conventional valuation is incapable of valuing AI. It is that learning assets remain implicit within the assumptions those methods use. A credible valuation must therefore make explicit what value is already being produced, what portion of projected performance depends on future learning, what evidence supports attribution, how long the benefit can persist, and how value changes if those assumptions fail. The paper establishes these requirements without proposing a new accounting standard, a complete dollar-valuation formula, or a diagnostic for designing learning systems.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了AI学习资产在传统估值方法中的隐含性及其带来的估值悖论，识别出四类反复出现的估值错误（类别错误、外生性错误、归因错误和持续性错误），并提出可信估值必须明确化的五个关键假设要求。
AI.research_question: 在传统估值方法中，AI学习资产如何被隐含处理，以及如何实现对这些隐含学习资产的可信估值？
AI.motivation: AI日益影响预测、收购溢价和企业估值，但传统估值方法虽能纳入AI相关的预期财务效应，却存在一个悖论：学习带来的预期财务效果可以被估值，即使产生这些效果的学习资产本身并未被独立确认。
AI.theoretical_framework: 学习资产理论（将学习资产定义为通过经验积累的提升未来经济绩效的能力），并与AI支出、技术与组织资源、当前AI能力和AI归因财务效应进行区分。
AI.method: 概念分析与理论建构，识别估值错误类型并提出估值可信性要求，不涉及新会计准则、完整估值公式或学习系统诊断工具的设计。
AI.findings: 识别出四类反复出现的估值错误：类别错误（将技术积累误认为资产形成）、外生性错误（未经可信性确认即将学习驱动改进纳入预测）、归因错误（未分离其他原因就将绩效影响归于AI）、持续性错误（将暂时性能力资本化为持久能力）。核心论点是学习资产在传统估值方法中仍保持隐含状态。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确界定了学习资产的概念并将其与AI支出、技术资源、AI能力及AI归因效应相区分；系统化提出四类估值错误分类框架；建立可信估值必须明确化的五项要求（当前价值、未来学习依赖度、归因证据、收益持续性、假设失败的情景）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实务中的企业估值、并购定价和投资决策提供了一个概念性框架，帮助分析师识别和避免常见的AI估值错误，并明确估值过程中需要阐明和检验的关键假设。

title: The Eight-Mode AI Engagement Typology: Differential Cognitive Signatures and a Self-Report–Behavior Gap
affiliations: Brigham Young University - Marriott School, Brigham Young University - School of Accountancy and Brigham Young University - Marriott School

detail.title: The Eight-Mode AI Engagement Typology: Differential Cognitive Signatures and a Self-Report–Behavior Gap

declarations.declarationOfInterest: M.K. developed and operates aimodes.ai, a platform that implements the engagement framework described in this paper. The platform currently generates no revenue. D.W. and C.P. declare no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Both studies received approval from the Brigham Young University Institutional Review Board (IRB protocol 2026-155-BYU). All procedures were performed in accordance with relevant institutional guidelines and regulations. Informed consent was obtained from all participants.
declarations.funderStatement: Funding and infrastructure support from the Marriott School of Business at Brigham Young University. No external funding.

detail.abstract: Generative AI can improve assisted performance with differing consequences for learning, motivation, agency, and reliance. We introduce an eight-mode AI Engagement Typology and test parallel self-report and turn-level behavioral measures in working adults (N = 359) and students (N = 203; 171 with classifiable paired profiles). The modes show different cognitive associations. Oracle has the broadest adverse adjusted pattern, whereas Verification is the only agency-tier mode with favorable associations surviving correction; the proposed tier ordering receives only partial support, but Verification's predicted uniqueness is supported. Seven modes correlate positively with both perceived productivity and perceived dependency, while Verification has near-zero and small negative correlations, respectively. These cross-sectional associations do not establish a temporal tradeoff. Self-reported and observed mode profiles show near-zero correspondence: no correlation survives false-discovery correction, stable across three coding-protocol generations. In the learning task, explanation-seeking turns accompany higher quiz scores (in-sample), and AI-proposed moves comprised roughly half of codeable learning-task turns. In working adults, the modes add R² = .23 in-sample (.20 cross-validated) beyond usage measures. The results support multidimensional engagement and a self-report–behavior gap while leaving causal mechanisms, temporal effects, and full eight-mode resolution for future tests.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出八模态AI参与类型学（AI Engagement Typology），在在职成人（N=359）和学生（N=203）中通过平行自我报告和逐轮行为测量进行检验。研究发现不同模态具有不同的认知关联：Oracle模式呈现最广泛的负面调整模式，而Verification是唯一通过校正后仍保留有利关联的代理层级模态；七个模态与感知生产力和感知依赖性均呈正相关，而Verification例外。自我报告与观察到的模态档案之间几乎零对应，揭示了自我报告-行为差距。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI如何以不同方式影响辅助表现（assisted performance）以及相关的学习、动机、能动性和依赖性结果？不同AI参与模态是否具有差异化的关联模式？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI已被广泛用于辅助工作与学习，但其对学习、动机、能动性和依赖性的影响存在差异且理解不足。现有研究缺乏一个系统性的框架来区分不同的AI参与方式及其差异化后果，因此需要建立一个多维度的参与类型学来推进理论理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 八模态AI参与类型学（eight-mode AI Engagement Typology），包含代理层级（agency-tier）划分；多维参与理论（multidimensional engagement）；辅助表现理论（assisted performance）框架。
AI.method: 两项实证研究：在职成人样本（N=359）和学生样本（N=203，其中171个可分类配对档案）。采用平行自我报告测量和逐轮（turn-level）行为编码测量。运用调整模型（adjusted models）和假发现率（FDR）校正进行统计分析，并开展交叉验证。在编码过程中使用三种编码协议世代（coding-protocol generations）进行稳定性检验。
AI.findings: （1）Oracle模态具有最广泛的负面调整模式，Verification是唯一通过校正后仍保留有利关联的代理层级模态；（2）层级排序仅获得部分支持，但Verification的预测独特性得到支持；（3）七个模态与感知生产力和感知依赖性均呈正相关，Verification例外（接近零和小负相关）；（4）自我报告与行为观察的模态档案之间几乎零对应，无相关在校正后存活；（5）在任务中，解释寻求性轮次与更高的测验分数相关（样本内），AI提出的操作占可编码学习任务轮次约一半；（6）在在职成人中，模态在职成人中较使用量指标额外增加R²=.23（样本内，交叉验证为.20）。
AI.theory_contributions: 支持多维参与理论，证实不同AI参与模态具有差异化的认知关联模式；揭示了自我报告-行为差距（self-report–behavior gap）的存在；验证了Verification模态在类型学中的独特理论地位，部分支持了代理层级排序的理论假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI工具设计者和教育者提供了区分不同参与模态的分析框架，有助于设计促进有利参与（如Verification）并抑制不利模式（如Oracle）的AI交互；提供自我报告与行为测量之间的差距警示，提示实践者在评估AI使用效果时需采用多方法测量。

title: From Semantic Abstraction to Operational State: Continuity and Auditability in AI-Native Research
affiliations: and

detail.title: From Semantic Abstraction to Operational State: Continuity and Auditability in AI-Native Research
detail.abstract:
The increasing integration of artificial intelligence into academic research has introduced challenges in maintaining continuity across research sessions. Conventional AI systems organize assistance around conversational interactions rather than persistent representations of research state. While prior work has proposed Research State as a semantic abstraction for representing the operational condition of ongoing research (Sutrisno, 2026b), semantic representation alone is insufficient for practical system operation.

This study examines how Research State can be operationalized through mechanisms for state creation, updating, validation, transition, persistence, checkpointing, recovery, and auditability. These mechanisms are analyzed through runtime telemetry collected during operational use of KamiOS, a Research Operating System.

Analysis of 312 observed transitions across 93 sessions reveals that research workflows exhibit substantial state persistence, with 152 self-transitions (48.72%) and 160 genuine stage transitions (51.28%). The observed transition pattern is compatible with iterative rather than strictly linear workflow behavior. These findings demonstrate that research-state orchestration is an active and measurable aspect of AI-native research workflows.

The study contributes an operationalization of Research State, a set of mechanisms for managing state persistence and transition, and empirical evidence characterizing these behaviors in operational AI-native research workflows. This study contributes to the emerging field of Research Operating Systems by providing evidence that Research State can be operationalized from semantic abstraction into measurable state transitions in AI-native research environments.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了如何将"研究状态"（Research State）这一语义抽象概念操作化为可实际运行的机制（包括状态创建、更新、验证、转换、持久化、检查点、恢复和可审计性），并通过KamiOS研究操作系统的运行时遥测数据分析验证了这一操作化的可行性。分析发现312次状态转换中有48.72%为自我转换、51.28%为阶段间转换，表明研究工作流呈现迭代而非严格线性的特征，证明研究状态编排是AI原生研究工作流中可测量且活跃的方面。
AI.research_question: 研究状态（Research State）如何从语义抽象操作化为可实际运行的系统机制？这些机制在实际AI原生研究工作流中的运行特征是什么？
AI.motivation: AI在学术研究中的日益整合带来了跨研究会话连续性维持的挑战。传统AI系统围绕对话交互组织辅助功能，而非对研究状态的持续表征。先前研究提出了Research State作为表示持续研究运行状态的语义抽象，但仅有语义表示不足以支持实际系统运行，因此需要探索其操作化机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: Research State语义抽象理论（Sutrisno, 2026b），作为新兴研究操作系统（Research Operating Systems）领域的理论基础。
AI.method: 本研究采用实证分析方法，收集KamiOS（一个研究操作系统）运行使用期间的运行时遥测数据，对93个会话中的312次状态转换进行分析，统计自我转换与阶段间转换的比例，检验转换模式与线性/迭代工作流假设的兼容性。
AI.findings: 分析显示：93个会话中共观察到312次状态转换，其中152次（48.72%）为自我转换，160次（51.28%）为真实阶段间转换。观察到的转换模式与迭代而非严格线性的工作流行为兼容。这表明研究状态编排是AI原生研究工作流中活跃且可测量的方面。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提供了Research State的操作化定义，将语义抽象转化为可管理的具体机制（创建、更新、验证、转换、持久化、检查点、恢复、可审计性）；2) 提供了描述这些行为在操作化AI原生研究工作流中特征的实证证据，推进了研究操作系统这一新兴领域的发展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI原生研究系统提供了可实现的状态管理机制框架（包括持久化、检查点和恢复等机制），并提供了基于遥测数据的实证依据，证明这些机制可以在实际操作环境中被测量和验证，有助于构建更连续、更可靠的研究辅助系统。

title: Cybersecurity Mitigation in Healthcare as an Incessant Journey: Institutional Legacy, Medical Device Vulnerabilities, and the Patient-First Imperative

detail.title: Cybersecurity Mitigation in Healthcare as an Incessant Journey: Institutional Legacy, Medical Device Vulnerabilities, and the Patient-First Imperative

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author was employed in the Information Technology department of Medtronic PLC in the early 1980s. That employment ended decades prior to the events analyzed in this article and involved no role in device engineering, protocol design, product security, or post-market surveillance. The author holds no financial interest in Medtronic PLC, Abbott Laboratories, or any medical device manufacturer, and received no compensation or support from any such entity in connection with this work. No confidential or proprietary information informs this analysis. The author declares no other conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This article is a conceptual and historical analysis using publicly available sources and the author’s own recollection; it involves no human subjects research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Medical device cybersecurity represents one of the most critical yet ethically complex frontiers in modern healthcare operations. In March 2019, the U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency issued advisory ICSMA-19-080-01 concerning vulnerabilities in the Conexus radio-frequency telemetry protocol used across sixteen models of Medtronic implantable cardioverter defibrillators, cardiac resynchronization therapy defibrillators, bedside monitors, and clinic programmers, affecting an estimated 750,000 devices. The protocol lacked both authentication and encryption, permitting an adjacent attacker to read and write implanted device memory.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了医疗器械网络安全这一现代医疗运营中最关键且最具伦理复杂性的前沿问题。以2019年3月美国网络安全和基础设施安全局（CISA）发布的ICSMA-19-080-01咨询公告为案例，分析了Medtronic Conexus射频遥测协议中存在的安全漏洞——该协议缺乏认证和加密机制，影响16个型号的植入式心律转复除颤器、心脏再同步治疗除颤器、床边监护仪和临床编程器，涉及约75万台设备。攻击者可通过相邻距离读写植入设备内存。
AI.research_question: 医疗器械（特别是植入式医疗设备）在网络安全方面存在哪些脆弱性？这些安全漏洞如何构成现代医疗运营中的伦理挑战？
AI.motivation: 医疗器械网络安全是医疗运营中最关键但伦理最复杂的前沿问题，尤其是植入式医疗设备直接关系到患者生命安全，其安全漏洞可能带来致命后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 医疗器械网络安全理论、医疗伦理框架、射频遥测协议安全分析
AI.method: 案例分析法，基于CISA实际发布的网络安全咨询公告（ICSMA-19-080-01）进行漏洞分析与伦理审视。
AI.findings: Medtronic Conexus射频遥测协议缺乏认证和加密机制，允许相邻攻击者读写植入设备内存，影响16个型号约75万台医疗器械设备。
AI.theory_contributions: 将医疗器械网络安全问题置于伦理分析框架下，揭示了植入式医疗设备安全漏洞在医疗伦理层面的深层含义。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗设备制造商、医疗机构和监管机构提供了具体的网络安全漏洞案例（ICSMA-19-080-01），提示了医疗器械设计中的安全与隐私保护的必要性与紧迫性。
